questions.q:
You are designing a mobile game using CloudFront, Lambda, DyanmoDB, and CloudWatch.

What is the MOST secure way to provide Lambda function a permission to access the DynamoDB table?
o: Create an IAM role to Amazon RDS with permissions to access DyanmoDB.
Create an IAM role to the Lambda function with permissions to access DyanmoDB.
Create an IAM access and secret key, and store it in the Lambda function.
Create an IAM access and secret key, and store it in an encrypted DynamoDB.
questions.e: Create an IAM role to the Lambda function with permissions to access DyanmoDB.

questions.q: What is the best solution to give access to the application which runs on EC2 to perform queries on the DynamoDB table?
o: Use Amazon Cognito Identity with MFA
Create an IAM access and secret key, and store it in the application.
Attach an IAM policy to the Amazon EC2 instance.
Create an IAM role with the required permission to access DynamoDB and assign the role to the EC2 instance
questions.e: Create an IAM role with the required permission to access DynamoDB and assign the role to the EC2 instance

questions.q:
A music company has multimedia files in S3 buckets. A Solutions Architect is designing an application to be hosted in Amazon EC2 instance which requires access to these files.

Which solution can be used to access these files without exposing credentials?
o: Assign an IAM role to the Amazon S3 bucket
Assign an IAM role to the Amazon EC2 instance
Store the AWS Access Key ID/Secret Access Key inside the new application
Assign an IAM user to the Amazon EC2 instance
questions.e: Assign an IAM role to the Amazon EC2 instance

questions.q:
An organization which is currently working in the health industry is building a new secure application which will run on Amazon EC2 and will make secure calls to Amazon S3 buckets using AWS credentials "Access Key ID and Secret Access Key".

Which rule should be created according to security best practices to protect the credentials?
o: Store credential in Amazon EC2 instance
Create an IAM user with restricted privilege and assign it to the Amazon EC2
Create an IAM role with restricted privilege and assign it to the Amazon EC2
Create an IAM role with least privilege and assign it to the Amazon S3 bucket policy
questions.e: Create an IAM role with restricted privilege and assign it to the Amazon EC2

questions.q:
An IT consultant is helping the owner of a medium-sized business set up an AWS account.

What are the security recommendations he must follow while creating the AWS account root user? (Select two)
o: Create a strong password for the AWS account root user
Encrypt the access keys and save them on Amazon S3
Create AWS account root user access keys and share those keys only with the business owner
Send an email to the business owner with details of the login username and password for the AWS root user. This will help the business owner to troubleshoot any login issues in future
Enable Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) for the AWS account root user account
questions.e:
Create a strong password for the AWS account root user

Enable Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) for the AWS account root user account

questions.q:
A cybersecurity firm wants to run their applications on single-tenant hardware to meet security guidelines.

Which of the following is the MOST cost-effective way of isolating their Amazon EC2 instances to a single tenant?
o: Dedicated Instances
Spot Instances
On-Demand Instances
Dedicated Hosts
questions.e: Dedicated Instances

questions.q:
Your team has just signed up an year-long contract with a client maintaining a three-tier web application, that needs to be moved to AWS Cloud. The application has steady traffic throughout the day and needs to be on a reliable system with no down-time or access issues. The solution needs to be cost-optimal for this startup.

Which of the following options should you choose?
o: Amazon EC2 Spot Instances
Amazon EC2 On Demand Instances
Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances
On-premise EC2 instance
questions.e: Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances

questions.q:
A company has a web application that runs 24*7 in the production environment. The development team at the company runs a clone of the same application in the dev environment for up to 8 hours every day. The company wants to build the MOST cost-optimal solution by deploying these applications using the best-fit pricing options for EC2 instances.

What would you recommend?
o: Use reserved EC2 instances for the production application and spot block instances for the dev application
Use reserved EC2 instances for the production application and on-demand instances for the dev application
Use reserved EC2 instances for the production application and spot instances for the dev application
Use on-demand EC2 instances for the production application and spot instances for the dev application
questions.e: Use reserved EC2 instances for the production application and on-demand instances for the dev application

questions.q:
A company runs a data processing workflow that takes about 60 minutes to complete. The workflow can withstand disruptions and it can be started and stopped multiple times.

Which is the most cost-effective solution to build a solution for the workflow?
o: Use AWS Lambda function to run the workflow processes
Use EC2 reserved instances to run the workflow processes
Use EC2 on-demand instances to run the workflow processes
Use EC2 spot instances to run the workflow processes
questions.e: Use EC2 spot instances to run the workflow processes

questions.q:
An IT company wants to optimize the costs incurred on its fleet of 100 EC2 instances for the next year. Based on historical analyses, the engineering team observed that 70 of these instances handle the compute services of its flagship application and need to be always available. The other 30 instances are used to handle batch jobs that can afford a delay in processing.

As a solutions architect, which of the following would you recommend as the MOST cost-optimal solution?
o: Purchase 70 reserved instances and 30 on-demand instances
Purchase 70 reserved instances and 30 spot instances
Purchase 70 on-demand instances and 30 reserved instances
Purchase 70 on-demand instances and 30 spot instances
questions.e: Purchase 70 reserved instances and 30 spot instances

sections.name: Section 2: EC2 Instance Storage, ELB + ASG

questions.q:
An E-commerce business, has its applications built on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances, spread across various Regions and AZs. The technical team has suggested using Elastic Load Balancers for better architectural design.

What characteristics of an Elastic Load Balancer make it a winning choice? (Select two)
o: Build a highly available system
Deploy EC2 instances across multiple AWS Regions
Improve vertical scalability of the system
The Load Balancer communicates with the underlying EC2 instances using their public IPs
Separate public traffic from private traffic
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- E-commerce business có applications trên fleet EC2 instances
- EC2 spread across multiple Regions và AZs
- Technical team đề xuất sử dụng Elastic Load Balancers
- Tìm 2 đặc điểm làm ELB trở thành winning choice

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Build a highly available system

Separate public traffic from private traffic
- ELB giúp build highly available system bằng cách distribute traffic across multiple AZs và healthy instances
- ELB tách biệt public traffic từ internet và private traffic đến backend instances
- ELB automatically route traffic chỉ đến healthy instances, tăng availability
- ELB cho phép backend instances ở private subnets, tăng security

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Deploy EC2 instances across multiple AWS Regions

ELB không deploy EC2 across Regions - đây là việc của architect, không phải ELB feature


❌ Improve vertical scalability of the system

ELB cải thiện horizontal scalability, không phải vertical scalability


❌ The Load Balancer communicates with the underlying EC2 instances using their public IPs

ELB communicate với EC2 instances qua private IPs trong VPC, không phải public IPs

🔑Tips and tricks:
ELB = High Availability + Public/Private separation + Horizontal scaling support!

questions.q:
You create an Auto Scaling group to work with an Application Load Balancer. The scaling group is configured with a minimum size value of 5, a maximum value of 20, and the desired capacity value of 10. One of the 10 EC2 instances has been reported as unhealthy.

Which of the following actions will take place?
o: The ASG will detach the EC2 instance from the group, and leave it running
The ASG will terminate the EC2 Instance
The ASG will keep the instance running and re-start the application
The ASG will format the root EBS drive on the EC2 instance and run the User Data again
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Auto Scaling group work với Application Load Balancer
- Configuration: minimum 5, maximum 20, desired capacity 10
- Một trong 10 EC2 instances được reported unhealthy
- Cần xác định action nào sẽ diễn ra

✅ Đáp án đúng: The ASG will terminate the EC2 Instance
- ASG sẽ terminate unhealthy EC2 instance
- ASG tự động launch instance mới để maintain desired capacity (10)
- Đây là default behavior của ASG để maintain healthy fleet
- Unhealthy instance bị remove và replace bằng healthy instance

Các đáp án sai:
❌ The ASG will detach the EC2 instance from the group, and leave it running

ASG không detach và leave running, điều này không solve health issue


❌ The ASG will keep the instance running and re-start the application

ASG không restart applications, chỉ manage instance lifecycle


❌ The ASG will format the root EBS drive on the EC2 instance and run the User Data again

ASG không format EBS drives hay re-run User Data

🔑Tips and tricks:
ASG unhealthy instance = Terminate + Launch replacement để maintain desired capacity!

questions.q:
A company is looking at storing their less frequently accessed files on AWS that can be concurrently accessed by hundreds of EC2 instances. The company needs the most cost-effective file storage service that provides immediate access to data whenever needed.

Which of the following options represents the best solution for the given requirements?
o: Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class
Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS)
Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) Standard–IA storage class
Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) Standard storage class
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Company muốn store less frequently accessed files trên AWS
- Files cần được access đồng thời bởi hundreds of EC2 instances
- Cần most cost-effective file storage service
- Provide immediate access to data whenever needed

✅ Đáp án đúng: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) Standard–IA storage class
- Amazon EFS Standard-IA storage class được thiết kế cho less frequently accessed files
- Cung cấp concurrent access cho hundreds of EC2 instances
- Cost-effective hơn EFS Standard cho infrequently accessed data (tiết kiệm lên đến 92%)
- Vẫn provide immediate access khi cần, không có retrieval delay như archival storage

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class

S3 Standard-IA là object storage, không support concurrent file system access từ EC2


❌ Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS)

EBS không support concurrent access từ multiple instances


❌ Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) Standard storage class

EFS Standard đắt hơn cho infrequently accessed files so với Standard-IA

🔑Tips and tricks:
Concurrent access + Less frequent + Cost-effective + Immediate access = EFS Standard-IA!

questions.q: Which of the following scenarios are NOT correct about EC2 Auto Scaling? (Select two)
o: An Auto Scaling group can contain EC2 instances in only one Availability Zone of a Region
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling attempts to distribute instances evenly between the Availability Zones that are enabled for your Auto Scaling group
An Auto Scaling group can contain EC2 instances in one or more Availability Zones within the same Region
Auto Scaling groups that span across multiple Regions need to be enabled for all the Regions specified
• For Auto Scaling groups in a VPC, the EC2 instances are launched in subnets
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Tìm 2 scenarios KHÔNG đúng về EC2 Auto Scaling
- Cần hiểu cách Auto Scaling group hoạt động với AZs và Regions
- Phân biệt các tính năng đúng và sai của ASG

✅ Đáp án đúng:

An Auto Scaling group can contain EC2 instances in only one Availability Zone of a Region

SAI - ASG có thể chứa EC2 instances trong nhiều AZs, không bị giới hạn chỉ 1 AZ

For Auto Scaling groups in a VPC, the EC2 instances are launched in subnets

SAI - Auto Scaling groups KHÔNG thể span across multiple Regions, chỉ hoạt động trong 1 Region


- ASG chỉ hoạt động trong single Region nhưng có thể distribute across multiple AZs
- ASG được thiết kế để tăng availability bằng cách spread instances across AZs


Các đáp án sai:

Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling attempts to distribute instances evenly between the Availability Zones that are enabled for your Auto Scaling group
❌ ASG cố gắng distribute instances đều giữa các AZs được enable

An Auto Scaling group can contain EC2 instances in one or more Availability Zones within the same Region
❌ ASG có thể chứa EC2 instances trong một hoặc nhiều AZs trong cùng Region

Auto Scaling groups that span across multiple Regions need to be enabled for all the Regions specified
❌ Trong VPC, EC2 instances được launch trong subnets

🔑Tips and tricks:
ASG = Single Region + Multiple AZs + Distribute evenly cho high availability!

questions.q:
A firm maintains a highly available application that receives HTTPS traffic from mobile devices and web browsers. The main Developer would like to set up the Load Balancer routing to route traffic from web servers to smart.com/api and from mobile devices to smart.com/mobile. A developer advises that the previous recommendation is not needed and that requests should be sent to api.smart.com and mobile.smart.com instead.

Which of the following routing options were discussed in the given use-case? (select two)
o: Path based
Client IP
Host based
Web browser version
Cookie value
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Highly available application nhận HTTPS traffic từ mobile devices và web browsers
- Main Developer muốn route traffic: web servers → smart.com/api, mobile devices → smart.com/mobile
- Developer khác đề xuất: api.smart.com và mobile.smart.com thay vì paths
- Tìm 2 routing options được thảo luận trong use-case

✅ Đáp án đúng:
- Path based - Recommendation đầu tiên sử dụng paths (/api và /mobile) để route traffic
- Host based - Recommendation thứ hai sử dụng different hostnames (api.smart.com và mobile.smart.com)
- Cả hai approaches đều valid cho Application Load Balancer routing
- Path-based route theo URL path, Host-based route theo domain/subdomain

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Client IP không được đề cập trong scenario này
❌ Web browser version không được thảo luận
❌ Cookie value không được mentioned trong use-case

🔑Tips and tricks:
URL paths (/api, /mobile) = Path-based, Different domains (api., mobile.) = Host-based routing!

questions.q:
You have created an Elastic Load Balancer that has marked all the EC2 instances in the target group as unhealthy. Surprisingly, when you enter the IP address of the EC2 instances in your web browser, you can access your website.

What could be the reason your instances are being marked as unhealthy? (Select two)
o: Your web-app has a runtime that is not supported by the Application Load Balancer
You need to attach Elastic IP to the EC2 instances
The security group of the EC2 instance does not allow for traffic from the security group of the Application Load Balancer
The route for the health check is misconfigured
The EBS volumes have been improperly mounted
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Elastic Load Balancer đã mark tất cả EC2 instances trong target group là unhealthy
- Khi nhập IP address của EC2 instances vào web browser có thể access website
- EC2 instances hoạt động bình thường nhưng health check fail
- Tìm 2 nguyên nhân có thể gây ra vấn đề này

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The security group of the EC2 instance does not allow for traffic from the security group of the Application Load Balancer

Security group của EC2 không allow traffic từ ELB security group làm health check fail

The route for the health check is misconfigured:

Health check route bị misconfigured (sai path, port, protocol) khiến ELB không check đúng endpoint


- EC2 vẫn hoạt động bình thường với direct access nhưng ELB không thể health check
- Đây là 2 nguyên nhân phổ biến nhất gây health check failures

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Your web-app has a runtime that is not supported by the Application Load Balancer

ALB support hầu hết web runtimes, không phải nguyên nhân health check fail

❌ You need to attach Elastic IP to the EC2 instances

Elastic IP không liên quan đến health check status, EC2 trong target group không cần EIP

❌ The EBS volumes have been improperly mounted

EBS volume mounting không ảnh hưởng đến health check nếu app vẫn chạy được


🔑Tips and tricks:
Health check fail nhưng direct access OK = Security Group rules hoặc Health check configuration!

questions.q:
An IT company is working on a client project to build a Supply Chain Management application. The web-tier of the application runs on an EC2 instance and the database tier is on Amazon RDS MySQL. For beta testing, all the resources are currently deployed in a single Availability Zone. The development team wants to improve application availability before the go-live.

Given that all end users of the web application would be located in the US, which of the following would be the MOST resource-efficient solution?
o: Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two Availability Zones, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in Multi-AZ configuration
Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two regions, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in read replica configuration
Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two Availability Zones, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in read replica configuration
Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two regions, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in Multi-AZ configuration
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- IT company xây dựng Supply Chain Management application
- Web-tier trên EC2, database tier trên RDS MySQL
- Hiện tại deploy trong single AZ cho beta testing
- Muốn improve availability trước go-live, all end users ở US
- Tìm MOST resource-efficient solution

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two Availability Zones, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in Multi-AZ configuration
- Deploy web-tier EC2 trong 2 AZs behind ELB để có high availability cho web layer
- RDS Multi-AZ cung cấp automatic failover cho database layer
- Resource-efficient vì chỉ cần 2 AZs trong cùng region (US)
- Multi-AZ RDS đảm bảo database availability mà không cần additional read replicas
- Cost-effective cho users chỉ ở một geographic region

Các đáp án sai:


❌ Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two regions, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in read replica configuration

Deploy across 2 regions không cần thiết khi users chỉ ở US, tốn resources hơn


❌ Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two Availability Zones, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in read replica configuration

Read replica không cải thiện availability như Multi-AZ, chỉ để read scaling


❌ Deploy the web-tier EC2 instances in two regions, behind an Elastic Load Balancer. Deploy the Amazon RDS MySQL database in Multi-AZ configuration

Multi-region deployment quá phức tạp và expensive cho single region users

🔑Tips and tricks:
High availability trong cùng region + Resource-efficient = Multi-AZ deployment!

questions.q:
A retail company is migrating its on-premises database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company has read-heavy workloads. The development team at the company is looking at refactoring the code to achieve optimum read performance for SQL queries.

Which solution will address this requirement with the least current as well as future development effort?
o: Configure Elasticache for Redis to act as a caching layer for Amazon RDS. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the Elasticache for Redis endpoint
Set up Amazon RDS with one or more read replicas. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the endpoint for the read replicas
Configure Elasticache for Memcached to act as a caching layer for Amazon RDS. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the Elasticache for Memcached endpoint
Set up Amazon RDS in the multi-AZ configuration with a single standby instance. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the standby instance endpoint
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Retail company migrate on-premises database đến Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
- Company có read-heavy workloads
- Development team muốn refactor code để achieve optimum read performance cho SQL queries
- Cần giải pháp với least current và future development effort

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up Amazon RDS with one or more read replicas. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the endpoint for the read replicas
- RDS Read Replicas được thiết kế specifically cho read-heavy workloads
- Least development effort vì vẫn sử dụng SQL queries, không cần thay đổi query logic
- Read replicas scale horizontally cho read performance
- Future scaling dễ dàng bằng cách add thêm read replicas
- Native database solution, không cần manage additional caching layer

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Configure Elasticache for Redis to act as a caching layer for Amazon RDS. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the Elasticache for Redis endpoint

ElastiCache Redis yêu cầu significant code changes để implement caching logic


❌ Configure Elasticache for Memcached to act as a caching layer for Amazon RDS. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the Elasticache for Memcached endpoint

ElastiCache Memcached cũng yêu cầu major application refactoring cho caching


❌ Set up Amazon RDS in the multi-AZ configuration with a single standby instance. Refactor the application code so that the queries use the standby instance endpoint

Multi-AZ standby instance không available cho read queries, chỉ dành cho failover

🔑Tips and tricks:
Read-heavy + SQL queries + Least effort = RDS Read Replicas!

questions.q:
An application is hosted by a 3rd party and exposed at yourapp.3rdparty.com. You would like to have your users access your application using www.mydomain.com, which you own and manage under Route 53.

What Route 53 record should you create?
o: Create a CNAME record
Create an A record
Create an Alias Record
Create a PTR record
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Application được hosted bởi 3rd party và exposed tại yourapp.3rdparty.com
- Muốn users access application sử dụng www.mydomain.com (owned và managed under Route 53)
- Cần tạo Route 53 record phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng: Create a CNAME record
- CNAME record map một domain name đến another domain name
- www.mydomain.com (subdomain) có thể point đến yourapp.3rdparty.com bằng CNAME
- CNAME phù hợp cho việc redirect subdomain đến external domain
- Route 53 sẽ resolve www.mydomain.com thành yourapp.3rdparty.com

Các đáp án sai:
❌ A record map domain đến IP address, không phải domain name
❌ Alias record chỉ dành cho AWS resources, không cho external 3rd party domains
❌ PTR record dành cho reverse DNS lookup, không phù hợp use case này

🔑Tips and tricks:
Subdomain point to external domain = CNAME record!

questions.q:
A media company has created a video streaming application and it would like their Brazilian users to be served by the company's Brazilian servers. Other users around the globe should not be able to access the servers through DNS queries.

Which Route 53 routing policy meets this requirement?
o: Latency
Weighted
Failover
Geolocation
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Media company có video streaming application
- Brazilian users phải được phục vụ bởi Brazilian servers
- Other users globally không thể access servers through DNS queries
- Tìm Route 53 routing policy phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng: Geolocation
- Geolocation routing route traffic dựa trên geographic location của users
- Có thể specify Brazilian users route đến Brazilian servers
- Có thể restrict access từ other geographic locations
- Perfect cho compliance requirements và geographic content restrictions
- Allow hoặc block traffic based on user location

Các đáp án sai:
❌ A. Latency routing route đến lowest latency region, không restrict by geography
❌ B. Weighted routing distribute traffic by percentage, không có geographic control
❌ C. Failover routing dành cho disaster recovery, không geographic-based

🔑Tips and tricks:
Geographic access control + Location-based routing = Geolocation routing policy!

questions.q:
A company has a critical application on AWS. The application exposes an HTTP API by using Amazon API Gateway. The API is integrated with an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with 2 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64 GB of RAM.

Customers have reported that some of the API calls return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses. Amazon CloudWatch Logs shows errors for “too many connections.” The errors occur during peak usage times that are unpredictable.

The company needs to make the application resilient. The database cannot be down outside of scheduled maintenance hours.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Decrease the number of vCPUs for the DB instance. Increase the max_connections setting.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy that connects to the DB instance. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy.
Add a CloudWatch alarm that changes the DB instance class when the number of connections increases to more than 1,000.
Add an Amazon EventBridge rule that increases the max_connections setting of the DB instance when CPU utilization is above 75%.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Critical application sử dụng API Gateway + Lambda function + RDS MySQL
- API calls return HTTP 500 errors với "too many connections" trong CloudWatch Logs
- Errors xảy ra trong thời gian cao điểm không dự đoán được
- Cần make application co dãn, database không thể down ngoài scheduled maintenance

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy that connects to the DB instance. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy.
- Amazon RDS Proxy manage database connections efficiently và prevent "too many connections" errors
- Connection pooling giảm số active connections đến database
- Lambda functions connect đến proxy thay vì directly đến RDS
- RDS Proxy handle connection management, scaling, và failover automatically
- Không cần downtime để implement

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Decrease the number of vCPUs for the DB instance. Increase the max_connections setting.

Decrease vCPUs sẽ reduce performance, không solve connection limit issue


❌ Add a CloudWatch alarm that changes the DB instance class when the number of connections increases to more than 1,000.

CloudWatch alarm change instance class require downtime, vi phạm requirement


❌ Add an Amazon EventBridge rule that increases the max_connections setting of the DB instance when CPU utilization is above 75%.

EventBridge rule modify max_connections không thực tế và có thể cause instability

🔑Tips and tricks:
Lambda + RDS connection issues + No downtime = RDS Proxy (connection pooling)!

questions.q:
You are creating a web application in which users can follow each other. Some users will be more popular than others and thus their data will be requested very often. Currently, the user data sits in RDS and it has been recommended by your Developer to use ElastiCache as a caching layer to improve the read performance. The whole dataset of users cannot sit in ElastiCache without incurring tremendous costs and therefore you would like to cache only the most often requested users profiles there. As your website is high traffic, it is accepted to have stale data for users for a while, as long as the stale data is less than a minute old.

What caching strategy do you recommend implementing?
o: Use a Write Through strategy with TTL
Use a Lazy Loading strategy with TTL
Use a Write Through strategy without TTL
Use a Lazy Loading strategy without TTL
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Web application có users follow lẫn nhau, một số users popular hơn
- User data trong RDS, muốn sử dụng ElastiCache để improve read performance
- Chỉ cache most often requested user profiles để tránh chi phí cao
- Website high traffic, chấp nhận data cũ dưới 1 phút
- Tìm caching strategy phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng: Use a Lazy Loading strategy with TTL
- Lazy Loading với TTL chỉ cache data khi được requested (cache miss)
- Perfect cho việc cache only most requested users thay vì entire dataset
- TTL đảm bảo stale data không cũ hơn 1 phút
- Cost-effective vì chỉ cache popular data
- Cache hit cho popular users, cache miss trigger load từ RDS

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Use a Write Through strategy with TTL

Write Through cache tất cả data khi write, không chọn lọc cho popular users


❌ Use a Write Through strategy without TTL

Write Through without TTL có thể có nhiều dữ liệu rất cũ


❌ Use a Lazy Loading strategy without TTL

Lazy Loading without TTL không đẩm bảo data làm mới trong 1 phút

🔑Tips and tricks:
Cache only popular data + Acceptable stale < 1 minute = Lazy Loading + TTL!

questions.q:
A company has recently launched a new mobile gaming application that the users are adopting rapidly. The company uses RDS MySQL as the database. The engineering team wants an urgent solution to this issue where the rapidly increasing workload might exceed the available database storage.

As a solutions architect, which of the following solutions would you recommend so that it requires minimum development and systems administration effort to address this requirement?
o: Enable storage auto-scaling for RDS MySQL
Create read replica for RDS MySQL
Migrate RDS MySQL database to DynamoDB which automatically allocates storage space when required
Migrate RDS MySQL database to Aurora which offers storage auto-scaling
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Company launch mobile gaming application với lượng user tăng nhanh chóng
- Sử dụng RDS MySQL làm database
- Khối lượng công việc tăng có thể đạt ngưỡng available database storage
- Cần urgent solution với minimum development và systems administration effort

✅ Đáp án đúng: Enable storage auto-scaling for RDS MySQL
- Enable storage auto-scaling cho RDS MySQL tự động increase storage khi cần
- Zero development effort - chỉ enable feature trong RDS configuration
- Minimal systems administration - AWS handle storage scaling automatically
- Immediate solution cho storage capacity issue
- Không cần migration hay code changes

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create read replica for RDS MySQL

Read replica không solve storage capacity issue, chỉ improve read performance


❌ Migrate RDS MySQL database to DynamoDB which automatically allocates storage space when required

Migrate đến DynamoDB yêu cầu development effort đáng kể cho schema changes


❌ Migrate RDS MySQL database to Aurora which offers storage auto-scaling

Migrate đến Aurora require administrative effort và potential downtime

🔑Tips and tricks:
Storage capacity issue + Minimum effort = RDS Storage Auto-scaling (zero code changes)!

questions.q:
You have an S3 bucket that contains files in two different folders - s3://my-bucket/images and s3://my-bucket/thumbnails. When an image is first uploaded and new, it is viewed several times. But after 45 days, analytics prove that image files are on average rarely requested, but the thumbnails still are. After 180 days, you would like to archive the image files and the thumbnails. Overall you would like the solution to remain highly alvailable to prevent disasters happening against a whole AZ.

How can you implement an efficient cost strategy for your S3 bucket? (Select two)
o: Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to Glacier using a prefix after 180 days
Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to S3 Standard IA using a prefix after 45 days
Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone IA using a prefix after 45 days
Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition all objects to S3 Standard IA after 45 days
Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition all objects to Glacier after 180 days
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-S3 bucket chứa 2 thư mục: images/ và thumbnails/
-image mới upload được truy cập thường xuyên, nhưng sau 45 ngày thì ít truy cập
-Thumbnails vẫn được truy cập sau 45 ngày
-Sau 180 ngày, cả images và thumbnails có thể được archive
-Yêu cầu: high availability (phòng tránh sự cố AZ), cost-efficient

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to S3 Standard IA using a prefix after 45 days
Chỉ transition images sau 45 ngày vì ít được truy cập, S3 Standard IA vẫn highly available across multiple AZs

Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition all objects to Glacier after 180 days
Archive cả images và thumbnails sau 180 ngày → phù hợp để archive với chi phí thấp nhất, đồng thời Glacier vẫn đảm bảo durability và khả năng phục hồi khi cần

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to Glacier using a prefix after 180 days

Chỉ transition images sau 180 ngày, không tối ưu cost từ ngày 45-180


❌ Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone IA using a prefix after 45 days

S3 One Zone IA chỉ store trong 1 AZ, không đáp ứng highly available requirement


❌ Create a Lifecycle Policy to transition all objects to S3 Standard IA after 45 days

Transition cả thumbnails sau 45 ngày là không phù hợp vì thumbnails vẫn được truy cập thường xuyên

🔑 Tips and tricks:
-Highly available = Multi-AZ storage classes (Standard, Standard IA, Glacier)
-One Zone IA không phù hợp khi yêu cầu disaster recovery across AZs
-Sử dụng prefix để áp dụng lifecycle policy cho specific folders!

questions.q:
A financial services company has to retain the activity logs for each of their customers to meet compliance guidelines. Depending on the business line, the company wants to retain the logs for 5-10 years in highly available and durable storage on AWS. The overall data size is expected to be in PetaBytes. In case of an audit, the data would need to be accessible within a timeframe of up to 48 hours.

Which AWS storage option is the MOST cost-effective for the given compliance requirements?
o: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
Third party tape storage
Amazon S3 Glacier
Amazon S3 Standard storage
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-Financial services company cần lưu trữ activity logs để compliance
-Thời gian lưu trữ: 5-10 năm (Dung lượng: PetaBytes)
-Yêu cầu: highly available và durable storage
-Thời gian truy xuất khi audit: trong vòng 48 giờ
-Tìm solution MOST cost-effective

✅ Đáp án đúng: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
-S3 Glacier Deep Archive có retrieval time 12-48 giờ
-Chi phí lưu trữ thấp nhất trong các S3 storage classes (khoảng $1/TB/tháng)
-đảm bảo durability 11 số 9 (99.999999999%) và multi-AZ availability

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Third party tape storage không guarantee high availability và durability như AWS, quản lý phức tạp
❌ S3 Glacier đắt hơn Deep Archive
❌ S3 Standard quá expensive cho long-term storage 5-10 năm

🔑Tips and tricks:
Long-term compliance storage + Cost-effective = S3 Glacier Deep Archive là cheapest option!

questions.q:
You are storing your video files in a separate S3 bucket than your main static website in an S3 bucket. When accessing the video URLs directly the users can view the videos on the browser, but they can't play the videos while visiting the main website.

What is the root cause of this problem?
o: Change the bucket policy
Enable CORS
Amend the IAM policy
Disable Server-Side Encryption
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-Video files lưu trong S3 bucket riêng biệt với main static website
-Truy cập direct video URLs thì xem được video trên browser
-Không thể play videos khi visit main website
-Tìm root cause

✅ Đáp án đúng: Enable CORS
-CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) cho phép web browser load resources từ domain khác
-Main website (domain A) cần access video files từ S3 bucket khác (domain B)

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Bucket policy liên quan đến access permissions, nhưng direct access đã work nên không phải permission issue
❌ IAM policy cũng về permissions, mà browser đã có thể access direct URLs
❌ Server-Side Encryption không ảnh hưởng đến việc play videos từ website

🔑Tips and tricks:
Cross-origin requests between different S3 buckets/domains = CORS configuration needed!

questions.q:
The IT department at a consulting firm is conducting a training workshop for new developers. As part of an evaluation exercise on Amazon S3, the new developers were asked to identify the invalid storage class lifecycle transitions for objects stored on S3.

Can you spot the INVALID lifecycle transitions from the options below? (Select two)
o: S3 Standard-IA => S3 One Zone-IA
S3 Intelligent-Tiering => S3 Standard
S3 One Zone-IA => S3 Standard-IA
S3 Standard-IA => S3 Intelligent-Tiering
S3 Standard => S3 Intelligent-Tiering
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-Yêu cầu xác định các chuyển đổi storage class không hợp lệ trong Amazon S3 Lifecycle
-Mục tiêu: chọn ra 2 chuyển đổi sai (INVALID)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

S3 Intelligent-Tiering => S3 Standard

S3 One Zone-IA => S3 Standard-IA
-Chỉ cho phép move từ higher cost tier xuống lower cost tier
-Không thể transition ngược lại từ lower cost lên higher cost


Transitioning objects using Amazon S3 Lifecycle


Các đáp án hợp lệ:
✅ S3 Standard-IA => S3 One Zone-IA (VALID)
✅ S3 Standard-IA => S3 Intelligent-Tiering (VALID)
✅ S3 Standard => S3 Intelligent-Tiering (VALID)

🔑Tips and tricks:
S3 Lifecycle transitions chỉ work theo hướng: Expensive → Cheaper, không được ngược lại!

questions.q:
A manufacturing company has machine sensors that upload .csv files to an Amazon S3 bucket. These .csv files must be converted into images and must be made available as soon as possible for the automatic generation of graphical reports.

The images become irrelevant after 1 month, but the .csv files must be kept to train machine learning (ML) models twice a year. The ML trainings and audits are planned weeks in advance.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two)
o: Launch an Amazon EC2 Spot Instance that downloads the .csv files every hour, generates the image files, and uploads the images to the S3 bucket.
Design an AWS Lambda function that converts the .csv files into images and stores the images in the S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function when a .csv file is uploaded.

Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.

Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.

Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Keep the image files in Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS).
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-Machine sensors upload .csv files lên S3 bucket
-Yêu cầu: chuyển .csv → ảnh càng sớm càng tốt để tạo báo cáo
- Ảnh chỉ cần giữ 1 tháng, còn .csv phải giữ để train ML models 2 lần/năm (có kế hoạch trước)
-Tìm giải pháp MOST cost-effective (Choose two)

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Design an AWS Lambda function that converts the .csv files into images and stores the images in the S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function when a .csv file is uploaded.
- Event-driven processing: ngay khi .csv upload sẽ trigger Lambda
- Chỉ pay khi execute, cost-effective hơn EC2 Spot chạy liên tục

Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.
- csv → S3 Glacier sau 1 ngày: tiết kiệm chi phí lâu dài, phù hợp vì ML training được lên kế hoạch trước
- Ảnh → xóa sau 30 ngày: tiết kiệm chi phí lưu trữ không cần thiết

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Launch an Amazon EC2 Spot Instance that downloads the .csv files every hour, generates the image files, and uploads the images to the S3 bucket.

EC2 Spot Instance chạy hourly không efficient, có thể bị terminate, tốn công setup và quản lý


❌ Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.

S3 One Zone-IA không đảm bảo availability cao, không optimal cho ML data


❌ Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Keep the image files in Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS).

S3 Standard-IA + RRS không cost-effective như Glacier cho long-term storage

🔑Tips and tricks:
S3 Event + Lambda = giải pháp phổ biến cho xử lý dữ liệu real-time
Lifecycle rules + đúng storage class giúp tiết kiệm lớn chi phí S3

questions.q:
A company stores raw collected data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is used for several types of analytics on behalf of the company's customers. The type of analytics requested determines the access pattern on the S3 objects.


The company cannot predict or control the access pattern. The company wants to reduce its S3 costs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use S3 replication to transition infrequently accessed objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
Use S3 Inventory to identify and transition objects that have not been accessed from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
-Company lưu raw data trong S3 bucket cho analytics
-Pattern truy cập không thể đoán trước hoặc kiểm soát
-Mục tiêu: giảm chi phí S3 storage mà vẫn đảm bảo data sẵn sàng cho phân tích

✅ Đáp án đúng: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
-S3 Intelligent-Tiering lựa chọn tối ưu khi không thể dự đoán pattern truy cập
-Tự động chuyển object giữa các tier (frequent, infrequent, archive) dựa trên real-time usage
-Không cần viết lifecycle rule chi tiết
-Không ảnh hưởng performance hoặc availability
-Tiết kiệm chi phí mà không cần quản lý thủ công

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Use S3 replication to transition infrequently accessed objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

S3 replication không có chức năng transition based on access patterns


❌ Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

Lifecycle to S3 Standard-IA cần biết objects ít được access, nhưng company không predict được


❌ Use S3 Inventory to identify and transition objects that have not been accessed from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering

S3 Inventory chỉ report, không automatic transition

🔑Tips and tricks:
Unpredictable access patterns + Cost optimization = S3 Intelligent-Tiering tự động handle!

questions.q:
A developer has configured inbound traffic for the relevant ports in both the Security Group of the EC2 instance as well as the Network Access Control List (NACL) of the subnet for the EC2 instance. The developer is, however, unable to connect to the service running on the Amazon EC2 instance.

As a solutions architect, how will you fix this issue?
o: Security Groups are stateful, so allowing inbound traffic to the necessary ports enables the connection. Network ACLs are stateless, so you must allow both inbound and outbound traffic
IAM Role defined in the Security Group is different from the IAM Role that is given access in the Network ACLs
Rules associated with Network ACLs should never be modified from command line. An attempt to modify rules from command line blocks the rule and results in an erratic behavior
Network ACLs are stateful, so allowing inbound traffic to the necessary ports enables the connection. Security Groups are stateless, so you must allow both inbound and outbound traffic
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Developer đã config inbound traffic cho các port liên quan trong cả Security Group và NACL
- Vẫn không thể connect đến service running trên EC2 instance
- Cần tìm cách fix issue này

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Security Groups are stateful, so allowing inbound traffic to the necessary ports enables the connection. Network ACLs are stateless, so you must allow both inbound and outbound traffic
- Security Groups là stateful - cho phép inbound traffic tự động enable return outbound traffic
- NACLs là stateless - phải allow cụ thể cả inbound và outbound traffic
- Developer chỉ config inbound cho NACL nhưng thiếu outbound rules
- Response traffic từ EC2 bị block bởi NACL vì không có outbound rules
- Cần add outbound rules trong NACL để allow return traffic

Các đáp án sai:
❌ IAM Role defined in the Security Group is different from the IAM Role that is given access in the Network ACLs

IAM Roles không liên quan đến Security Groups hay NACLs - đây là network layer security


❌ Rules associated with Network ACLs should never be modified from command line. An attempt to modify rules from command line blocks the rule and results in an erratic behavior

NACL rules có thể modify từ command line, không có restriction này


❌ Network ACLs are stateful, so allowing inbound traffic to the necessary ports enables the connection. Security Groups are stateless, so you must allow both inbound and outbound traffic

Ngược lại hoàn toàn - Security Groups stateful, NACLs stateless

🔑Tips and tricks:
Security Groups = Stateful (auto return traffic), NACLs = Stateless (cần explicit outbound rules)!

questions.q:
An HTTP application is deployed on an Auto Scaling Group, is accessible from an Application Load Balancer that provides HTTPS termination, and accesses a PostgreSQL database managed by RDS.

How should you configure the security groups? (Select three)
o: The security group of the ALB should have an inbound rule from anywhere on port 80
The security group of the EC2 instances should have an inbound rule from the security group of the ALB on port 80
The security group of RDS should have an inbound rule from the security group of the EC2 instances in the ASG on port 5432
The security group of the ALB should have an inbound rule from anywhere on port 443
The security group of RDS should have an inbound rule from the security group of the EC2 instances in the ASG on port 80
The security group of the EC2 instances should have an inbound rule from the security group of the RDS database on port 5432
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- HTTP application trên Auto Scaling Group
- ALB cung cấp HTTPS termination (SSL/TLS được terminate tại ALB)
- Application access PostgreSQL database trên RDS
- Cần config security groups cho 3 tiers: ALB, EC2, RDS

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The security group of the EC2 instances should have an inbound rule from the security group of the ALB on port 80

EC2 security group allow inbound từ ALB security group trên port 80 (HTTP traffic từ ALB đến EC2)


The security group of RDS should have an inbound rule from the security group of the EC2 instances in the ASG on port 5432

RDS security group allow inbound từ EC2 security group trên port 5432 (PostgreSQL port)


The security group of the ALB should have an inbound rule from anywhere on port 443

ALB security group allow inbound từ anywhere trên port 443 (HTTPS traffic từ internet)


- Traffic flow: Internet (HTTPS:443) → ALB → EC2 (HTTP:80) → RDS (PostgreSQL:5432)

Các đáp án sai:
❌ The security group of the ALB should have an inbound rule from anywhere on port 80

ALB không cần port 80 từ internet vì chỉ serve HTTPS


❌ The security group of RDS should have an inbound rule from the security group of the EC2 instances in the ASG on port 80

RDS sử dụng port 5432 cho PostgreSQL, không phải port 80


❌The security group of the EC2 instances should have an inbound rule from the security group of the RDS database on port 5432

EC2 connect đến RDS, không phải RDS connect đến EC2

🔑Tips and tricks:
HTTPS termination = Internet:443 → ALB → EC2:80 → RDS:5432!

questions.q:
An engineering lead is designing a VPC with public and private subnets. The VPC and subnets use IPv4 CIDR blocks. There is one public subnet and one private subnet in each of three Availability Zones (AZs) for high availability. An internet gateway is used to provide internet access for the public subnets. The private subnets require access to the internet to allow EC2 instances to download software updates.

Which of the following options represents the correct solution to set up internet access for the private subnets?
o: Set up three NAT gateways, one in each public subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ
Set up three Internet gateways, one in each private subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the Internet gateway in its AZ
Set up three egress-only internet gateways, one in each public subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the egress-only internet gateway in its AZ
Set up three NAT gateways, one in each private subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- VPC với public và private subnets sử dụng IPv4 CIDR blocks
- 1 public subnet và 1 private subnet trong mỗi AZ (3 AZs total) cho high availability
- Internet gateway cung cấp internet access cho public subnets
- Private subnets cần internet access để EC2 instances download software updates

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up three NAT gateways, one in each public subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ
- NAT Gateway phải đặt trong public subnet để có internet access
- Cần 3 NAT Gateways (1 trong mỗi AZ) để đảm bảo high availability
- Mỗi private subnet route traffic đến NAT Gateway trong cùng AZ
- Custom route table cho mỗi AZ forward non-local traffic đến NAT Gateway tương ứng
- Đảm bảo fault tolerance - nếu 1 AZ fail, các AZ khác vẫn có internet access

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Set up three Internet gateways, one in each private subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the Internet gateway in its AZ

Không thể đặt Internet Gateway trong private subnet, IGW attach vào VPC level


❌ Set up three egress-only internet gateways, one in each public subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the egress-only internet gateway in its AZ

Egress-only IGW chỉ dành cho IPv6, không phù hợp với IPv4 CIDR blocks


❌ Set up three NAT gateways, one in each private subnet in each AZ. Create a custom route table for each AZ that forwards non-local traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ

NAT Gateway phải đặt trong public subnet, không thể đặt trong private subnet

🔑Tips and tricks:
Private subnet internet access + High availability = NAT Gateway trong public subnet của mỗi AZ!

questions.q:
An e-commerce company has deployed its application on several Amazon EC2 instances that are configured in a private subnet using IPv4. These Amazon EC2 instances read and write a huge volume of data to and from Amazon S3 in the same AWS region. The company has set up subnet routing to direct all the internet-bound traffic through a Network Address Translation gateway (NAT gateway). The company wants to build the most cost-optimal solution without impacting the application's ability to communicate with Amazon S3 or the internet.

As an AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, which of the following would you recommend?
o: Set up a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the route table in the private subnet to direct the S3-bound traffic via the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) endpoint
Set up a VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3. Attach an endpoint policy to the endpoint. Update the route table to direct the S3-bound traffic to the VPC endpoint

Set up an egress-only internet gateway in the public subnet. Update the route table in the private subnet to route traffic to the internet gateway. Update the network ACL to allow the S3-bound traffic
Provision an internet gateway. Update the route table in the private subnet to route traffic to the internet gateway. Update the network ACL (NACL) to allow the S3-bound traffic
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- E-commerce company có EC2 instances trong private subnet (IPv4)
- EC2 instances read/write huge volume data với S3 trong cùng AWS region
- Hiện tại dùng NAT gateway cho internet-bound traffic
- Muốn most cost-optimal solution mà không impact khả năng communicate với S3/internet

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up a VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3. Attach an endpoint policy to the endpoint. Update the route table to direct the S3-bound traffic to the VPC endpoint
- VPC Gateway Endpoint cho S3 cho phép private subnet access S3 directly mà không qua NAT gateway
- Traffic đến S3 sẽ route qua VPC endpoint thay vì internet, tiết kiệm NAT gateway costs
- Endpoint policy control access permissions cho security
- Không impact internet connectivity vì other traffic vẫn đi qua NAT gateway
- Gateway endpoint miễn phí, chỉ pay for S3 usage

Các đáp án sai:
❌ A. GWLB endpoint không phù hợp cho S3 access, GWLB dành cho network appliances

Set up a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the route table in the private subnet to direct the S3-bound traffic via the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) endpoint


❌ Set up an egress-only internet gateway in the public subnet. Update the route table in the private subnet to route traffic to the internet gateway. Update the network ACL to allow the S3-bound traffic

Egress-only IGW chỉ cho IPv6, không phù hợp với IPv4 setup


❌ Provision an internet gateway. Update the route table in the private subnet to route traffic to the internet gateway. Update the network ACL (NACL) to allow the S3-bound traffic

Internet Gateway trong private subnet không khả thi, sẽ làm mất tính private

🔑Tips and tricks:
Private subnet + S3 heavy traffic + Cost optimal = VPC Gateway Endpoint (bypass NAT costs)!

questions.q:
A company has multiple Amazon EC2 instances operating in a private subnet which is part of a custom VPC. These instances are running an image processing application that needs to access images stored on Amazon S3. Once each image is processed, the status of the corresponding record needs to be marked as completed in a Amazon DynamoDB table.

How would you go about providing private access to these AWS resources which are not part of this custom VPC?
o: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 and add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC. Create an interface endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB and then add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC
Create a separate interface endpoint for Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB each. Then connect to these services by adding these as targets in the route table of the custom VPC

Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB and add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC. Create an Origin Access Identity for Amazon S3 and then connect to the S3 service using the private IP address
Create a separate gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB each. Add two new target entries for these two gateway endpoints in the route table of the custom VPC
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Multiple EC2 instances trong private subnet của custom VPC
- Instances chạy image processing app cần access S3 images
- Sau khi process xong cần update status trong DynamoDB table
- Cần provide private access đến S3 và DynamoDB mà không qua internet

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a separate gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB each. Add two new target entries for these two gateway endpoints in the route table of the custom VPC
- Gateway endpoint cho S3 - cost-effective và performance tốt cho S3 access
- Gateway endpoint cho DynamoDB - DynamoDB cũng support gateway endpoint và miễn phí
- Cả hai gateway endpoints được add vào route table của VPC
- Private access không qua NAT gateway hay internet, tiết kiệm costs
- Gateway endpoints miễn phí, chỉ pay for service usage

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 and add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC. Create an interface endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB and then add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC

DynamoDB có gateway endpoint, không cần dùng interface endpoint tốn phí


❌ Create a separate interface endpoint for Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB each. Then connect to these services by adding these as targets in the route table of the custom VPC

S3 nên dùng gateway endpoint thay vì interface endpoint để tiết kiệm costs


❌ Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB and add it as a target in the route table of the custom VPC. Create an Origin Access Identity for Amazon S3 and then connect to the S3 service using the private IP address

Origin Access Identity dành cho CloudFront, không phù hợp cho EC2 access S3

🔑Tips and tricks:
S3 + DynamoDB private access = Cả hai đều có Gateway Endpoint (free và performance tốt)!

questions.q:
A company has recently created a new department to handle their services workload. An IT team has been asked to create a custom VPC to isolate the resources created in this new department. They have set up the public subnet and internet gateway (IGW). However, they are not able to ping the Amazon EC2 instances with elastic IP address (EIP) launched in the newly created VPC.

As a Solutions Architect, the team has requested your help. How will you troubleshoot this scenario? (Select two)
o: Check if the security groups allow ping from the source
Contact AWS support to map your VPC with subnet
Disable Source / Destination check on the Amazon EC2 instance
Create a secondary internet gateway to attach with public subnet and move the current internet gateway to private and write route tables
Check if the route table is configured with internet gateway
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
- Company tạo custom VPC cho new department
- Đã setup public subnet và internet gateway (IGW)
- Không thể ping EC2 instances có elastic IP trong newly created VPC
- Cần troubleshoot để tìm nguyên nhân

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Check if the security groups allow ping from the source

Security groups phải allow ICMP traffic cho ping commands từ source IP


Check if the route table is configured with internet gateway

Route table của public subnet phải có route 0.0.0.0/0 pointing đến IGW
- Đây là 2 nguyên nhân phổ biến nhất khiến không ping được EC2 trong public subnet
- EC2 có EIP nhưng thiếu routing hoặc security rules sẽ không accessible

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Contact AWS support to map your VPC with subnet

không cần AWS Support map VPC với subnet, đây là configuration issue


❌ Disable Source / Destination check on the Amazon EC2 instance

Source/Destination check không ảnh hưởng đến ping, chỉ cần disable khi làm NAT


❌Create a secondary internet gateway to attach with public subnet and move the current internet gateway to private and write route tables

Không thể có multiple IGW trong VPC, mỗi VPC chỉ có 1 IGW

🔑Tips and tricks:
Ping fail trong public subnet = Check Security Groups (ICMP) + Route Tables (IGW route)!

questions.q:
Your company has embraced cloud-native microservices architectures. New applications must be dockerized and stored in a registry service offered by AWS. The architecture should support dynamic port mapping and support multiple tasks from a single service on the same container instance. All services should run on the same EC2 instance.

Which of the following options offers the best-fit solution for the given use-case?
o: Classic Load Balancer + Beanstalk
Application Load Balancer + Beanstalk
Application Load Balancer + ECS
Classic Load Balancer + ECS
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company áp dụng cloud-native microservices architectures

  • New applications phải dockerized và stored trong AWS registry service

  • Architecture cần support dynamic port mapping

  • Support multiple tasks từ single service trên same container instance

  • All services run trên same EC2 instance

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Application Load Balancer + ECS

  • Application Load Balancer support dynamic port mapping với ECS

  • ECS là AWS registry service cho Docker containers và support multiple tasks per instance

  • ALB có thể route traffic đến different ports trên same EC2 instance

  • ECS automatically register/deregister tasks với ALB using dynamic ports

  • Perfect cho microservices architecture với container orchestration

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Classic Load Balancer + Beanstalk

Classic Load Balancer không support dynamic port mapping

❌ Application Load Balancer + Beanstalk

Beanstalk không specialized cho microservices container orchestration như ECS

❌ Classic Load Balancer + ECS

Classic Load Balancer không có dynamic port mapping capability

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Microservices + Dynamic port mapping + Multiple tasks = ALB + ECS!

questions.q:
Your company is planning to move away from reserving EC2 instances and would like to adopt a more agile form of serverless architecture.

Which of the folloiwng is the simplest and the least effort way of deploying the Docker containers on this serverless architecture?
o: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Fargate
Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on EC2
AWS Elastic Beanstalk
Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Fargate
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company muốn move away từ reserving EC2 instances

  • Muốn adopt serverless architecture

  • Tìm cách simplest và least effort để deploy Docker containers trên serverless architecture

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Fargate

  • Amazon ECS on Fargate là fully managed serverless container platform

  • Không cần manage EC2 instances, AWS handle underlying infrastructure

  • Simplest setup - chỉ cần define task definitions và run containers

  • Least effort vì không có infrastructure management overhead

  • Pay chỉ cho resources containers sử dụng, true serverless model

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on EC2

ECS on EC2 không phải serverless, vẫn cần manage EC2 instances

❌ AWS Elastic Beanstalk

Elastic Beanstalk có thể deploy containers nhưng complexity cao hơn ECS Fargate

❌ Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Fargate

EKS on Fargate phức tạp hơn ECS, cần Kubernetes knowledge

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Serverless containers với least effort = ECS Fargate (fully managed, no EC2 management)!

questions.q:
Your company is shifting towards Elastic Container Service (ECS) to deploy applications. The process should be automated using the AWS CLI to create a service where at least ten instances of a task definition are kept running under the default cluster.

Which of the following commands should be executed?
o: aws ecr create-service --service-name ecs-simple-service --task-definition ecs-demo --desired-count 10
aws ecs run-task --cluster default --task-definition ecs-demo
aws ecs create-service --service-name ecs-simple-service --task-definition ecs-demo --desired-count 10
docker-compose create ecs-simple-service
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company shifting đến ECS để deploy applications

  • Process cần automated sử dụng AWS CLI

  • Tạo service với at least 10 instances của task definition running under default cluster

  • Cần tìm AWS CLI command đúng

✅ Đáp án đúng:

aws ecs create-service --service-name ecs-simple-service --task-definition ecs-demo --desired-count 10

  • aws ecs create-service là command đúng để tạo ECS service

  • --desired-count 10 ensure ít nhất 10 instances running

  • Service sẽ maintain desired count và restart failed tasks automatically

Các đáp án sai:

❌ aws ecr create-service --service-name ecs-simple-service --task-definition ecs-demo --desired-count 10

aws ecr create-service - ECR là container registry, không phải ECS orchestration

❌ aws ecs run-task --cluster default --task-definition ecs-demo

aws ecs run-task chỉ run single task, không maintain desired count

❌ docker-compose create ecs-simple-service

docker-compose không phải AWS CLI command cho ECS

🔑 Tips and tricks:

ECS service với desired count = aws ecs create-service với --desired-count parameter!

questions.q:
ECS Fargate container tasks are usually spread across Availability Zones (AZs) and the underlying workloads need persistent cross-AZ shared access to the data volumes configured for the container tasks.

Which of the following solutions is the best choice for these workloads?
o: Bind mounts
Docker volumes
AWS Gateway Storage volumes
Amazon EFS volumes
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • ECS Fargate container tasks được phân bố across Availability Zones (AZs)

  • Các workloads cần persistent cross-AZ shared access đến data volumes

  • Được cấu hình cho container tasks

  • Tìm giải pháp tốt nhất cho workloads này

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Amazon EFS volumes

  • Amazon EFS volumes cung cấp hệ thống file persistent, shared across AZs

  • Cross-AZ access cho phép containers trong các AZ khác nhau truy cập cùng dữ liệu

  • Fully managed, serverless file system phù hợp với Fargate

  • EFS tự động scale và cung cấp tính khả dụng cao

  • Hoàn hảo cho container workloads cần shared persistent storage

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Bind mounts chỉ mount host directories, không persistent across container restarts


❌ Docker volumes local với container host, không có cross-AZ shared access

❌ AWS Gateway Storage volumes không tồn tại, có thể nhầm với Storage Gateway

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cross-AZ shared persistent storage cho containers = Amazon EFS volumes!

questions.q:
The development team at an e-commerce company wants to run a serverless data store service on two docker containers that share resources.

Which of the following ECS configurations can be used to facilitate this use-case?
o: Put the two containers into two separate task definitions using a Fargate Launch Type.
Put the two containers into two separate task definitions using an EC2 Launch Type.
Put the two containers into a single task definition using a Fargate Launch Type.
Put the two containers into a single task definition using an EC2 Launch Type.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Development team muốn chạy serverless data store service

  • Trên two docker containers có share resources

  • Cần tìm ECS configuration phù hợp cho use-case này

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Put the two containers into a single task definition using a Fargate Launch Type.

  • Single task definition với Fargate Launch Type cho phép 2 containers share resources

  • Containers trong cùng task definition share CPU, memory, và network resources

  • Fargate cung cấp serverless environment theo requirement

  • Containers có thể communicate qua localhost và share storage volumes

  • Perfect cho containers có liên kết chắc chẽ cần resource sharing

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Put the two containers into two separate task definitions using a Fargate Launch Type.

Separate task definitions không cho phép containers share resources

❌ Put the two containers into two separate task definitions using an EC2 Launch Type.

Separate task definitions + EC2 Launch Type không serverless và không share resources

❌ Put the two containers into a single task definition using an EC2 Launch Type.

EC2 Launch Type không phải serverless environment

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Serverless + Share resources giữa containers = Single task definition + Fargate!

questions.q:
A retail company manages its IT infrastructure on AWS Cloud via Elastic Beanstalk. The development team at the company is planning to deploy the next version with MINIMUM application downtime and the ability to rollback quickly in case deployment goes wrong.

As a Developer Associate, which of the following options would you recommend to the development team?
o: Deploy the new application version using 'All at once' deployment policy
Deploy the new version to a separate environment via Blue/Green Deployment, and then swap Route 53 records of the two environments to redirect traffic to the new version
Deploy the new application version using 'Rolling with additional batch' deployment policy
Deploy the new application version using 'Rolling' deployment policy
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty bán lẻ sử dụng AWS Elastic Beanstalk để quản lý hạ tầng

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Triển khai phiên bản mới

    • Downtime tối thiểu

    • Rollback nhanh chóng nếu có sự cố

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Deploy the new version to a separate environment via Blue/Green Deployment, and then swap Route 53 records of the two environments to redirect traffic to the new version

  • Tạo một môi trường mới (Green) để triển khai phiên bản mới

  • Kiểm thử đầy đủ trước khi chuyển traffic

  • Khi sẵn sàng, swap DNS (Route 53) giữa Blue (môi trường cũ) và Green (môi trường mới)

  • Nếu có lỗi, chỉ cần đảo ngược lại DNS là rollback ngay lập tức → downtime gần như bằng 0

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Deploy the new application version using 'All at once' deployment policy

All at once triển khai toàn bộ cùng lúc → có thể gây downtime và rollback khó khăn nếu có lỗi

❌ Deploy the new application version using 'Rolling with additional batch' deployment policy

Rolling with additional batch có downtime ít hơn nhưng rollback chậm hơn Blue/Green

❌ Deploy the new application version using 'Rolling' deployment policy

Rolling có downtime trong quá trình deploy, rollback phức tạp

🔑 Tips and tricks:

MINIMUM downtime + Quick rollback = Blue/Green Deployment!

questions.q:
You have chosen AWS Elastic Beanstalk to upload your application code and allow it to handle details such as provisioning resources and monitoring.

When creating configuration files for AWS Elastic Beanstalk which naming convention should you follow?
o: .config/<mysettings>.ebextensions
.config_<mysettings>.ebextensions
.ebextensions_<mysettings>.config
.ebextensions/<mysettings>.config
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Sử dụng AWS Elastic Beanstalk để triển khai ứng dụng

  • Elastic Beanstalk cho phép tùy chỉnh môi trường bằng cách sử dụng các configuration files

  • Yêu cầu chọn đúng naming convention cho các file cấu hình

✅ Đáp án đúng:

.ebextensions/<mysettings>.config

  • Elastic Beanstalk configuration files phải nằm trong folder .ebextensions

  • Tên file phải có đuôi .config, ví dụ: .ebextensions/environment.config

  • Đây là chuẩn do Elastic Beanstalk định nghĩa, để xử lý cấu hình như môi trường, package, script, security group, v.v.

  • Các file này sẽ được Beanstalk tự động đọc và áp dụng khi tạo/triển khai môi trường

Các đáp án sai:

❌ .config/<mysettings>.ebextensions - sai thứ tự folder và extension

❌ .config_<mysettings>.ebextensions - sai format, không phải folder structure

❌ .ebextensions_<mysettings>.config - sai format, ebextensions phải là folder không phải prefix

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Elastic Beanstalk config files = .ebextensions/ folder + .config extension!

questions.q:
You have moved your on-premise infrastructure to AWS and are in the process of configuring an AWS Elastic Beanstalk deployment environment for production, development, and testing. You have configured your production environment to use a rolling deployment to prevent your application from becoming unavailable to users. For the development and testing environment, you would like to deploy quickly and are not concerned about downtime.

Which of the following deployment policies meet your needs?
o: Immutable
Rolling with additional batches
Rolling
All at once
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Di chuyển hạ tầng on-premise lên AWS và đang cấu hình Elastic Beanstalk cho production, development và testing

  • Production dùng rolling deployment để đảm bảo không bị downtime

  • Đối với development và testing, không lo lắng về downtime, chỉ muốn triển khai nhanh

✅ Đáp án đúng:

All at once

  • All at once là chính sách triển khai nhanh nhất, tất cả instance được cập nhật cùng lúc

  • Phù hợp cho môi trường dev/test, nơi bạn có thể chấp nhận downtime

  • Thời gian triển khai ngắn nhất, giúp đẩy nhanh quá trình thử nghiệm và phát triển

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Immutable deployment tạo nhóm instance mới và chuyển traffic sau khi kiểm thử – an toàn nhưng chậm, phù hợp cho production hơn

❌ Rolling with additional batches chậm hơn "All at once" vì deploy theo batches

❌ Rolling cũng chậm hơn vì deploy sequential batches để maintain availability

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Development/Testing + Quick deployment + Không care downtime = All at once deployment!

questions.q:
You have created a Java application that uses RDS for its main data storage and ElastiCache for user session storage. The application needs to be deployed using Elastic Beanstalk and every new deployment should allow the application servers to reuse the RDS database. On the other hand, user session data stored in ElastiCache can be re-created for every deployment.

Which of the following configurations will allow you to achieve this? (Select two)
o: ElastiCache bundled with the application source code
ElastiCache defined in .ebextensions/
ElastiCache database defined externally and referenced through environment variables
RDS database defined in .ebextensions/
RDS database defined externally and referenced through environment variables
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng Java sử dụng: Amazon RDS cho lưu trữ dữ liệu chính, Amazon ElastiCache cho lưu session người dùng

  • Triển khai bằng Elastic Beanstalk

  • Reuse RDS giữa các deployment (không tạo mới mỗi lần)

  • ElastiCache có thể khởi tạo lại mỗi lần, không cần giữ

  • Tìm configurations phù hợp (Select two)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

ElastiCache defined in .ebextensions/

Define trong .ebextensions/ thì ElastiCache sẽ được tạo/xóa cùng với Elastic Beanstalk environment

RDS database defined externally and referenced through environment variables

Để giữ nguyên RDS qua nhiều deployment, cần tạo RDS ngoài Beanstalk và truyền endpoint và thông tin kết nối qua Elastic Beanstalk environment variables

Các đáp án sai:

❌ ElastiCache bundled with the application source code

ElastiCache không thể bundle với source code

❌ ElastiCache database defined externally and referenced through environment variables

ElastiCache external không cần thiết vì session data có thể recreate

❌ RDS database defined in .ebextensions/

RDS trong .ebextensions/ sẽ bị xóa khi redeploy

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Persistent data (RDS) = External + Environment variables

  • Temporary data (ElastiCache) = .ebextensions!

questions.q:
A developer has been asked to create a web application to be deployed on EC2 instances. The developer just wants to focus on writing application code without worrying about server provisioning, configuration and deployment.

As a Developer Associate, which AWS service would you recommend for the given use-case?
o: CloudFormation
Serverless Application Model
Elastic Beanstalk
CodeDeploy
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

-Developer được yêu cầu tạo web application chạy trên EC2

-Muốn tập trung vào viết code, không muốn lo về provisioning, cấu hình, hay triển khai server

-Cần chọn dịch vụ AWS giảm thiểu effort vận hành, phù hợp cho developer

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Elastic Beanstalk

-Elastic Beanstalk là Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) cho web applications

-Cho phép developer triển khai ứng dụng web mà không cần lo hạ tầng

-Elastic Beanstalk sẽ tự lo việc provision EC2, load balancer, scaling, monitoring...

-Developer chỉ cần upload code

-Hỗ trợ nhiều ngôn ngữ và nền tảng như Java, Python, Node.js, PHP...

Các đáp án sai:

❌ CloudFormation là Infrastructure as Code tool, vẫn cần config infrastructure

❌ Serverless Application Model (SAM) cho serverless applications (Lambda), không phải EC2

❌ CodeDeploy chỉ là deployment service, vẫn cần quản lý EC2 thủ công hoặc kết hợp thêm dịch vụ khác

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Nếu đề cập đến “chỉ viết code” và không muốn quản lý infra = Elastic Beanstalk!

questions.q:
A company uses Elastic Beanstalk to manage its IT infrastructure on AWS Cloud and it would like to deploy the new application version to the EC2 instances. When the deployment is executed, some instances should serve requests with the old application version, while other instances should serve requests using the new application version until the deployment is completed.

Which deployment meets this requirement without incurring additional costs?
o: All at one
Rolling
Rolling with additional batches
Immutable
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng Elastic Beanstalk để quản lý hạ tầng

  • Muốn triển khai phiên bản mới của ứng dụng lên EC2

  • Trong quá trình deploy: một số instance phục vụ version cũ, một số instance phục vụ version mới,

  • Yêu cầu: triển khai không phát sinh thêm chi phí

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Rolling

  • Rolling deployment deploy new version theo batches (từng nhóm instances)

  • Tại mỗi thời điểm: một số instances chạy old version, một số chạy new version

  • KHÔNG tạo additional instances → không có extra costs

Các đáp án sai:

❌ All at once deploy tất cả instances cùng lúc, không có mixed versions

❌ Rolling with additional batches tạo extra instances → additional costs

❌ Immutable tạo completely new instances → significant additional costs

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Rolling = gradual update + không tăng chi phí

  • Rolling with additional batches = safer nhưng tốn thêm tiền (tăng capacity tạm thời)

  • Immutable khi cần an toàn cao, nhưng phải chấp nhận chi phí tăng

questions.q:
Your organization has set up a full CI/CD pipeline leveraging CodePipeline and the deployment is done on Elastic Beanstalk. This pipeline has worked for over a year now but you are approaching the limits of Elastic Beanstalk in terms of how many versions can be stored in the service.

How can you remove older versions that are not used by Elastic Beanstalk so that new versions can be created for your applications?
o: Define a Lambda function
Use a Lifecycle Policy
Setup an .ebextensions file
Use Worker Environments
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Tổ chức đang dùng CodePipeline triển khai ứng dụng lên Elastic Beanstalk

  • Sau hơn 1 năm, sắp chạm giới hạn số phiên bản (application versions) mà Elastic Beanstalk cho phép lưu trữ

  • Yêu cầu: xóa bớt các phiên bản cũ không còn được sử dụng, để có thể upload phiên bản mới

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use a Lifecycle Policy

  • Cho phép tự động xóa các application version cũ

  • Có thể cấu hình theo số lượng phiên bản giữ lại (max count) hoặc thời gian (max age)

  • Giúp giải phóng dung lượng mà không ảnh hưởng đến môi trường đang chạy

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Define a Lambda function

Lambda function không cần thiết, Elastic Beanstalk có built-in lifecycle management

❌ Setup an .ebextensions file

.ebextensions file dùng cho environment configuration, không phải version management

❌ Use Worker Environments
