*: Cho phép mọi account có state machine cùng tên ⇒ không giới hạn đúng một state machine.

❌

"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "aws:SourceAccount": "11111111111"
  }
}

Chỉ giới hạn theo account, không chỉ ra state machine cụ thể.

❌

"Condition": {
  "StringNotEquals": {
    "aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:states:ap-south-1:111111111111:stateMachine:myStateMachine"
  }
}

StringNotEquals: Cho phép mọi ARN khác myStateMachine → sai mục tiêu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn “chỉ cho 1 state machine”: kiểm tra nguồn gọi bằng ARN của state machine; có thể thêm account ID để chặt hơn.

📖 Reference:

Creating a state machine IAM role

questions.q:
A cloud-based video surveillance company is developing an application that analyzes video files. After the application analyzes the files, the company can discard the files.

The company stores the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The files are 1 GB in size on average. No file is larger than 2 GB. An AWS Lambda function will run one time for each video file that is processed. The processing is very I/O intensive, and the application must read each file multiple times.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST performance-optimized way?
o: Attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is larger than 1 GB to the Lambda function. Copy the files from the S3 bucket to the EBS volume.
Attach an Elastic Network Adapter (ENA) to the Lambda function. Use the ENA to read the video files from the S3 bucket.
Increase the ephemeral storage size to 2 GB. Copy the files from the S3 bucket to the /tmp directory of the Lambda function.
Configure the Lambda function code to read the video files directly from the S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty phân tích file video lưu ở Amazon S3 (trung bình 1 GB, tối đa 2 GB).

  • Mỗi file được xử lý bởi một Lambda; xử lý I/O nặng và đọc đi đọc lại nhiều lần.

  • Sau khi xử lý có thể bỏ file.

  • Mục tiêu: tối ưu hiệu năng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the ephemeral storage size to 2 GB. Copy the files from the S3 bucket to the /tmp directory of the Lambda function.

→ Tăng ephemeral storage và copy file về /tmp giúp đọc lặp lại với tốc độ local (không phụ thuộc mạng), tối ưu cho workload I/O nặng.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is larger than 1 GB to the Lambda function. Copy the files from the S3 bucket to the EBS volume.

→ Lambda không gắn EBS; chỉ có ephemeral /tmp và EFS (không có trong lựa chọn).

❌ Attach an Elastic Network Adapter (ENA) to the Lambda function. Use the ENA to read the video files from the S3 bucket.

→ Lambda không hỗ trợ gắn ENA; mạng được quản lý sẵn, không cải thiện đọc lặp từ S3.

❌ Configure the Lambda function code to read the video files directly from the S3 bucket.

→ Đọc trực tiếp từ S3 cho mỗi lượt đọc sẽ tốn mạng và chậm hơn nhiều so với đọc local khi cần đọc lặp lại.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Đọc lặp, I/O nặng ⇒ tải về /tmp (ephemeral storage tối đa 10 GB) để tăng tốc.

📖 Reference:

AWS Lambda Now Supports Up to 10 GB Ephemeral Storage

questions.q:
A company wants to send notifications to customers to advertise a sale on the company’s products. The company needs to use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics.

The company needs to examine the rate at which the topics send notifications and the latency with which the topics send notifications.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?
o: Use AWS X-Ray. Enable active tracing for Amazon SNS.
Use the Amazon CloudWatch NumberOfNotificationsFailed metric.
Use AWS CloudTrail to log all Amazon SNS API calls.
Use Amazon GuardDuty. Enable runtime monitoring.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng SNS FIFO topics để gửi thông báo.

  • Cần xem tốc độ gửi (rate) và độ trễ gửi (latency) của topic.

  • Muốn cách làm ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS X-Ray. Enable active tracing for Amazon SNS.

X-Ray cung cấp trace/segment cho SNS, cho phép xem thông lượng và đặc biệt độ trễ giữa publish → deliver trên service map/graphs mà không phải tự ghi log hay refactor.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the Amazon CloudWatch NumberOfNotificationsFailed metric.

→ Chỉ đếm số lần thất bại, không cho biết rate tổng hay latency.

❌ Use AWS CloudTrail to log all Amazon SNS API calls.

→ CloudTrail ghi API management events (Publish, CreateTopic…) chứ không cung cấp latency gửi thông báo; xử lý và phân tích thủ công, vận hành cao.

❌ Use Amazon GuardDuty. Enable runtime monitoring.

→ GuardDuty là dịch vụ phát hiện đe doạ, không đo rate/latency của SNS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cần latency end-to-end cho SNS ⇒ dùng AWS X-Ray tracing

📖 Reference:

AWS X-Ray integration with Amazon SNS (end-to-end message tracing).

questions.q:
A developer is using AWS CodeDeploy to launch an application onto Amazon EC2 instances. The application deployment fails during testing. The developer notices an IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS error code in Amazon CloudWatch logs.

What should the developer do to resolve the error?
o: Ensure that the deployment group is using the correct role name for the CodeDeploy service role.
Attach the AWSCodeDeployRoleECS policy to the CodeDeploy service role.
Attach the AWSCodeDeployRole policy to the CodeDeploy service role.
Ensure the CodeDeploy agent is installed and running on all instances in the deployment group.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng AWS CodeDeploy để triển khai app lên EC2.

  • Deployment bị fail với lỗi IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS trong CloudWatch logs.

  • Cần khắc phục quyền IAM cho CodeDeploy.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Attach the AWSCodeDeployRole policy to the CodeDeploy service role.

→ Khi triển khai EC2/On-Premises, CodeDeploy cần service role có AWSCodeDeployRole policy để có đủ quyền thực hiện deploy lên EC2/On-Premises.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Ensure that the deployment group is using the correct role name for the CodeDeploy service role.

→ Role name sai thì lỗi thường là role not found, không phải IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.

❌ Attach the AWSCodeDeployRoleECS policy to the CodeDeploy service role.

→ Policy này dành cho ECS, không phải EC2.

❌ Ensure the CodeDeploy agent is installed and running on all instances in the deployment group.

→ Agent lỗi sẽ gây vấn đề khác (ví dụ AppSpec not found, communication failed), không phải lỗi IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • AWSCodeDeployRole → cho EC2/On-Premises

  • AWSCodeDeployRoleForECS → cho ECS

📖 Reference:

Create IAM Service Role for CodeDeploy (EC2/On-Premises)

questions.q:
A developer needs to migrate an online retail application to AWS to handle an anticipated increase in traffic. The application currently runs on two servers: one server for the web application and another server for the database. The web server renders webpages and manages session state in memory. The database server hosts a MySQL database that contains order details. When traffic to the application is heavy, the memory usage for the web server approaches 100% and the application slows down considerably.
The developer has found that most of the memory increase and performance decrease is related to the load of managing additional user sessions. For the web server migration, the developer will use Amazon EC2 instances with an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.


Which additional set of changes should the developer make to the application to improve the application's performance?
o: Use an EC2 instance to host the MySQL database. Store the session data and the application data in the MySQL database.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data and the application data.
Use the EC2 instance store to manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng bán lẻ online hiện chạy trên 2 server:

  • Web server (render page + quản lý session trong memory).

  • DB server (MySQL lưu order).

  • Khi traffic cao → RAM web server ~100%, app chậm.

  • Nguyên nhân chính: tải quản lý session.

  • Migration: web server chuyển sang EC2 Auto Scaling group + ALB.

  • Hỏi: cần thay đổi gì thêm để cải thiện hiệu năng?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.

  • ElastiCache (Memcached) lưu session state tách khỏi web server → giảm tải memory, scale web server dễ dàng.

  • Amazon RDS MySQL lưu dữ liệu app (orders) thay vì tự host DB → dễ quản lý, scale tốt.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use an EC2 instance to host the MySQL database. Store the session data and the application data in the MySQL database.

→ Lưu session vào DB MySQL gây tải nặng, không tối ưu cho session management.

❌ Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to store and manage the session data and the application data.

→ ElastiCache chỉ phù hợp cho session/cache, không lưu application data bền vững.

❌ Use the EC2 instance store to manage the session data. Use an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store the application data.

→ EC2 instance store không bền vững, dữ liệu session mất khi instance bị thay thế → không phù hợp cho session shared giữa nhiều EC2.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Session state tốt nhất cho MySQL = ElastiCache (Memcached/Redis) để giảm tải và hỗ trợ scale-out.

📖 Reference:

Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache

questions.q:
A company uses two AWS accounts: production and development. The company stores data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is in the production account. The data is encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. The company plans to copy the data to another S3 bucket that is in the development account.

A developer needs to use a KMS key to encrypt the data in the S3 bucket that is in the development account. The KMS key in the development account must be accessible from the production account,

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Replicate the customer managed KMS key from the production account to the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.
Create a new customer managed KMS key in the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.
Create a new AWS managed KMS key for Amazon S3 in the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.
Replicate the default AWS managed KMS key for Amazon S3 from the production account to the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có 2 account: production & development.

  • Dữ liệu ở S3 bucket (production), mã hóa bằng customer managed KMS key.

  • Muốn copy sang S3 bucket (development).

  • Yêu cầu: dữ liệu ở development phải được mã hóa bằng KMS key trong development account, và key này phải accessible từ production.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new customer managed KMS key in the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.

  • Tạo customer managed KMS key ở development để mã hóa dữ liệu copy.

  • Thêm production account vào key policy để cho phép production account sử dụng key khi thực hiện copy.

{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {
    "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::production-Account:role/ApplicationRole"
  },
  "Action": [
    "kms:Decrypt",
    "kms:DescribeKey"
  ],
  "Resource": "*"
}

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Replicate the customer managed KMS key from the production account to the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.

→ KMS keys không thể replicate giữa accounts.

❌ Create a new AWS managed KMS key for Amazon S3 in the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.

→ AWS managed keys không cho phép chỉnh sửa key policy ⇒ không thêm được cross-account access.

❌ Replicate the default AWS managed KMS key for Amazon S3 from the production account to the development account. Specify the production account in the key policy.

→ AWS managed keys không thể replicate giữa accounts và không thể chỉnh policy.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn chỉnh policy để cấp quyền cho cross-account → Customer managed KMS key

📖 Reference:

Access AWS Secrets Manager secrets from a different account

questions.q:
A company generates SSL certificates from a third-party provider. The company imports the certificates into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to use with public web applications.

A developer must implement a solution to notify the company’s security team 90 days before an imported certificate expires. The company already has configured an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The company also has configured an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that has the security team’s email address as a subscriber.

Which solution will provide the security team with the required notification about certificates?
o: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that specifies the ACM Certificate Approaching Expiration event type. Set the SNS topic as the EventBridge rule’s target.

Create an AWS Lambda function to search for all certificates that are expiring within 90 days. Program the Lambda function to send each identified certificate’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in a message to the SQS queue.

Create an AWS Step Functions workflow that is invoked by each certificate’s expiration notification from AWS CloudTrail. Create an AWS Lambda function to send each certificate's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in a message to the SQS queue.

Configure AWS Config with the acm-certificate-expiration-check managed rule to run every 24 hours. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that includes an event pattern that specifies the Config Rules Compliance Change detail type and the configured rule. Set the SNS topic as the EventBridge rule’s target.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng SSL cert từ bên thứ 3, import vào ACM.

  • Đã có SQS queue và SNS topic với email team security.

  • Yêu cầu: gửi cảnh báo 90 ngày trước khi cert hết hạn.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure AWS Config with the acm-certificate-expiration-check managed rule to run every 24 hours. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that includes an event pattern that specifies the Config Rules Compliance Change detail type and the configured rule. Set the SNS topic as the EventBridge rule’s target.

  • AWS Config có managed rule acm-certificate-expiration-check → phát hiện cert hết hạn trong 90 ngày.

  • Kết hợp EventBridge rule để bắn sự kiện noncompliant tới SNS topic (email team security).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that specifies the ACM Certificate Approaching Expiration event type. Set the SNS topic as the EventBridge rule’s target.

→ ACM chỉ phát sự kiện cho ACM-managed certificates, không phát sự kiện cho imported certs.

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to search for all certificates that are expiring within 90 days. Program the Lambda function to send each identified certificate’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in a message to the SQS queue.

→ Hoạt động được nhưng phải tự code + tự quản lý lịch chạy → nhiều effort hơn, không tối ưu vận hành.

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions workflow that is invoked by each certificate’s expiration notification from AWS CloudTrail. Create an AWS Lambda function to send each certificate's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in a message to the SQS queue.

→ CloudTrail không sinh event expiration cho imported certs → không đáp ứng yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Với imported certs → phải dùng AWS Config managed rule.

📖 Reference:

AWS Config managed rule: acm-certificate-expiration-check

questions.q:
A developer is deploying a new Node.js AWS Lambda function that is not connected to a VPC. The Lambda function needs to connect to and query an Amazon Aurora database that is not publicly accessible. The developer is expecting unpredictable surges in database traffic.

What should the developer do to give the Lambda function access to the database?
o: Configure the Lambda function to use an Amazon RDS proxy.
Configure a NAT gateway. Attach the NAT gateway to the Lambda function.
Enable public access on the Aurora database. Configure a security group on the database to allow outbound access for the database engine’s port.
Enable VPC access for the Lambda function. Attach the Lambda function to a new security group that does not have rules.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function (Node.js) hiện không nằm trong VPC.

  • Aurora DB không public (private trong VPC).

  • Yêu cầu: Lambda phải query Aurora.

  • Lưu ý: có thể có traffic surge (cần quản lý connection tốt).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the Lambda function to use an Amazon RDS proxy.

Surge traffic thì RDS Proxy là giải pháp tối ưu

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a NAT gateway. Attach the NAT gateway to the Lambda function.

→ NAT chỉ cho outbound internet traffic từ VPC ra ngoài, không giúp Lambda truy cập Aurora private DB.

❌ Enable public access on the Aurora database. Configure a security group on the database to allow outbound access for the database engine’s port.

→ Làm Aurora public mở ra lỗ hổng bảo mật; “outbound access” không cần thiết, database cần inbound từ Lambda.

❌ Enable VPC access for the Lambda function. Attach the Lambda function to a new security group that does not have rules.

→ Chỉ gắn Lambda vào VPC là chưa đủ; cần security group rule cho phép inbound vào Aurora và giải pháp connection pooling để handle surge.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Traffic surge → dùng RDS Proxy để connection pooling.

📖 Reference:

Using Amazon RDS Proxy with AWS Lambda

Tutorial: Using a Lambda function to access an Amazon RDS database

questions.q:
A developer is creating a stock trading application. The developer needs a solution to send text messages to application users to confirmation when a trade has been completed.

The solution must deliver messages in the order a user makes stock trades. The solution must not send duplicate messages.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure the application to publish messages to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to have a destination of each user’s mobile phone number that is passed in the trade confirmation message.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Use the SendMessageIn API call to send the trade confirmation messages to the queue. Use the SendMessageOut API to send the messages to users by using the information provided in the trade confirmation message.

Configure a pipe in Amazon EventBridge Pipes. Connect the application to the pipe as a source. Configure the pipe to use each user’s mobile phone number as a target. Configure the pipe to send incoming events to the users.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) FIFO topic. Configure the application to use the AWS SDK to publish notifications to the SNS topic to send SMS messages to the users.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App giao dịch chứng khoán cần gửi SMS xác nhận trade cho user.

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Giữ đúng thứ tự theo giao dịch của user.

    • Không gửi trùng lặp (exactly-once delivery).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) FIFO topic. Configure the application to use the AWS SDK to publish notifications to the SNS topic to send SMS messages to the users.

  • SNS FIFO hỗ trợ ordering (MessageGroupId) và deduplication.

  • Kết hợp với SMS endpoints trong SNS để gửi tin nhắn đến user, đáp ứng yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the application to publish messages to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to have a destination of each user’s mobile phone number that is passed in the trade confirmation message.

→ Kinesis Data Firehose không gửi trực tiếp SMS; chỉ đẩy vào storage (S3, Redshift, OpenSearch).

❌ Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Use the SendMessageIn API call to send the trade confirmation messages to the queue. Use the SendMessageOut API to send the messages to users by using the information provided in the trade confirmation message.

→ SQS FIFO đảm bảo thứ tự và không trùng, nhưng không gửi trực tiếp SMS; lại còn không tồn tại API SendMessageIn/Out. Cần thêm SNS hoặc Lambda để fanout, nên không phải đáp án đúng.

❌ Configure a pipe in Amazon EventBridge Pipes. Connect the application to the pipe as a source. Configure the pipe to use each user’s mobile phone number as a target. Configure the pipe to send incoming events to the users.

→ EventBridge Pipes không có khả năng gửi SMS trực tiếp. Cần target khác (SNS, Lambda), overhead cao.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Ordering + no duplicates → chỉ có FIFO (SQS/SNS).

📖 Reference:

Amazon SNS FIFO topics – Ordering & deduplication

questions.q:
A developer needs to automate deployments for a serverless, event-based workload. The developer needs to create standardized templates to define the infrastructure and to test the functionality of the workload locally before deployment

The developer already uses a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. The developer needs to incorporate any other infrastructure changes into the existing pipeline.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. Configure the pipeline stages in CodePipeline to run the necessary AWS SAM CLI commands to deploy the serverless workload.
Create an AWS Step Functions workflow template based on the infrastructure by using the Amazon States Language. Start the Step Functions state machine from the existing pipeline.
Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Use the existing pipeline workflow to build a pipeline for AWS CloudFormation stacks.
Create an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. Use an automated script to deploy the serverless workload by using the AWS SAM CLI deploy command.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Workload serverless, event-based cần template chuẩn hóa để định nghĩa infra.

  • Cần test local trước khi deploy.

  • Đã có CodePipeline, muốn tích hợp thay đổi infra vào pipeline hiện có.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. Configure the pipeline stages in CodePipeline to run the necessary AWS SAM CLI commands to deploy the serverless workload.

AWS SAM cung cấp template chuẩn cho serverless và hỗ trợ test local (sam local) và gọi SAM CLI trong các stage của CodePipeline để build/test/deploy, đáp ứng đầy đủ yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions workflow template based on the infrastructure by using the Amazon States Language. Start the Step Functions state machine from the existing pipeline.

→ ASL/Step Functions chỉ định nghĩa workflow, không cho test local.

❌ Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Use the existing pipeline workflow to build a pipeline for AWS CloudFormation stacks.

→ CloudFormation không hỗ trợ test local cho function/event như yêu cầu.

❌ Create an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. Use an automated script to deploy the serverless workload by using the AWS SAM CLI deploy command.

→ Dùng script riêng lẻ không tích hợp vào CodePipeline như bài yêu cầu “incorporate… into the existing pipeline”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Serverless + test local + CI/CD → SAM template + SAM CLI tích hợp trong CodePipeline.

📖 Reference:

Using AWS CodePipeline to deploy with AWS SAM

Implementing cross-account CI/CD with AWS SAM for container-based Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that needs network access to private resources in a VPC.

Which solution will provide this access with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Attach the Lambda function to the VPC through private subnets. Create a security group that allows network access to the private resources. Associate the security group with the Lambda function.

Configure the Lambda function to route traffic through a VPN connection. Create a security group that allows network access to the private resources. Associate the security group with the Lambda function.
Configure a VPC endpoint connection for the Lambda function. Set up the VPC endpoint to route traffic through a NAT gateway.
Configure an AWS PrivateLink endpoint for the private resources. Configure the Lambda function to reference the PrivateLink endpoint.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần truy cập tài nguyên private trong VPC.

  • Hỏi: giải pháp nào ít vận hành nhất (least operational overhead).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Attach the Lambda function to the VPC through private subnets. Create a security group that allows network access to the private resources. Associate the security group with the Lambda function.

→ Đây là cách chuẩn để cho Lambda kết nối tới tài nguyên private trong VPC: cấu hình VPC access + SG.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the Lambda function to route traffic through a VPN connection. Create a security group that allows network access to the private resources. Associate the security group with the Lambda function.

→ VPN dùng để nối on-premises ↔ AWS, không cần thiết khi Lambda và tài nguyên cùng trong VPC.

❌ Configure a VPC endpoint connection for the Lambda function. Set up the VPC endpoint to route traffic through a NAT gateway.

→ VPC Endpoint dùng để truy cập AWS services private, không để Lambda truy cập private resources trong VPC. NAT gateway chỉ giúp outbound Internet, không giúp private access.

❌ Configure an AWS PrivateLink endpoint for the private resources. Configure the Lambda function to reference the PrivateLink endpoint.

→ PrivateLink dùng cho dịch vụ chia sẻ cross-VPC/account, không cần thiết nếu Lambda và resource cùng trong 1 VPC.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda → private resources: cấu hình VPC access (private subnet + SG).

  • NAT/PrivateLink/VPN chỉ áp dụng khi có dịch vụ ngoài VPC hoặc cross-account.

📖 Reference:

Configuring VPC access for Lambda

questions.q:
A developer is deploying an application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. The developer is using a Docker container with an Ubuntu image.

The developer needs to implement a solution to store application data that is available from multiple ECS tasks. The application data must remain accessible after the container is terminated.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Attach an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server volume to the container definition.
Specify the DockerVolumeConfiguration parameter in the ECS task definition to attach a Docker volume.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Specify the mountPoints attribute and the efsVolumeConfiguration attribute in the ECS task definition.
Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Specify the mount point configuration in the ECS task definition.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên ECS (Fargate), container Ubuntu.

  • Cần lưu application data dùng chung cho nhiều task và không mất khi container kết thúc.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Specify the mountPoints attribute and the efsVolumeConfiguration attribute in the ECS task definition.

→ EFS là network file system, hỗ trợ Fargate và nhiều task truy cập đồng thời, dữ liệu persist sau khi container dừng.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Attach an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server volume to the container definition.

→ FSx for Windows dùng SMB/Windows workloads; không phải lựa chọn tiêu chuẩn cho Linux/Fargate.

❌ Specify the DockerVolumeConfiguration parameter in the ECS task definition to attach a Docker volume.

→ DockerVolumeConfiguration áp dụng EC2 launch type; Fargate không hỗ trợ Docker volumes kiểu này.

❌ Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Specify the mount point configuration in the ECS task definition.

→ EBS gắn vào EC2 instance, không gắn trực tiếp cho Fargate tasks và không share cho nhiều task.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Fargate + shared persistent storage ⇒ EFS (mount qua efsVolumeConfiguration).

📖 Reference:

Use Amazon EFS volumes with Amazon ECS

Developers guide to using Amazon EFS with Amazon ECS and AWS Fargate

questions.q:
A team deploys an AWS CloudFormation template to update a stack that already included an Amazon DynamoDB table. However, before the deployment of the update, the team changed the name of the DynamoDB table on the template by mistake. The DeletionPolicy attribute for all resources has the default value.

What will be the result of this mistake?
o: CloudFormation will create a new table and will delete the existing table.
CloudFormation will create a new table and will keep the existing table.
CloudFormation will overwrite the existing table and will rename the existing table.
CloudFormation will keep the existing table and will not create a new table.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Đội deploy CloudFormation template update một stack.

  • Stack có sẵn DynamoDB table.

  • Trước khi update, họ đổi tên table trong template (nhầm).

  • DeletionPolicy đang mặc định (nghĩa là Delete).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

CloudFormation will create a new table and will delete the existing table.

CloudFormation xác định resource dựa trên logical ID trong template, nếu đổi logical ID hoặc name, CloudFormation sẽ delete + recreate resource (nếu không có DeletionPolicy giữ lại).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ CloudFormation will create a new table and will keep the existing table.

→ Sai. Với DeletionPolicy=Delete, resource cũ sẽ không được giữ lại.

❌ CloudFormation will overwrite the existing table and will rename the existing table.

→ Sai. CloudFormation không rename resource; nó chỉ delete + create mới.

❌ CloudFormation will keep the existing table and will not create a new table.

→ Sai. Vì đổi tên resource ⇒ CloudFormation xem đó là resource mới cần tạo.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DeletionPolicy = Delete (mặc định) → DynamoDB table cũ sẽ bị xóa.

📖 Reference:

CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute

questions.q:
A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application needs to use dynamic feature flags that will be shared with other applications. The application must poll on an interval for new feature flag values. The values must be cached when they are retrieved.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Store the feature flag values in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache node to cache the values by using a lazy loading strategy in the application. Update the application to poll for the values on an interval from ElastiCache.

Store the feature flag values in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache the values by using a lazy loading strategy in the application. Update the application to poll for the values on an interval from DynamoDB.

Store the feature flag values in AWS AppConfig. Configure AWS AppConfig Agent on the EC2 instances to poll for the values on an interval. Update the application to retrieve the values from the AppConfig Agent localhost endpoint.

Store the feature flag values in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to poll on an interval. Configure the application to use the AWS SDK to retrieve the values from Parameter Store and to store the values in memory.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên EC2, cần feature flags động dùng chung cho app khác.

  • Phải poll theo chu kỳ để lấy giá trị mới và cache khi đã lấy.

  • Mục tiêu: ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the feature flag values in AWS AppConfig. Configure AWS AppConfig Agent on the EC2 instances to poll for the values on an interval. Update the application to retrieve the values from the AppConfig Agent localhost endpoint.

AWS AppConfig (Feature Flags) + AppConfig Agent hỗ trợ polling định kỳ, rollout/rollback an toàn, và local caching qua endpoint localhost → tối thiểu công vận hành, chuẩn best practice cho feature flags.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the feature flag values in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache node to cache the values by using a lazy loading strategy in the application. Update the application to poll for the values on an interval from ElastiCache.

→ Secrets Manager không phải dịch vụ quản lý feature flags; thêm ElastiCache làm phức tạp kiến trúc, tăng vận hành.

❌ Store the feature flag values in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache the values by using a lazy loading strategy in the application. Update the application to poll for the values on an interval from DynamoDB.

→ DAX cải thiện độ trễ đọc DynamoDB nhưng bạn vẫn phải tự xây polling + cache strategy và quy trình thay đổi/triển khai cờ; vận hành cao.

❌ Store the feature flag values in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to poll on an interval. Configure the application to use the AWS SDK to retrieve the values from Parameter Store and to store the values in memory.

→ Cần tự code toàn bộ polling + in-memory cache; thiếu tính năng rollout/validation và cảnh báo so với AppConfig.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Feature flags trên AWS → AppConfig + AppConfig Agent: polling, caching, rollout có kiểm soát.

📖 Reference:

AWS AppConfig – Feature flags

Retrieving basic and multi-variant feature flags

questions.q:
A developer has an application container, an AWS Lambda function, and an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The Lambda function uses the SQS queue as an event source. The Lambda function makes a call to a third-party machine learning API when the function is invoked. The response from the third-party API can take up to 60 seconds to return.

The Lambda function's timeout value is currently 65 seconds. The developer has noticed that the Lambda function sometimes processes duplicate messages from the SQS queue.

What should the developer do to ensure that the Lambda function does not process duplicate messages?
o: Configure the Lambda function with a larger amount of memory.
Configure an increase in the Lambda function’s timeout value.
Configure the SQS queue’s delivery delay value to be greater than the maximum time it takes to call the third-party API.
Configure the SQS queue’s visibility timeout value to be greater than the maximum time it takes to call the third-party API.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda được trigger bởi SQS queue.

  • Lambda gọi API ML bên thứ ba có thể mất tới 60s.

  • Lambda timeout = 65s.

  • Bị xử lý trùng message từ SQS.

  • Cần tránh xử lý trùng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the SQS queue’s visibility timeout value to be greater than the maximum time it takes to call the third-party API.

Tăng visibility timeout → thời gian xử lý tối đa (gồm gọi API) để message không hiện lại cho consumer khác trước khi Lambda hoàn tất → tránh xử lý trùng.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the Lambda function with a larger amount of memory.

→ Nhiều memory không giải quyết việc message hiển thị lại khi visibility timeout quá ngắn.

❌ Configure an increase in the Lambda function’s timeout value.

→ Tăng Lambda timeout không giúp nếu visibility timeout của SQS ngắn hơn thời gian xử lý → SQS vẫn re-deliver.

❌ Configure the SQS queue’s delivery delay value to be greater than the maximum time it takes to call the third-party API.

→ Delivery delay chỉ trì hoãn lần hiển thị đầu tiên, không liên quan đến re-delivery trong khi xử lý.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Với Lambda + SQS, đặt Visibility Timeout → thời gian xử lý tối đa (thêm buffer) để tránh re-delivery.

📖 Reference:

Amazon SQS visibility timeout

questions.q:
A developer is building an image-processing application that includes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function moves images from one AWS service to another AWS service for image processing. For images that are larger than 2 MB, the Lambda function returns the following error: “Task timed out after 3.01 seconds.”

The developer needs to resolve the error without modifying the Lambda function code.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Increase the Lambda function’s timeout value.
Configure the Lambda function to not move images that are larger than 2 MB.
Request a concurrency quota increase for the Lambda function.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda chuyển ảnh giữa các dịch vụ AWS để xử lý.

  • Ảnh > 2 MB thường bị lỗi: “Task timed out after 3.01 seconds.”

  • Yêu cầu: khắc phục mà không sửa code.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the Lambda function’s timeout value.

→ Vấn đề là hết thời gian thực thi. Tăng timeout (ví dụ 15–30s hoặc phù hợp kích thước file) để Lambda có đủ thời gian xử lý tệp lớn hơn.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the Lambda function to not move images that are larger than 2 MB.

→ Lách vấn đề bằng cách bỏ qua dữ liệu, không phải giải pháp kỹ thuật cho lỗi timeout.

❌ Request a concurrency quota increase for the Lambda function.

→ Concurrency liên quan số lượng thực thi song song, không ảnh hưởng thời gian chạy của 1 invocation.

❌ Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.

→ Provisioned concurrency giảm cold start, không giải quyết timeout khi tác vụ chạy lâu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lỗi “timed out after X seconds” → kiểm tra và tăng function timeout; nếu xử lý I/O lớn, cân nhắc tăng bộ nhớ để có băng thông mạng/CPU cao hơn.

📖 Reference:

Configure Lambda function timeout

questions.q:
A developer is building an ecommerce application that uses multiple AWS Lambda functions. Each function performs a specific step in a customer order workflow, such as order processing and inventory management.

The developer must ensure that the Lambda functions run in a specific order.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to contain messages about each step a function must perform. Configure the Lambda functions to run sequentially based on the order of messages in the SQS queue.

Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to contain notifications about each step a function must perform. Subscribe the Lambda functions to the SNS topic. Use subscription filters based on the step each function must perform.
Configure an AWS Step Functions state machine to invoke the Lambda functions in a specific order.
Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler schedules to invoke the Lambda functions in a specific order.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng ecommerce có nhiều AWS Lambda, mỗi function xử lý một bước (order, inventory, …).

  • Yêu cầu: chạy đúng thứ tự các bước.

  • Ưu tiên: ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure an AWS Step Functions state machine to invoke the Lambda functions in a specific order.

→ Step Functions là dịch vụ orchestration có sẵn mô hình tuần tự, rẽ nhánh, retry, timeout… giúp chạy Lambda đúng thứ tự với overhead tối thiểu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to contain messages about each step a function must perform. Configure the Lambda functions to run sequentially based on the order of messages in the SQS queue.

→ SQS không điều phối nhiều Lambda theo chuỗi bước; phải tự viết routing/chaining, dễ rối và tốn vận hành.

❌ Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to contain notifications about each step a function must perform. Subscribe the Lambda functions to the SNS topic. Use subscription filters based on the step each function must perform.

→ SNS là pub/sub, không đảm bảo thứ tự thực thi tuần tự giữa nhiều subscriber.

❌ Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler schedules to invoke the Lambda functions in a specific order.

→ Scheduler là lịch thời gian; không phải công cụ điều phối workflow theo phụ thuộc logic giữa các bước.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Chạy tuần tự nhiều Lambda → Step Functions (orchestration, retry, timeout, quan sát dễ).

📖 Reference:

AWS Step Functions Use Cases

questions.q:
A developer is writing an application in AWS Lambda. To simplify testing and deployments, the developer needs the database connection string to be easily changed without modifying the Lambda code.

How can this requirement be met?
o: Store the connection string as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager.
Store the connection string in an IAM user account.
Store the connection string in AWS KMS.
Store the connection string as a Lambda layer.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer viết ứng dụng trên AWS Lambda.

  • Cần dễ dàng thay đổi connection string DB mà không phải chỉnh sửa code.

  • Hỏi: giải pháp nào phù hợp?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the connection string as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager.

  • Secrets Manager lưu thông tin nhạy cảm (như connection string, password).

  • Khi cần đổi connection string, chỉ cần cập nhật secret → không phải sửa code.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the connection string in an IAM user account.

→ IAM user quản lý quyền, không dùng để lưu application config như connection string.

❌ Store the connection string in AWS KMS.

→ KMS dùng để mã hóa/giải mã key, không phải nơi lưu dữ liệu cấu hình trực tiếp.

❌ Store the connection string as a Lambda layer.

→ Lambda layer chứa code hoặc library chung, không phải chỗ lưu connection string (không tiện để update config).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Config nhạy cảm (DB credentials, connection string) ⇒ dùng Secrets Manager hoặc Parameter Store.

Ưu tiên Secrets Manager khi có yêu cầu rotation + bảo mật cao.

📖 Reference:

Use AWS Secrets Manager secrets in AWS Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that will process messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The application needs to process the messages in an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task.

Which actions will result in the MOST cost-effective processing of the messages? (Choose two.)
o: Use long polling to query the queue for new messages.
Use short polling to query the queue for new messages.
Use message batching to retrieve messages from the queue.
Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache messages in the queue.
Use an SQS FIFO queue to manage the messages.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App sẽ xử lý message từ Amazon SQS Standard Queue.

  • ECS task sẽ đọc & xử lý message.

  • Yêu cầu: xử lý tiết kiệm chi phí nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use long polling to query the queue for new messages.

Long polling giảm số lượng request API rỗng so với short polling → ít tốn chi phí API.

Use message batching to retrieve messages from the queue.

Batching cho phép lấy nhiều message trong 1 request (tối đa 10 message) → giảm chi phí API call.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use short polling to query the queue for new messages.

→ Short polling tốn nhiều request API hơn (khi queue rỗng vẫn trả về ngay) → chi phí cao hơn.

❌ Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache messages in the queue.

→ Không cần cache message SQS; ElastiCache làm tăng thêm chi phí và phức tạp.

❌ Use an SQS FIFO queue to manage the messages.

→ FIFO đắt hơn Standard và không cần thiết khi yêu cầu chỉ là cost-effective (câu hỏi chỉ nói Standard queue).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

SQS tiết kiệm chi phí = Long polling + Batch processing.

📖 Reference:

Amazon SQS short and long polling

Amazon SQS batch actions

questions.q:
A development team is designing a mobile app that requires multi-factor authentication.

Which steps should be taken to achieve this? (Choose two.)
o: Use Amazon Cognito to create a user pool and create users in the user pool.
Send multi-factor authentication text codes to users with the Amazon SNS Publish API call in the app code.
Enable multi-factor authentication for the Amazon Cognito user pool.
Use AWS IAM to create IAM users.
Enable multifactor authentication for the users created in AWS IAM.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App mobile cần multi-factor authentication (MFA) cho người dùng cuối.

  • Yêu cầu: chọn các bước phù hợp để triển khai MFA.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon Cognito to create a user pool and create users in the user pool.

→ Cognito user pool quản lý user identity cho app (sign up/sign in).

Enable multi-factor authentication for the Amazon Cognito user pool.

→ Cognito hỗ trợ MFA (SMS, TOTP) tích hợp sẵn, chỉ cần bật trong user pool settings.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Send multi-factor authentication text codes to users with the Amazon SNS Publish API call in the app code.

→ Không cần tự code bằng SNS; Cognito tự quản lý gửi SMS/TOTP khi bật MFA.

❌ Use AWS IAM to create IAM users.

→ IAM users dành cho quản trị AWS resources, không dành cho end-user của ứng dụng.

❌ Enable multifactor authentication for the users created in AWS IAM.

→ MFA trong IAM là cho người quản trị AWS account, không áp dụng cho mobile app end-users.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

App end-users → Cognito user pool.

📖 Reference:

Amazon Cognito MFA and verification

questions.q:
A company is launching a photo sharing application on AWS. Users use the application to upload images to an Amazon S3 bucket. When users upload images, an AWS Lambda function creates thumbnail versions of the images and stores the thumbnail versions in another S3 bucket.

During development, a developer notices that the Lambda function takes more than 2 minutes to complete the thumbnail process. The company needs alll images to be processed in less than 30 seconds.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Increase the virtual CPUs (vCPUs) for the Lambda function to use 10 vCPUs.
Change Lambda function instance type to use m6a.4xlarge.
Configure the Lambda function to increase the amount of memory.
Configure burstable performance for the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chia sẻ ảnh: user upload lên S3.

  • Lambda tạo thumbnail và lưu sang S3 khác.

  • Hiện tại xử lý > 2 phút; yêu cầu < 30 giây mỗi ảnh.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the Lambda function to increase the amount of memory.

Tăng memory trong Lambda sẽ tăng tương ứng CPU & network → rút ngắn thời gian xử lý ảnh (thumbnail).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the virtual CPUs (vCPUs) for the Lambda function to use 10 vCPUs.

→ Lambda không cấu hình trực tiếp số vCPU; CPU scale theo memory.

❌ Change Lambda function instance type to use m6a.4xlarge.

→ Lambda không có instance type như EC2.

❌ Configure burstable performance for the Lambda function.

→ Không có cấu hình “burstable performance” trong Lambda; hiệu năng phụ thuộc memory (kéo theo CPU/throughput).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Tăng memory → tăng CPU/network trong Lambda → cách nhanh nhất để giảm thời gian xử lý.

📖 Reference:

Configure Lambda function memory

questions.q:
A developer has an application that uses AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS). The application calls the STS AssumeRole API operation to provide trusted users with temporary security credentials. The application calls AWS STS at the service's default endpoint: https://sts.amazonaws.com.

The application is deployed in an Asia Pacific AWS Region. The application is experiencing errors that are related to intermittent latency when the application calls AWS STS.

What should the developer do to resolve this issue?
o: Update the application to use the GetSessionToken API operation.
Update the application to use the AssumeRoleWithSAML API operation.
Update the application to use a Regional STS endpoint that is closer to the application deployment.
Update the application to use the AssumeRoleWithWebldentity API operation. Move the STS endpoint to a global endpoint.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng AWS STS gọi AssumeRole qua global endpoint https://sts.amazonaws.com.

  • App deploy ở Asia Pacific Region và gặp độ trễ ngắt quãng khi gọi STS.

  • Cần khắc phục latency.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Update the application to use a Regional STS endpoint that is closer to the application deployment.

→ Dùng Regional STS endpoint (ví dụ https://sts.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com) để giảm độ trễ và không phụ thuộc mạng đến STS global endpoint.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update the application to use the GetSessionToken API operation.

→ Thay API không giải quyết vấn đề latency mạng tới endpoint.

❌ Update the application to use the AssumeRoleWithSAML API operation.

→ Đổi sang SAML không liên quan đến vị trí endpoint hay độ trễ.

❌ Update the application to use the AssumeRoleWithWebldentity API operation. Move the STS endpoint to a global endpoint.

→ Vẫn là global endpoint → không giảm latency; đổi API không giúp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Luôn dùng Regional STS endpoints gần nơi workload chạy để giảm latency và tăng resilience.

📖 Reference:

AWS STS Regions and endpoints

How to use Regional AWS STS endpoints

questions.q:
A developer is building a three-tier application with an Application Load Balancer (ALB), Amazon EC2 instances, and Amazon RDS. There is an alias record in Amazon Route 53 that points to the ALB. When the developer tries to access the ALB from a laptop, the request times out.

Which logs should the developer investigate to verify that the request is reaching the AWS network?
o: VPC Flow Logs
Amazon Route 53 logs
AWS Systems Manager Agent logs
Amazon CloudWatch agent logs
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App 3-tier: ALB + EC2 + RDS.

  • Có Route 53 alias record trỏ tới ALB.

  • Khi truy cập ALB từ laptop thì timeout.

  • Hỏi: cần check log nào để xác minh request có vào AWS network không?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

VPC Flow Logs

  • VPC Flow Logs ghi lại thông tin về IP traffic in/out trong VPC.

  • Nếu request tới ALB thực sự vào VPC, ta sẽ thấy record trong Flow Logs. Đây là cách để biết request có tới AWS network hay chưa.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Amazon Route 53 logs

→ Route 53 có DNS query logging, chỉ log truy vấn DNS, không cho biết request có tới ALB/VPC hay chưa.

❌ AWS Systems Manager Agent logs

→ Liên quan đến Systems Manager agent trên EC2, không theo dõi traffic tới ALB.

❌ Amazon CloudWatch agent logs

→ CloudWatch agent log metrics/process trên instance, không log network traffic inbound tới ALB.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Debug request vào VPC chưa → check VPC Flow Logs

📖 Reference:

VPC Flow Logs – Capture IP traffic information

questions.q:
A company is hosting an Amazon AP! Gateway REST API that calls a single AWS Lambda function. The function is infrequently invoked by multiple clients at the same time.

The code performance is optimal, but the company wants to optimize the startup time of the function

What can a developer do to optimize the initialization of the function?
o: Enable API Gateway caching for the REST API.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
Use Lambda proxy integration for the REST API.
Configure AWS Global Accelerator for the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway REST API → gọi 1 Lambda.

  • Lambda ít khi được invoke, nhưng khi có thì nhiều client gọi cùng lúc.

  • Code chạy nhanh, nhưng công ty muốn giảm startup time (tức giảm cold start).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.

Provisioned Concurrency giữ cho một số instance Lambda luôn warm, loại bỏ cold start → tối ưu startup time khi nhiều client invoke đồng thời.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Enable API Gateway caching for the REST API.

→ Caching ở API Gateway giảm call tới Lambda khi request giống nhau, nhưng không giảm cold start.

❌ Use Lambda proxy integration for the REST API.

→ Proxy integration chỉ thay đổi cách API Gateway truyền input/output, không ảnh hưởng startup Lambda.

❌ Configure AWS Global Accelerator for the Lambda function.

→ Global Accelerator giúp tối ưu routing toàn cầu, không giảm cold start của Lambda.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cold start → khắc phục bằng Provisioned Concurrency.

📖 Reference:

Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function

questions.q:
An application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances stores data in an Amazon S3 bucket. All the data must be encrypted in transit.

How can a developer ensure that all traffic to the S3 bucket is encrypted?
o: Install certificates on the EC2 instances.
Create a private VPC endpoint.
Configure the S3 bucket with server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS).
Create an S3 bucket policy that denies traffic when the value for the aws:SecureTransport condition key is false.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EC2, lưu data vào S3 bucket.

  • Yêu cầu: tất cả traffic đến S3 phải được mã hóa khi truyền (in transit).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an S3 bucket policy that denies traffic when the value for the aws:SecureTransport condition key is false.

→ Dùng bucket policy với aws:SecureTransport để deny mọi request không dùng HTTPS. Điều này đảm bảo mã hóa in-transit.

{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [{
        "Sid": "RestrictToTLSRequestsOnly",
        "Action": "s3:*",
        "Effect": "Deny",
        "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket",
            "arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket/*"
        ],
        "Condition": {
            "Bool": {
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
            }
        },
        "Principal": "*"
    }]
}

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install certificates on the EC2 instances.

→ Cài cert lên EC2 chỉ giúp instance dùng HTTPS, nhưng không enforce bắt buộc cho S3 bucket.

❌ Create a private VPC endpoint.

→ VPC endpoint cho truy cập private tới S3, nhưng không đảm bảo encryption in-transit (vẫn cần policy enforce HTTPS).

❌ Configure the S3 bucket with server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS).

→ SSE-KMS = mã hóa at rest, không phải in-transit.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • In-transit encryption = enforce HTTPS → bucket policy với aws:SecureTransport.

  • At-rest encryption = SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, hoặc CSE.

📖 Reference:

Amazon S3 Bucket Policy for HTTPS-only access

questions.q:
An Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream is receiving customer data that contains personally identifiable information. A developer needs to remove pattern-based customer identifiers from the data and store the modified data in an Amazon S3 bucket.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Implement Kinesis Data Firehose data transformation as an AWS Lambda function. Configure the function to remove the customer identifiers. Set an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery stream.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Set the EC2 instance as the destination of the delivery stream. Run an application on the EC2 instance to remove the customer identifiers. Store the transformed data in an Amazon S3 bucket.

Create an Amazon OpenSearch Service instance. Set the OpenSearch Service instance as the destination of the delivery stream. Use search and replace to remove the customer identifiers. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to remove the customer identifiers. As the last step in the workflow, store the transformed data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set the workflow as the destination of the delivery stream.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Kinesis Data Firehose nhận customer data có PII.

  • Cần remove pattern-based identifiers rồi lưu data vào S3 bucket.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Implement Kinesis Data Firehose data transformation as an AWS Lambda function. Configure the function to remove the customer identifiers. Set an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery stream.

→ Firehose hỗ trợ data transformation bằng Lambda trước khi ghi xuống đích (S3, Redshift, OpenSearch).

→ Đây là cách chuẩn, serverless & managed, phù hợp để xử lý PII.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Set the EC2 instance as the destination of the delivery stream. Run an application on the EC2 instance to remove the customer identifiers. Store the transformed data in an Amazon S3 bucket.

→ Không tối ưu, tốn chi phí quản lý EC2. Firehose không hỗ trợ trực tiếp EC2 làm destination.

❌ Create an Amazon OpenSearch Service instance. Set the OpenSearch Service instance as the destination of the delivery stream. Use search and replace to remove the customer identifiers. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

→ OpenSearch không phải công cụ để clean data trước khi lưu; phức tạp không cần thiết.

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions workflow to remove the customer identifiers. As the last step in the workflow, store the transformed data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set the workflow as the destination of the delivery stream.

→ Firehose không thể gửi trực tiếp vào Step Functions workflow; phải dùng Lambda transformation.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Firehose → Lambda transform → S3 là mô hình chuẩn để xử lý dữ liệu (masking/redaction) trước khi lưu trữ.

📖 Reference:

Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose

Redact sensitive data from streaming data in near-real time using Amazon Comprehend and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose

questions.q:
A developer is writing a mobile application that allows users to view images from an S3 bucket. The users must be able to log in with their Amazon login, as well as supported social media accounts.

How can the developer provide this authentication functionality?
o: Use Amazon Cognito with web identity federation.
Use Amazon Cognito with SAML-based identity federation.
Use IAM access keys and secret keys in the application code to allow Get* on the S3 bucket.
Use AWS STS AssumeRole in the application code and assume a role with Get* permissions on the S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App mobile cho user xem ảnh trong S3 bucket.

  • User có thể login bằng Amazon login hoặc social media accounts (Facebook, Google, Apple ID, …).

  • Cần giải pháp xác thực phù hợp.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon Cognito with web identity federation.

Cognito User Pool hỗ trợ federation với social IdPs (Google, Facebook, Amazon login).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon Cognito with SAML-based identity federation.

→ SAML federation thường áp dụng cho enterprise IdPs (ADFS, Okta), không dùng cho social login.

❌ Use IAM access keys and secret keys in the application code to allow Get* on the S3 bucket.

→ Không bao giờ nhúng IAM credentials trong app client → mất an toàn bảo mật.

❌ Use AWS STS AssumeRole in the application code and assume a role with Get* permissions on the S3 bucket.

→ App không thể trực tiếp AssumeRole, cần Cognito làm trung gian cấp temporary credentials.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Social logins / Amazon login → dùng Cognito User Pool (federation).

📖 Reference:

Using social identity providers with a user pool

questions.q:
Two containerized microservices are hosted on Amazon EC2 ECS. The first microservice reads an Amazon RDS Aurora database instance, and the second microservice reads an Amazon DynamoDB table.

How can each microservice be granted the minimum privileges?
o: Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE to false on EC2 instance boot in ECS agent configuration file. Run the first microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access for the Aurora database. Run the second microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access to DynamoDB.
Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM ROLE to false on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Grant the instance profile role read-only access to the Aurora database and DynamoDB.

Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM ROLE to true on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Run the first microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access for the Aurora database. Run the second microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access to DynamoDB.
Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE to true on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Grant the instance profile role read-only access to the Aurora database and DynamoDB.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Có 2 microservice chạy trên Amazon ECS (EC2 launch type):

  • Service 1: đọc Aurora RDS.

  • Service 2: đọc DynamoDB.

  • Yêu cầu: cấp ít quyền nhất (least privilege).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM ROLE to true on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Run the first microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access for the Aurora database. Run the second microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access to DynamoDB.

  • Bật ECS task IAM roles (ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE=true) để mỗi task có role riêng với đúng quyền cần.

  • Microservice 1 có IAM role chỉ đọc Aurora; Microservice 2 có IAM role chỉ đọc DynamoDB → đúng principle of least privilege.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE to false on EC2 instance boot in ECS agent configuration file. Run the first microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access for the Aurora database. Run the second microservice with an IAM role for ECS tasks with read-only access to DynamoDB.

Nếu tắt task IAM role, không thể gán quyền riêng cho từng microservice.

❌ Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM ROLE to false on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Grant the instance profile role read-only access to the Aurora database and DynamoDB.

Instance profile role dùng chung cho cả 2 service → không tách biệt được quyền, vi phạm least privilege.

❌ Set ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE to true on EC2 instance boot in the ECS agent configuration file. Grant the instance profile role read-only access to the Aurora database and DynamoDB.

Dù bật task IAM role, nhưng vẫn cấp quyền cho instance profile role chung → cả 2 microservice đều có quyền thừa.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • ECS tasks IAM roles → gán đúng quyền theo từng task/container.

  • Instance profile role → dùng cho ECS agent, không nên cấp quyền ứng dụng.

📖 Reference:

Amazon ECS task IAM role

questions.q:
A company has an application that processes audio files for different departments. When audio files are saved to an Amazon S3 bucket, an AWS Lambda function receives an event notification and processes the audio input.

A developer needs to update the solution so that the application can process the audio files for each department independently. The application must publish the audio file location for each department to each department's existing Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

Which solution will meet these requirements with no changes to the Lambda function code?
o: Configure the S3 bucket to send the event notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe each department’s SQS queue to the SNS topic. Configure subscription filter policies.
Update the Lambda function to write the file location to a single shared SQS queue. Configure the shared SQS queue to send the file reference to each department’s SQS queue.
Update the Lambda function to send the file location to each department’s SQS queue.
Configure the S3 bucket to send the event notifications to each department’s SQS queue.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App xử lý audio file trong S3 bucket.

  • Lambda function nhận event notification và xử lý audio.

  • Yêu cầu: mỗi department phải nhận event độc lập qua SQS queue riêng.

  • Không được thay đổi code Lambda.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the S3 bucket to send the event notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe each department’s SQS queue to the SNS topic. Configure subscription filter policies.

  • S3 gửi event → SNS topic.

  • Các SQS queues (mỗi department) subscribe vào topic.

  • SNS filter policies đảm bảo mỗi department chỉ nhận file location liên quan đến mình.

  • Giải pháp này không cần chỉnh sửa Lambda code.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update the Lambda function to write the file location to a single shared SQS queue. Configure the shared SQS queue to send the file reference to each department’s SQS queue.

Yêu cầu thay đổi code Lambda → vi phạm đề.

❌ Update the Lambda function to send the file location to each department’s SQS queue.

Cũng phải chỉnh code Lambda → không đúng.

❌ Configure the S3 bucket to send the event notifications to each department’s SQS queue.

S3 bucket chỉ hỗ trợ giới hạn số notification configuration; khó quản lý khi nhiều queue. Không linh hoạt bằng SNS fan-out với filter.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Muốn fan-out event từ S3 tới nhiều consumer → S3 → SNS → SQS queues.

  • Thêm filter policies để mỗi department chỉ nhận message phù hợp.

questions.q:
A developer needs to configure an AWS Lambda function to make HTTP POST requests to an internal application. The application is in the same AWS account that hosts the function. The internal application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet within a VPC.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure a VPC endpoint to connect to the private subnet. Attach the endpoint to the Lambda function.
Attach the Lambda function to the VPC and to the private subnet.
Configure a VPN connection between the Lambda function and the private subnet. Attach the VPN to the Lambda function.
Configure the VPC route table to include the Lambda function’s IP address.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần gửi HTTP POST đến internal app chạy trên EC2.

  • App nằm trong private subnet trong VPC (không public).

  • Lambda và app cùng AWS account.

  • Hỏi: giải pháp nào cho Lambda truy cập private subnet?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Attach the Lambda function to the VPC and to the private subnet.

→ Khi gắn Lambda vào VPC + private subnet, Lambda có thể trực tiếp truy cập resource trong VPC (EC2, RDS, app nội bộ).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a VPC endpoint to connect to the private subnet. Attach the endpoint to the Lambda function.

→ VPC endpoint dùng để private connect tới AWS services (S3, DynamoDB), không dùng để kết nối tới EC2 trong private subnet.

❌ Configure a VPN connection between the Lambda function and the private subnet. Attach the VPN to the Lambda function.

→ VPN không cần thiết, vì Lambda và EC2 cùng trong AWS account và VPC.

❌ Configure the VPC route table to include the Lambda function’s IP address.

→ Route table không thể thêm Lambda IP trực tiếp (Lambda IP ephemeral, thay đổi mỗi lần).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda muốn nói chuyện với resource private (EC2, RDS) → attach vào VPC + subnet.

questions.q:
An AWS Lambda function that handles application requests uses the default Lambda logging mechanism to log the timestamp, processing time, and status of requests.

A developer needs to create Amazon CloudWatch metrics based on the logs. The developer needs to write the metrics to a custom CloudWatch metrics namespace.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate custom metrics from the logs by using CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF).
Use Amazon CloudWatch RUM to generate custom metrics from the logs by using CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF).
Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate custom metrics from the logs by using JSON format.
Use the CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF) for the structure of the log statements to generate custom CloudWatch metrics.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda dùng default logging (CloudWatch Logs).

  • Dev cần tạo custom CloudWatch metrics từ logs.

  • Metrics phải được ghi vào custom namespace.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF) for the structure of the log statements to generate custom CloudWatch metrics.

Nếu app log theo EMF format, CloudWatch Logs sẽ tự động trích xuất → tạo custom metrics trong namespace tùy chọn, không cần job ngoài.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate custom metrics from the logs by using CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF).

→ Logs Insights chỉ để query logs, không tự động publish metrics từ EMF.

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch RUM to generate custom metrics from the logs by using CloudWatch embedded metric format (EMF).

→ RUM (Real User Monitoring) chỉ dành cho frontend web app metrics, không liên quan đến Lambda logs.

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to generate custom metrics from the logs by using JSON format.

→ JSON query được logs nhưng không biến thành custom metrics trong namespace.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

EMF (Embedded Metric Format) = cách nhúng metric trực tiếp vào log → CloudWatch tự publish metrics.

📖 Reference:

CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format (EMF)

Lowering costs and focusing on our customers with Amazon CloudWatch embedded custom metrics

questions.q:
A developer has deployed an AWS Lambda function that is subscribed to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The developer must implement a solution to add a record of each Lambda function invocation to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Configure the SQS queue as a dead-letter queue for the Lambda function.
Create code that uses the AWS SDK to call the SQS SendMessage operation to add the invocation details to the SQS queue. Add the code to the end of the Lambda function.

Add two asynchronous invocation destinations to the Lambda function: one destination for successful invocations and one destination for failed invocations. Configure the SQS queue as the destination for each type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm based on the DestinationDeliveryFailures metric to catch any message that cannot be delivered.

Add a single asynchronous invocation destination to the Lambda function to capture successful invocations. Configure the SQS queue as the destination. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm based on the DestinationDeliveryFailures metric to catch any message that cannot be delivered.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda được subscribe SNS topic.

  • Yêu cầu: mỗi lần Lambda được invoke → phải ghi lại record vào SQS queue.

  • Muốn giải pháp native, ít code nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a single asynchronous invocation destination to the Lambda function to capture successful invocations. Configure the SQS queue as the destination. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm based on the DestinationDeliveryFailures metric to catch any message that cannot be delivered.

  • Lambda hỗ trợ asynchronous invocation destinations.

  • Có thể gửi metadata (request ID, payload, status) tới SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Lambda.

  • Chỉ cần destination cho thành công là đủ để log invocation → lưu vào SQS queue.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the SQS queue as a dead-letter queue for the Lambda function.

→ DLQ chỉ nhận event gốc chưa xử lý khi Lambda fail → không log được mọi invocation.

❌ Create code that uses the AWS SDK to call the SQS SendMessage operation to add the invocation details to the SQS queue. Add the code to the end of the Lambda function.

→ Làm được, nhưng cần chỉnh sửa code → không tối ưu, tăng độ phức tạp.

❌ Add two asynchronous invocation destinations to the Lambda function: one destination for successful invocations and one destination for failed invocations. Configure the SQS queue as the destination for each type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm based on the DestinationDeliveryFailures metric to catch any message that cannot be delivered.

→ Không cần tạo cả 2 (success + fail) nếu chỉ yêu cầu ghi lại invocation. Chỉ cần log success là đủ.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn log metadata của Lambda invocation → dùng asynchronous destinations thay vì tự code hoặc DLQ.

📖 Reference:

Lambda destinations – Asynchronous invocation

questions.q:
A developer is building a three-tier web application that should be able to handle a minimum of 5000 requests per minute. Requirements state that the web tier should be completely stateless while the application maintains session state for the users.

How can session data be externalized, keeping latency at the LOWEST possible value?
o: Create an Amazon RDS instance, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage a database inside the RDS database instance for session data storage.

Implement a shared file system solution across the underlying Amazon EC2 instances, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the shared file system for session data storage.
Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached) cluster, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the cluster for session data storage.
Create an Amazon DynamoDB table, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the table for session data storage.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App 3-tier, tối thiểu 5000 requests/minute.

  • Web tier phải stateless, nhưng vẫn cần duy trì session state cho user.

  • Yêu cầu: latency thấp nhất khi lưu session.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Memcached) cluster, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the cluster for session data storage.

ElastiCache (Memcached/Redis) là in-memory cache, cực nhanh, latency microseconds → lựa chọn tốt nhất cho hiệu năng session management.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon RDS instance, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage a database inside the RDS database instance for session data storage.

→ RDS có độ trễ cao hơn (millisecond), không tối ưu cho session storage.

❌ Implement a shared file system solution across the underlying Amazon EC2 instances, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the shared file system for session data storage.

→ Shared file system (EFS, etc.) có độ trễ cao, không thiết kế cho session handling, dễ bottleneck.

❌ Create an Amazon DynamoDB table, then implement session handling at the application level to leverage the table for session data storage.

→ DynamoDB nhanh (ms-level), nhưng vẫn chậm hơn in-memory cache. Không phải lựa chọn tối ưu latency cho session.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

lowest-latency session store → ElastiCache.

📖 Reference:

Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache

questions.q:
A developer has code that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The code must be deployed as an AWS Lambda function across multiple accounts in the same AWS Region as the S3 bucket. An AWS CloudFormation template that runs for each account will deploy the Lambda function.

What is the MOST secure way to allow CloudFormation to access the Lambda code in the S3 bucket?
o: Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “AWS”: [account numbers].
Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 GetObject permission. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “*”.
Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions by explicitly adding the S3 bucket’s account number in the resource.
Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 GetObject permission. Add a resource of “*” to allow access to the S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Cần triển khai code Lambda (lưu trong S3) sang nhiều accounts nhưng cùng 1 Region.

  • Mỗi tài khoản chạy CloudFormation để tạo Lambda.

  • Hỏi cách an toàn nhất để CloudFormation/Lambda truy cập code trong S3.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “AWS”: [account numbers].

→ Dùng bucket policy của S3 cấp quyền cho CloudFormation giới hạn theo account ID giúp kiểm soát truy cập cross-accounts ở mức tối thiểu cần thiết.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Grant the CloudFormation service role the S3 GetObject permission. Add a bucket policy to Amazon S3 with the principal of “*”.

Dùng principal * mở quyền cho mọi principal → không an toàn

❌ Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 ListBucket and GetObject permissions by explicitly adding the S3 bucket’s account number in the resource.

Quyền cần thiết là cho CloudFormation để lấy code khi tạo Lambda, không phải cấp cho Lambda function → cấp cho sai principal (Lambda thay vì CloudFormation)

❌ Use a service-based link to grant the Lambda function the S3 GetObject permission. Add a resource of “*” to allow access to the S3 bucket.

Vừa cấp cho sai principal (Lambda thay vì CloudFormation), vừa dùng Resource * mở rộng quá mức → không an toàn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cross-account S3 access cho CFN/CodePackage → Bucket policy chỉ rõ Principal = account IDs/role ARNs và Action tối thiểu (thường s3:GetObject; s3:ListBucket chỉ khi pipeline cần list).

questions.q:
A company is building a social media application. A developer is modifying an AWS Lambda function that updates a database with data that tracks each user's online activity. A web application server uses the AWS SDK to invoke the Lambda function.

The developer has tested the new Lambda code and is ready to deploy the code into production. However, the developer wants to allow only a small percentage of the invocations from the AWS SDK to call the new code.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure a Lambda version that has a specific weight value for the updated Lambda function.
Create an alias for the Lambda function. Configure a specific weight value for the updated version.
Create an Application Load Balancer. Specify weighted target groups for the original Lambda function and the updated Lambda function.
Create a Network Load Balancer. Specify weighted target groups for the original Lambda function and the updated Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App social media, Lambda function update database user activity.

  • Dev đã test code mới, muốn triển khai dần → chỉ cho một phần nhỏ request chạy vào code mới (canary/weighted traffic shifting).

  • Invoke Lambda qua AWS SDK.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an alias for the Lambda function. Configure a specific weight value for the updated version.

  • Dùng Lambda alias để trỏ đến nhiều version với tỉ lệ traffic khác nhau (weighted routing).

  • Cách này cho phép 1 phần request chạy code mới, còn lại chạy code cũ → đáp ứng yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a Lambda version that has a specific weight value for the updated Lambda function.

→ Weight chỉ được gán cho alias, không trực tiếp cho version.

❌ Create an Application Load Balancer. Specify weighted target groups for the original Lambda function and the updated Lambda function.

→ ALB có thể invoke Lambda, nhưng weighted routing ở ALB là giữa target group khác nhau, không dùng để traffic shifting giữa Lambda versions.

❌ Create a Network Load Balancer. Specify weighted target groups for the original Lambda function and the updated Lambda function.

→ NLB không invoke Lambda trực tiếp, và không dùng cho weighted Lambda versions.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Weighted alias = cách native để triển khai canary/linear deploy cho Lambda.

📖 Reference:

Building well-architected serverless applications: Approaching application lifecycle management

questions.q:
An AWS Lambda function generates a 3 MB JSON file and then uploads it to an Amazon S3 bucket daily. The file contains sensitive information, so the developer must ensure that it is encrypted before uploading to the bucket.

Which of the following modifications should the developer make to ensure that the data is encrypted before uploading it to the bucket?
o: Use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for Amazon S3 in the Lambda function code.
Use the S3 managed key and call the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file.
Use the GenerateDataKey API, then use that data key to encrypt the file in the Lambda function code.
Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key for Amazon S3 in the Lambda function code.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda tạo file JSON 3 MB mỗi ngày, upload lên S3 bucket.

  • File có sensitive info → phải mã hóa trước khi upload.

  • Hỏi: sửa code Lambda thế nào để đảm bảo encrypt before upload.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the GenerateDataKey API, then use that data key to encrypt the file in the Lambda function code.
