  • GenerateDataKey tạo data key (plaintext + encrypted).

  • App (Lambda) dùng plaintext key để mã hóa file trước khi upload (client-side encryption).

  • Sau đó upload file đã mã hóa lên S3 → đảm bảo dữ liệu được encrypt trước khi rời Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for Amazon S3 in the Lambda function code.

→ Đây là SSE-S3/SSE-KMS (server-side encryption), dữ liệu được mã hóa sau khi vào S3, không phải “before uploading”.

❌ Use the S3 managed key and call the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file.

→ GenerateDataKey chỉ làm việc với KMS keys, không phải với S3 managed key (SSE-S3).

❌ Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key for Amazon S3 in the Lambda function code.

→ Vẫn là SSE-KMS (server-side encryption), dữ liệu mã hóa khi lưu vào S3, không đảm bảo client-side encryption.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Encrypt before upload (client-side) → dùng KMS GenerateDataKey.

  • Encrypt after upload (server-side) → dùng SSE-S3, SSE-KMS.

📖 Reference:

Generate data keys

Client-side encryption with AWS KMS

questions.q:
A developer has a legacy application that is hosted on-premises. Other applications hosted on AWS depend on the on-premises application for proper functioning. In case of any application errors, the developer wants to be able to use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor and troubleshoot all applications from one place.
How can the developer accomplish this?
o: Install an AWS SDK on the on-premises server to automatically send logs to CloudWatch.
Download the CloudWatch agent to the on-premises server. Configure the agent to use IAM user credentials with permissions for CloudWatch.
Upload log files from the on-premises server to Amazon S3 and have CloudWatch read the files.
Upload log files from the on-premises server to an Amazon EC2 instance and have the instance forward the logs to CloudWatch.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Legacy app chạy on-premises.

  • App khác chạy trên AWS phụ thuộc vào app này.

  • Muốn dùng CloudWatch để monitor/troubleshoot tập trung tất cả logs.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Download the CloudWatch agent to the on-premises server. Configure the agent to use IAM user credentials with permissions for CloudWatch.

  • CloudWatch agent có thể cài on-premises hoặc EC2, forward log/metrics trực tiếp lên CloudWatch.

  • Đây là cách chính thống để đưa log từ on-prem lên AWS CloudWatch.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install an AWS SDK on the on-premises server to automatically send logs to CloudWatch.

→ AWS SDK không tự động gửi log lên CloudWatch; cần agent hoặc code custom.

❌ Upload log files from the on-premises server to Amazon S3 and have CloudWatch read the files.

→ CloudWatch không tự đọc log từ S3; cần thêm pipeline (Kinesis/Firehose/Subscription).

❌ Upload log files from the on-premises server to an Amazon EC2 instance and have the instance forward the logs to CloudWatch.

→ Làm được nhưng phức tạp, không tối ưu bằng CloudWatch agent trực tiếp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn log on-prem → CloudWatch → cài CloudWatch agent.

📖 Reference:

CloudWatch agent on-premises

questions.q:
A gaming company has deployed a web portal on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. The company sometimes needs to deploy new versions three or four times in a day. The company needs to deploy new features for all users as quickly as possible. The solution must minimize performance impact and must maximize availability.

What solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use a rolling deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.
Use an immutable deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.
Use an all-at-once deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.
Use a-canary deployment strategy to deploy changes to Amazon EC2 instances.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Web portal chạy trên Elastic Beanstalk.

  • Yêu cầu: deploy nhiều lần/ngày, rollout nhanh, ít ảnh hưởng performance, tối đa availability.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use an immutable deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.

  • Immutable = Elastic Beanstalk tạo new instances với version mới, gắn vào environment sau khi sẵn sàng, rồi terminate instances cũ.

  • zero downtime, ít ảnh hưởng performance, an toàn rollback.

  • Phù hợp khi cần triển khai nhiều lần/ngày.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use a rolling deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.

→ Rolling update sẽ update từng batch instance → gây giảm capacity tạm thời, ảnh hưởng performance.

❌ Use an all-at-once deployment policy to deploy to Amazon EC2 instances.

→ Nhanh nhất nhưng downtime toàn bộ environment → không đáp ứng yêu cầu availability.

❌ Use a-canary deployment strategy to deploy changes to Amazon EC2 instances.

→ Canary (Traffic splitting) = dùng được, nhưng vẫn có rủi ro performance tạm thời khi chia traffic.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Immutable = best choice khi cần nhiều lần deploy/ngày + đảm bảo availability.

📖 Reference:

Elastic Beanstalk Deployment Policies

questions.q:
A developer is troubleshooting the permissions of an application that needs to make changes to an Amazon RDS database. The developer has access to the IAM role that the application is using.

Which command structure should the developer use to test the role permissions?
o: aws sts assume-role
aws iam attach-role-policy
aws ssm resume-session
aws rds add-role-to-db-cluster
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App cần thay đổi dữ liệu trong Amazon RDS.

  • Dev có quyền truy cập vào IAM role mà app đang dùng.

  • Dev muốn test permission của role đó.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

aws sts assume-role

  • Dùng STS AssumeRole để tạm thời nhận credential của role → test chính xác quyền của role.

  • Sau khi assume role, dev có thể chạy các lệnh RDS để kiểm tra permission.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ aws iam attach-role-policy

→ Dùng để gắn thêm policy vào role, không phải để test role.

❌ aws ssm resume-session

→ Liên quan tới Session Manager để connect instance, không dùng test IAM role.

❌ aws rds add-role-to-db-cluster

→ Gán role cho RDS cluster, không dùng để assume/test role permission.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn test role permission → dùng aws sts assume-role để có temporary credentials.

📖 Reference:

AssumeRole

questions.q:
A developer has implemented an AWS Lambda function that inserts new customers into an Amazon RDS database. The function is expected to run hundreds of times each hour. The function and RDS database are in the same VPC. The function is configured to use 512 MB of RAM and is based on the following pseudo code:

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    db = database.connect()
    db.statement("INSERT INTO Customers (CustomerName) VALUES (%s)")
    db.execute(event.name)
    db.close()

After successfully testing the function multiple times, the developer notices that the execution time is longer than expected.

What should the developer do to improve performance?
o: Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function.
Increase the size of the RDS database to facilitate an increased number of database connections each hour.
Move the database connection and close statement out of the handler. Place the connection in the global space.
Replace Amazon RDS with Amazon DynamoDB to implement control over the number of writes per second.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda chèn record vào RDS nhiều lần/giờ.

  • Code hiện tại: mỗi lần invoke → connect → insert → close.

  • Quan sát: execution time lâu hơn mong đợi.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Move the database connection and close statement out of the handler. Place the connection in the global space.

Đặt connection ở global scope để Lambda reuse connection giữa các invocations (trong cùng execution environment) → Giảm latency đáng kể.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function.

→ Concurrency không giúp giảm latency của mỗi invocation, chỉ giúp handle nhiều request cùng lúc.

❌ Increase the size of the RDS database to facilitate an increased number of database connections each hour.

→ Không phải bottleneck DB size, mà do overhead kết nối DB nhiều lần.

❌ Replace Amazon RDS with Amazon DynamoDB to implement control over the number of writes per second.

→ Thay đổi kiến trúc quá lớn, không cần thiết. Vấn đề là kết nối, không phải throughput RDS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Với Lambda + RDS: connection pooling/reuse cực quan trọng.

📖 Reference:

Reuse of database connections by a lambda

questions.q:
A developer is updating the code for an AWS Lambda function to add new capabilities. The Lambda function has version aliases for production and development environments that run separate versions of the function. The developer needs to configure a staging environment for the Lambda function to handle invocations to both the development version and the production version.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a weighted alias that references the production version of the function and the updated version of the function.
Add a Network Load Balancer. Add the production version of the function and updated version of the function as targets.
Use AWS CodeDeploy to create a linear traffic shifting deployment.
Create a tag for the Lambda function that contains the production version and updated version of the code.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer đang update code cho Lambda function.

  • Lambda function có alias cho production và development (chạy version khác nhau).

  • Cần tạo staging environment để test invocations cho cả dev và prod version.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a weighted alias that references the production version of the function and the updated version of the function.

→ Lambda alias có thể cấu hình weighted traffic để route một phần request sang version mới và phần còn lại sang version hiện tại.

→ Đây là cách native để tạo staging environment trong Lambda.

→ Cho phép kiểm thử trước khi rollout full cho production.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a Network Load Balancer. Add the production version of the function and updated version of the function as targets.

→ Lambda không tích hợp trực tiếp với NLB cho việc routing weighted traffic.

→ Sai mục đích, overhead cao.

❌ Use AWS CodeDeploy to create a linear traffic shifting deployment.

→ CodeDeploy dùng để triển khai rollout Lambda versions sang production (blue/green, linear, canary).

→ Không tạo staging environment để test song song dev + prod.

❌ Create a tag for the Lambda function that contains the production version and updated version of the code.

→ Tag chỉ để metadata, không có chức năng route traffic hoặc tạo môi trường staging.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda alias + weighted traffic = cách tốt nhất để test version mới (canary/staging) trước khi promote.

📖 Reference:

Building well-architected serverless applications: Approaching application lifecycle management

questions.q:
A company is creating a new application that gives users the ability to upload and share short video files. The average size of the video files is 10 MB. After a user uploads a file, a message needs to be placed into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue so the file can be processed. The files need to be accessible for processing within 5 minutes.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Write the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Add the S3 location of the files to the SQS queue.
Write the files to Amazon S3 Standard. Add the S3 location of the files to the SQS queue.
Write the files to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD volume. Add the EBS location of the files to the SQS queue.
Write messages that contain the contents of the uploaded files to the SQS queue.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App cho phép user upload & share video ngắn (~10 MB).

  • Sau khi upload, cần đặt message vào SQS để xử lý.

  • File phải truy cập được để xử lý trong vòng 5 phút.

  • Mục tiêu: tối ưu chi phí.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Write the files to Amazon S3 Standard. Add the S3 location of the files to the SQS queue.

→ S3 Standard truy cập ngay lập tức, phù hợp yêu cầu ≤ 5 phút.

→ Chi phí hợp lý cho workload truy cập thường xuyên, không lock-in thời gian khôi phục.

→ Đặt S3 object key vào SQS để worker tải và xử lý ⇒ nhẹ message, rẻ & đơn giản.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Write the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Add the S3 location of the files to the SQS queue.

→ Glacier Deep Archive cần giờ để restore, không đáp ứng SLA 5 phút. Dùng cho lưu trữ lâu dài, truy cập hiếm.

❌ Write the files to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD volume. Add the EBS location of the files to the SQS queue.

→ EBS gắn với EC2 và AZ-bound, khó chia sẻ đa consumer, tốn kém hơn cho shared processing. Không phù hợp mô hình fan-out qua SQS.

❌ Write messages that contain the contents of the uploaded files to the SQS queue.

→ SQS giới hạn 256 KB/message, không thể chứa file 10 MB. Chi phí cũng không tối ưu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Upload → S3 Standard; Queue → chỉ gửi object key/URL; Worker → get từ S3 để xử lý.

questions.q:
A developer is working on a new authorization mechanism for an application. The developer must create an Amazon API Gateway API and must test JSON Web Token (JWT) authorization on the API.

The developer must use the built-in authorizer and must avoid managing the code with custom logic. The developer needs to define an API route that is available at /auth to test the authorizer configuration.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a WebSocket API and the /auth route. Configure and attach the JWT authorizer to the API. Deploy the API.
Create a WebSocket API and the /auth route. Create and configure an AWS Lambda authorizer. Attach the Lambda authorizer to the API. Deploy the API.
Create an HTTP API and the /auth route. Create and configure an AWS Lambda authorizer. Attach the Lambda authorizer to the /auth route. Deploy the API.
Create an HTTP API and the /auth route. Configure the JWT authorizer. Attach the JWT authorizer to the /auth route. Deploy the API.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần test JWT authorization cho API Gateway.

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Dùng built-in authorizer (không viết custom Lambda).

    • Tạo route /auth để test config.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an HTTP API and the /auth route. Configure the JWT authorizer. Attach the JWT authorizer to the /auth route. Deploy the API.

→ API Gateway HTTP API hỗ trợ native JWT authorizer (OpenID Connect, Amazon Cognito).

→ Chỉ cần tạo route /auth, gán JWT authorizer, rồi deploy.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a WebSocket API and the /auth route. Configure and attach the JWT authorizer to the API. Deploy the API.

WebSocket API không hỗ trợ JWT authorizer (chỉ hỗ trợ Lambda authorizer).

❌ Create a WebSocket API and the /auth route. Create and configure an AWS Lambda authorizer. Attach the Lambda authorizer to the API. Deploy the API.

Dùng Lambda authorizer = custom code → không đúng yêu cầu.

❌ Create an HTTP API and the /auth route. Create and configure an AWS Lambda authorizer. Attach the Lambda authorizer to the /auth route. Deploy the API.

Dùng Lambda authorizer = custom code → không đúng yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

HTTP API = lightweight, cost-effective, có native JWT authorizer.

REST API = không có built-in JWT authorizer (chỉ Lambda/Cognito).

📖 Reference:

How to secure API Gateway HTTP endpoints with JWT authorizer

questions.q:
A developer has an AWS Lambda function that needs to access an Amazon DynamoDB table named DailyOrders. The Lambda function must be able to perform read operations on the table. The Lambda function must not be able to perform write operations on the table.

The developer needs to create an IAM policy to associate with the Lambda function's execution role.

Which IAM policy statement will meet these requirements?
o:
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan",
        "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda cần quyền read-only với bảng DailyOrders.

  • Được phép: GetItem, BatchGetItem, Query, Scan.

  • Không được phép: PutItem, UpdateItem, BatchWriteItem (các thao tác ghi).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

Policy này chỉ cấp quyền đọc dữ liệu (GetItem, BatchGetItem, Query, Scan.)

Các đáp án sai:

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan",
        "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

Bao gồm PutItem, UpdateItem, BatchWriteItem → có quyền ghi.

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:GetItem",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

Có PutItem → vẫn cho phép ghi.

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan",
        "dynamodb:PutItem",
        "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:eu-east-1:321456987012:table/DailyOrders"
    }
  ]
}

Dùng Effect: Deny → chặn quyền đọc luôn (Query, Scan bị Deny). Không đáp ứng yêu cầu “Allow read”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DynamoDB read actions: GetItem, BatchGetItem, Query, Scan.

  • DynamoDB write actions: PutItem, UpdateItem, DeleteItem, BatchWriteItem.

questions.q:
An application that runs on AWS Lambda requires access to specific highly confidential objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In accordance with the principle of least privilege, a company grants access to the S3 bucket by using only temporary credentials.

How can a developer configure access to the S3 bucket in the MOST secure way?
o: Hardcode the credentials that are required to access the S3 objects in the application code. Use the credentials to access the required S3 objects.

Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the Secrets Manager secret and use the credentials to access the S3 objects.
Create a Lambda function execution role. Attach a policy to the role that grants access to specific objects in the S3 bucket.

Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID as environment variables in Lambda. Use the environment variables to access the required S3 objects.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên AWS Lambda cần truy cập các object S3 rất nhạy cảm.

  • Yêu cầu: tuân thủ nguyên tắc least privilege và chỉ dùng temporary credentials.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a Lambda function execution role. Attach a policy to the role that grants access to specific objects in the S3 bucket.

→ Cấp quyền thông qua Role, có Policy giới hạn chỉ cho phép truy cập một số object cụ thể trong bucket.

→ Đây là cách an toàn và chuẩn AWS best practice (không hardcode, không lưu key).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Hardcode the credentials that are required to access the S3 objects in the application code. Use the credentials to access the required S3 objects.

→ Rất mất an toàn, không xoay vòng key, vi phạm best practice.

❌ Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the Secrets Manager secret and use the credentials to access the S3 objects.

→ Chuẩn AWS best practice (không hardcode, không lưu key).

❌ Create a secret access key and access key ID with permission to access the S3 bucket. Store the key and key ID as environment variables in Lambda. Use the environment variables to access the required S3 objects.

→ Chuẩn AWS best practice (không hardcode, không lưu key).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda access to the S3 bucket in the MOST secure way → IAM execution role

questions.q:
A developer is launching a global application that delivers content to multiple countries. The developer needs to serve specific content based on the country of each user and each user’s primary language. The developer must ensure that content is served reliably and with low latency.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator to resolve requests to the API. Configure endpoint groups on the accelerator. Attach listeners for each country and language.

Store the content in a centralized Amazon S3 bucket. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket. Create an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone that includes the endpoint for the S3 bucket. Create records in Route 53 that use geoproximity and geolocation routing policies.

Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Connect the REST API to AWS WAF. Use geo match statements and regex match statements to allow or deny requests based on the labels returned from web request evaluations.

Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the application as an origin. Configure the distribution to forward the Accept-Language header and the CloudFront-Viewer-Country header to the origin.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App global, cần phân phối content đến nhiều quốc gia.

  • Yêu cầu: phục vụ content theo country + primary language của user.

  • Mục tiêu: reliable + low latency.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the application as an origin. Configure the distribution to forward the Accept-Language header and the CloudFront-Viewer-Country header to the origin.

  • CloudFront = CDN toàn cầu, tối ưu latency.

  • Header CloudFront-Viewer-Country cung cấp country của user.

  • Header Accept-Language cung cấp ngôn ngữ của user.

  • Origin có thể xử lý logic dựa trên headers này để trả về content phù hợp.

→ Đây là giải pháp chuẩn, cost-effective và global scale.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator to resolve requests to the API. Configure endpoint groups on the accelerator. Attach listeners for each country and language.

→ Global Accelerator dùng cho TCP/UDP traffic (EC2, ALB, NLB). Không giải quyết được caching content tĩnh & header-based content routing.

❌ Store the content in a centralized Amazon S3 bucket. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket. Create an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone that includes the endpoint for the S3 bucket. Create records in Route 53 that use geoproximity and geolocation routing policies.

→ S3 Transfer Acceleration chỉ giúp tăng tốc upload/download, không hỗ trợ logic theo language.

→ Route 53 geolocation routing chỉ route theo country, không xử lý language header.

❌ Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Connect the REST API to AWS WAF. Use geo match statements and regex match statements to allow or deny requests based on the labels returned from web request evaluations.

→ WAF dùng cho security (allow/deny), không phải để phân phát content dựa trên language & country.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Global app cần phân phát content → CloudFront là default answer.

  • Dựa vào CloudFront-Viewer-Country + Accept-Language để personalize nội dung.

📖 Reference:

Cache content based on request headers

questions.q:
A company has an Amazon DynamoDB table that contains records of users that have signed up for a trial of the company’s product. The company is using a spreadsheet to track data about the product trial. The company needs to ensure the spreadsheet is automatically updated with the latest information when individual trials begin, are updated, or finish.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster from the table. Set the view type to old image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the cluster data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the cluster.

Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster from the table. Set the view type to new image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the cluster data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the cluster.
Enable a DynamoDB stream for the table. Set the view type to new image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the stream data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the stream.
Enable a DynamoDB stream for the table. Set the view type to old image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the stream data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the stream.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table chứa trial user records.

  • Cần update spreadsheet tự động khi record trial start/update/finish.

  • Giải pháp cần trigger real-time update từ DynamoDB → Spreadsheet.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable a DynamoDB stream for the table. Set the view type to new image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the stream data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the stream.

  • DynamoDB Streams phát sự kiện khi có thay đổi (INSERT, MODIFY, REMOVE).

  • View type = New Image → nhận được bản ghi mới nhất sau khi update.

  • Lambda function consume stream → update spreadsheet theo real-time.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster from the table. Set the view type to old image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the cluster data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the cluster.

❌ Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster from the table. Set the view type to new image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the cluster data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the cluster.

→ DAX chỉ là in-memory cache để tăng tốc đọc DynamoDB, không phát stream event. Không phù hợp để trigger cập nhật spreadsheet.

❌ Enable a DynamoDB stream for the table. Set the view type to old image. Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the stream data to update the spreadsheet. Subscribe the Lambda function to the stream.

→ Old image chỉ cho bản ghi trước khi thay đổi, không phải dữ liệu cuối cùng cần đưa vào spreadsheet.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DynamoDB Streams = chuẩn để bắt event thay đổi bên trong DynamoDB.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB Streams

questions.q:
A company is developing a new application that uses Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda resources. The company wants to allow employees to access the AWS Management Console by using existing credentials that the company stores and manages in an on-premises Microsoft Active Directory. Each employee must have a specific level of access to the AWS resources that is based on the employee’s role.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Configure AWS Directory Service to create an Active Directory in AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. Establish a trust relationship with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure IAM roles and trust policies to give the employees access to the AWS resources.
Use LDAP to directly integrate the on-premises Active Directory with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Map Active Directory groups to IAM roles to control access to AWS resources.

Implement a custom identity broker to authenticate users into the on-premises Active Directory. Configure the identity broker to use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to grant authorized users IAM role based access to the AWS resources.
Configure Amazon Cognito to federate users into the on-premises Active Directory. Use Cognito user pools to manage user identities and to manage user access to the AWS resources.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng EC2, S3, Lambda.

  • Nhân viên login vào AWS Console bằng on-prem AD credentials.

  • Cần phân quyền theo role.

  • Yêu cầu: ít overhead nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure AWS Directory Service to create an Active Directory in AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. Establish a trust relationship with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure IAM roles and trust policies to give the employees access to the AWS resources.

  • AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD có thể trust với on-prem AD.

  • Người dùng dùng existing AD credentials để SSO vào AWS.

  • IAM roles xác định quyền cho từng role trong AD.

  • Đây là giải pháp native AWS + ít overhead.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use LDAP to directly integrate the on-premises Active Directory with AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Map Active Directory groups to IAM roles to control access to AWS resources.

→ IAM không hỗ trợ LDAP direct integration.

❌ Implement a custom identity broker to authenticate users into the on-premises Active Directory. Configure the identity broker to use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to grant authorized users IAM role based access to the AWS resources.

→ Làm được nhưng tốn effort dev + maintain, không phải “least overhead”.

❌ Configure Amazon Cognito to federate users into the on-premises Active Directory. Use Cognito user pools to manage user identities and to manage user access to the AWS resources.

→ Cognito chủ yếu dùng cho app users, không phù hợp cho AWS Console SSO cho nhân viên.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

AWS Directory Service (AD Connector / Microsoft AD) = cách chính thống để federate on-prem AD với AWS Console.

📖 Reference:

How to Access the AWS Management Console Using AWS Microsoft AD and Your On-Premises Credentials

questions.q:
A developer created an AWS Lambda function named ProcessMessages. The Lambda function is invoked asynchronously when a message is published to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic named InputTopic. The developer uses a second SNS topic named ErrorTopic to handle alerts of failures for other services.

The developer wants to receive notifications from the ErrorTopic SNS topic when the ProcessMessages Lambda function fails to process a message.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Configure a subscription for the ErrorTopic SNS topic. Configure a filter policy for failures. Specify the ProcessMessages Lambda function as the endpoint.
Configure a failure destination for the ProcessMessages Lambda function. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ErrorTopic SNS topic as the destination ARN.
Configure a trigger for the ProcessMessages Lambda function. Specify the ErrorTopic SNS topic as the trigger topic. Configure a filter policy on the topic for failures
Configure a delivery policy on the ErrorTopic SNS topic. Configure a filter policy for failures. Specify the Lambda function as the input endpoint.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function ProcessMessages được invoke async từ SNS InputTopic.

  • Có SNS ErrorTopic dùng để nhận alert lỗi.

  • Yêu cầu: nếu ProcessMessages fail, phải gửi notification đến ErrorTopic.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure a failure destination for the ProcessMessages Lambda function. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the ErrorTopic SNS topic as the destination ARN.

  • Với Lambda Async, có thể cấu hình:

    • Success destination: khi Lambda chạy thành công

    • Failure destination: khi Lambda lỗi

  • Ở đây cần thông báo khi lỗi → dùng SNS ErrorTopic làm failure destination.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a subscription for the ErrorTopic SNS topic. Configure a filter policy for failures. Specify the ProcessMessages Lambda function as the endpoint.

→ Filter policy chỉ lọc message trong SNS, không bắt được Lambda execution failure.

❌ Configure a trigger for the ProcessMessages Lambda function. Specify the ErrorTopic SNS topic as the trigger topic. Configure a filter policy on the topic for failures

→ Trigger = nguồn event cho Lambda. ErrorTopic không thể làm trigger để bắt failure.

❌ Configure a delivery policy on the ErrorTopic SNS topic. Configure a filter policy for failures. Specify the Lambda function as the input endpoint.

→ Delivery policy chỉ kiểm soát retry/delivery của SNS, không liên quan đến Lambda execution failure.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Với async Lambda, dùng destinations gửi kết quả (success/failure) đến SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge.

📖 Reference:

Lambda asynchronous – destinations

questions.q:
A developer is creating an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to transform and load data from an Amazon S3 bucket. When the developer tests the application, the developer finds that some invocations of the Lambda function are slower than others.

The developer needs to update the Lambda function to have predictable invocation durations that run with low latency. Any initialization activities, such as loading libraries and instantiating clients, must run during allocation time rather than during actual function invocations.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Create a schedule group in Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to invoke the Lambda function.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function to have the necessary number of execution environments.
Use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function.
Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda function to have the necessary number of execution environments.
Deploy changes, and publish a new version of the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda có latency không ổn định (một số invocation chậm) → vấn đề cold start.

  • Yêu cầu: predictable duration, init (load libraries/clients) chạy ở allocation time, không ở runtime.

  • Đây là use case cho Provisioned Concurrency.

  • Muốn dùng provisioned concurrency → phải publish version (không chạy $LATEST).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function to have the necessary number of execution environments.

Giữ sẵn execution environments → loại bỏ cold start, predictable latency.

Deploy changes, and publish a new version of the Lambda function.

Provisioned concurrency chỉ áp dụng cho published versions hoặc aliases, không áp dụng cho $LATEST.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a schedule group in Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to invoke the Lambda function.

chỉ trigger định kỳ, không giảm cold start.

❌ Use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function.

$LATEST không hỗ trợ provisioned concurrency.

❌ Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda function to have the necessary number of execution environments.

chỉ giới hạn max concurrent executions, không giữ sẵn execution env → không giúp loại bỏ cold start.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Provisioned concurrency = giữ warm environments luôn sẵn sàng.

📖 Reference:

https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/new-provisioned-concurrency-for-lambda-functions/

questions.q:
A company offers a business-to-business software service that runs on dedicated infrastructure deployed in each customer’s AWS account. Before a feature release, the company needs to run integration tests on real AWS test infrastructure. The test infrastructure consists of Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon RDS database.

A developer must set up a continuous delivery process that will provision the test infrastructure across the different AWS accounts. The developer then must run the integration tests.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?
o: Use AWS CodeDeploy with AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the infrastructure. Use Amazon CodeGuru to run the tests.
Use AWS CodePipeline with AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the infrastructure. Use AWS CodeBuild to run the tests.
Use AWS CodePipeline with AWS CloudFormation change sets to deploy the infrastructure. Use a CloudFormation custom resource to run the tests.
Use AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) templates with AWS CloudFormation change sets to deploy the infrastructure. Use AWS CodeDeploy to run the tests.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty cần CI/CD pipeline để:

  • Provision hạ tầng test (EC2 + RDS) trên nhiều AWS accounts.

  • Chạy integration tests trên hạ tầng này.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort quản trị nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS CodePipeline with AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the infrastructure. Use AWS CodeBuild to run the tests.

  • CodePipeline: điều phối toàn bộ CI/CD.

  • CloudFormation StackSets: dễ dàng deploy hạ tầng đa tài khoản / đa region.

  • CodeBuild: service chuẩn để chạy test scripts trên hạ tầng đã provisioned.

  • Đây là giải pháp native AWS, ít overhead.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS CodeDeploy with AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the infrastructure. Use Amazon CodeGuru to run the tests.

  • CodeDeploy chủ yếu để deploy app, không deploy hạ tầng.

  • CodeGuru dùng để review code & profiler, không chạy integration tests.

❌ Use AWS CodePipeline with AWS CloudFormation change sets to deploy the infrastructure. Use a CloudFormation custom resource to run the tests.

Change sets chỉ preview thay đổi, còn Custom resource để chạy test → quá phức tạp.

❌ Use AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) templates with AWS CloudFormation change sets to deploy the infrastructure. Use AWS CodeDeploy to run the tests.

SAM chỉ phù hợp cho serverless infra (Lambda, API Gateway), không phù hợp khi đề yêu cầu EC2 + RDS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Multi-account infra → dùng CloudFormation StackSets.

  • Integration tests trong pipeline → CodeBuild là lựa chọn chuẩn (chạy bất kỳ test script nào).

📖 Reference:

Building a CI/CD pipeline to update an AWS CloudFormation StackSets

questions.q:
A company is building an application to accept data from customers. The data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

The application uses an Amazon API Gateway API that resolves to AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions store the data in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The application worked properly during testing.

A developer configured an Amazon CloudFront distribution with field-level encryption that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. After the configuration of the distribution, the application behaved unexpectedly. All the data in the database changed from plaintext to ciphertext.

The developer must ensure that the data is not stored in the database as the ciphertext from the CloudFront field-level encryption.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Change the CloudFront Viewer protocol policy from “HTTP and HTTPS” to “HTTPS only.”
Add a Lambda function that uses the KMS key to decrypt the data fields before saving the data to the database.
Enable encryption on the DB cluster by using the same KMS key that is used in CloudFront.
Request and deploy a new SSL certificate to use with the CloudFront distribution.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng API Gateway → Lambda → Aurora MySQL.

  • Dev thêm CloudFront Field-Level Encryption với KMS key.

  • Sau đó DB lưu ciphertext thay vì plaintext.

  • Yêu cầu: DB lưu plaintext, không lưu ciphertext từ CloudFront.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a Lambda function that uses the KMS key to decrypt the data fields before saving the data to the database.

  • Field-Level Encryption tại CloudFront sẽ mã hóa field nhạy cảm bằng public key trước khi gửi request về origin.

  • Nếu backend (Lambda) không KMS decrypt thì DB chỉ nhận được ciphertext.

  • Cần Lambda thực hiện giải mã trước khi insert DB.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change the CloudFront Viewer protocol policy from “HTTP and HTTPS” to “HTTPS only.”

→ HTTPS chỉ mã hóa in-transit, không ảnh hưởng đến FLE.

❌ Enable encryption on the DB cluster by using the same KMS key that is used in CloudFront.

→ Aurora encryption at rest chỉ bảo mật dữ liệu khi lưu, không tự động decrypt ciphertext của FLE.

❌ Request and deploy a new SSL certificate to use with the CloudFront distribution.

→ SSL/TLS cũng chỉ mã hóa transport, không thay thế/decrypt được Field-Level Encryption.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

CloudFront Field-Level Encryption → cần backend Lambda giải mã trước khi xử lý/lưu DB.

📖 Reference:

CloudFront Field-Level Encryption

How to protect sensitive data for its entire lifecycle in AWS

questions.q:
A development team has an Amazon API Gateway REST API that is backed by an AWS Lambda function.

Users have reported performance issues for the Lambda function. The development team identified the source of the issues as a cold start of the Lambda function. The development team needs to reduce the time needed for the Lambda function to initialize.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Change the Lambda concurrency to reserved concurrency.
Increase the timeout of the Lambda function.
Increase the memory allocation of the Lambda function.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway → Lambda backend.

  • Người dùng báo performance issues.

  • Root cause: cold start của Lambda.

  • Yêu cầu: giảm thời gian init của Lambda.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.

→ Provisioned concurrency giữ sẵn execution environments warm, loại bỏ cold start.

→ Giúp Lambda luôn sẵn sàng phục vụ request với độ trễ ổn định.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change the Lambda concurrency to reserved concurrency.

Reserved concurrency chỉ giới hạn max số execution concurrent, không giữ warm → không giảm cold start.

❌ Increase the timeout of the Lambda function.

Timeout chỉ tăng thời gian Lambda được phép chạy, không giảm latency init.

❌ Increase the memory allocation of the Lambda function.

Có thể gián tiếp tăng tốc độ xử lý (CPU/network), nhưng không loại bỏ cold start.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cold start → giải pháp chuẩn = Provisioned Concurrency.

📖 Reference:

Understanding reserved concurrency and provisioned concurrency

Lambda Provisioned Concurrency - Improving AWS Lambda Cold Start Times

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that includes an AWS Lambda function that is written in .NET Core. The Lambda function’s code needs to interact with Amazon DynamoDB tables and Amazon S3 buckets. The developer must minimize the Lambda function’s deployment time and invocation duration.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Increase the Lambda function’s memory.
Include the entire AWS SDK for .NET in the Lambda function’s deployment package.
Include only the AWS SDK for .NET modules for DynamoDB and Amazon S3 in the Lambda function’s deployment package.
Configure the Lambda function to download the AWS SDK for .NET from an S3 bucket at runtime.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function viết bằng .NET Core.

  • Cần tương tác với DynamoDB và S3.

  • Yêu cầu: giảm deployment time và giảm invocation duration.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Include only the AWS SDK for .NET modules for DynamoDB and Amazon S3 in the Lambda function’s deployment package.

Chỉ đóng gói đúng các module cần thiết giúp:

  • Giảm kích thước deployment package → deploy nhanh hơn.

  • Giảm thời gian load/init SDK khi Lambda cold start → invocation nhanh hơn.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the Lambda function’s memory.

→ Tăng memory giúp tăng CPU/network throughput, nhưng không giải quyết vấn đề deployment time/package size.

❌ Include the entire AWS SDK for .NET in the Lambda function’s deployment package.

→ Gói SDK đầy đủ rất lớn, gây deploy chậm và khởi động lâu.

❌ Configure the Lambda function to download the AWS SDK for .NET from an S3 bucket at runtime.

→ Làm tăng độ trễ runtime, vì mỗi lần Lambda cold start phải tải SDK trước khi chạy.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Luôn đóng gói chỉ các dependency cần thiết để tối ưu package size và cold start.

  • Điều này đặc biệt quan trọng với .NET, Java vì SDK khá nặng.

📖 Reference:

Best practices for working with AWS Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer needs to build a workflow to handle messages that are sent to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. When a message reaches the queue, the workflow must implement a delay before invoking an AWS Lambda function to process the message.

Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Create an AWS Step Functions state machine to process the SQS queue. Use a Wait state to delay the Lambda function’s processing for the required number of seconds after message delivery to the SQS queue. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the state machine every 5 minutes.

Configure the Lambda function to poll the SQS queue. Update the Lambda code to republish each message with a custom attribute that contains a future time when the message should be fully processed. Update the Lambda code to fully process messages when the custom attribute’s future time has passed.

Set the DelaySeconds value of the SQS queue to be the number of seconds required to delay delivery of the messages. Add an event source mapping for the Lambda function. Specify the SQS queue as a source.

Set the Visibility Timeout value of the SQS queue to be the number of seconds required to delay delivery of the messages. Add an event source mapping for the Lambda function. Specify the SQS queue as a source.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Có SQS queue.

  • Khi message vào queue → cần delay trước khi invoke Lambda để xử lý.

  • Yêu cầu: giải pháp ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the DelaySeconds value of the SQS queue to be the number of seconds required to delay delivery of the messages. Add an event source mapping for the Lambda function. Specify the SQS queue as a source.

→ DelaySeconds cho queue hoặc từng message sẽ trì hoãn thời gian message có thể được consumer (Lambda) nhận.

→ Sau khi delay hết hạn, Lambda sẽ tự động poll và xử lý.

→ Đây là giải pháp native, đơn giản, không cần code thêm.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions state machine to process the SQS queue. Use a Wait state to delay the Lambda function’s processing for the required number of seconds after message delivery to the SQS queue. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke the state machine every 5 minutes.

→ Quá phức tạp, nhiều dịch vụ không cần thiết.

❌ Configure the Lambda function to poll the SQS queue. Update the Lambda code to republish each message with a custom attribute that contains a future time when the message should be fully processed. Update the Lambda code to fully process messages when the custom attribute’s future time has passed.

→ Tự implement delay logic trong code → phức tạp, không hiệu quả.

❌ Set the Visibility Timeout value of the SQS queue to be the number of seconds required to delay delivery of the messages. Add an event source mapping for the Lambda function. Specify the SQS queue as a source.

→ Visibility Timeout chỉ áp dụng sau khi message đã được nhận bởi consumer, không phải để trì hoãn ban đầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DelaySeconds = trì hoãn message ban đầu (0–15 phút).

  • VisibilityTimeout = khoảng thời gian message “ẩn” khỏi các consumer sau khi đã được nhận, để tránh xử lý trùng.

📖 Reference:

Amazon SQS Delay Queues

questions.q:
A company’s application includes an Amazon DynamoDB table for product orders. The table has a primary partition key of orderId and has no sort key. The company is adding a new feature that requires the application to query the table by using the customerId attribute.

Which solution will provide this query functionality?
o: Change the existing primary key by setting customerId as the sort key.
Create a new global secondary index (GSI) on the table with a partition key of customerId.
Create a new local secondary index (LSI) on the table with a partition key of customerId.
Create a new local secondary index (LSI) on the table with a partition key of orderId and a sort key of customerId.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table ProductOrders:

    • Partition key = orderId.

    • Không có sort key.

  • Yêu cầu: query theo customerId.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new global secondary index (GSI) on the table with a partition key of customerId.

→ GSI cho phép query table bằng thuộc tính khác không phải primary key.

→ Có thể tạo GSI với customerId làm partition key để query theo customerId.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change the existing primary key by setting customerId as the sort key.

→ Không thể thay đổi primary key của DynamoDB table sau khi tạo.

❌ Create a new local secondary index (LSI) on the table with a partition key of customerId.

→ LSI phải dùng cùng partition key với table gốc (orderId). Không thể dùng customerId làm partition key.

❌ Create a new local secondary index (LSI) on the table with a partition key of orderId and a sort key of customerId.

→ LSI chỉ được tạo khi table ban đầu đã có sort key. Table này không có sort key, nên không thể tạo LSI.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • LSI → phải cùng partition key với table gốc, và table phải có sort key.

  • GSI → cho phép index trên bất kỳ thuộc tính nào, partition key khác table gốc.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB: Global secondary indexes

questions.q:
A company is developing a set of AWS Lambda functions to process data. The Lambda functions need to use a common third-party library as a dependency. The library is frequently updated with new features and bug fixes. The company wants to ensure that the Lambda functions always use the latest version of the library.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Store the dependency and the function code in an Amazon S3 bucket.
Create a Lambda layer that includes the library. Attach the layer to each Lambda function.
Install the dependency in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Attach the file system to each Lambda function.
Create a new Lambda function to load the library. Configure the existing Lambda functions to invoke the new Lambda function when the existing functions need to use the library.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Nhiều Lambda function cần dùng chung một thư viện third-party.

  • Thư viện này được update thường xuyên (feature + bug fix).

  • Yêu cầu: các Lambda luôn dùng bản mới nhất.

  • Cần giải pháp ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Install the dependency in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Attach the file system to each Lambda function.

  • Tất cả Lambda function share cùng source → luôn dùng chung bản mới nhất của thư viện.

  • Khi update thư viện trong EFS, tất cả Lambda tự động dùng bản mới mà không cần redeploy hay update layer.

  • Đây là cách ít effort vận hành nhất trong tình huống thư viện update thường xuyên.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the dependency and the function code in an Amazon S3 bucket.

S3 không thể mount trực tiếp vào Lambda runtime. Phải build lại package khi update lib → tốn effort.

❌ Create a Lambda layer that includes the library. Attach the layer to each Lambda function.

Layer dùng tốt để share lib, nhưng mỗi lần update lib cần publish layer mới + update từng Lambda → overhead cao.

❌ Create a new Lambda function to load the library. Configure the existing Lambda functions to invoke the new Lambda function when the existing functions need to use the library.

Lambda không thể "share" code execution kiểu này. Gọi Lambda khác để lấy thư viện không hợp lý và còn tăng latency.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lib ít thay đổi → Lambda Layer = best practice.

  • Lib thay đổi thường xuyên → EFS mount là giải pháp tốt nhất vì không cần redeploy.

📖 Reference:

Using Amazon EFS with AWS Lambda

questions.q:
A developer is writing a web application that must share secure documents with end users. The documents are stored in a private Amazon S3 bucket. The application must allow only authenticated users to download specific documents when requested, and only for a duration of 15 minutes.

How can the developer meet these requirements?
o: Copy the documents to a separate S3 bucket that has a lifecycle policy for deletion after 15 minutes.
Create a presigned S3 URL using the AWS SDK with an expiration time of 15 minutes.
Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS) and download the documents using HTTPS.
Modify the S3 bucket policy to only allow specific users to download the documents. Revert the change after 15 minutes.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Web app cần chia sẻ document trong private S3 bucket.

  • Chỉ cho authenticated users tải document cụ thể.

  • Thời gian cho phép: 15 phút.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a presigned S3 URL using the AWS SDK with an expiration time of 15 minutes.

→ Presigned URL cho phép truy cập object cụ thể trong S3 trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định.

→ Hết hạn (15 phút) → URL không còn hiệu lực.

→ Đây là cách đơn giản, secure, và native AWS để giải quyết yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Copy the documents to a separate S3 bucket that has a lifecycle policy for deletion after 15 minutes.

→ Rất phức tạp, không tự động kiểm soát thời gian truy cập chính xác, và tốn effort quản lý lifecycle.

❌ Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS) and download the documents using HTTPS.

→ Chỉ mã hóa dữ liệu at-rest và in-transit, không giới hạn thời gian truy cập.

❌ Modify the S3 bucket policy to only allow specific users to download the documents. Revert the change after 15 minutes.

→ Bucket policy thay đổi liên tục để quản lý từng user và thời gian truy cập là cồng kềnh, khó kiểm soát.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn giới hạn quyền truy cập tạm thời vào object S3 → dùng Presigned URL.

📖 Reference:

Amazon S3 Pre-Signed URLs

Securing Amazon S3 presigned URLs for serverless applications

questions.q:
A company hosts applications on premises. The on-premises servers generate audit logs that are available through an HTTP endpoint.

The company needs an automated solution to regularly ingest and store large volumes of audit data from the on-premises servers. The company also needs to perform queries on the audit data.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Export the audit logs. Upload the logs to Amazon S3. Import the logs to an Amazon RDS DB instance.

Create an AWS Lambda function to call the HTTP endpoint to fetch audit logs. Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to push the logs to AWS CloudTrail Lake.
Use AWS DataSync to transfer audit logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Load the logs into an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the bucket.
Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the on-premises servers. Give the agent the ability to push audit logs to CloudWatch. Use CloudWatch Insights to query the logs.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty chạy ứng dụng on-premises, xuất audit logs (có sẵn qua HTTP).

  • Cần giải pháp tự động, định kỳ ingest khối lượng log lớn và lưu trữ lâu dài, đồng thời có thể chạy truy vấn trên dữ liệu.

  • Mục tiêu: vận hành tối thiểu.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS DataSync to transfer audit logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Load the logs into an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the bucket.

→ DataSync auto đồng bộ data từ on-prem lên S3.

→ S3 là storage rẻ cho lưu log ở quy mô lớn

→ Athena truy vấn trực tiếp trên S3 → tối ưu vận hành và chi phí.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Export the audit logs. Upload the logs to Amazon S3. Import the logs to an Amazon RDS DB instance.

→ Phải tự viết/kịch bản export & upload ⇒ nhiều thao tác thủ công.

→ RDS không phù hợp phân tích log khối lượng lớn theo thời gian; tốn công quản trị (sizing, backup, index, maintenance).

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to call the HTTP endpoint to fetch audit logs. Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to push the logs to AWS CloudTrail Lake.

→ Lambda kéo log lớn/định kỳ dễ vướng giới hạn timeout/bandwidth; phải tự xử lý phân mảnh, retry, checkpoint.

→ CloudTrail Lake chủ yếu cho sự kiện audit kiểu CloudTrail/custom events; không tối ưu cho file log khối lượng lớn dạng file/line-based như web/app logs.

❌ Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the on-premises servers. Give the agent the ability to push audit logs to CloudWatch. Use CloudWatch Insights to query the logs.

→ Cần cài và quản lý agent trên tất cả server (overhead vận hành).

→ CloudWatch Logs phù hợp quan sát/monitoring thời gian thực, nhưng lưu trữ khối lượng log rất lớn lâu dài sẽ tốn chi phí hơn so với S3

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Khối lượng log lớn, lưu trữ lâu dài + phân tích ad-hoc → S3 + Athena.

On-prem → AWS ở quy mô lớn: DataSync (đặt lịch, incremental, retry tốt).

📖 Reference:

https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/storage/migrate-on-premises-data-to-aws-for-insightful-visualizations/

questions.q:
A developer must cache dependent artifacts from Maven Central, a public package repository, as part of an application’s build pipeline. The build pipeline has an AWS CodeArtifact repository where artifacts of the build are published. The developer needs a solution that requires minimum changes to the build pipeline.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Modify the existing CodeArtifact repository to associate an upstream repository with the public package repository.
Create a new CodeAtfact repository that has an external connection to the public package repository.
Create a new CodeAifact domain that contains a new repository that has an external connection to the public package repository.
Modify the CodeAnifact repository resource policy to allow artifacts to be fetched from the public package repository.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Build pipeline dùng AWS CodeArtifact để publish artifacts.

  • Cần cache Maven Central (public repo) trong pipeline.

  • Yêu cầu: ít thay đổi pipeline nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the existing CodeArtifact repository to associate an upstream repository with the public package repository.

  • CodeArtifact hỗ trợ upstream repositories để cache artifacts từ public sources (như Maven Central, npm registry).

  • Khi build pipeline yêu cầu artifact không có trong CodeArtifact → tự động fetch từ Maven Central, cache lại.

  • Ít thay đổi nhất vì không cần tạo repo/domain mới, chỉ chỉnh upstream của repo sẵn có.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new CodeAtfact repository that has an external connection to the public package repository.

→ Có thể hoạt động, nhưng yêu cầu tạo repo mới ⇒ thay đổi pipeline config (không phải “minimum changes”).

❌ Create a new CodeAifact domain that contains a new repository that has an external connection to the public package repository.

→ Không cần domain mới; domain hiện tại đủ, chỉ cần chỉnh upstream.

❌ Modify the CodeAnifact repository resource policy to allow artifacts to be fetched from the public package repository.

→ Resource policy chỉ quản lý IAM access control, không cấu hình upstream caching.

📖 Reference:

AWS CodeArtifact – upstream repositories

Improve the security of your software supply chain with Amazon CodeArtifact package group configuration

questions.q:
A large company has its application components distributed across multiple AWS accounts. The company needs to collect and visualize trace data across these accounts.

What should be used to meet these requirements?
o: AWS X-Ray
Amazon CloudWatch
Amazon VPC flow logs
Amazon OpenSearch Service
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App components chạy trên nhiều AWS accounts.

  • Cần collect + visualize trace data across accounts.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

AWS X-Ray

→ X-Ray là dịch vụ đúng use case để thu thập & phân tích trace data.

→ Hỗ trợ multi-account trace collection và visualization (service map, latency, errors).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Amazon CloudWatch

→ Monitoring (metrics, logs, alarms), không phải distributed tracing.

❌ Amazon VPC Flow Logs

→ Log traffic IP-level (network monitoring), không cung cấp application-level traces.

❌ Amazon OpenSearch Service

→ Dùng cho search + log analytics (vd: ELK stack), không phải native AWS tracing solution.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Tracing across services/accounts → dùng X-Ray.

  • Metrics/logs → CloudWatch.

  • Network flows → VPC Flow Logs.

  • Search/log analytics → OpenSearch.

📖 Reference:

Cross-account tracing

questions.q:
A developer is updating an Amazon API Gateway REST API to have a mock endpoint. The developer wants to update the integration request mapping template so the endpoint will respond to mock integration requests with specific HTTP status codes based on various conditions.

Which statement will meet these requirements?
o:
{
  #if( $input.params('integration') == "mock" )
    "statusCode": 404
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}

{
  #if( $input.params('scope') == "internal" )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}

{
  #if( $input.path("integration") )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 404
  #end
}

{
  #if( $context.integration.status )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev đang cấu hình API Gateway REST API với mock integration.

  • Yêu cầu: chỉnh integration request mapping template để endpoint trả về các HTTP status code khác nhau dựa vào điều kiện.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

{
  #if( $input.params('scope') == "internal" )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}

  • $input.params('scope') lấy parameter (query/header/path) từ request.

  • Dựa vào giá trị param (internal) thì trả ra mock response status code (200 hoặc 500).

  • Đây là cách đúng khi dùng Velocity Template Language (VTL) trong API Gateway để tùy biến mock integration response.

Các đáp án sai:

❌

{
  #if( $input.params('integration') == "mock" )
    "statusCode": 404
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}

→ Sai vì không có param integration trong request; không map với requirement.

❌

{
  #if( $input.path("integration") )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 404
  #end
}

→ $input.path() là để extract từ body JSON chứ không phải param request; không đúng với scenario mock integration.

❌

{
  #if( $context.integration.status )
    "statusCode": 200
  #else
    "statusCode": 500
  #end
}

→ $context không có field integration.status; context variables không dùng để đặt mock status code như vậy.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Mock integration trong API Gateway → dùng VTL mapping template.

  • Logic #if / #else trong VTL kiểm tra request param/header → xuất statusCode.

📖 Reference:

Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A developer needs to write an AWS CloudFormation template on a local machine and deploy a CloudFormation stack to AWS.

What must the developer do to complete these tasks?
o: Install the AWS CLI. Configure the AWS CLI by using an IAM user name and password.
Install the AWS CLI. Configure the AWS CLI by using an SSH key.
Install the AWS CLI, Configure the AWS CLI by using an IAM user access key and secret key.
Install an AWS software development kit (SDK). Configure the SDK by using an X.509 certificate.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev viết CloudFormation template local.

  • Cần deploy stack lên AWS.

  • Hỏi: cần cài gì và dùng loại credential nào?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Install the AWS CLI, Configure the AWS CLI by using an IAM user access key and secret key.

→ AWS CLI là công cụ để deploy CloudFormation stack (aws cloudformation deploy).

→ Để authenticate, CLI cần IAM credentials (Access Key ID + Secret Access Key).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install the AWS CLI. Configure the AWS CLI by using an IAM user name and password.

→ Username/password không dùng trực tiếp với AWS CLI.

❌ Install the AWS CLI. Configure the AWS CLI by using an SSH key.

→ SSH key dùng để login EC2, không phải để auth CLI.

❌ Install an AWS software development kit (SDK). Configure the SDK by using an X.509 certificate.

→ SDK là để dev app, không cần cho deploy CloudFormation. X.509 certificate dùng cho IoT/legacy API, không cho CloudFormation CLI.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

AWS CLI auth bằng: IAM access key/secret key, hoặc SSO/profile/role.

Deploy CloudFormation = aws cloudformation deploy --template-file ... --stack-name ....

📖 Reference:

Setting up AWS CLI credentials

questions.q:
A developer is making changes to a custom application that uses AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

Which solutions will update the Elastic Beanstalk environment with the new application version after the developer completes the changes? (Choose two.)
o: Package the application code into a zip file. Use the AWS Management Console to upload the .zip file and deploy the packaged application.
Package the application code into a .tar file. Use the AWS Management Console to create a new application version from the .tar file. Update the environment by using the AWS CLI.
Package the application code into a .tar file. Use the AWS Management Console to upload the .tar file and deploy the packaged application.
Package the application code into a .zip file. Use the AWS CLI to create a new application version from the .zip file and to update the environment.
Package the application code into a .zip file. Use the AWS Management Console to create a new application version from the .zip file. Rebuild the environment by using the AWS CLI.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev thay đổi code cho app chạy trên Elastic Beanstalk.

  • Cần update environment với new application version.

  • Elastic Beanstalk chỉ hỗ trợ ZIP file (không dùng .tar).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Package the application code into a zip file. Use the AWS Management Console to upload the .zip file and deploy the packaged application.

Cách trực tiếp và chuẩn: upload .zip qua console, EB sẽ tạo application version và deploy.

Package the application code into a .zip file. Use the AWS CLI to create a new application version from the .zip file and to update the environment.

AWS CLI hỗ trợ aws elasticbeanstalk create-application-version và aws elasticbeanstalk update-environment.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Package the application code into a .tar file. Use the AWS Management Console to create a new application version from the .tar file. Update the environment by using the AWS CLI.

Elastic Beanstalk không hỗ trợ .tar cho application bundle, chỉ .zip.

❌ Package the application code into a .tar file. Use the AWS Management Console to upload the .tar file and deploy the packaged application.

Như trên, .tar không hợp lệ.

❌ Package the application code into a .zip file. Use the AWS Management Console to create a new application version from the .zip file. Rebuild the environment by using the AWS CLI.

“Rebuild environment” = terminate & recreate → unnecessary overhead. Chỉ cần update environment với new version.

📖 Reference:

Learn how to get started with Elastic Beanstalk

Creating Elastic Beanstalk environments with the AWS CLI

questions.q:
A company runs a new application on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. The company needs to deploy updates to the application. The updates must not cause any downtime for application users.

The deployment must forward a specified percentage of incoming client traffic to a new application version during an evaluation period.

Which deployment type will meet these requirements?
o: rolling
traffic-splitting
in-place
immutable
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên Elastic Beanstalk.

  • Yêu cầu: deploy không downtime.

  • Trong thời gian đánh giá → chỉ forward một tỷ lệ traffic sang phiên bản mới (canary).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

traffic-splitting

  • Deploy version mới lên temporary Auto Scaling group.

  • Forward X% traffic sang version mới trong evaluation period.

  • Nếu OK → rollout tiếp, nếu fail → rollback.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ rolling

Deploy theo batch → vẫn có thể gây gián đoạn tạm thời. Không cho phép split % traffic để test version mới.

❌ in-place

Cập nhật trực tiếp trên instance hiện tại → gây downtime.

❌ immutable

Tạo toàn bộ instance mới với version mới → zero downtime, nhưng không có traffic splitting % (chỉ chuyển toàn bộ khi xong).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Rolling = batch update, có downtime nhỏ.

  • Immutable = zero downtime, nhưng all-or-nothing.

  • Traffic-splitting = canary style, forward % traffic.

📖 Reference:

How traffic-splitting deployments work

questions.q:
A developer is troubleshooting a three-tier application, which is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. There is a connectivity problem between the application servers and the database servers.

Which AWS services or tools should be used to identity the faulty component? (Choose two.)
o: AWS CloudTrail
AWS Trusted Advisor
Amazon VPC Flow Logs
Network access control lists
AWS Config rules
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App 3-tier trên EC2.

  • Có vấn đề kết nối giữa app servers ↔ DB servers.

  • Hỏi: dùng công cụ nào để xác định lỗi mạng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Amazon VPC Flow Logs

→ Ghi lại traffic in/out ở ENI, subnet, hoặc VPC level.

→ Giúp xem packet có đến DB không, có bị chặn bởi SG/NACL không.

Network access control lists

→ Kiểm tra rule inbound/outbound NACL để biết traffic có bị deny không.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ AWS CloudTrail

→ Dùng để log API calls, không giúp debug network connectivity.

❌ AWS Trusted Advisor

→ Đưa ra best practices / recommendations, không debug connectivity trực tiếp.

❌ AWS Config rules

→ Giúp compliance check resource config, không trực tiếp debug network flow.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Debug EC2 connectivity issues → check VPC Flow Logs, SG, NACL, Route Table.

📖 Reference:

VPC Flow Logs

Network ACL rules

questions.q:
A company runs continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for its application on AWS CodePipeline. A developer must write unit tests and run them as part of the pipelines before staging the artifacts for testing.

How should the developer incorporate unit tests as part of CI/CD pipelines?
o: Create a separate CodePipeline pipeline to run unit tests.
Update the AWS CodeBuild build specification to include a phase for running unit tests.
Install the AWS CodeDeploy agent on an Amazon EC2 instance to run unit tests.
Create a testing branch in a git repository for the pipelines to run unit tests.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy CI/CD bằng CodePipeline.

  • Dev cần chạy unit tests trước khi staging artifact.

  • Hỏi: cách tích hợp unit test vào pipeline?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Update the AWS CodeBuild build specification to include a phase for running unit tests.

→ CodeBuild hỗ trợ buildspec.yml với các phase (install, pre_build, build, post_build).

→ Unit tests nên chạy trong phase build hoặc test.

→ Đây là cách chuẩn để tích hợp testing vào CI/CD với CodePipeline + CodeBuild.

buildspec.yml

version: 0.2

phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.7
    commands:
      - pip3 install pytest
  build:
    commands:
      - python -m pytest --junitxml=<test report directory>/<report filename>

reports:
  pytest_reports:
    files:
      - <report filename>
    base-directory: <test report directory>
    file-format: JUNITXML

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a separate CodePipeline pipeline to run unit tests.

→ Tách pipeline không cần thiết, overhead cao, khó maintain.

❌ Install the AWS CodeDeploy agent on an Amazon EC2 instance to run unit tests.

→ CodeDeploy dùng để deploy, không phải để chạy unit tests.

❌ Create a testing branch in a git repository for the pipelines to run unit tests.

→ Branching strategy không đảm bảo unit tests được tự động chạy trong pipeline.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • CodePipeline = orchestration.

  • CodeBuild = compile, build, test.

  • Unit test luôn được đưa vào buildspec.yml trong CodeBuild stage.

📖 Reference:

AWS CodeBuild buildspec reference

questions.q:
A company has an ecommerce application. The application's API sends order data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. A developer needs to modify the application to enrich the order data before the application sends the order data to a fulfillment system.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SQS queue. enrich the message data, and send the enriched data to the fulfilment system, Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic.

Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the state machine when an order is published to the SQS queue. Map the orders to an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to perform the data enrichment and to invoke the state machine. Configure the last step of the state machine to send the enriched data to the fulfilment system.

Create an Amazon EMR cluster to read messages from the SQS queue. Configure an EMR job to enrich the order data. Create and configure an Amazon S3 bucket as the output location. Adjust the order fulfilment system to retrieve the enriched files from the S3 bucket.
Create an Amazon EventBridge pipe that uses event enrichment. Configure the SQS queue as a source for the pipe. Set the fulfillment system as the target of the pipe.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App ecommerce → API gửi order data vào SQS queue.

  • Cần enrich order data trước khi gửi đến fulfillment system.

  • Yêu cầu: giải pháp ít effort dev nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon EventBridge pipe that uses event enrichment. Configure the SQS queue as a source for the pipe. Set the fulfillment system as the target of the pipe.

EventBridge Pipes cho phép:

  • Lấy event từ SQS (source).

  • Dùng enrichment step (Lambda hoặc API) để enrich dữ liệu.

  • Forward enriched event đến target (ở đây là fulfillment system).

→ Đây là giải pháp native, serverless, ít development nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SQS queue. enrich the message data, and send the enriched data to the fulfilment system, Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic.

→ Làm được nhưng cần viết code poll + xử lý forwarding ⇒ nhiều effort hơn Pipes.

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the state machine when an order is published to the SQS queue. Map the orders to an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to perform the data enrichment and to invoke the state machine. Configure the last step of the state machine to send the enriched data to the fulfilment system.

→ Rất phức tạp cho use case đơn giản.

❌ Create an Amazon EMR cluster to read messages from the SQS queue. Configure an EMR job to enrich the order data. Create and configure an Amazon S3 bucket as the output location. Adjust the order fulfilment system to retrieve the enriched files from the S3 bucket.

→ EMR dành cho big data, không hợp cho transactional enrichment, quá tốn chi phí/vận hành.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

EventBridge Pipes là best choice khi cần source → enrich → target với SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB, etc.

Giảm hẳn code và vận hành so với Lambda polling hoặc Step Functions.

📖 Reference:

Amazon EventBridge Pipes

questions.q:
A developer manages encryption keys in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The developer must ensure that all encryption keys can be deleted immediately when the keys are no longer required. The developer wants a solution that is highly available and does not require manual management for compute infrastructure.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use AWS KMS managed keys. When the keys are no longer required, schedule the keys for immediate deletion.
Use customer managed keys with imported key material. When the keys are no longer required, delete the imported key material.
Use customer managed keys. When the keys are no longer required, delete the key material.
Use customer managed keys and an AWS CloudHSM key store. When the keys are no longer required, schedule the keys for immediate deletion.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev quản lý KMS keys.

  • Có thể xóa ngay lập tức khi không cần.

  • HA (highly available).

  • Không phải tự quản lý compute infrastructure.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use customer managed keys with imported key material. When the keys are no longer required, delete the imported key material.

Với CMK có imported key material:

  • KMS quản lý hạ tầng (HA, no infra ops).

  • Bạn chỉ quản lý vòng đời key material.

  • Khi delete key material → key unusable ngay lập tức (không cần chờ 7–30 ngày như schedule deletion).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS KMS managed keys. When the keys are no longer required, schedule the keys for immediate deletion.

AWS managed keys không thể delete, và schedule deletion không có "immediate".

❌ Use customer managed keys. When the keys are no longer required, delete the key material.

Native KMS keys không cho trực tiếp delete key material; chỉ có schedule deletion (7–30 days).

❌ Use customer managed keys and an AWS CloudHSM key store. When the keys are no longer required, schedule the keys for immediate deletion.

CloudHSM yêu cầu tự quản lý cluster HSM → trái yêu cầu “no manual compute infra”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • encryption keys can be deleted immediately → chọn imported key material.

  • Schedule deletion (7–30 days) → chỉ áp dụng cho native KMS keys.

  • AWS managed CMK → không bao giờ xóa được.

📖 Reference:

KMS – Imported key material

questions.q:
A team has an Amazon API Gateway REST API that consists of a single resource and a GET method that is backed by an AWS Lambda integration.

A developer makes a change to the Lambda function and deploys the function as a new version. The developer needs to set up a process to test the new version of the function before using the new version in production. The tests must not affect the production REST API.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Create a new resource in the REST API. Add a GET method to the new resource, and add a Lambda integration to the updated version of the Lambda function. Deploy the new version.

Create a new stage for the REST API. Create a stage variable. Assign the stage variable to the Lambda function. Set the API Gateway integrated Lambda function name to the stage variable. Deploy the new version.
Create a new REST API. Add a resource that has a single GET method that is integrated with the updated version of the Lambda function.
Update the Lambda integration of the existing GET method to point to the updated version of the Lambda function. Deploy the new version.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway REST API: 1 resource + 1 GET method → backed by Lambda integration.

  • Dev deploy Lambda function new version.

  • Yêu cầu: test new Lambda version trước khi production.
