  • Test không được ảnh hưởng tới production API.

  • Cần ít overhead nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new stage for the REST API. Create a stage variable. Assign the stage variable to the Lambda function. Set the API Gateway integrated Lambda function name to the stage variable. Deploy the new version.

Dùng stage + stage variables:

  • Production stage → Lambda version cũ.

  • Test stage → Lambda version mới.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new resource in the REST API. Add a GET method to the new resource, and add a Lambda integration to the updated version of the Lambda function. Deploy the new version.

→ Tăng complexity, dư thừa khi chỉ cần stage.

❌ Create a new REST API. Add a resource that has a single GET method that is integrated with the updated version of the Lambda function.

→ Quá phức tạp, không cần tạo API mới.

❌ Update the Lambda integration of the existing GET method to point to the updated version of the Lambda function. Deploy the new version.

→ Sẽ ảnh hưởng luôn production → trái yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

API Gateway + Lambda testing best practice = stage variables để trỏ đến Lambda alias/version.

Không cần nhân bản API hay resource.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A developer created reusable code that several AWS Lambda functions need to use. The developer bundled the code into a zip archive. The developer needs to deploy the code to AWS and update the Lambda functions to use the code.

Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Upload the zip archive to Amazon S3. Configure an import path on the Lambda functions to point to the zip archive.
Create a new Lambda function that contains and runs the shared code. Update the existing Lambda functions to invoke the new Lambda function synchronously.
Create a Lambda layer that contains the zip archive. Attach the Lambda layer to the Lambda functions.
Create a Lambda container image that includes the shared code. Use the container image as a Lambda base image for all the functions.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Có reusable code cần dùng chung cho nhiều Lambda function.

  • Code đã bundle thành .zip.

  • Yêu cầu: deploy 1 lần và cho nhiều Lambda dùng lại.

  • Ưu tiên: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a Lambda layer that contains the zip archive. Attach the Lambda layer to the Lambda functions.

→ Lambda layers được thiết kế để chia sẻ thư viện hoặc reusable code giữa nhiều Lambda function.

→ Khi update layer chỉ cần update layer version, rồi các Lambda có thể tham chiếu.

→ Đây là giải pháp chuẩn AWS, đơn giản và operationally efficient.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Upload the zip archive to Amazon S3. Configure an import path on the Lambda functions to point to the zip archive.

→ Lambda không hỗ trợ import path trực tiếp từ S3.

❌ Create a new Lambda function that contains and runs the shared code. Update the existing Lambda functions to invoke the new Lambda function synchronously.

→ Không tối ưu: tăng latency, coupling, và không phải cách chia sẻ code mà chỉ biến shared code thành 1 service.

❌ Create a Lambda container image that includes the shared code. Use the container image as a Lambda base image for all the functions.

→ Hợp lý nếu app toàn bộ dựa trên container, nhưng ở đây chỉ cần share code. Tạo image riêng cho shared code là overkill.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda Layers = best practice để share library hoặc reusable code.

📖 Reference:

AWS Lambda Layers

questions.q:
A developer is testing an AWS Lambda function that has an event source of an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The developer notices that some of the messages the Lambda function processes re-appear in the queue while the messages are being processed.

The developer must correct this behavior.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Increase the timeout of the Lambda function.
Increase the visibility timeout of the SQS queue.
Increase the memory allocation of the Lambda function.
Increase the batch size in the event source mapping.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function được trigger từ SQS queue.

  • Vấn đề: message đã được Lambda xử lý nhưng vẫn reappear trong queue khi đang xử lý.

  • Nguyên nhân: Lambda chưa xử lý xong thì SQS visibility timeout hết hạn → message lại trở nên visible.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the visibility timeout of the SQS queue.

  • Visibility timeout ngắn hơn processing time → message quay lại SQS → duplicate processing.

  • Visibility timeout cần lớn hơn thời gian xử lý tối đa của Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the timeout of the Lambda function.

→ Giúp Lambda có thêm thời gian chạy, nhưng không ngăn message reappear. Visibility timeout vẫn phải khớp với max processing time.

❌ Increase the memory allocation of the Lambda function.

→ Có thể làm Lambda chạy nhanh hơn, nhưng không đảm bảo xử lý xong trước visibility timeout.

❌ Increase the batch size in the event source mapping.

→ Chỉ ảnh hưởng số message mỗi batch, không liên quan đến re-delivery khi visibility timeout hết.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Visibility timeout ≥ (Lambda max execution time).

📖 Reference:

Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout

questions.q:
A company has an application that uses an Amazon Cognito user pool for authentication. A developer needs to add a new REST API that will use the user pool to authenticate requests.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create a new API key and a new usage plan. Associate the API key and the REST API with the usage plan.
Create a Cognito authorizer for the correct user pool. Reference the header that contains the Cognito token.
Create an AWS Lambda token authorizer. Reference the authorization token in the event payload. Authenticate requests based on the token value.
Create an AWS Lambda request authorizer. Reference the authorization header in the event payload. Authenticate requests by using the header value in a request to the Cognito API.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng Cognito User Pool để authenticate.

  • Dev cần thêm REST API mới cũng dùng cùng user pool để auth requests.

  • Yêu cầu: giải pháp với ít effort dev nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a Cognito authorizer for the correct user pool. Reference the header that contains the Cognito token.

API Gateway hỗ trợ Cognito User Pool authorizer native:

  • Validate JWT token được trả về sau khi user login qua Cognito.

  • Tích hợp sẵn, không cần viết custom code.

  • Ít effort nhất để tái sử dụng user pool cho REST API auth.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new API key and a new usage plan. Associate the API key and the REST API with the usage plan.

API key chỉ để rate limiting / usage tracking, không phải auth bằng Cognito.

❌ Create an AWS Lambda token authorizer. Reference the authorization token in the event payload. Authenticate requests based on the token value.

Cần viết code để validate JWT token → nhiều effort hơn Cognito authorizer có sẵn.

❌ Create an AWS Lambda request authorizer. Reference the authorization header in the event payload. Authenticate requests by using the header value in a request to the Cognito API.

Cũng phải viết code gọi Cognito để validate token → phức tạp, không cần thiết.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

API Gateway + Cognito User Pool Authorizer = best practice để auth REST API bằng Cognito.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway Cognito Authorizers

questions.q:
A company is launching a feature that uses an HTTP API built with Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. An API Gateway endpoint performs several independent tasks that run in a Lambda function. The independent tasks can take up to 10 minutes in total to finish running.

Users report that the endpoint sometimes returns an HTTP 604 status code. The Lambda function invocations are successful.

Which solution will stop the endpoint from returning the HTTP 504 status cade?
o: Increase the Lambda function’s timeout value.
Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function.
Increase the memory that is available to the Lambda function.
Refactor the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions state machine.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway HTTP API → invoke Lambda.

  • Lambda thực hiện nhiều task độc lập, tổng thời gian có thể tới 10 phút.

  • Người dùng báo API đôi khi trả về HTTP 504 (gateway timeout).

  • Nhưng Lambda invocation thực tế vẫn chạy thành công.

  • Vấn đề: API Gateway timeout tối đa = 29 giây (REST API, HTTP API).

  • Nếu Lambda chạy >29s → API Gateway trả về 504.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Refactor the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions state machine.

  • Lambda không xử lý trực tiếp toàn bộ công việc dài (vì API Gateway giới hạn tối đa 29 giây).

  • Thay vào đó, Lambda chỉ khởi tạo một Step Functions state machine execution rồi trả về ngay cho client một phản hồi HTTP (ví dụ 200 OK hoặc 202 Accepted).

  • Step Functions chạy workflow lâu dài phía sau mà không bị ràng buộc bởi timeout của API Gateway.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the Lambda function’s timeout value.

→ Lambda có thể chạy đến 15 phút, nhưng API Gateway chỉ chờ tối đa 29s → vẫn timeout 504.

❌ Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function.

→ Chỉ tăng khả năng concurrent execution, không ảnh hưởng timeout.

❌ Increase the memory that is available to the Lambda function.

→ Tăng CPU có thể cải thiện tốc độ, nhưng task có thể vẫn >29s → vẫn bị 504.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway max timeout = 29 seconds.

  • Lambda max timeout = 15 minutes.

  • Xử lý tác vụ >29s → dùng async pattern (Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge).

📖 Reference:

Implement the serverless saga pattern by using AWS Step Functions

questions.q:
A developer is creating an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer needs to develop code that reads all records that were added to the table during the previous day, creates HTML reports, and pushes the reports into third-party storage. The item size varies from 1 KB to 4 KB, and the index structure is defined with the date. The developer needs to minimize the read capacity that the application requires from the DynamoDB table.

Which DynamoDB API operation should the developer use in the code to meet these requirements?
o: Query
Scan
BatchGetItem
GetItem
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App cần đọc tất cả record của ngày hôm qua từ DynamoDB.

  • Table được index theo date.

  • Yêu cầu: minimize read capacity.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Query

  • Query cho phép đọc các item trong DynamoDB dựa vào partition key (và có thể filter thêm bằng sort key / condition).

  • Vì bảng đã định nghĩa index theo date, ta có thể dùng Query để lấy toàn bộ record của previous day chỉ trong 1 partition key.

  • Đây là cách hiệu quả nhất, vì DynamoDB chỉ đọc đúng các item trong partition key đó → tốn ít RCU nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Scan

→ Đọc toàn bộ table (hoặc toàn bộ index), tốn nhiều read capacity.

❌ BatchGetItem

  • BatchGetItem chỉ hiệu quả khi bạn đã biết primary key cụ thể của các item cần lấy.

  • Ở đây ta chỉ biết ngày, không biết từng PK/SK của item → không dùng được.

❌ GetItem

  • GetItem đọc 1 item duy nhất theo PK + SK.

  • Không thể dùng để lấy toàn bộ record theo ngày.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Query = hiệu quả nhất khi biết partition key (vd: date).

  • Scan = fallback khi không có key condition, nhưng tốn RCU.

  • BatchGetItem/GetItem = chỉ cho các trường hợp biết key chính xác.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB Query vs Scan

questions.q:
A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application experiences variable loads throughout each day.

The company needs to collect detailed metrics from the EC2 instances to right-size the instances. The company also wants to monitor custom application metrics to ensure the application is performing efficiently.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Install the AWS X-Ray agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
Install the AWS SDK in the application’s cade. Update the application to use the AWS SDK to collect and publish the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture and analyze the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EC2 Auto Scaling group.

  • Detailed metrics từ EC2 instances để right-size.

  • Custom application metrics để theo dõi hiệu năng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.

CloudWatch agent cho phép:

  • Thu thập detailed system-level metrics (CPU, mem, disk, network) vượt ngoài basic metrics.

  • Thu thập custom metrics từ app log hoặc stats và publish trực tiếp lên CloudWatch.

  • Đúng yêu cầu với ít effort nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install the AWS X-Ray agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.

→ Dùng để trace request (distributed tracing), không collect instance metrics.

❌ Install the AWS SDK in the application’s cade. Update the application to use the AWS SDK to collect and publish the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.

→ Có thể publish custom metrics, nhưng không phải cách chuẩn để thu thập detailed system metrics từ EC2. Nhiều overhead dev.

❌ Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture and analyze the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.

→ Ghi log API calls, không phải để monitor EC2 performance hay custom metrics.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

CloudWatch agent = best practice cho EC2 detailed + custom metrics.

📖 Reference:

CloudWatch Agent

questions.q:
A developer compiles an AWS Lambda function and packages the result as a .zip file. The developer uses the Functions page on the Lambda console to attempt to upload the local packaged .zip file. When pushing the package ta Lambda, the console returns the following error:

An error occurred (RequestEntityTooLargeException) when calling the UpdateFunctionCode operation

Which solutions can the developer use to publish the code? (Choose two.)
o: Upload the package to Amazon S3. Use the Functions page on the Lambda console to upload the package from the S3 location.
Create an AWS Support ticket to increase the maximum package size.
Use the update-function-code AWS CLI command. Pass the --publish parameter.

Repackage the Lambda function as a Docker container image. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Reference the image that is deployed to Amazon ECR.

Sign the .zip file digitally. Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Update the configuration of the new Lambda function to include the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code signing configuration.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev build Lambda function thành .zip file.

  • Upload qua console → lỗi vì package vượt quá 50 MB (console direct upload limit).

  • Hỏi: có thể publish code bằng cách nào?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Upload the package to Amazon S3. Use the Functions page on the Lambda console to upload the package from the S3 location.

Nếu file .zip > 50 MB, phải upload vào S3 trước rồi tham chiếu.

Repackage the Lambda function as a Docker container image. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Reference the image that is deployed to Amazon ECR.

Lambda hỗ trợ container image up to 10 GB, giải quyết giới hạn size package.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Support ticket to increase the maximum package size.

Không thể tăng giới hạn, là hard limit AWS.

❌ Use the update-function-code AWS CLI command. Pass the --publish parameter.

CLI upload trực tiếp .zip vẫn bị giới hạn 50 MB (zip file), không bypass được.

❌ Sign the .zip file digitally. Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Update the configuration of the new Lambda function to include the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code signing configuration.

Code signing = security compliance, không liên quan tới file size limit.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Direct console/CLI upload limit = 50 MB zipped.

  • From S3 = 250 MB unzipped.

  • Container image in ECR = up to 10 GB.

📖 Reference:

Function configuration, deployment, and execution

questions.q:
In a move toward using microservices, a company’s management team has asked all development teams to build their services so that API requests depend only on that service’s data store. One team is building a Payments service which has its own database; the service needs data that originates in the Accounts database. Both are using Amazon DynamoDB.

What approach will result in the simplest, decoupled, and reliable method to get near-real time updates from the Accounts database?
o: Use AWS Glue to perform frequent ETL updates from the Accounts database to the Payments database.
Use Amazon ElastiCache in Payments, with the cache updated by triggers in the Accounts database.
Use Amazon Data Firehose to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.
Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty áp dụng microservices, mỗi service chỉ phụ thuộc vào data store riêng.

  • Service:

    • Accounts → DynamoDB.

    • Payments → DynamoDB.

  • Payments cần dữ liệu từ Accounts, yêu cầu near real-time update.

  • Mục tiêu: giải pháp đơn giản, decoupled, reliable.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.

→ DynamoDB Streams ghi lại tất cả thay đổi trong table Accounts (insert, update, delete).

→ Lambda hoặc consumer app có thể đọc stream và cập nhật Payments DB theo near-real time.

→ Đây là cách native, decoupled, near real-time giữa hai microservices.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS Glue to perform frequent ETL updates from the Accounts database to the Payments database.

→ ETL batch processing, không near real-time.

❌ Use Amazon ElastiCache in Payments, with the cache updated by triggers in the Accounts database.

→ Triggers trong DynamoDB không tồn tại; và cache không phải DB chính thức, không đảm bảo reliability.

❌ Use Amazon Data Firehose to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.

→ Firehose dùng để stream dữ liệu đến S3, Redshift, OpenSearch. Không dùng trực tiếp để sync giữa DynamoDB tables.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DynamoDB Streams = best practice để replicate/propagate dữ liệu giữa services/tables trong microservices.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB Streams

questions.q:
A company’s AWS accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. An application in Account A uses environment variables that are stored as parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. A developer is creating a new application in Account B that needs to use the same environment variables.

The application in Account B needs access to the parameters in Account A without duplicating the parameters into Account B.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Configure the application in Account B to use credentials for an IAM user in AccountA that has access to the parameters.
Create an assumable IAM role in Account A. Grant the role the permission to access the parameters.
Configure cross-account resource sharing for the parameters by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).
Write a script that stores the parameter values in a private Amazon S3 bucket that both accounts can access.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Account A: chứa Parameter Store với env variables.

  • Account B: app cần dùng cùng parameters.

  • Yêu cầu: không duplicate, ít overhead nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure cross-account resource sharing for the parameters by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).

→ Từ 2024, AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store hỗ trợ cross-account sharing thông qua AWS RAM.

→ Cho phép Account B access trực tiếp Parameter Store parameters trong Account A.

→ Giải pháp native, ít vận hành nhất, không cần IAM user hay script copy.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the application in Account B to use credentials for an IAM user in AccountA that has access to the parameters.

→ Cần quản lý credentials cross-account → high overhead, không recommended.

❌ Create an assumable IAM role in Account A. Grant the role the permission to access the parameters.

→ Làm được, nhưng app Account B phải assume role mỗi lần → nhiều config, hơn overhead so với RAM sharing.

❌ Write a script that stores the parameter values in a private Amazon S3 bucket that both accounts can access.

→ Tốn effort, không real-time sync, tăng complexity.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Parameter Store cross-account sharing via AWS RAM = best practice.

📖 Reference:

Amazon Systems Manager Parameter Store supports cross-account sharing

Introducing Parameter Store cross-account sharing

questions.q:
A developer is using AWS CloudFormation to deploy an AWS Lambda function. The developer needs to set the Lambda function's timeout value based on the environment parameter of the template. The template contains mappings of EnvironmentData for each environment's timeout value. The environment parameter and EnvironmentData mappings are as follows:

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: The name of the deployment environment.

Mappings:
  EnvironmentData:
    dev:
      Timeout: 30
    test:
      Timeout: 60
    prod:
      Timeout: 90


Which statement will meet these requirements?
o: Timeout: !GetAtt [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
Timeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
Timeout: !Select [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
Timeout: !ForEach[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • CloudFormation template có:

    • Parameter: Environment (Dev, Test, Prod).

    • Mapping: EnvironmentData chứa giá trị Timeout cho từng môi trường.

  • Yêu cầu: Lambda Timeout phải tham chiếu giá trị từ mapping dựa trên parameter.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Timeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

  • Fn::FindInMap (hoặc !FindInMap shorthand) dùng để lấy value từ Mappings.

  • Cú pháp: !FindInMap [ MapName, TopLevelKey, SecondLevelKey ]

    • MapName = EnvironmentData

    • TopLevelKey = !Ref Environment (ví dụ: Dev/Test/Prod)

    • SecondLevelKey = Timeout

Các đáp án sai:

❌Timeout: !GetAtt [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

dùng để lấy attribute từ resource, không phải từ Mappings.

❌Timeout: !Select [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

→ chọn giá trị theo index từ list, không áp dụng cho mapping.

❌ Timeout: !ForEach[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

→ không tồn tại trong CloudFormation intrinsic functions.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Dùng Mappings + !FindInMap khi muốn hardcode config theo environment (timeout, instance type, AMI ID...).

📖 Reference:

CloudFormation Fn::FindInMap

questions.q:
An application is experiencing performance issues based on increased demand. This increased demand is on read-only historical records pulled from an Amazon RDS-hosted database with custom views and queries. A developer must improve performance without changing the database structure.

Which approach will improve performance and MINIMIZE management overhead?
o: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB, move all the data, and point to DynamoDB.
Deploy Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and cache the data for the application.
Deploy Memcached on Amazon EC2 and cache the data for the application.
Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) on Amazon RDS to improve cache performance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App gặp performance issue do tăng read-only demand.

  • Data: historical records từ Amazon RDS với custom views/queries.

  • Yêu cầu: cải thiện hiệu năng, không đổi DB structure, ít overhead quản lý.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Deploy Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and cache the data for the application.

  • ElastiCache Redis hỗ trợ caching layer cho read-heavy workloads.

  • Cache kết quả query/views từ RDS.

  • Fully managed, ít overhead

  • Không cần thay đổi DB schema.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Deploy Amazon DynamoDB, move all the data, and point to DynamoDB.

→ Yêu cầu di chuyển toàn bộ schema sang NoSQL → thay đổi lớn + sai yêu cầu.

❌ Deploy Memcached on Amazon EC2 and cache the data for the application.

→ Có thể cache, nhưng phải tự quản lý EC2 cluster → overhead cao hơn so với managed ElastiCache.

❌ Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) on Amazon RDS to improve cache performance.

→ DAX chỉ dành cho DynamoDB, không dùng cho RDS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

RDS read-only demand → ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached) để cache.

📖 Reference:

Amazon ElastiCache

Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that processes a stream of user-supplied data. The data stream must be consumed by multiple Amazon EC2 based processing applications in parallel and in real time. Each processor must be able to resume without losing data if there is a service interruption. The application architect plans to add other processors in the near future, and wants to minimize the amount of data duplication involved.

Which solution will satisfy these requirements?
o: Publish the data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS).
Publish the data to Amazon Data Firehose.
Publish the data to Amazon EventBridge.
Publish the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App cần xử lý real-time stream data từ người dùng.

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Nhiều EC2-based processors tiêu thụ song song.

    • Có thể resume mà không mất data sau service interruption.

    • Kiến trúc sẵn sàng để thêm processors mới trong tương lai.

    • Giảm duplication dữ liệu.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Publish the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

  • Dữ liệu được lưu trong stream nhiều giờ (tối đa 7 ngày).

  • Mỗi consumer có checkpoint riêng (iterator) để resume mà không mất dữ liệu.

  • Hỗ trợ multiple consumers (parallel) mà không cần duplicate data.

  • Thêm processor mới chỉ cần đăng ký consumer mới.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Publish the data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS).

  • Queue message được xử lý và bị xóa.

  • Không phù hợp cho streaming real-time data processing.

❌ Publish the data to Amazon Data Firehose.

Chỉ dùng để đưa data vào S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, Splunk, không cho nhiều custom consumer app xử lý real-time song song.

❌ Publish the data to Amazon EventBridge.

Event bus tối ưu cho event-driven integration (fan-out đến nhiều target services), nhưng không phù hợp cho streaming real-time data processing.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Kinesis Data Streams = best for real-time, multi-consumer, durable streaming use cases.

  • SQS = best for decoupling producer/consumer.

  • Firehose = for streaming data delivery in near real-time.

📖 Reference:

Kinesis Data Streams – Real-time data streaming

questions.q:
A developer published a change to a new version of an AWS Lambda function. To test the change, the developer must route 50% of the traffic to the new version and 50% of the traffic to the current version.

What is the MOST operationally efficient way to meet this requirement?
o: Create two Amazon Route 53 records that use a simple routing policy to route traffic to the different versions of the Lambda function. Create another Route 53 record that uses a weighted routing policy to route 50% of the traffic to each simple routing record. Test the Lambda function by using the weighted routing record.

Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a POST method that is integrated with the Lambda function. Add a stage variable that includes the version of the Lambda function. Add a canary release that will override the version variable 50% of the time. Deploy and test the Lambda function through the API Gateway stage.
Create a Lambda function alias. Set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version. Set the event source mappings for the Lambda function to point to the alias.
Update the event source mappings for the Lambda function. In the mappings, set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda có current version và new version.

  • Dev cần test bằng cách route traffic: 50% new, 50% current

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a Lambda function alias. Set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version. Set the event source mappings for the Lambda function to point to the alias.

→ Lambda alias hỗ trợ weighted traffic shifting giữa các versions.

→ Đây là cách native, dễ quản lý nhất để làm canary/linear deploy.

→ Event source (API Gateway, SQS, etc.) trỏ vào alias thay vì trực tiếp version.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create two Amazon Route 53 records that use a simple routing policy to route traffic to the different versions of the Lambda function. Create another Route 53 record that uses a weighted routing policy to route 50% of the traffic to each simple routing record. Test the Lambda function by using the weighted routing record.

→ Route 53 không route traffic trực tiếp đến Lambda versions. Sai service.

❌ Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a POST method that is integrated with the Lambda function. Add a stage variable that includes the version of the Lambda function. Add a canary release that will override the version variable 50% of the time. Deploy and test the Lambda function through the API Gateway stage.

→ Có thể dùng nhưng chỉ phù hợp khi Lambda được invoke qua API Gateway. Không general solution, và phức tạp hơn alias weighted routing.

❌ Update the event source mappings for the Lambda function. In the mappings, set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version.

→ Event source mapping không hỗ trợ weighted routing giữa versions. Chỉ alias mới có.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda alias weighted routing = cách chuẩn để test nhiều versions (canary, linear deployment).

📖 Reference:

Lambda aliases – Traffic shifting

questions.q:
A developer is implementing a serverless application by using AWS CloudFormation to provision Amazon S3 web hosting. Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda function source code is zipped and uploaded to an S3 bucket. The S3 object key of the zipped source code is specified in the Lambda resource in the CloudFormation template.

The developer notices that there are no changes in the Lambda function every time the CloudFormation stack is updated.

How can the developer resolve this issue?
o: Create a new Lambda function alias before updating the CloudFormation stack.
Change the S3 object key or the S3 version in the CloudFormation template before updating the CloudFormation stack.
Upload the zipped source code to another S3 bucket before updating the CioudFormation stack.
Associate a cade signing configuration with the Lambda function before updating the CloudFormation stack.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App serverless provisioned bằng CloudFormation:

    • S3 web hosting.

    • API Gateway.

    • Lambda (source code = .zip file trong S3).

  • CloudFormation template tham chiếu S3 object key.

  • Khi update stack, Lambda function không thay đổi → code cũ vẫn chạy.

  • Hãy giải quyết vấn đề trên

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Change the S3 object key or the S3 version in the CloudFormation template before updating the CloudFormation stack.

  • CloudFormation chỉ redeploy Lambda nếu S3Key hoặc S3ObjectVersion trong template thay đổi.

  • Dùng S3 versioned bucket và tham chiếu S3ObjectVersion trong template.

  • Hoặc đổi S3 object key mỗi lần upload code mới.

AWS CloudFormation template

  ImageUri: String
  S3Bucket: String
  S3Key: String
  S3ObjectVersion: String
  SourceKMSKeyArn: String
  ZipFile: String

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new Lambda function alias before updating the CloudFormation stack.

→ Alias chỉ quản lý version routing, không ép CloudFormation redeploy code.

❌ Upload the zipped source code to another S3 bucket before updating the CioudFormation stack.

→ Nếu S3Key không đổi trong template → vẫn không trigger update.

❌ Associate a cade signing configuration with the Lambda function before updating the CloudFormation stack.

→ Code signing = bảo mật, không liên quan đến trigger redeploy.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn Lambda cập nhật khi deploy bằng CloudFormation:

  • Luôn dùng versioned S3 bucket + S3ObjectVersion.

  • Hoặc đổi S3 object key theo version (vd: function_v2.zip).

📖 Reference:

AWS::Lambda::Function Code Property

questions.q:
A company has an Amazon API Gateway REST API that integrates with an AWS Lambda function. The API’s development stage references a development alias of the Lambda function named dev.

A developer needs make a production alias of the Lambda function named prod available through the API.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure the method to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure an integration request on the API’s development stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure the stage to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure an integration request on the API’s production stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway REST API → Lambda integration.

  • Development stage của API trỏ vào Lambda alias = dev.

  • Dev cần expose Lambda alias = prod qua API.

  • Giải pháp: phải có stage riêng cho prod, với stage variable/alias mapping.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure the stage to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.

  • Stage development → alias dev.

  • Stage production → alias prod.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure the method to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.

→ API methods là cho HTTP verbs (GET, POST, …), không dùng để phân tách environments.

❌ Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure an integration request on the API’s development stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.

→ Nếu làm vậy thì dev stage lại trỏ tới prod ⇒ phá vỡ isolation môi trường.

❌ Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure an integration request on the API’s production stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.

→ Có thể chạy, nhưng stage variables là cách recommended, ít effort, dễ quản lý alias mapping.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway: Stage = Environment.

  • Stage variables cho phép tham chiếu Lambda alias.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A company has implemented a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. The company is using a single AWS account and does not use AWS Organizations. The company needs to test its AWS CloudFormation templates in its primary AWS Region and a disaster recovery Region.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?
o: In the CodePipeline pipeline, implement an AWS CodeDeploy action for each Region to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Update CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild with appropriate permissions.
Configure CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Use CloudFormation StackSets to start deployment across both Regions.
Configure CodePipeline to invoke AWS CodeBuild to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region. Update CodeBuild and CloudFormation with appropriate permissions.
Use the Snyk action in CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng AWS CodePipeline (1 account, không dùng AWS Organizations).

  • Cần test CloudFormation templates ở primary Region và disaster recovery Region.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Use CloudFormation StackSets to start deployment across both Regions.

→ CloudFormation StackSets cho phép deploy cùng 1 template vào nhiều Region trong cùng 1 account (hoặc nhiều accounts).

→ Tích hợp dễ dàng vào CodePipeline → chỉ cần 1 action mà deploy được ra nhiều Region.

→ Đây là giải pháp native, ít overhead nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ In the CodePipeline pipeline, implement an AWS CodeDeploy action for each Region to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Update CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild with appropriate permissions.

→ CodeDeploy là cho app deployment (EC2, Lambda, ECS), không để test CloudFormation.

❌ Configure CodePipeline to invoke AWS CodeBuild to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region. Update CodeBuild and CloudFormation with appropriate permissions.

→ Có thể làm, nhưng phải viết custom script để chạy CloudFormation deploy trong từng Region ⇒ nhiều overhead hơn StackSets.

❌ Use the Snyk action in CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region.

→ Snyk = security scanning tool, không dùng để deploy/test CloudFormation templates.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Multi accounts, MultiRegions → dùng StackSets.

📖 Reference:

AWS CloudFormation StackSets

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process data. The application requires minimum latency. The Lambda function must have predictable function start times. All setup activities for the execution environment must happen before invocation of the Lambda function.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Increase the memory of the Lambda function to the maximum amount. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to schedule invocations of the Lambda function every minute to keep the execution environment active.

Optimize the static initialization code that runs when a new execution environment is prepared for the first time. Decrease and compress the size of the Lambda function package and the imported libraries and dependencies.

Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function to the maximum value for unreserved account concurrency. Run any setup activities manually before the initial invocation of the Lambda function.
Publish a new version of the Lambda function. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function with the required minimum number of execution environments.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function xử lý data.

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Minimum latency.

    • Predictable start times (không bị cold start).

    • Tất cả setup environment phải xong trước khi invoke.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Publish a new version of the Lambda function. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function with the required minimum number of execution environments.

→ Provisioned Concurrency giữ sẵn execution environment warm, init xong trước khi có request.

→ Giúp Lambda có start time predictable và latency thấp.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the memory of the Lambda function to the maximum amount. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to schedule invocations of the Lambda function every minute to keep the execution environment active.

→ Memory tăng chỉ giúp CPU mạnh hơn, không loại bỏ cold start.

→ EventBridge keep-alive hacky, không đảm bảo “predictable”.

❌ Optimize the static initialization code that runs when a new execution environment is prepared for the first time. Decrease and compress the size of the Lambda function package and the imported libraries and dependencies.

→ Giúp giảm cold start time, nhưng không loại bỏ hoàn toàn. Vẫn không predict được.

❌ Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function to the maximum value for unreserved account concurrency. Run any setup activities manually before the initial invocation of the Lambda function.

→ Reserved concurrency = limit concurrent executions, không ảnh hưởng đến cold start.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Provisioned Concurrency = cách duy nhất đảm bảo Lambda luôn sẵn sàng, không cold start.

  • Reserved concurrency ≠ warm concurrency.

  • Keep-alive hacks = không reliable, tốn tài nguyên.

📖 Reference:

Understanding reserved concurrency and provisioned concurrency

Lambda Provisioned Concurrency - Improving AWS Lambda Cold Start Times

questions.q:
An application ingests data from an Amazon Kinesis data stream. The shards in the data stream are set for normal traffic.

During tests for peak traffic, the application ingests data slowly. A developer needs to adjust the data stream to handle the peak traffic.

What should the developer do to meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
o: Install the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to ingest data into the data stream.
Switch to on-demand capacity mode for the data stream. Specify a partition key when writing data to the data stream.
Decrease the amount of time that data is kept in the data stream by using the DecreaseStreamRetentionPeriod API operation.
Increase the shard count in the data stream by using the UpdateShardCount API operation.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng ingest dữ liệu từ Kinesis Data Stream.

  • Bình thường thì ổn, nhưng khi peak traffic thì ingest chậm.

  • Dev cần điều chỉnh stream để handle peak traffic với chi phí tối ưu.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the shard count in the data stream by using the UpdateShardCount API operation.

  • Trong Kinesis, throughput phụ thuộc vào số shards.

  • Nếu ingest chậm ở peak traffic, tức là shard không đủ capacity (write = 1 MB/s hoặc 1000 record/s mỗi shard).

  • Giải pháp đúng và cost-effective là Split shard để tăng throughput.

  • Khi hết peak có thể giảm shard (Merge shards) để tiết kiệm chi phí.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to ingest data into the data stream.

KPL giúp optimize batching/aggregation, nhưng không giải quyết vấn đề thiếu shard capacity. Nếu throughput vượt shard limit thì vẫn nghẽn.

❌ Switch to on-demand capacity mode for the data stream. Specify a partition key when writing data to the data stream.

  • On-demand phù hợp nếu traffic unpredictable.

  • Nhưng ở đây đã có “normal traffic” và chỉ cần handle peak → tăng shard count rẻ hơn.

  • Partition key bắt buộc khi ghi data, nhưng không giải quyết bottleneck.

❌ Decrease the amount of time that data is kept in the data stream by using the DecreaseStreamRetentionPeriod API operation.

Chỉ giảm retention (từ mặc định 24h) để tiết kiệm chi phí lưu trữ, không giúp tăng throughput ingest.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Kinesis Data Stream throughput scale theo shard.

  • Mỗi shard: 1 MB/s write + 2 MB/s read.

  • Nếu ingest chậm → check shard limit trước.

📖 Reference:

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams – Resharding

Under the hood: Scaling your Kinesis data streams

questions.q:
An application stores user data in Amazon S3 buckets in multiple AWS Regions. A developer needs to implement a solution that analyzes the user data in the S3 buckets to find sensitive information. The analysis findings from all the S3 buckets must be available in the eu-west-2 Region.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create an AWS Lambda function to generate findings. Program the Lambda function to send the findings to another S3 bucket in eu-west-2.
Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.
Configure Amazon Inspector to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.
Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings and to publish the findings to AWS CloudTrail. Use a CloudTrail trail to copy the results to eu-west-2.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng lưu user data trên nhiều S3 bucket ở nhiều Region.

  • Cần giải pháp để analyze sensitive data trong S3 và tập trung kết quả findings ở Region eu-west-2.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.

→ Amazon Macie là dịch vụ chuyên để phát hiện và phân tích dữ liệu nhạy cảm trong S3 (PII, PCI, HIPAA…).

→ Findings của Macie có thể gửi qua EventBridge, từ đó thiết lập rule để consolidate findings về 1 Region (eu-west-2).

→ Đây là giải pháp native, managed, ít effort nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to generate findings. Program the Lambda function to send the findings to another S3 bucket in eu-west-2.

→ Phải tự code Lambda để scan dữ liệu và detect sensitive info → rất nhiều effort, không hiệu quả.

❌ Configure Amazon Inspector to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.

→ Inspector chuyên cho EC2, ECR, Lambda (security vulnerabilities), không phải để scan S3 sensitive data.

❌ Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings and to publish the findings to AWS CloudTrail. Use a CloudTrail trail to copy the results to eu-west-2.

→ Macie findings không publish trực tiếp qua CloudTrail. CloudTrail log API calls, không phải data classification findings.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Scan sensitive data trong S3 → dùng Amazon Macie.

📖 Reference:

Processing Macie findings with Amazon EventBridge

Building sensitive data remediation workflows in multi-account AWS environments

questions.q:
A developer built an application that uses AWS Lambda functions to process images. The developer wants to improve image processing times throughout the day.

The developer needs to create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights query that shows the average, slowest, and fastest processing time in 1-minute intervals.

Which query will meet these requirements?
o:
filter @type="REPORT"
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (lm)

filter @type = "DISPLAY" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (5m)

filter @type = "STATS" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (5m)

filter @type="PATTERN" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (lm)
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng dùng AWS Lambda để xử lý ảnh.

  • Dev muốn xem thời gian xử lý trung bình, nhanh nhất và chậm nhất theo từng khoảng 1 phút.

  • Cần viết query CloudWatch Logs Insights đúng cú pháp.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

filter @type="REPORT"
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (lm)

Trong CloudWatch Logs Insights:

  • @type="REPORT": dòng REPORT chứa thông tin duration, memory, init time của Lambda.

  • stats: dùng để tính avg / max / min.

  • @duration: metric thể hiện thời gian chạy Lambda.

  • bin(1m): gom nhóm dữ liệu theo 1 phút.

Các đáp án sai:

❌

filter @type = "DISPLAY" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (5m)

→ Không tồn tại DISPLAY type, và yêu cầu đề là 1 phút, không phải 5 phút.

❌

filter @type = "STATS" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (5m)

→ Không tồn tại STATS type, sai cú pháp.

❌

filter @type="PATTERN" 
    | stats avg (@duration), max (@duration), min (@duration) by bin (lm)

→ Không có PATTERN type, và lm là sai cú pháp (phải là 1m).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Muốn phân tích performance Lambda → dùng @type="REPORT".

  • Muốn chia khoảng thời gian → dùng bin(xm) (ví dụ 1m, 5m, 1h).

📖 Reference:

Viewing CloudWatch logs for Lambda functions

questions.q:
A company is developing a serverless application that requires storage of sensitive API keys as environment variables for various services. The application requires the automatic rotation of the encryption keys every year.

Which solution will meet these requirements with no development effort?
o: Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Secrets Manager. Set up automatic rotation in Secrets Manager.
Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Enable automatic key rotation.
Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed keys. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to automate key rotation.
Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set up automatic rotation in Parameter Store.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng serverless cần lưu trữ API keys nhạy cảm trong environment variables.

  • Yêu cầu: tự động rotate encryption keys mỗi năm, và phải không tốn effort phát triển thêm.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Enable automatic key rotation.

  • AWS KMS customer managed keys (CMKs) hỗ trợ tự động rotation hằng năm mà không cần code thêm.

  • đúng yêu cầu “no development effort”.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Secrets Manager. Set up automatic rotation in Secrets Manager.

Ở đây yêu cầu là rotate encryption keys, không phải rotate secrets.

❌ Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed keys. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to automate key rotation.

  • AWS managed keys (do AWS tạo sẵn) không cho phép user control rotation.

  • Muốn rotate phải tự viết Lambda → trái yêu cầu "no development effort".

❌ Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set up automatic rotation in Parameter Store.

Parameter Store có thể lưu secrets, nhưng rotation phải tích hợp với Lambda/Secrets Manager → vẫn cần code, không phải "no effort".

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Rotate KMS CMK tự động mỗi năm → enable auto key rotation.

  • AWS managed keys: không cho tùy chỉnh rotation.

  • Secrets Manager: rotate secrets, không rotate KMS keys.

📖 Reference:

Enable automatic key rotation

questions.q:
A developer needs to fix an AWS CodeDeploy deployment that failed. During the failed deployment, the developer received the following error message:

“The overall deployment failed because too many individual instances failed deployment, too few healthy instances are available for deployment, or some instances in your deployment group are experiencing problems. (Error code: HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS)”

What are the possible causes of the failed deployment? (Choose two.)
o: The CodeDeploy agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.
The unified Amazon CloudWatch agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.
The developer’s IAM role did not have the necessary permissions to perform code deployment to the instances.
CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were attached to an IAM instance profile that did not have the required permissions.
CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were not set up with correct CodeDeploy health checks.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev chạy AWS CodeDeploy nhưng deployment bị fail với lỗi:

  • HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS = quá nhiều instance fail, không đủ instance healthy, hoặc instance gặp vấn đề trong deployment group.

  • Hỏi: nguyên nhân là gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The CodeDeploy agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.

  • CodeDeploy bắt buộc cần agent trên EC2/on-prem để thực hiện deployment.

  • Nếu agent không chạy → instance báo unhealthy → fail.

CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were not set up with correct CodeDeploy health checks.

  • Nếu health check config sai (ví dụ: load balancer health check fail, lifecycle event scripts lỗi) → instance unhealthy → fail với error HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The unified Amazon CloudWatch agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.

→ Không liên quan. CloudWatch agent chỉ để metrics/logs, không ảnh hưởng tới CodeDeploy health.

❌ The developer’s IAM role did not have the necessary permissions to perform code deployment to the instances.

→ Nếu thiếu permission thì fail ngay từ đầu (AccessDenied), không phải HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS.

❌ CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were attached to an IAM instance profile that did not have the required permissions.

→ Instance profile cần thiết để download appspec/app từ S3 hoặc pull log, nhưng lỗi đó sẽ hiển thị khác (AccessDenied/Failure), không phải HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS = vấn đề về agent hoặc health check.

  • Permission issues sẽ trả về AccessDenied, không phải health constraint.

📖 Reference:

AWS CodeDeploy – Error Code HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS

questions.q:
A developer is using an AWS Lambda function to process data. The developer needs to extract custom metrics about processing times from the Lambda logs. The developer needs to analyze the metrics, set alarms, and detect issues in real time.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Publish custom metric data to AWS CloudTrail by using the PutMetricData API operation. Classify and collect the metrics. Create graphs and alarms in CloudTrail for the custom metrics.

Use the open source client libraries provided by Amazon to generate the logs in the Amazon CloudWatch embedded metric format. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.
Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to create custom metrics by querying the logs that come from the Lambda function. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.

Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to stream log events in real time from Lambda. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination for the Kinesis data stream. Use Amazon CloudWatch to visualize the log data and to set alarms.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev có Lambda function xử lý dữ liệu.

  • Cần trích xuất custom metrics về processing time từ log, sau đó phân tích, tạo alarm, phát hiện sự cố real-time.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the open source client libraries provided by Amazon to generate the logs in the Amazon CloudWatch embedded metric format. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.

  • Lambda có thể ghi log theo CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format (EMF) → log sẽ được CloudWatch tự động chuyển thành custom metrics.

  • Trực tiếp tạo graph và alarm trong CloudWatch.

  • Đây là giải pháp native, real-time, ít effort.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Publish custom metric data to AWS CloudTrail by using the PutMetricData API operation. Classify and collect the metrics. Create graphs and alarms in CloudTrail for the custom metrics.

→ CloudTrail dùng để log API calls, không dùng cho metrics.

❌

Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to create custom metrics by querying the logs that come from the Lambda function. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.

→ Logs Insights chỉ để truy vấn ad-hoc, không tạo realtime custom metrics.

❌ Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to stream log events in real time from Lambda. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination for the Kinesis data stream. Use Amazon CloudWatch to visualize the log data and to set alarms.

→ Quá phức tạp, không cần thiết. CloudWatch EMF đã xử lý trực tiếp từ Lambda log.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Custom metrics từ Lambda logs → dùng Embedded Metric Format (EMF).

  • CloudWatch Logs Insights = query logs, không tạo alarm real-time.

  • CloudTrail = audit API calls, không phải metrics.

📖 Reference:

Embedding metrics within logs

Enhancing workload observability using Amazon CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format

questions.q:
A developer has an application that uses AWS Lambda functions and AWS CloudFormation templates. Usage of the application has increased. As a result, the Lambda functions are encountering rate limit errors when they retrieve data.

The Lambda functions retrieve an advanced parameter from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store on every call. The parameter changes only during new deployments. Because the application’s usage is unpredictable, the developer needs a way to avoid the rate limiting.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Configure the Lambda functions to use reserved concurrency that is equal to the last month’s average number of concurrent invocations.
Add a retry mechanism with exponential backoff to the call to Parameter Store.
Request a service quota increase for Parameter Store GetParameter API operations to match the expected usage of the Lambda functions.
Add an SSM dynamic reference as an environment variable to the Lambda functions resource in the CloudFormation templates.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda bị rate limit khi mỗi lần gọi đều GetParameter (advanced parameter) từ SSM Parameter Store.

  • Tham số chỉ đổi khi deploy.

  • Traffic khó đoán → cần cách tránh rate limit, tiết kiệm chi phí.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add an SSM dynamic reference as an environment variable to the Lambda functions resource in the CloudFormation templates.

→ SSM Dynamic Reference trong CloudFormation sẽ resolve giá trị tại thời điểm deploy, gán thẳng vào environment variable của Lambda.

→ Runtime không còn gọi Parameter Store mỗi request → hết nguy cơ rate limit, giảm latency và chi phí.

→ Phù hợp vì tham số chỉ thay đổi khi deploy.

Reference pattern:

{{resolve:ssm:parameter-name:version}}

Example:

Resources:
  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: my-function
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: arn:aws:iam::1234567890xx:role/lambda-role
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MY_SECRET: '{{resolve:ssm:/myapp/config/dbpassword:1}}'
      Code:
        S3Bucket: my-bucket
        S3Key: lambda-code.zip

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the Lambda functions to use reserved concurrency that is equal to the last month’s average number of concurrent invocations.

→ Giới hạn/sắp xếp concurrency không xử lý nguyên nhân gốc (throttling từ SSM).

❌ Add a retry mechanism with exponential backoff to the call to Parameter Store.

→ Chỉ giảm bớt lỗi tạm thời, vẫn tốn call SSM, tăng latency và không “cost-effective”.

❌ Request a service quota increase for Parameter Store GetParameter API operations to match the expected usage of the Lambda functions.

→ Tăng quota = tăng chi phí/độ phức tạp vận hành; không cần thiết khi có cách loại bỏ hoàn toàn call runtime.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Tham số đổi khi deploy → dùng Dynamic References (SSM/Secrets Manager) trong CloudFormation để tránh rate limiting.

📖 Reference:

Get a plaintext value from Systems Manager Parameter Store

questions.q:
A developer is creating a web application to upload and store private data. The application will encrypt private data and then will upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

The developer needs to implement a solution to automatically find any unencrypted private data in the S3 bucket. The solution must monitor the security and access control of the S3 bucket and must provide a notification if there are any security issues.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use AWS Step Functions to run Amazon Athena queries. Configure Athena to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues in the S3 bucket. Start the queries when new objects are added to the S3 bucket. Configure Athena to provide a notification if security issues are detected.

Enable Amazon Macie for the S3 bucket. Set up custom criteria to find unencrypted private data in the S3 bucket. Set up AWS User Notifications to provide a notification when Macie detects security issues.

Enable Amazon Inspector for the AWS account. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the S3 bucket to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Set up Amazon EventBridge to provide a notification when Amazon Inspector detects security issues.

Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon S3 to send new object notifications to the stream. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs every 10 minutes to check the stream for unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Program the Lambda function to provide a notification when security issues are detected.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Web app upload dữ liệu private lên S3.

  • Ứng dụng tự mã hóa trước khi upload, nhưng cần giải pháp tự động phát hiện bất kỳ dữ liệu private nào không được mã hóa trong bucket.

  • Đồng thời phải giám sát bảo mật/quyền truy cập của S3 bucket và gửi thông báo khi có vấn đề.

  • Yêu cầu: giải pháp managed, ít effort.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable Amazon Macie for the S3 bucket. Set up custom criteria to find unencrypted private data in the S3 bucket. Set up AWS User Notifications to provide a notification when Macie detects security issues.

→ Amazon Macie chuyên phát hiện dữ liệu nhạy cảm trong S3 (PII, PCI, v.v.) và đánh giá security posture của S3 bucket (public access, bucket policy, default encryption, v.v.).

→ Có thể cấu hình classification job với custom criteria để phát hiện dữ liệu private/sensitive và xác định trường hợp không được mã hóa.

→ Findings từ Macie có thể gửi qua AWS User Notifications (hoặc EventBridge) để push cảnh báo.

→ Giải pháp native, managed, hầu như không cần code.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS Step Functions to run Amazon Athena queries. Configure Athena to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues in the S3 bucket. Start the queries when new objects are added to the S3 bucket. Configure Athena to provide a notification if security issues are detected.

Phải tự dựng pipeline (S3 Inventory/Athena queries/trigger) để dò encryption & security issues → nhiều effort, không chuyên cho phát hiện dữ liệu nhạy cảm.

❌ Enable Amazon Inspector for the AWS account. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the S3 bucket to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Set up Amazon EventBridge to provide a notification when Amazon Inspector detects security issues.

  • Inspector không quét S3 để tìm dữ liệu nhạy cảm hay kiểm tra access control của S3.

  • Inspector chủ yếu cho EC2/ECR/Lambda vulnerability scanning.

❌ Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon S3 to send new object notifications to the stream. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs every 10 minutes to check the stream for unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Program the Lambda function to provide a notification when security issues are detected.

  • Giải pháp phức tạp, tốn chi phí vận hành.

  • Không bằng Macie (đã có classification + findings + tích hợp cảnh báo).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Tìm dữ liệu nhạy cảm + posture S3 → Amazon Macie là dịch vụ đúng bài.

📖 Reference:

Concepts and terminology in Macie

questions.q:
A developer is building an application on AWS. The application has an Amazon API Gateway API that sends requests to an AWS Lambda function. The API is experiencing increased latency because the Lambda function has limited available CPU to fulfill the requests.

Before the developer deploys the API into production, the developer must configure the Lambda function to have more CPU.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Increase the virtual CPU (vCPU) cores quota of the Lambda function.
Increase the amount of memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Increase the ephemeral storage size of the Lambda function.
Increase the timeout value of the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng có API Gateway → Lambda.

  • API bị latency cao vì Lambda thiếu CPU.

  • Dev cần tăng CPU cho Lambda trước khi đưa vào production.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the amount of memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.

  • Lambda không thể tăng CPU riêng lẻ, mà phải tăng memory → Lambda sẽ được cấp thêm CPU.

  • Đây là cách chuẩn và duy nhất để tăng CPU cho Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the virtual CPU (vCPU) cores quota of the Lambda function.

→ Lambda không cho tăng trực tiếp vCPU quota. CPU scale theo memory.

❌ Increase the ephemeral storage size of the Lambda function.

→ Ephemeral storage (512 MB – 10 GB) chỉ ảnh hưởng tới disk space tạm (/tmp), không ảnh hưởng CPU.

❌ Increase the timeout value of the Lambda function.

→ Chỉ kéo dài thời gian chạy, không tăng CPU. Có thể còn làm latency tệ hơn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda muốn tăng performance (CPU-bound) → tăng memory.

📖 Reference:

Configuring function memory (console)

questions.q:
A developer is working on a project that requires regular updates to a web application’s backend code. The code is stored in AWS CodeCommit. Company policy states that all code must have complete unit testing and that the test results must be available for access.

The developer needs to implement a solution that will take each change to the code repository, build the code, and run unit tests. The solution also must provide a detailed report of the test results.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure AWS CodeDeploy to deploy code from CodeCommit and to run unit tests. Send the test results to Amazon CloudWatch metrics to view reports.
Configure Amazon CodeWhisperer to create the code and to run unit tests. Save the test results in an Amazon S3 bucket to generate reports.
Configure AWS CodeBuild to build the code and to run unit tests. Use test reporting in CodeBuild to generate and view reports.
Create AWS Lambda functions that run when changes are made in CodeCommit. Program the Lambda functions to build the code, run unit tests, and save the test results to a Lambda layer.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

Công ty yêu cầu:

  • Code lưu trong CodeCommit.

  • Mỗi khi code thay đổi → phải build + chạy unit test.

  • Báo cáo test phải sẵn có để truy cập.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure AWS CodeBuild to build the code and to run unit tests. Use test reporting in CodeBuild to generate and view reports.

  • CodeBuild là dịch vụ CI/CD managed của AWS → có thể build code, chạy unit tests.

  • Test reports là tính năng built-in trong CodeBuild: hỗ trợ JUnit, Cucumber, NUnit… → tạo báo cáo chi tiết, truy cập ngay trên console.

  • Đây là giải pháp đúng yêu cầu, ít effort.

Example of a buildspec.yaml reports section:

reports:
    DotnetTestExamples:
        file-format: VisualStudioTrx
        files:
            - '**/*'
        base-directory: './testresults'

View test report

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure AWS CodeDeploy to deploy code from CodeCommit and to run unit tests. Send the test results to Amazon CloudWatch metrics to view reports.

→ CodeDeploy dùng để triển khai ứng dụng (EC2, Lambda, ECS), không phải build/test.

❌ Configure Amazon CodeWhisperer to create the code and to run unit tests. Save the test results in an Amazon S3 bucket to generate reports.

→ CodeWhisperer là AI code suggestion tool, không build hay chạy test.

❌ Create AWS Lambda functions that run when changes are made in CodeCommit. Program the Lambda functions to build the code, run unit tests, and save the test results to a Lambda layer.

→ Có thể custom làm, nhưng quá phức tạp, không có test reporting built-in, sai với yêu cầu "có báo cáo test".

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Test Reports → chỉ cần CodeBuild.

📖 Reference:

Create test reports

AWS CodeBuild Test Reporting with .NET Core

questions.q:
A developer adds new dependencies to an existing AWS Lambda function. The developer cannot deploy the Lambda function because the unzipped deployment package exceeds the maximum size quota for the Lambda function. The instruction set architecture of the Lambda function is x86_64.

The developer must implement a solution to deploy the Lambda function with the new dependencies.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a snapshot of all the dependencies. Configure the Lambda function to use the snapshot.
Change the instruction set architecture of the Lambda function to use an arm64 architecture.
Associate an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the Lambda function. Store all the dependencies on the EBS volume.
Create and deploy a Lambda container image with all the dependencies.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev thêm dependency vào Lambda function → package unzip vượt quá quota (≥ 250 MB).

  • Kiến trúc hiện tại: x86_64.

  • Cần giải pháp deploy Lambda với đầy đủ dependencies.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create and deploy a Lambda container image with all the dependencies.

→ Lambda hỗ trợ container image (dung lượng tối đa 10 GB).

→ Dev có thể đóng gói code + dependency thành Docker image, push lên Amazon ECR, sau đó deploy Lambda từ image.

→ Đây là cách native, đơn giản nhất để xử lý khi deployment package vượt quá limit của .zip.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a snapshot of all the dependencies. Configure the Lambda function to use the snapshot.

→ Lambda không hỗ trợ snapshot dependency. Không phải giải pháp khả thi.

❌ Change the instruction set architecture of the Lambda function to use an arm64 architecture.

→ arm64 chỉ giúp tối ưu chi phí/hiệu năng, không làm tăng quota package. Vẫn không deploy được nếu vượt 250 MB.

❌ Associate an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the Lambda function. Store all the dependencies on the EBS volume.

→ Lambda không hỗ trợ attach EBS. Chỉ hỗ trợ ephemeral storage /tmp (512 MB – 10 GB) hoặc Amazon EFS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • .zip package ≤ 50 MB zipped, ≤ 250 MB unzipped.

  • Lambda Layer: dùng khi chia nhỏ dependency, nhưng vẫn bị giới hạn.

  • Container image: tối đa 10 GB, phù hợp khi dependency nặng.

📖 Reference:

Lambda quotas

Create a Lambda function using a container image

questions.q:
A developer is creating a script to automate the deployment process for a serverless application. The developer wants to use an existing AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template for the application.

What should the developer use for the project? (Choose two.)
o: Call aws cloudformation package to create the deployment package. Call aws cloudformation deploy to deploy the package afterward.
Call sam package to create the deployment package. Call sam deploy to deploy the package afterward.
Call aws s3 cp to upload the AWS SAM template to Amazon S3. Call aws lambda update-function-code to create the application.
Create a ZIP package locally and call aws serverlessrepo create-application to create the application.
Create a ZIP package and upload it to Amazon S3. Call aws cloudformation create-stack to create the application.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev muốn viết script tự động deploy serverless app dựa trên AWS SAM template có sẵn.

  • Hỏi nên dùng công cụ/lệnh nào. (Chọn hai)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Call sam package to create the deployment package. Call sam deploy to deploy the package afterward.

→ SAM CLI: sam package upload artifacts lên S3 và tạo output template đã thay thế CodeUri bằng S3 object.

→ sam deploy deploy stack (tạo/ cập nhật) qua CloudFormation.

→ Cách native, ít effort nhất khi làm với SAM.

Call aws cloudformation package to create the deployment package. Call aws cloudformation deploy to deploy the package afterward.

→ Bộ lệnh AWS CLI này là tương đương với sam package/deploy, cũng xử lý SAM transform và thay thế CodeUri bằng S3 object.

→ Hữu ích khi không cài SAM CLI nhưng vẫn muốn deploy SAM template qua CloudFormation.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Call aws s3 cp to upload the AWS SAM template to Amazon S3. Call aws lambda update-function-code to create the application.

→ Chỉ upload template và cập nhật code Lambda thủ công; không xử lý đầy đủ tài nguyên trong SAM (API Gateway, IAM, DynamoDB…) và không thay thế CodeUri. Không phải quy trình deploy SAM.

❌ Create a ZIP package locally and call aws serverlessrepo create-application to create the application.

→ Lệnh Serverless Application Repository dùng để publish ứng dụng lên SAR, không phải để deploy SAM template của bạn. Yêu cầu metadata khác hẳn, không phù hợp.

❌ Create a ZIP package and upload it to Amazon S3. Call aws cloudformation create-stack to create the application.

→ Thiếu bước package để biến đổi CodeUri (đường dẫn local) sang S3 URI; CloudFormation không tự xử lý local paths trong SAM template. Quy trình không đúng cho SAM.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Script tự động deploy serverless app:

  • sam build → sam package → sam deploy

  • cloudformation package/deploy

📖 Reference:

AWS SAM CLI command reference

Package and deploy a template with local artifacts

Simplifying operations

questions.q:
A developer is creating a database of products. Queries for frequently accessed products must have retrieval times of microseconds. To ensure data consistency, the application cache must be updated whenever products are added, changed, or deleted.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Set up an Amazon DynamoDB database and a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy with ElastiCache.
Set up an Amazon DynamoDB database that has an in-memory cache. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy in the application.
Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Specify a TTL setting for the DAX cluster.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev cần database lưu sản phẩm.

  • Query sản phẩm thường xuyên → yêu cầu retrieval time microseconds.

  • Phải data consistency: cache luôn update khi thêm/sửa/xoá.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up an Amazon DynamoDB database and a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.

  • DAX cung cấp độ trễ microseconds cho đọc nhờ in-memory caching.

  • Hỗ trợ write-through: khi ứng dụng gọi Put/Update/Delete qua DAX, DAX ghi vào DynamoDB rồi cập nhật/ghi-đè/invalidates cache ngay → dữ liệu trong cache luôn nhất quán sau các thay đổi.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy with ElastiCache.

Lazy loading chỉ nạp cache khi đọc; khi ghi (add/change/delete) không tự cập nhật cache → dễ bị stale.

❌ Set up an Amazon DynamoDB database that has an in-memory cache. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy in the application.

DynamoDB bản thân không có built-in cache (ngoài DAX). Lazy loading → không đảm bảo consistency khi data thay đổi.

❌ Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Specify a TTL setting for the DAX cluster.

DAX chỉ dùng cho DynamoDB, không dùng cho RDS. TTL không phải cơ chế update cache mà chỉ để expire data. Sai hoàn toàn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần microseconds + nhất quán sau ghi với DynamoDB → chọn DAX (write-through).

  • Tránh lazy loading khi yêu cầu cache phải phản ánh ngay thay đổi dữ liệu.

📖 Reference:

DAX: How it works

questions.q:
A gaming application stores scores for players in an Amazon DynamoDB table that has four attributes: user_id, user_name, user_score, and user_rank. The users are allowed to update their names only. A user is authenticated by web identity federation.

Which set of conditions should be added in the policy attached to the role for the dynamodb:PutItem API call?
o:
"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_id}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name"
    ]
  }
}

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_name}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_id}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name",
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_name}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name",
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Game app lưu điểm trong DynamoDB với 4 thuộc tính: user_id, user_name, user_score, user_rank.

  • User chỉ được phép cập nhật tên (user_name).

  • User authenticated bằng web identity federation.

  • Cần cấu hình policy condition cho dynamodb:PutItem để:

    • Chỉ cho phép user thao tác đúng item của họ (khóa = user_id).

    • Chỉ được ghi vào thuộc tính user_name.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_id}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name"
    ]
  }
}

→ dynamodb:LeadingKeys đảm bảo user chỉ Put/Update item có partition key bằng chính user_id của họ (lấy từ claim của IdP).

→ dynamodb:Attributes: ["user_name"] giới hạn chỉ được ghi thuộc tính user_name, không được chạm vào user_id, user_score, user_rank.

→ Đáp ứng đúng yêu cầu “chỉ đổi tên” và “đúng item của mình”.

Các đáp án sai:

❌

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_name}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}

→ So sánh key theo user_name là sai: partition key là user_id. Lại còn cho phép ghi user_id (không được phép).

❌

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_id}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name",
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}

→ Cho phép ghi cả user_id → vi phạm yêu cầu (user chỉ được đổi user_name).

❌

"Condition": {
  "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
    "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": [
      "${www.amazon.com:user_name}"
    ],
    "dynamodb:Attributes": [
      "user_name",
      "user_id"
    ]
  }
}

→ Sai cả khóa so sánh (user_name), và vẫn cho ghi user_id.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Fine-grained access DynamoDB:

  • Dùng dynamodb:LeadingKeys để ghim user vào đúng item của họ.

  • Dùng dynamodb:Attributes để hạn chế thuộc tính có thể ghi/đọc.

  • Với web identity federation, map claim (ví dụ sub/user_id) sang biến policy như ${www.amazon.com:user_id}.

📖 Reference:

Using web identity federation

questions.q:
A developer is working on an ecommerce application that stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster. The developer needs to implement a caching layer for the application to retrieve information about the most viewed products.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Edit the RDS for MySQL cluster by adding a cache node. Configure the cache endpoint instead of the cluster endpoint in the application.
Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use the ElastiCache for Redis cluster endpoint.
Create an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the RDS for MySQL cluster. Configure the application to connect to the DAX endpoint instead of the RDS endpoint.
Configure the RDS for MySQL cluster to add a standby instance in a different Availability Zone. Configure the application to read the data from the standby instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng ecommerce dùng Amazon RDS for MySQL.

  • Cần thêm lớp cache để truy xuất thông tin sản phẩm được xem nhiều nhất nhanh hơn.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use the ElastiCache for Redis cluster endpoint.

→ Redis (in-memory) cho độ trễ rất thấp, phù hợp làm cache hot items (most viewed).

→ Dễ tích hợp: app ghi/đọc key (ví dụ topN:products) từ Redis, giảm tải cho RDS.
