→ CodeArtifact là dịch vụ package repository, không dùng để chạy test/report.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần test + report trong CodePipeline → dùng CodeBuild + buildspec.yml.

  • reports: section trong buildspec giúp xuất kết quả ra CodeBuild/CodePipeline console.

📖 Reference:

AWS CodeBuild – Test Reporting in Buildspec

questions.q:
A developer needs to freeze changes to an AWS CodeCommit repository before a production release. The developer will work on new features while a quality assurance (QA) team tests the release.

The QA testing and all bug fixes must take place in isolation from the main branch. After the release, the developer must integrate all bug fixes into the main branch.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Merge the release branch into the main branch after the release.

Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply fixes to the main branch. Update the Git tag for the release to be on the latest commit on the main branch.

Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Rebase the main branch onto the release branch after the release.

Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply the Git commits for fixes to the Git tag for the release.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Cần “đóng băng” code để QA test bản phát hành.

  • QA và bugfix phải tách biệt với main.

  • Sau khi release xong, cần tích hợp mọi bugfix vào main.

  • Dev vẫn tiếp tục phát triển tính năng mới song song.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Merge the release branch into the main branch after the release.

  • Tạo release branch từ commit chuẩn bị phát hành để QA test và fix bug cô lập khỏi main.

  • Dev tiếp tục phát triển tính năng mới trên main (hoặc nhánh tính năng).

  • Khi release xong, merge release branch → main để đưa toàn bộ bugfix vào dòng chính.

  • Đây là quy trình chuẩn (tương tự GitFlow).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply fixes to the main branch. Update the Git tag for the release to be on the latest commit on the main branch.

  • Tag chỉ là điểm đánh dấu → không chứa commit mới.

  • Fix bug trực tiếp trên main sẽ không cô lập khỏi tính năng mới.

❌ Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Rebase the main branch onto the release branch after the release.

  • Rebase main lên release dễ gây rewrite lịch sử, xung đột và rủi ro.

  • Chuẩn nhất là merge release → main sau khi QA xong.

❌ Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply the Git commits for fixes to the Git tag for the release.

  • Không thể “apply commit vào tag”.

  • Tag không phải nhánh để nhận commit.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần “đóng băng” để QA: tạo release branch.

  • Sau QA: merge release → main để gom toàn bộ bugfix.

📖 Reference:

Implement a GitHub Flow branching strategy for multi-account DevOps environments

questions.q:
A developer builds a serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon Route 53. During testing, the developer notices errors but cannot immediately locate the root cause.

To identify the errors, the developer needs to search all the application's logs.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Set up API Gateway health checks to monitor the application's availability. Use the Amazon CloudWatch PutMetricData API operation to publish the logs to CloudWatch. Search and query the logs by using Amazon Athena.

Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on AWS CloudTrail logs for all the AWS services that the application uses. Send the logs to a specified Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log files directly from Amazon S3.

Configure all the application's AWS services to publish a real-time feed of log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to publish all the logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to search and analyze the logs.

Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API Gateway stages to log API requests with a JSON log format. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to search and analyze the logs from the AWS services that the application uses.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng serverless gồm API Gateway + Lambda + Route 53.

  • Trong quá trình test, dev thấy lỗi nhưng không tìm được ngay nguyên nhân.

  • Yêu cầu: tìm kiếm log toàn bộ ứng dụng với ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API Gateway stages to log API requests with a JSON log format. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to search and analyze the logs from the AWS services that the application uses.

  • API Gateway và Lambda đều tích hợp native với CloudWatch Logs.

  • Dùng CloudWatch Logs Insights để search, filter, và query log tập trung.

  • Ít vận hành nhất vì không cần thêm service như Kinesis, Athena, hay OpenSearch.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up API Gateway health checks to monitor the application's availability. Use the Amazon CloudWatch PutMetricData API operation to publish the logs to CloudWatch. Search and query the logs by using Amazon Athena.

  • PutMetricData dùng để ghi custom metrics, không phù hợp để lưu log.

  • Athena không phải công cụ query trực tiếp log CloudWatch.

❌ Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on AWS CloudTrail logs for all the AWS services that the application uses. Send the logs to a specified Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log files directly from Amazon S3.

CloudTrail chỉ log API call đến AWS control plane (management API), không log traffic/app error → Không giải quyết vấn đề tìm lỗi trong app.

❌ Configure all the application's AWS services to publish a real-time feed of log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to publish all the logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to search and analyze the logs.

Làm được, nhưng phải thiết lập nhiều dịch vụ, vận hành phức tạp → Overkill so với CloudWatch Logs đã có sẵn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • App serverless (API Gateway, Lambda) → luôn bật CloudWatch Logs.

  • Query nhanh → dùng CloudWatch Logs Insights.

📖 Reference:

Viewing CloudWatch logs for Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer has an application that uses WebSocket APIs in Amazon API Gateway. The developer wants to use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to control access to the application.

The developer needs to add credential caching and reduce repeated usage of secret keys and authorization tokens on every request.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Use a token-based Lambda authorizer.
Use a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer.
Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the context map from the API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the identity API key value from the API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
Use VPC endpoint policies for the WebSocket APIs.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng API Gateway WebSocket và muốn Lambda authorizer để kiểm soát truy cập.

  • Mục tiêu: caching thông tin xác thực và tránh gửi lại secret/token ở mọi request.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Use a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer.

  • WebSocket APIs dùng Lambda authorizer kiểu request (REQUEST) lấy identity từ headers/queryStrings/stageVariables để cache kết quả (TTL).

  • Cho phép authorize ở $connect rồi tái sử dụng output đã cache cho các route sau.

Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the context map from the APIGateway Lambda authorizer.

  • Sau khi authorizer chạy, thông tin được đặt trong $context.authorizer.*.

  • Tại integration mapping template, tham chiếu $context.authorizer để truyền danh tính/quyền xuống backend mà không cần gửi lại token mỗi lần.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Use a token-based Lambda authorizer.
Token-based (TOKEN) là cho REST API → WebSocket API dùng REQUEST.

❌ Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the identity API key value from the API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
API key không phải cơ chế auth/authorization → Không giải quyết caching credential.

❌ Use VPC endpoint policies for the WebSocket APIs.
VPC endpoint policies liên quan đến quyền truy cập qua PrivateLink, không xử lý auth/caching cho WebSocket messages.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • WebSocket + Lambda authorizer → REQUEST authorizer + TTL cache.

  • Dùng $context.authorizer.* trong mapping template để truyền claims/roles mà không cần token mỗi request.

📖 Reference:

Control and manage access to WebSocket APIs in API Gateway

Control access to WebSocket APIs with AWS Lambda REQUEST authorizers

questions.q:
A developer is creating an application that must transfer expired items from Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon S3. The developer sets up the DynamoDB table to automatically delete items after a specific TTL. The application must process the items in DynamoDB and then must store the expired items in Amazon S3. The entire process, including item processing and storage in Amazon S3, will take 5 minutes.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to query for expired items based on the TTL. Save the results to Amazon S3.
Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

Deploy a custom application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Program the custom application to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng cần chuyển item hết hạn (TTL) từ DynamoDB sang S3.

  • Bảng DynamoDB đã bật TTL auto-delete.

  • Toàn bộ xử lý (process + lưu S3) mất ~5 phút.

  • Yêu cầu: ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

  • Khi TTL xóa item, DynamoDB Streams phát sinh bản ghi REMOVE → Bật stream với OLD_IMAGE để lấy dữ liệu item trước khi xóa.

  • Lambda (timeout ≤ 15 phút) xử lý từng bản ghi và ghi sang S3 → hoàn toàn serverless, không cần quản trị hạ tầng → Đáp ứng thời lượng 5 phút và “ít overhead” nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to query for expired items based on the TTL. Save the results to Amazon S3.

→ DAX là cache để tăng tốc đọc/ghi, không hỗ trợ truy vấn item đã hết hạn TTL, và không phát hiện sự kiện xóa.

❌ Deploy a custom application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Program the custom application to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

→ Chạy ECS trên EC2 cần quản trị cụm, scaling, patching → overhead cao so với Lambda + Streams.

❌ Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

→ EventBridge không biết item nào vừa hết hạn; phải tự quét/scan bảng để tìm item TTL → tốn tài nguyên và phức tạp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Bật DynamoDB Streams (OLD_IMAGE) để nhận bản ghi xóa do TTL.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB Streams and AWS Lambda triggers

questions.q:
A company has an ecommerce web application that uses an on-premises MySQL database as a data store. The company migrates the on-premises MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL.

A developer needs to configure the application's access to the RDS for MySQL database. The developer's solution must not use long term credentials.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Enable IAM database authentication on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions. Assign the role to the application.
Store the MySQL credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the secrets. Assign the role to the application.
Configure the MySQL credentials as environment variables that are available at runtime for the application.

Store the MySQL credentials as SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the parameters. Assign the role to the application.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App ecommerce dùng MySQL on-premises → đã migrate lên Amazon RDS for MySQL.

  • Yêu cầu: App phải kết nối tới RDS nhưng không dùng long-term credentials.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Enable IAM database authentication on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions. Assign the role to the application.

  • Với IAM DB Authentication, app có thể dùng IAM token tạm thời (15 phút) thay vì password cố định.

  • Đây là cơ chế native để tránh long-term credentials, phù hợp nhất cho yêu cầu đề bài.

  • App chỉ cần assume role được gán quyền rds-db:connect.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ BStore the MySQL credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager.
→ Secrets Manager vẫn phải tạo long-term credentials ban đầu để quản lý (mặc dù có thể rotate). Đề yêu cầu không dùng long-term credentials.

❌ Configure the MySQL credentials as environment variables that are available at runtime for the application.
→ Đây chính là hardcode credentials, vẫn là long-term credentials, không an toàn.

❌ Store the MySQL credentials as SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
→ Cũng cần long-term credentials được lưu ở Parameter Store. Không đáp ứng yêu cầu “không dùng long-term credentials”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • RDS MySQL/PostgreSQL/MariaDB có hỗ trợ IAM Database Authentication → tránh lưu password cố định.

  • Khi đề thi AWS nhấn mạnh “no long-term credentials” → nghĩ ngay đến IAM-based temporary credentials.

📖 Reference:

IAM database authentication for MariaDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL

IAM authentication with Amazon RDS for MariaDB

questions.q:
A company had an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that was named mysql-db. The DB instance was deleted within the past 90 days.

A developer needs to find which IAM user or role deleted the DB instance in the AWS environment.

Which solution will provide this information?
o: Retrieve the AWS CloudTrail events for the resource mysql-db where the event name is DeleteDBInstance. Inspect each event.
Retrieve the Amazon CloudWatch log events from the most recent log stream within the rds/mysql-db log group. Inspect the log events.
Retrieve the AWS X-Ray trace summaries. Filter by services with the name mysql-db. Inspect the ErrorRootCauses values within each summary.
Retrieve the AWS Systems Manager deletions inventory. Filter the inventory by deletions that have a TypeName value of RDS. Inspect the deletion details.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Một DB instance RDS MySQL (mysql-db) đã bị xóa trong vòng 90 ngày qua.

  • Dev cần biết IAM user hoặc role nào đã xóa DB này.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Retrieve the AWS CloudTrail events for the resource mysql-db where the event name is DeleteDBInstance. Inspect each event.

  • CloudTrail log tất cả management API calls, bao gồm DeleteDBInstance.

  • Event chứa thông tin IAM identity (user/role) thực hiện hành động.

  • Đây là cách chính xác để truy ra ai đã xóa RDS instance.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Retrieve the Amazon CloudWatch log events from the most recent log stream within the rds/mysql-db log group. Inspect the log events.

CloudWatch log group rds/mysql-db chỉ chứa log của DB engine (error, general, slow query logs) → Không ghi lại hành động quản trị RDS như DeleteDBInstance.

❌ Retrieve the AWS X-Ray trace summaries. Filter by services with the name mysql-db. Inspect the ErrorRootCauses values within each summary.

X-Ray dùng để trace request trong app → Không theo dõi event quản trị RDS.

❌ Retrieve the AWS Systems Manager deletions inventory. Filter the inventory by deletions that have a TypeName value of RDS. Inspect the deletion details.

→ Không tồn tại khái niệm “deletions inventory” trong Systems Manager cho RDS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cần biết ai xóa resource → check CloudTrail.

📖 Reference:

Monitoring Amazon RDS API calls in AWS CloudTrail

DeleteDBInstance

questions.q:
A developer uses an AWS Lambda function in an application to edit users' uploaded photos. The developer needs to update the Lambda function code and needs to test the updates.

For testing, the developer must divide the user traffic between the original version of the Lambda function and the new version of the Lambda function.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Publish a version of the original Lambda function. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish a new version of the Lambda function.

Use AWS CodeBuild to detect updates to the Lambda function. Configure CodeBuild to incrementally shift traffic from the original version of the Lambda function to the new version of the Lambda function.
Update the original version of the Lambda function to add a function URL. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish another function URL for the updated Lambda code.

Create an alias that points to the original version of the Lambda function. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the new version of the Lambda function. Divide traffic between the two versions.
Create an alias that points to the original function URL. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the additional function URL. Divide traffic between the two function URLs.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

Cần test bản cập nhật Lambda bằng cách chia traffic giữa bản gốc và bản mới.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Publish a version of the original Lambda function. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish a new version of the Lambda function.

→ Cần có version cố định cho cả bản gốc và bản mới để làm traffic shifting.

Create an alias that points to the original version of the Lambda function. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the new version of the Lambda function. Divide traffic between the two versions.

→ Dùng Lambda alias với weighted routing để phân chia % traffic giữa 2 versions (ví dụ 90/10, 50/50) mà không đổi endpoint.

AWS Lambda function versions and aliases

AWS Lambda alias routing

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS CodeBuild to detect updates to the Lambda function. Configure CodeBuild to incrementally shift traffic from the original version of the Lambda function to the new version of the Lambda function.

→ CodeBuild là service build, không làm traffic shifting cho Lambda.

❌ Update the original version of the Lambda function to add a function URL. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish another function URL for the updated Lambda code.

→ Function URL không phải cơ chế chia traffic giữa versions; không có weighted alias cho URL.

❌ Create an alias that points to the original function URL. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the additional function URL. Divide traffic between the two function URLs.

→ Alias áp dụng cho Lambda versions, không áp dụng cho function URL.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Quy trình chuẩn: Publish versions → tạo alias → weighted routing để canary/gradual rollout.

Có thể kết hợp CloudWatch Alarms + rollback thủ công nếu cần.

📖 Reference:

Lambda aliases – Traffic shifting

questions.q:
A company uses AWS X-Ray to monitor a serverless application. The components of the application have different request rates. The user interactions and transactions are important to trace, but they are low in volume. The background processes such as application health checks, polling, and connection maintenance generate high volumes of read-only requests.

Currently, the default X-Ray sampling rules are universal for all requests. Only the first request per second and some additional requests are recorded. This setup is not helping the company review the requests based on service or request type.

A developer must configure rules to trace requests based on service or request properties. The developer must trace the user interactions and transactions without wasting effort recording minor background tasks.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a lower rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a higher rate.
Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a lower rate.
Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a higher rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
Công ty dùng AWS X-Ray để trace serverless app.

  • User interactions & transactions: volume thấp, quan trọng.

  • Background processes (health checks, polling, connection maintenance): volume cao, ít quan trọng.

  • Hiện tại X-Ray dùng default sampling rule (universal) → chưa phân biệt theo service/request type.

  • Yêu cầu: trace user interactions/transactions đầy đủ, không lãng phí effort cho background tasks.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a lower rate.

  • Với các request quan trọng (user interactions, transactions): phải trace tất cả để không bỏ sót.

  • Với background request (read-only, health check…): nên sample ít hơn để tránh tốn chi phí và dữ liệu không cần thiết.

  • Đây là best practice của X-Ray: kết hợp “always trace” cho critical traffic + “low sampling” cho non-critical high-volume traffic.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a lower rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
→ Sai vì user interactions phải trace tất cả, không chỉ sample một phần.

❌ Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a higher rate.
→ Sai vì background requests không cần “higher rate” → lãng phí.

❌ Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a higher rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
→ Sai vì user interactions cần trace full, không phải “sample at higher rate”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • X-Ray → dùng sampling rules theo service & request type.

  • Critical (user interaction, transaction) → trace full.

  • Non-critical (background tasks) → sample thấp.

📖 Reference:
AWS X-Ray sampling rules

Dynamically adjusting X-Ray sampling rules

questions.q:
A developer needs to store files in an Amazon S3 bucket for a company's application. Each S3 object can have multiple versions. The objects must be permanently removed 1 year after object creation.

The developer creates an S3 bucket that has versioning enabled.

What should the developer do next to meet the data retention requirements?
o: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to expire current versions of objects and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

Create an event notification for all object creation events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.

Create an event notification for all object removal events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to delete expired object delete markers and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần lưu file vào S3 bucket có versioning.

  • Mỗi object có thể có nhiều version.

  • Yêu cầu: xóa vĩnh viễn object sau 1 năm kể từ ngày tạo.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to expire current versions of objects and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

  • Lifecycle rule có thể áp dụng cho current version và noncurrent version.

  • “Expire current versions” = xóa version hiện tại sau 1 năm.

  • “Permanently delete noncurrent versions” = xóa luôn các version cũ.

  • Đây là cách native, tự động, không cần custom code.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an event notification for all object creation events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
→ Không cần dùng Lambda để check ngày tạo, Lifecycle policy đã built-in chức năng này.
→ Giải pháp này phức tạp, tốn effort vận hành.

❌ Create an event notification for all object removal events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
→ Sự kiện “removal” chỉ xảy ra khi object bị xóa, không phục vụ việc xóa theo thời gian tạo.

❌ Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to delete expired object delete markers and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.
→ “Delete expired object delete markers” chỉ dùng để dọn dẹp marker khi không còn phiên bản nào, không áp dụng cho current version.
→ Không đảm bảo xóa tất cả object sau 1 năm.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Nếu yêu cầu xóa cả current và noncurrent versions → dùng Expiration + NoncurrentVersionExpiration.

📖 Reference:
Expiring objects

questions.q:
A company uses AWS CloudFormation templates to manage infrastructure for a public-facing application in its development, pre-production, and production environments. The company needs to scale for increasing customer demand. A developer must upgrade the Amazon RDS DB instance type to a larger instance.

The developer deploys an update to the CloudFormation stack with the instance size change in the pre-production environment. The developer notices that the stack is in an UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED slate in CloudFormation.

Which option is the cause of this issue?
o: The new instance type specified in the CloudFormation template is invalid
The database was deleted or modified manually outside of the CloudFormation stack
There is a syntax error in the CloudFormation template
The developer has insufficient IAM permissions to provision an instance of the specified type
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng CloudFormation để quản lý hạ tầng cho app public (dev, pre-prod, prod).

  • Dev cần scale RDS instance → đổi instance type lớn hơn.

  • Khi update stack (pre-prod), CloudFormation báo UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED.

  • Hỏi: Nguyên nhân là gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The database was deleted or modified manually outside of the CloudFormation stack

  • Khi resource trong stack bị thay đổi hoặc xóa thủ công ngoài CloudFormation, stack mất khả năng quản lý → update thất bại.

  • Trong trạng thái này, CloudFormation không thể rollback vì resource không khớp với template gốc.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ The new instance type specified in the CloudFormation template is invalid
→ Nếu sai instance type thì lỗi sẽ xảy ra ngay trong quá trình update (UPDATE_FAILED), không dẫn tới UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED.

❌ There is a syntax error in the CloudFormation template
→ Syntax error thì CloudFormation sẽ không deploy được từ đầu (CREATE_FAILED), chứ không rollback sau khi đã chạy update.

❌ The developer has insufficient IAM permissions to provision an instance of the specified type
→ Thiếu quyền IAM sẽ gây lỗi khi gọi API tạo/modify RDS, nhưng lỗi sẽ báo AccessDenied hoặc UPDATE_FAILED, chứ không dính tới rollback fail.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Nếu gặp UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED trong CloudFormation → nguyên nhân thường là do drift (thay đổi thủ công ngoài stack).

  • Dùng Detect Drift trong CloudFormation để kiểm tra resource nào đã bị thay đổi.

questions.q:
A company has a monolithic desktop-based application that processes images. A developer is converting the application into an AWS Lambda function by using Python. Currently, the desktop application runs every 5 minutes to process the latest image from an Amazon S3 bucket. The desktop application completes the image processing task within 1 minute.

During testing on AWS, the developer notices that the Lambda function runs at the specified 5-minute interval. However, the Lambda function takes more than 2 minutes to complete the image processing task. The developer needs a solution that will improve the Lambda function's performance.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Update the instance type of the Lambda function to a compute optimized instance with at least eight virtual CPU (vCPU).
Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the latest Python runtime.
Increase the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Configure a reserved concurrency on the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng desktop monolithic xử lý ảnh mỗi 5 phút → chuyển sang AWS Lambda (Python).

  • Desktop xử lý xong trong 1 phút, nhưng Lambda lại mất hơn 2 phút.

  • Yêu cầu: cải thiện hiệu năng Lambda function.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Increase the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.

  • Trên AWS Lambda, khi tăng memory thì đồng thời CPU power (vCPU), network bandwidth và I/O throughput cũng được tăng theo tỷ lệ.

  • Việc chọn nhiều memory hơn sẽ giúp Lambda xử lý tính toán nhanh hơn.

  • Đây là cách tối ưu hiệu năng chuẩn nhất cho Lambda workloads compute-intensive.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Update the instance type of the Lambda function to a compute optimized instance with at least eight virtual CPU (vCPU).
Lambda không cho chọn instance type cụ thể, chỉ có thể scale memory → CPU được gán tương ứng.

❌ Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the latest Python runtime.
Nên dùng runtime mới để có security và performance improvements, nhưng bản thân nó không giải quyết việc Lambda chạy chậm hơn desktop app.

❌ Configure a reserved concurrency on the Lambda function.
Reserved concurrency chỉ dùng để giới hạn hoặc đảm bảo số lượng concurrent executions, không giúp một execution chạy nhanh hơn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Tăng memory trong Lambda = tăng luôn CPU & network → cách duy nhất để “scale up” hiệu năng 1 Lambda function.

📖 Reference:
Configure Lambda function memory

questions.q:
A company has an application that uses an Amazon S3 bucket for object storage. A developer needs to configure in-transit encryption for the S3 bucket. All the S3 objects containing personal data needs to be encrypted at rest with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys, which can be rotated on demand.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using permissions boundary.
Configure an S3 bucket policy to enable client-side encryption for the objects containing personal data by using an AWS KMS customer managed key.
Configure the application to encrypt the objects by using an AWS KMS customer managed key before uploading the objects containing personal data to Amazon S3.
Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using the aws:SecureTransport condition.
Configure S3 Block Public Access settings for the S3 bucket to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
Ứng dụng dùng Amazon S3 để lưu object. Yêu cầu:

  • Bảo mật dữ liệu in-transit (khi truyền).

  • Object chứa dữ liệu cá nhân phải được mã hóa at rest bằng AWS KMS CMK (cho phép xoay khóa).

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Configure the application to encrypt the objects by using an AWS KMS customer managed key before uploading the objects containing personal data to Amazon S3.

  • Đáp ứng yêu cầu mã hóa at rest bằng AWS KMS CMK, hỗ trợ rotation on-demand.

  • Application có thể chỉ định x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms khi upload object.

Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using the aws:SecureTransport condition.
→ Đảm bảo in-transit encryption: buộc client chỉ được kết nối qua HTTPS (SSL/TLS).
→ Đây là best practice trong S3 bucket policy.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Write an S3 bucket policy to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS by using permissions boundary.
→ Sai vì permissions boundary là cho IAM policies, không dùng để bắt buộc HTTPS cho S3.

❌ Configure an S3 bucket policy to enable client-side encryption for the objects containing personal data by using an AWS KMS customer managed key.
→ Sai vì client-side encryption không được quản lý trực tiếp qua bucket policy, mà phải do ứng dụng quản lý keys & encryption.

❌ Configure S3 Block Public Access settings for the S3 bucket to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS.
→ Block Public Access chỉ chặn public ACL/policy, không liên quan đến HTTPS encryption.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • In-transit encryption (HTTPS) → dùng bucket policy với aws:SecureTransport.

  • At rest encryption (S3 + KMS) → dùng SSE-KMS với CMK (customer managed key).

📖 Reference:

Security best practices for Amazon S3

S3 Bucket Keys for SSE-KMS

questions.q:
An AWS Lambda function is invoked asynchronously to process events. Occasionally, the Lambda function falls to process events. A developer needs to collect and analyze these failed events to fix the issue.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Add logging statements for all events in the Lambda function. Filter AWS CloudTrail logs for errors.
Configure the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions workflow with retries for failed events.
Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue.
Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function chạy asynchronous invocation để xử lý events.

  • Thỉnh thoảng có event bị fail.

  • Dev cần thu thập và phân tích các event fail để fix bug.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort dev nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue.

  • Khi Lambda async invocation fail (sau retries), AWS hỗ trợ native DLQ (SQS hoặc SNS).

  • SQS phù hợp để lưu trữ, giữ message lại → dễ dàng review, phân tích.

  • Đây là giải pháp native, cấu hình nhanh, không cần code nhiều.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add logging statements for all events in the Lambda function. Filter AWS CloudTrail logs for errors.
→ Logging thì chỉ thấy lỗi, không giữ lại event input để replay/analysis chi tiết.
→ CloudTrail chủ yếu log API call, không log payload của event.

❌ Configure the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions workflow with retries for failed events.
→ Step Functions dùng cho orchestrations phức tạp. Ở đây chỉ cần lưu events fail → overkill, tốn effort.

❌ Add a dead-letter queue to send messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic.
→ DLQ của Lambda không hỗ trợ SNS FIFO, chỉ hỗ trợ SQS standard queue hoặc SNS standard topic.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Async Lambda fail → dùng DLQ (SQS/SNS standard) hoặc Lambda Destinations (tùy use case).

📖 Reference:

Adding a dead-letter queue
Implementing AWS Lambda error handling patterns

questions.q:
A company that has large online business uses an Amazon DynamoDB table to store sales data. The company enabled Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. The transaction status of each sale is stored in a TransactionStatus attribute in the table. The value of the TransactionStatus attribute must be either failed, pending, or completed.

The company wants to be notified of failed sales where the Price attribute is above a specific threshold. A developer needs to set up notification for the failed sales.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Use Lambda event filtering to trigger the Lambda function only if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold. Configure the Lambda function to publish the data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function handler code to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail when price is above the specified threshold.

Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use event filtering to publish to the SNS topic if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold.

Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor the DynamoDB Streams sales data. Configure the alarm to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail due when price is above the specified threshold.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng DynamoDB lưu sales, bật DynamoDB Streams.

  • Thuộc tính TransactionStatus chỉ có: failed | pending | completed.

  • Cần nhận thông báo khi giao dịch failed và Price > ngưỡng.

  • Mục tiêu: ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Use Lambda event filtering to trigger the Lambda function only if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold. Configure the Lambda function to publish the data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

  • Dùng Lambda event filtering tại event source mapping để chỉ kích hoạt khi TransactionStatus = failed và Price > threshold → không cần code lọc trong hàm.

  • Lambda chỉ chạy cho sự kiện hợp lệ rồi publish SNS → tối giản logic, giảm chi phí chạy và công vận hành.

  • Tận dụng native integration DynamoDB Streams → Lambda → SNS.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function handler code to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail when price is above the specified threshold.
→ Vẫn làm được nhưng phải tự viết code lọc (status và price) trong Lambda → nhiều effort.

❌ Create an event source mapping between DynamoDB Streams and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use event filtering to publish to the SNS topic if sales fail when the price is above the specified threshold.
→ Không có event source mapping trực tiếp từ DynamoDB Streams → SNS. Cần qua Lambda hoặc dịch vụ trung gian khác.

❌ Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor the DynamoDB Streams sales data. Configure the alarm to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic if sales fail due when price is above the specified threshold.
→ CloudWatch Alarm không trực tiếp “đọc” và lọc record chi tiết từ Streams theo điều kiện field (TransactionStatus, Price).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DynamoDB Streams → Lambda event filtering để giảm code & chi phí.

  • Gửi thông báo: Lambda → SNS là pattern tiêu chuẩn.

📖 Reference:

DynamoDB Streams and AWS Lambda triggers

Using event filtering with a DynamoDB event source

questions.q:
A developer has a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that uses AWS CodeArtifact and AWS CodeBuild. The build artifacts are between 0.5 GB and 1.5 GB in size. The builds happen frequently and retrieve many dependencies from CodeArtifact each time.

The builds have been slow because of the time it takes to transfer dependencies. The developer needs to improve build performance by reducing the number of dependencies that are retrieved for each build.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Specify an Amazon S3 cache in CodeBuild. Add the S3 cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
Retrieve the buildspec.yaml file directly from CodeArtifact. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer có pipeline CI/CD dùng CodeArtifact + CodeBuild.

  • Artifact size 0.5–1.5 GB, build chạy thường xuyên, mỗi lần build lại tải nhiều dependency từ CodeArtifact → build chậm.

  • Yêu cầu: cải thiện performance bằng cách giảm số lần tải dependency.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.

  • CodeBuild hỗ trợ local caching (modes: source cache, Docker layer cache, custom cache).

  • Dùng local cache để giữ lại dependency (npm, maven, pip, gradle…) giữa các lần build, không phải tải lại toàn bộ từ CodeArtifact.

  • Giải pháp này giảm thời gian build rõ rệt, ít effort nhất.

Specify local caching (console)

Specify local caching (AWS CloudFormation)

CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: MyProject
      ServiceRole: <service-role>
      Artifacts:
        Type: S3
        Location: <bucket-name>
        Name: myArtifact
        EncryptionDisabled: true
        OverrideArtifactName: true
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:5.0
        Certificate: <bucket/cert.zip>
        # PrivilegedMode must be true if you specify LOCAL_DOCKER_LAYER_CACHE
        PrivilegedMode: true
      Source:
        Type: GITHUB
        Location: <github-location>
        InsecureSsl: true
        GitCloneDepth: 1
        ReportBuildStatus: false
      TimeoutInMinutes: 10
      Cache:
        Type: LOCAL
        Modes: # You can specify one or more cache mode, 
          - LOCAL_CUSTOM_CACHE
          - LOCAL_DOCKER_LAYER_CACHE
          - LOCAL_SOURCE_CACHE

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Specify an Amazon S3 cache in CodeBuild. Add the S3 cache folder path to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
→ S3 cache phù hợp khi cần share cache giữa nhiều build instance, nhưng chậm hơn local cache vì phải upload/download từ S3.

❌ Specify a local cache in CodeBuild. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
→ Sai vì cache cần folder path, không phải repository name.

❌ Retrieve the buildspec.yaml file directly from CodeArtifact. Add the CodeArtifact repository name to the buildspec.yaml file for the build project.
→ CodeArtifact dùng để quản lý package, không phải để chứa buildspec.yaml.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Build chậm do dependency nhiều → dùng CodeBuild local cache.

📖 Reference:
Specify a local cache

questions.q:
A developer needs to use a code template to create an automated deployment of an application onto Amazon EC2 instances. The template must be configured to repeat deployment, installation, and updates of resources for the application. The template must be able to create identical environments and roll back to previous versions.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use AWS Amplify for automatic deployment templates. Use a traffic-splitting deployment to copy any deployments. Modify any resources created by Amplify, if necessary.

Use AWS CodeBuild for automatic deployment. Upload the required AppSpec file template. Save the appspec.yml file in the root directory folder of the revision. Specify the deployment group that includes the EC2 instances for the deployment.

Use AWS CloudFormation to create an infrastructure template in JSON format to deploy the EC2 instances. Use CloudFormation helper scripts to install the necessary software and to start the application. Call the scripts directly from the template.

Use AWS AppSync to deploy the application. Upload the template as a GraphQL schema. Specify the EC2 instances for deployment of the application. Use resolvers as a version control mechanism and to make any updates to the deployments.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev cần “code template” để tự động deploy app lên EC2.

  • Template phải hỗ trợ lặp lại việc triển khai/cài đặt/cập nhật tài nguyên, tạo môi trường giống hệt nhau và có khả năng rollback về phiên bản trước.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Use AWS CloudFormation to create an infrastructure template in JSON format to deploy the EC2 instances. Use CloudFormation helper scripts to install the necessary software and to start the application. Call the scripts directly from the template.

  • CloudFormation là IaC, bảo đảm môi trường đồng nhất, triển khai lặp lại chỉ từ 1 template.

  • Hỗ trợ rollback tự động khi cập nhật stack lỗi.

  • Dùng helper scripts (cfn-init, cfn-hup, cfn-signal) để cài đặt package, config, start service ngay trong UserData/Metadata → đáp ứng yêu cầu cài đặt & cập nhật app.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Use AWS Amplify for automatic deployment templates. Use a traffic-splitting deployment to copy any deployments. Modify any resources created by Amplify, if necessary.
→ Amplify chủ yếu cho web/mobile front-end hosting & backend managed, không phải công cụ tiêu chuẩn để deploy app tùy biến lên EC2 và quản lý vòng đời hạ tầng như yêu cầu.

❌ Use AWS CodeBuild for automatic deployment. Upload the required AppSpec file template. Save the appspec.yml file in the root directory folder of the revision. Specify the deployment group that includes the EC2 instances for the deployment.
→ AppSpec thuộc AWS CodeDeploy, không phải CodeBuild, không điều phối triển khai EC2 hay rollback hạ tầng.

❌ Use AWS AppSync to deploy the application. Upload the template as a GraphQL schema. Specify the EC2 instances for deployment of the application. Use resolvers as a version control mechanism and to make any updates to the deployments.
→ AppSync là GraphQL API service, không dùng để deploy ứng dụng lên EC2, cũng không quản lý hạ tầng/rollback.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần hạ tầng lặp lại, đồng nhất, có rollback → ưu tiên CloudFormation (hoặc CDK).

  • Triển khai/cài đặt app trên EC2 qua cfn-init + UserData; tự cập nhật qua cfn-hup.

📖 Reference:

How CloudFormation works

CloudFormation helper scripts reference

Best practices for deploying EC2 instances with AWS CloudFormation

questions.q:
A developer creates an Amazon DynamoDB table. The table has OrderID as the partition key and NumberOfItemsPurchased as the sort key. The data type of the partition key and the sort key is Number.

When the developer queries the table, the results are sorted by NumberOfItemsPurchased in ascending order. The developer needs the query results to be sorted by NumberOfItemsPurchased in descending order.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Create a local secondary index (LSI) on the NumberOfItemsPurchased sort key.
Change the sort key from NumberOfItemsPurchased to NumberOfItemsPurchasedDescending.
In the Query operation, set the ScanIndexForward parameter to false.
In the Query operation, set the KeyConditionExpression parameter to false.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table có:

    • Partition key = OrderID (Number)

    • Sort key = NumberOfItemsPurchased (Number)

    • Mặc định, khi query → kết quả sort theo sort key ASC (tăng dần).

  • Yêu cầu: sort theo DESC (giảm dần).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

In the Query operation, set the ScanIndexForward parameter to false.

DynamoDB Query hỗ trợ tham số ScanIndexForward:

  • true (default) = sort ASC.

  • false = sort DESC.

→ Không cần đổi schema hay tạo index mới.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a local secondary index (LSI) on the NumberOfItemsPurchased sort key.

→ LSI không giúp đổi chiều sort, chỉ dùng để query thêm thuộc tính sort key khác.

❌ Change the sort key from NumberOfItemsPurchased to NumberOfItemsPurchasedDescending.

→ Không cần tạo thêm sort key duplicate. Dùng ScanIndexForward = false là đủ.

❌ In the Query operation, set the KeyConditionExpression parameter to false.

→ KeyConditionExpression là để lọc theo key, không liên quan đến sắp xếp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DynamoDB Query: sort key luôn ASC by default, muốn sort DESC → ScanIndexForward = false.

📖 Reference:

Query

questions.q:
A company has a web application that is hosted on AWS. The application is behind an Amazon CloudFront distribution. A developer needs a dashboard to monitor error rates and anomalies of the CloudFront distribution as frequently as possible.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Detect anomalies and error rates by using Amazon Athena.
Enable real-time logs on the CloudFront distribution. Create a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to send the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service by using an AWS Lambda function. Make a dashboard in OpenSearch Dashboards.
Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to send the logs to AWS CloudTrail. Create CloudTrail metrics, alarms, and dashboards.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng web chạy trên AWS, đặt sau CloudFront.

  • Dev cần dashboard giám sát lỗi & phát hiện bất thường (anomaly) với tần suất cao nhất (gần real-time).

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Enable real-time logs on the CloudFront distribution. Create a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

  • CloudFront Real-Time Logs gửi log gần như theo request tới Kinesis Data Streams (KDS) với độ trễ rất thấp → phù hợp yêu cầu “as frequently as possible”.

  • Có thể tiêu thụ log từ KDS để phân tích/đẩy sang hệ giám sát & dashboard.

Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to send the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service by using an AWS Lambda function. Make a dashboard in OpenSearch Dashboards.

  • Dùng Lambda làm consumer của KDS để chuẩn hóa & nạp dữ liệu vào Amazon OpenSearch Service.

  • Xây OpenSearch Dashboards để vẽ dashboard (error rate, anomaly) theo thời gian thực.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Detect anomalies and error rates by using Amazon Athena.
→ Access Logs ra S3 chỉ phù hợp phân tích batch (không real-time). Athena là truy vấn theo lô, không đáp ứng “tần suất cao nhất”.

❌ Stream the CloudFront distribution logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
→ CloudFront không stream Real-Time Logs trực tiếp sang Firehose; Real-Time Logs chỉ hỗ trợ Kinesis Data Streams.

❌ Set up Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to send the logs to AWS CloudTrail. Create CloudTrail metrics, alarms, and dashboards.
→ CloudTrail là audit API call, không phải nơi nhận CloudFront request logs. Không đúng luồng dữ liệu & mục đích.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần near real-time → bật CloudFront Real-Time Logs → Kinesis Data Streams.

  • Dashboard & anomaly detection live → đưa vào OpenSearch (hoặc Kafka/Fluentd→OpenSearch), dùng OpenSearch Dashboards.

📖 Reference:

Logs through Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

questions.q:
A company runs a critical application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) by using Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to migrate the application to Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate. A developer is configuring Fargate and the ECS capacity providers to make the change.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime during migration?
o: Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.

Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng đang chạy trên ECS with EC2 và cần migrate sang ECS on Fargate.

  • Dev phải cấu hình capacity providers để giảm downtime tối đa trong quá trình chuyển đổi.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

  • FARGATE và FARGATE_SPOT là built-in capacity providers (không cần tự tạo).

  • Dùng PutClusterCapacityProviders để gán chiến lược cho cluster.

  • Đặt FARGATE làm Provider chính (có base để đảm bảo số task tối thiểu chạy ổn định) giúp chuyển đổi mượt, ít downtime.

  • Thêm FARGATE_SPOT làm provider phụ để nhận thêm tải (chi phí thấp, chấp nhận bị ngắt).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 2 for failover.

→ CreateCapacityProvider dùng cho EC2/Auto Scaling groups. Với FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT (managed), không cần dùng API này.

❌ Use the PutClusterCapacityProviders API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.

→ SPOT có thể bị thu hồi → rủi ro downtime. Không phù hợp làm Provider chính.

❌ Use the CreateCapacityProvider API operation to associate the ECS cluster with the FARGATE and FARGATE_SPOT capacity provider strategies. Use FARGATE_SPOT as Provider 1 with a base value. Use FARGATE as Provider 2 for failover.

→ Vừa sai API, vừa chọn SPOT làm chính → tăng rủi ro gián đoạn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Migrate sang Fargate: gắn FARGATE + FARGATE_SPOT ở cluster, dùng FARGATE làm primary để ổn định; SPOT để mở rộng tiết kiệm chi phí.

📖 Reference:

Fargate launch type for Amazon ECS

Deep dive into Fargate Spot to run your ECS Tasks for up to 70% less

questions.q:
A developer received the following error message during an AWS CloudFormation deployment:

DELETE_FAILED (The following resource(s) failed to delete: [ASGInstanceRole12345678].)

Which action should the developer take to resolve this error?
o: Contact AWS Support to report an issue with the Auto Scaling Groups (ASG) service.
Add a DependsOn attribute to the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource in the CloudFormation template. Then delete the stack.
Modify the CloudFormation template to retain the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource. Then manually delete the resource after deployment.
Add a force parameter when calling CloudFormation with the role-arn of ASGInstanceRole12345678.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev deploy CloudFormation stack, bị lỗi khi xóa resource: ASGInstanceRole12345678.

  • Thông báo lỗi: DELETE_FAILED.

  • Yêu cầu: chọn cách xử lý đúng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Modify the CloudFormation template to retain the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource. Then manually delete the resource after deployment.

  • Nguyên nhân: Khi xóa stack, CloudFormation gặp lỗi với IAM Role/Instance Profile (thường do còn đang được gắn với EC2/ASG nên không xóa được).

  • Cách xử lý best practice: thêm Retain policy trong template để CloudFormation bỏ qua việc xóa resource này.

  • Đây là cách an toàn, được AWS khuyến nghị khi CloudFormation không thể cleanup.

YAML

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  MyBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Contact AWS Support to report an issue with the Auto Scaling Groups (ASG) service.
→ Đây không phải bug của service, mà là dependency giữa IAM Role và ASG. Không cần liên hệ AWS Support.

❌ Add a DependsOn attribute to the ASGInstanceRole12345678 resource in the CloudFormation template. Then delete the stack.
→ DependsOn chỉ điều chỉnh thứ tự tạo/xóa resource, không giải quyết được vấn đề role đang bị "in use".

❌ Add a force parameter when calling CloudFormation with the role-arn of ASGInstanceRole12345678.
→ CloudFormation không có tham số force để ép xóa resource.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Khi stack delete fail với IAM Role/Policy → dùng Retain, sau đó xóa thủ công.

📖 Reference:
DeletionPolicy attribute

questions.q:
A company has a development team that uses AWS CodeCommit for version control. The development team has CodeCommit repositories in multiple AWS accounts. The team is expanding to include developers who work in various locations.

The company must ensure that the developers have secure access to the repositories.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Configure IAM roles for each developer and grant access individually.
Configure permission sets in AWS IAM Identity Center to grant access to the accounts.
Share AWS access keys with the development team for direct repository access.
Use public SSH keys for authentication to the CodeCommit repositories.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có team dev sử dụng AWS CodeCommit (nhiều account AWS).

  • Team mở rộng, có dev ở nhiều địa điểm.

  • Yêu cầu: đảm bảo truy cập an toàn vào các repo, đồng thời phải ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Configure permission sets in AWS IAM Identity Center to grant access to the accounts.

  • AWS IAM Identity Center (trước đây là AWS SSO) giúp quản lý tập trung user access cho nhiều account.

  • Dev chỉ cần 1 lần login (SSO), dùng credential tạm thời để pull/push CodeCommit.

  • Không cần tạo IAM user/role riêng cho từng account → tối ưu vận hành, bảo mật cao.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure IAM roles for each developer and grant access individually.
→ Quản lý phức tạp, phải tạo role per dev per account → overhead cao.

❌ Share AWS access keys with the development team for direct repository access.
→ Không an toàn, vi phạm best practice (access keys là static, dễ lộ).

❌ Use public SSH keys for authentication to the CodeCommit repositories.
→ Có thể dùng được, nhưng phải quản lý key cho từng dev ở từng account → overhead cao.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Multi-account, multi-user access → dùng IAM Identity Center.

  • Không dùng access keys hoặc SSH key share.

questions.q:
A developer manages a website that distributes its content by using Amazon CloudFront. The website's static artifacts are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket.

The developer deploys some changes and can see the new artifacts in the S3 bucket. However, the changes do not appear on the webpage that the CloudFront distribution delivers.

How should the developer resolve this issue?
o: Configure S3 Object Lock to update to the latest version of the files every time an S3 object is updated.
Configure the S3 bucket to clear all old objects from the bucket before new artifacts are uploaded.
Set CloudFront to invalidate the cache after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.
Set CloudFront to modify the distribution origin after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Website phân phối nội dung qua CloudFront, dữ liệu gốc trong S3.

  • Dev đã update artifacts trong S3 nhưng CloudFront vẫn hiển thị nội dung cũ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Set CloudFront to invalidate the cache after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.

  • CloudFront lưu cache các object ở Edge Location.

  • Khi thay đổi file trong S3, CloudFront vẫn có thể phân phát bản cache cũ.

  • Cần invalidate cache để CloudFront lấy phiên bản mới từ S3.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure S3 Object Lock to update to the latest version of the files every time an S3 object is updated.
→ S3 Object Lock chỉ dùng cho compliance & ngăn xóa/chỉnh sửa object (WORM). Không liên quan đến cache CloudFront.

❌ Configure the S3 bucket to clear all old objects from the bucket before new artifacts are uploaded.
→ Không cần xoá object cũ, vấn đề là CloudFront cache, không phải S3 storage.

❌ Set CloudFront to modify the distribution origin after the artifacts have been deployed to Amazon S3.
→ Origin không thay đổi, vẫn là S3 bucket. Chỉ cần refresh cache, không cần sửa origin.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Khi update static content trên S3 nhưng CloudFront không thấy thay đổi → cần cache invalidation.

📖 Reference:
Invalidate files to remove content

questions.q:
A developer has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table with a configured local secondary index (LSI). During application testing, the DynamoDB table metrics report a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error message. The number of requests made by the test suite did not exceed the table's provisioned capacity limits.

What is the cause of this issue?
o: The data in the table's partition key column is not evenly distributed.
The LSI's capacity is different from the table's capacity.
The application is not implementing exponential backoff retry logic while interacting with the DynamoDB API.
The application has the IAM permission to query the DynamoDB table but not to query the LSI.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng dùng DynamoDB table có Local Secondary Index (LSI).

  • Khi test app thì gặp lỗi ProvisionedThroughputExceededException, dù số request không vượt quá provisioned capacity.

  • Hỏi nguyên nhân?

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The data in the table's partition key column is not evenly distributed.

  • Nếu dữ liệu không phân bố đều (hot partition) → nhiều request dồn vào một partition → gây ra ProvisionedThroughputExceededException, mặc dù tổng request chưa vượt limit.

  • Đây là nguyên nhân phổ biến nhất khi gặp lỗi này.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The LSI's capacity is different from the table's capacity.
→ Sai. LSI chia sẻ capacity với table, không có capacity riêng.

❌ The application is not implementing exponential backoff retry logic while interacting with the DynamoDB API.
→ Retry logic là best practice để giảm lỗi tạm thời, nhưng không phải nguyên nhân gốc của ProvisionedThroughputExceededException.

❌ The application has the IAM permission to query the DynamoDB table but not to query the LSI.
→ Nếu thiếu quyền thì sẽ bị AccessDeniedException, không phải ProvisionedThroughputExceededException.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DynamoDB throughput bị giới hạn theo partition, không chỉ tổng table.

  • Luôn thiết kế partition key phân tán đều để tránh hot partition.

📖 Reference:
Designing partition keys to distribute your workload in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A company has an application that receives batches of orders from partners every day. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to process the batches.

If a batch contains no orders, the Lambda function must publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as soon as possible.

Which combination of steps will meet this requirement with the LEAST implementation effort? (Choose two.)
o: Update the existing Lambda function's code to send an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric for the number of orders in a batch for each partner.
Create a new Lambda function as an Amazon Kinesis data stream consumer. Configure the new Lambda function to track orders and to publish to the SNS topic when a batch contains no orders.
Set up an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that will send a notification to the SNS topic when the value of the custom metric is 0.
Schedule a new Lambda function to analyze Amazon CloudWatch metrics every 24 hours to identify batches that contain no orders. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic.
Modify the existing Lambda function to log orders to an Amazon Kinesis data stream.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng nhận batch orders hằng ngày, xử lý bằng AWS Lambda.

  • Nếu batch không có order, cần thông báo lên Amazon SNS càng sớm càng tốt.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort triển khai nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Update the existing Lambda function's code to send an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric for the number of orders in a batch for each partner.

Set up an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that will send a notification to the SNS topic when the value of the custom metric is 0.

  • Lambda hiện có chỉ cần ghi thêm 1 custom metric (số orders trong batch).

  • Tạo CloudWatch Alarm kiểm tra metric == 0 và notify trực tiếp SNS → realtime gần như ngay lập tức, không cần viết thêm pipeline phức tạp.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create a new Lambda function as an Amazon Kinesis data stream consumer. Configure the new Lambda function to track orders and to publish to the SNS topic when a batch contains no orders.
→ Thêm Kinesis + Lambda mới làm consumer là thừa và phức tạp; không cần stream để phát hiện “0 orders”.

❌ Schedule a new Lambda function to analyze Amazon CloudWatch metrics every 24 hours to identify batches that contain no orders. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic.
→ Chạy theo lịch 24h không “as soon as possible”; trễ cảnh báo.

❌ Modify the existing Lambda function to log orders to an Amazon Kinesis data stream.
→ Ghi vào Kinesis không tự giải quyết việc cảnh báo khi = 0; vẫn cần thêm logic/consumer khác.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Khi cần cảnh báo theo điều kiện đơn giản từ kết quả xử lý: CloudWatch Custom Metric → CloudWatch Alarm → SNS (nhanh, ít code).

questions.q:
A developer is creating a new batch application that will run on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires read access to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to follow security best practices to grant S3 read access to the application.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a role. Attach the role to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions inline to an IAM group. Attach the group to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a user. Attach the user to the EC2 instance profile.
Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Use IAM web identity federation to access the S3 bucket with the policy.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev tạo batch app chạy trên EC2, cần read access đến S3 bucket.

  • Yêu cầu: theo security best practices để cấp quyền.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a role. Attach the role to the EC2 instance profile.

  • Best practice: gán IAM Role cho EC2 thông qua Instance Profile.

  • Policy gán cho Role → EC2 tự động lấy temporary credentials để truy cập S3.

  • Đây là cách an toàn, không hardcode credentials.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Add the permissions inline to an IAM group. Attach the group to the EC2 instance profile.
→ IAM group chỉ gán cho users, không attach trực tiếp vào instance profile được.

❌ Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a user. Attach the user to the EC2 instance profile.
→ Không gán user cho instance profile, chỉ gán Role. Nếu dùng user → phải dùng access key, không secure.

❌ Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Use IAM web identity federation to access the S3 bucket with the policy.
→ Web identity federation dành cho external identity providers (Cognito, OIDC), không áp dụng cho EC2 app nội bộ.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Quyền cho EC2 → luôn dùng IAM Role + Instance Profile, tránh dùng access key.

📖 Reference:
Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances

questions.q:
A company uses an AWS Lambda function to transfer files from an Amazon S3 bucket to the company's SFTP server. The Lambda function connects to the SFTP server by using credentials such as username and password. The company uses Lambda environment variables to store these credentials.

A developer needs to implement encrypted username and password credentials.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Remove the user credentials from the Lambda environment. Implement IAM database authentication.
Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
Move the user credentials from the Lambda environment to an encrypted .txt file. Store the file in an S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có Lambda function chuyển file từ S3 sang SFTP server.

  • Lambda hiện đang lưu username/password trong environment variables.

  • Yêu cầu: phải mã hóa (encrypted) username/password credentials.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.

  • AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (hoặc Secrets Manager) là chuyên dùng để lưu thông tin nhạy cảm (password, API key, DB credentials).

  • Có hỗ trợ encryption bằng KMS key.

  • Lambda có thể đọc trực tiếp thông qua IAM Role, đảm bảo security best practice thay vì hardcode vào environment variables.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Remove the user credentials from the Lambda environment. Implement IAM database authentication.
→ IAM DB authentication chỉ áp dụng cho Amazon RDS (MySQL/Postgres). Không liên quan đến SFTP server.

❌ Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
→ AWS KMS chỉ quản lý và cung cấp keys để mã hóa/giải mã. Không phải nơi để trực tiếp lưu trữ credentials.

❌ Move the user credentials from the Lambda environment to an encrypted .txt file. Store the file in an S3 bucket.
→ Có thể làm, nhưng phải viết thêm code để quản lý việc decrypt, rotate key, phân quyền… → phức tạp và không chuẩn best practice.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Lưu trữ secrets (password, API key, credentials) → dùng SSM Parameter Store hoặc Secrets Manager, kết hợp KMS để mã hóa.

📖 Reference:

Using Parameter Store parameters in AWS Lambda functions

questions.q:
An IAM role is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance that explicitly denies access to all Amazon S3 API actions. The EC2 instance credentials file specifies the IAM access key and secret access key, which allow full administrative access.

Given that multiple modes of IAM access are present for this EC2 instance, which of the following is correct?
o: The EC2 instance will only be able to list the S3 buckets.
The EC2 instance will only be able to list the contents of one S3 bucket at a time.
The EC2 instance will be able to perform all actions on any S3 bucket.
The EC2 instance will not be able to perform any S3 action on any S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:


EC2 instance có IAM Role gắn vào (role này có explicit deny với tất cả S3 actions).
Nhưng trong EC2 instance, có credentials file chứa access key/secret key của một IAM user có full admin.
Hỏi: EC2 sẽ truy cập S3 thế nào trong trường hợp có nhiều mode IAM access?

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The EC2 instance will not be able to perform any S3 action on any S3 bucket.

  • Trong IAM, explicit deny > allow (Nguyên tắc IAM evaluation: explicit deny thắng tất cả).

  • Dù IAM user credentials có full quyền, nhưng vì instance role gắn explicit deny S3 nên mọi request đến S3 từ instance này đều bị từ chối.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ The EC2 instance will only be able to list the S3 buckets.
→ Không đúng, vì explicit deny block tất cả S3 actions, kể cả s3:ListAllMyBuckets.

❌ The EC2 instance will only be able to list the contents of one S3 bucket at a time.
→ Không đúng, deny áp dụng toàn diện, không có ngoại lệ kiểu này.

❌ The EC2 instance will be able to perform all actions on any S3 bucket.
→ Không đúng, vì explicit deny luôn chặn mọi quyền, kể cả full admin.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
IAM policy evaluation = Explicit deny > Allow > Default deny.(explicit deny thắng tất cả)

📖 Reference:
Evaluating identity-based policies with resource-based policies

questions.q:
A company uses an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy and manage its AWS infrastructure. The CloudFormation template creates Amazon VPC security groups and Amazon EC2 security groups.

A manager finds out that some engineers modified the security groups of a few EC2 instances for testing purposes. A developer needs to determine what modifications occurred.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Add a Conditions section statement in the source YAML file of the template. Run the CloudFormation stack.
Perform a drift detection operation on the CloudFormation stack.
Execute a change set for the CloudFormation stack.
Use Amazon Detective to detect the modifications.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng CloudFormation để deploy hạ tầng (bao gồm VPC security groups và EC2 security groups).

  • Manager phát hiện có engineer chỉnh sửa thủ công security group.

  • Developer cần xác định những thay đổi nào đã xảy ra.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Perform a drift detection operation on the CloudFormation stack.

  • Drift detection trong CloudFormation cho phép phát hiện sự khác biệt (drift) giữa resource thực tế trên AWS và resource đã được định nghĩa trong template.

  • Đây là cách native, trực tiếp để xác định các thay đổi thủ công ngoài CloudFormation.

Detect drift:

View drift results:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a Conditions section statement in the source YAML file of the template. Run the CloudFormation stack.
→ Conditions chỉ điều khiển logic tạo/tùy chọn resource khi stack chạy. Không phát hiện được thay đổi ngoài template.

❌ Execute a change set for the CloudFormation stack.
→ Change Set chỉ hiển thị những thay đổi sắp được áp dụng khi update stack. Nó không cho biết resource đã bị chỉnh sửa thủ công ngoài CloudFormation.

❌ Use Amazon Detective to detect the modifications.
→ Amazon Detective chuyên để phân tích và điều tra bảo mật (IAM, VPC flow logs, CloudTrail…), không để phát hiện drift trong CloudFormation.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn kiểm tra resource bị chỉnh thủ công ngoài CloudFormation → dùng Drift Detection.

📖 Reference:
AWS CloudFormation Drift Detection

questions.q:
A company maintains a REST service using Amazon API Gateway and the API Gateway native API key validation. The company recently launched a new registration page, which allows users to sign up for the service. The registration page creates a new API key using CreateApiKey and sends the new key to the user. When the user attempts to call the API using this key, the user receives a 403 Forbidden error. Existing users are unaffected and can still call the API.

What code updates will grant these new users access to the API?
o: The createDeployment method must be called so the API can be redeployed to include the newly created API key.
The updateAuthorizer method must be called to update the API's authorizer to include the newly created API key.
The importApiKeys method must be called to import all newly created API keys into the current stage of the API.
The createUsagePlanKey method must be called to associate the newly created API key with the correct usage plan.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có REST API chạy trên Amazon API Gateway, đang dùng API key validation.

  • Trang đăng ký mới cho phép tạo API key qua CreateApiKey và gửi cho user.

  • User mới gọi API thì bị 403 Forbidden, nhưng user cũ thì vẫn dùng bình thường.

  • Yêu cầu: Làm gì để cấp quyền cho key mới hoạt động?

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The createUsagePlanKey method must be called to associate the newly created API key with the correct usage plan.

  • Tạo API key bằng CreateApiKey chỉ sinh ra key.

  • Để key dùng được, cần gắn nó vào usage plan bằng createUsagePlanKey.

  • Usage plan quy định quota/throttle và stage nào key được dùng.

  • Nếu không gắn thì key không có hiệu lực → 403 Forbidden.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The createDeployment method must be called so the API can be redeployed to include the newly created API key.
→ Redeploy chỉ áp dụng khi thay đổi resource/method trong API, không liên quan đến API key.

❌ The updateAuthorizer method must be called to update the API's authorizer to include the newly created API key.
→ API key validation không dùng authorizer (authorizer là cho JWT, Lambda, Cognito).

❌ The importApiKeys method must be called to import all newly created API keys into the current stage of the API.
→ importApiKeys dùng khi batch import keys từ file, không dành cho từng key mới.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

API key trong API Gateway chỉ có tác dụng khi:

  1. API method yêu cầu API key.

  2. Key đã được gắn với Usage Plan → Stage.

📖 Reference:

CreateApiKey
CreateUsagePlanKey

Set up usage plans for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A developer wants the ability to roll back to a previous version of an AWS Lambda function in the event of errors caused by a new deployment.

How can the developer achieve this with MINIMAL impact on users?
o: Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to use the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, point the alias back to the previous version.

Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to direct 10% of users to the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the previous version.

Do not make any changes to the application. Deploy the new version of the code. If too many errors are encountered, point the application back to the previous version using the version number in the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Create three aliases: new, existing, and router. Point the existing alias to the current version. Have the router alias direct 100% of users to the existing alias. Update the application to use the router alias. Deploy the new version of the code. Point the new alias to this version. Update the router alias to direct 10% of users to the new alias. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the existing alias.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev muốn có khả năng rollback về version Lambda trước đó khi deploy mới gây lỗi
