  • Đồng thời giảm tối đa ảnh hưởng tới người dùng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to direct 10% of users to the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the previous version.

  • Dùng Lambda alias với weighted traffic (canary) cho 10% user thử version mới.

  • Nếu lỗi, chuyển alias về 100% traffic cho version cũ ngay lập tức.

  • Ảnh hưởng tới người dùng là nhỏ nhất (chỉ một phần nhỏ traffic bị tác động), rollback nhanh gọn không đổi endpoint.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to use the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, point the alias back to the previous version.
→ Chuyển 100% sang version mới ngay ⇒ rủi ro ảnh hưởng toàn bộ người dùng trước khi kịp rollback.

❌ Do not make any changes to the application. Deploy the new version of the code. If too many errors are encountered, point the application back to the previous version using the version number in the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
→ Ứng dụng không dùng alias ⇒ rollback phải đổi ARN version trong app/config ⇒ dễ gây downtime/nhầm lẫn, không “minimal impact”.

❌ Create three aliases: new, existing, and router. Point the existing alias to the current version. Have the router alias direct 100% of users to the existing alias. Update the application to use the router alias. Deploy the new version of the code. Point the new alias to this version. Update the router alias to direct 10% of users to the new alias. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the existing alias.
→ Kỹ thuật “router alias” hoạt động được nhưng quá phức tạp cho nhu cầu đề bài; thêm alias trung gian không cần thiết so với B.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda versioning + aliases hỗ trợ weighted traffic (canary/linear) để giảm rủi ro.

📖 Reference:

Lambda aliases – Traffic shifting

questions.q:
A developer updates an AWS Lambda function that an Amazon API Gateway API uses. The API is the backend for a web application.

The developer needs to test the updated Lambda function before deploying the Lambda function to production. The testing must not affect any production users of the web application.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Create a canary release deployment for the existing API stage. Deploy the API to the existing stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the existing URL.
Update the API Gateway API endpoint type to private. Deploy the changes to the existing API stage. Test the API by using the existing URL.
Create a new test API stage in API Gateway. Add stage variables to deploy the updated Lambda function to only the test stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the new stage URL.
Create a new AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy a copy of the entire production API and Lambda function. Use the stack's API URL to test the updated Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API Gateway + Lambda làm backend cho web app.

  • Developer update Lambda function.

  • Cần test function mới nhưng không ảnh hưởng production user.

  • Yêu cầu: cách đơn giản, ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new test API stage in API Gateway. Add stage variables to deploy the updated Lambda function to only the test stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the new stage URL.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ multi-stage (prod, dev, test).

  • Mỗi stage có stage variables để map đến version/alias của Lambda khác nhau.

  • Dùng stage URL riêng để test → không ảnh hưởng production.

  • Đây là giải pháp native, dễ vận hành nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a canary release deployment for the existing API stage. Deploy the API to the existing stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the existing URL.

→ Canary release vẫn share cùng URL production, có thể route 1 phần traffic user thật đến function mới → ảnh hưởng user.

❌ Update the API Gateway API endpoint type to private. Deploy the changes to the existing API stage. Test the API by using the existing URL.

→ Endpoint private chỉ thay đổi access control, không giúp tách biệt test/prod.

❌ Create a new AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy a copy of the entire production API and Lambda function. Use the stack's API URL to test the updated Lambda function.

→ Làm được nhưng quá nặng, tốn effort so với chỉ cần tạo stage mới.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway best practice: sử dụng stages (dev/test/prod).

  • Dùng stage variables để map Lambda alias/version cho từng stage.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A company has a web application that contains an Amazon API Gateway REST API. A developer has created an AWS CloudFormation template for the initial deployment of the application. The developer has deployed the application successfully as part of an AWS CodePipeline continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. All resources and methods are available through the deployed stage endpoint.

The CloudFormation template contains the following resource types:

•AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
•AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
•AWS::ApiGateway::Method
•AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
•AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment

The developer adds a new resource to the REST API with additional methods and redeploys the template. CloudFormation reports that the deployment is successful and that the stack is in the UPDATE_COMPLETE state. However, calls to all new methods are returning 404 (Not Found) errors.

What should the developer do to make the new methods available?
o: Specify the disable-rollback option during the update-stack operation.
Unset the CloudFormation stack failure options.
Add an AWS CodeBuild stage to CodePipeline to run the aws apigateway create-deployment AWS CLI command.
Add an action to CodePipeline to run the aws cloudfront create-invalidation AWS CLI command.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có web app dùng API Gateway REST API, deploy qua CloudFormation (CodePipeline CI/CD).

  • Template gồm RestApi, Resource, Method, Stage, Deployment.

  • Dev thêm resource + method mới, redeploy template → CloudFormation báo UPDATE_COMPLETE nhưng gọi API mới bị 404.

  • Yêu cầu: xử lý để call API mới được

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Add an AWS CodeBuild stage to CodePipeline to run the aws apigateway create-deployment AWS CLI command.

  • Trong API Gateway, khi thêm Resource/Method mới thì cần tạo Deployment mới để các thay đổi có hiệu lực trên Stage.

  • CloudFormation chỉ update resource, nhưng Stage đã gắn với Deployment cũ → chưa “deploy” thay đổi.

  • Giải pháp: tự động chạy aws apigateway create-deployment (có thể dùng CodeBuild trong CodePipeline) để deploy API mới.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Specify the disable-rollback option during the update-stack operation.
→ disable-rollback chỉ ngăn stack rollback khi lỗi, không liên quan đến việc deploy lại API.

❌ Unset the CloudFormation stack failure options.
→ Không ảnh hưởng đến việc 404 khi gọi method mới.

❌ Add an action to CodePipeline to run the aws cloudfront create-invalidation AWS CLI command.
→ CloudFront invalidation chỉ làm refresh cache, không giải quyết việc API Gateway chưa deploy.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Khi update API Gateway qua CloudFormation, phải Deployment lại thì method mới mới hoạt động.

📖 Reference:
AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment – CloudFormation Docs

questions.q:
A developer is monitoring an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer has configured a custom Amazon CloudWatch metric with data granularity of 1 second. If any issues occur, the developer wants to be notified within 30 seconds by Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

What should the developer do to meet this requirement?
o: Configure a high-resolution CloudWatch alarm.
Set up a custom CloudWatch dashboard.
Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights.
Change to a default CloudWatch metric.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev đang monitor app chạy trên EC2.

  • Có custom CloudWatch metric với high-resolution metric 1 giây.

  • Muốn nếu có sự cố thì được SNS notify trong vòng 30 giây.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Configure a high-resolution CloudWatch alarm.

  • CloudWatch hỗ trợ high-resolution metrics (1 second, 5 seconds, 10 seconds, 30 seconds, or any multiple of 60 seconds).

  • Với high-resolution metric, bạn có thể tạo high-resolution alarm với evaluation period ngắn (10 seconds or 30 seconds).

  • Nhờ đó có thể trigger SNS notify trong vòng <30s.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up a custom CloudWatch dashboard.
→ Dashboard chỉ để visualize metric, không gửi cảnh báo.

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights.
→ Logs Insights dùng để query log, không phải real-time alerting.

❌ Change to a default CloudWatch metric.
→ Default metric chỉ hỗ trợ 1 phút (standard resolution), không thể notify trong 30s.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn alert < 1 phút → dùng high-resolution metrics + high-resolution alarms.

📖 Reference:
High-resolution metrics

questions.q:
A company has a website that displays a daily newsletter. When a user visits the website, an AWS Lambda function processes the browser's request and queries the company's on-premises database to obtain the current newsletter. The newsletters are stored in English. The Lambda function uses the Amazon Translate TranslateText API operation to translate the newsletters, and the translation is displayed to the user.

Due to an increase in popularity, the website's response time has slowed. The database is overloaded. The company cannot change the database and needs a solution that improves the response time of the Lambda function.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Change to asynchronous Lambda function invocation.
Cache the translated newsletters in the Lambda/tmp directory.
Enable TranslateText API caching.
• Change the Lambda function to use parallel processing.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có website hiển thị bản tin hàng ngày (newsletter).

  • Lambda xử lý request, lấy dữ liệu từ database on-premises → bản tin tiếng Anh.

  • Lambda gọi Amazon Translate → TranslateText API để dịch.

  • Vấn đề: website chậm, database bị quá tải.

  • Yêu cầu: cải thiện response time, không thay đổi database.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Cache the translated newsletters in the Lambda/tmp directory.

  • Newsletter chỉ thay đổi mỗi ngày (1 lần/ngày).

  • Không cần truy vấn DB & gọi TranslateText cho mỗi request.

  • Lambda có thể lấy bản dịch đã cache trong /tmp (512 MB - 10,240 MB).

  • Giảm tải database + tăng tốc độ phản hồi cho user.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change to asynchronous Lambda function invocation.
→ Asynchronous chỉ thay đổi cách Lambda nhận xử lý request, không giảm số lần truy vấn DB/Translate API.

❌ Enable TranslateText API caching.
→ Amazon Translate không có caching native.

❌ Change the Lambda function to use parallel processing.
→ Parallel processing chỉ làm Lambda xử lý song song, không giải quyết được bottleneck DB.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Nếu data thay đổi ít, không real-time → nên cache (DynamoDB, ElastiCache, hoặc /tmp trong Lambda).

  • /tmp trong Lambda phù hợp cho cache tạm thời theo vòng đời execution environment.

📖 Reference:
Configure ephemeral storage for Lambda functions

Amazon Translate

questions.q:
A company launched an online portal to announce a new product that the company will release in 6 months. The portal requests that users enter an email address to receive communications about the product. The company needs to create a REST API that will store the email addresses in Amazon DynamoDB.

A developer has created an AWS Lambda function that can store the email addresses. The developer will deploy the Lambda function by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The developer must provide access to the Lambda function over HTTP.

Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST additional configuration? (Choose two.)
o: Expose the Lambda function by using function URLs.
Expose the Lambda function by using a Gateway Load Balancer.
Expose the Lambda function by using a Network Load Balancer.
Expose the Lambda function by using AWS Global Accelerator.
Expose the Lambda function by using Amazon API Gateway.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty cần REST API cho portal thu email (lưu vào DynamoDB).

  • Dev đã có Lambda (deploy bằng AWS SAM) và cần mở truy cập HTTP/HTTPS đến Lambda với cấu hình tối thiểu.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Expose the Lambda function by using function URLs.

  • Lambda Function URL tạo ngay một endpoint HTTPS cho function, không cần dựng dịch vụ trung gian.

  • Cấu hình cực ít (IAM/URL auth, CORS), phù hợp MVP/landing page thu email.

  • Dễ khai báo trong SAM (AWS::Serverless::Function với FunctionUrlConfig).

Expose the Lambda function by using Amazon API Gateway.

  • API Gateway (REST/HTTP API) là cách native để mở HTTP endpoint cho Lambda.

  • Tích hợp trực tiếp Lambda, có sẵn CORS, throttling, auth; trong SAM chỉ cần AWS::Serverless::Api hoặc Events: Api.

  • Vẫn “ít cấu hình” cho nhu cầu đơn giản, nhất là với HTTP API.

Các đáp án sai:
Expose the Lambda function by using a Gateway Load Balancer.
→ Gateway Load Balancer dùng cho network/traffic inspection appliances (firewall/IDS), không để public Lambda làm REST API.

Expose the Lambda function by using a Network Load Balancer.
→ NLB là L4 (TCP/UDP), không tích hợp trực tiếp Lambda cho HTTP endpoint (ALB mới hỗ trợ Lambda target).

Expose the Lambda function by using AWS Global Accelerator.
→ Global Accelerator chỉ là front door tăng hiệu năng/anycast, vẫn cần backend HTTP như API Gateway/ALB.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Truy cập HTTP/HTTPS đến Lambda: Lambda Function URL, API Gateway, Application Load Balancer.

📖 Reference:

CreateFunctionUrlConfig

Select a method to invoke your Lambda function using an HTTP request

questions.q:
A company used AWS to develop an application for customers. The application includes an Amazon API Gateway API that invokes AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions process data and store the data in Amazon DynamoDB tables.

The company must monitor the entire application to identify potential bottlenecks in the architecture that can negatively affect customers.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
o: Instrument the application with AWS X-Ray. Inspect the service map to identify errors and issues.
Configure Lambda exceptions and additional logging to Amazon CloudWatch. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to query the logs.
Configure API Gateway to log responses to Amazon CloudWatch. Create a metric filter for the TooManyRequestsException error message.
Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB tables to identify all the ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error messages.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Hệ thống gồm API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB.

  • Cần giám sát end-to-end để phát hiện “nút thắt cổ chai” ảnh hưởng trải nghiệm khách hàng.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Instrument the application with AWS X-Ray. Inspect the service map to identify errors and issues.

  • API Gateway, Lambda và DynamoDB đều tích hợp native với AWS X-Ray → tạo service map end-to-end giúp thấy ngay latency, error rate, segment nào chậm/tắc.

  • Bật sampling + active tracing gần như cấu hình là xong, ít phải viết code (chủ yếu thêm annotation nếu cần).

  • Phù hợp nhất để xác định bottleneck toàn tuyến (API → compute → DB) với ít effort.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Configure Lambda exceptions and additional logging to Amazon CloudWatch. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to query the logs.
→ Chỉ focus Lambda; thiếu bức tranh end-to-end và tương quan giữa API Gateway/Lambda/DynamoDB.

❌ Configure API Gateway to log responses to Amazon CloudWatch. Create a metric filter for the TooManyRequestsException error message.
→ Chỉ tập trung vào API Gateway và một loại lỗi cụ thể (429/TooManyRequests), thiếu bức tranh end-to-end và tương quan giữa API Gateway/Lambda/DynamoDB.

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB tables to identify all the ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error messages.
→ Chỉ giám sát DynamoDB và một lỗi (throttling), thiếu bức tranh end-to-end và tương quan giữa API Gateway/Lambda/DynamoDB.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Muốn quan sát end-to-end trên kiến trúc serverless (API Gateway/Lambda/DynamoDB) → bật AWS X-Ray và xem service map trước, rồi mới đào sâu CloudWatch khi cần.

📖 Reference:
https://blog.cloudmentor.pro/blog/aws/aws-x-ray-from-scratch

questions.q:
A company is developing an application that will be accessed through the Amazon API Gateway REST API. Registered users should be the only ones who can access certain resources of this API. The token being used should expire automatically and needs to be refreshed periodically.

How can a developer meet these requirements?
o: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool, configure the Amazon Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the temporary credentials generated by the identity pool.
Create and maintain a database record for each user with a corresponding token and use an AWS Lambda authorizer in API Gateway.
Create an Amazon Cognito user pool, configure the Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the identity or access token.
Create an IAM user for each API user, attach an invoke permissions policy to the API, and use an IAM authorizer in API Gateway.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có ứng dụng được truy cập qua API Gateway REST API.

  • Yêu cầu: Chỉ user đã đăng ký mới được truy cập một số tài nguyên.

  • Token phải tự động hết hạn và có thể refresh định kỳ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create an Amazon Cognito user pool, configure the Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the identity or access token.

  • Cognito User Pool quản lý user (sign-up/sign-in).

  • Tự động phát hành JWT access token & refresh token.

  • Token có TTL mặc định (ví dụ 1h cho access token) → tự động hết hạn.

  • Có refresh token để lấy token mới khi cần.

  • Tích hợp native với API Gateway qua Cognito Authorizer.

  • Giải pháp chuẩn, ít effort, đáp ứng đúng yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool, configure the Amazon Cognito Authorizer in API Gateway, and use the temporary credentials generated by the identity pool.
→ Identity Pool cung cấp temporary AWS credentials (STS) để truy cập service AWS, không dùng để quản lý auth user/token cho REST API.

❌ Create and maintain a database record for each user with a corresponding token and use an AWS Lambda authorizer in API Gateway.
→ Làm thủ công, phải quản lý token expiry và refresh logic, tốn effort, không tối ưu.

❌ Create an IAM user for each API user, attach an invoke permissions policy to the API, and use an IAM authorizer in API Gateway.
→ Không khả thi: IAM user không phù hợp để quản lý hàng loạt ứng dụng end-user. Token IAM không hỗ trợ refresh định kỳ cho web/mobile users.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • End-user authentication → Cognito User Pool.

  • Token lifecycle (expire + refresh) → User Pool.

📖 Reference:
API Gateway Cognito Authorizers

questions.q:
A developer creates an AWS Lambda function that is written in Java. During testing, the Lambda function does not work how the developer expected. The developer wants to use tracing capabilities to troubleshoot the problem.

Which AWS service should the developer use to accomplish this goal?
o: AWS Trusted Advisor
Amazon CloudWatch
AWS X-Ray
AWS CloudTrail
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer có 1 Lambda function viết bằng Java, test thì không hoạt động như mong đợi.

  • Muốn dùng tracing để debug/troubleshoot.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

AWS X-Ray

  • AWS X-Ray cho phép tracing request end-to-end, xem chi tiết từng segment trong Lambda execution.

  • Giúp developer thấy latency, lỗi, exception stack trace trong code Java.

  • Công cụ chuẩn để troubleshoot khi cần theo dõi chi tiết flow trong Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ AWS Trusted Advisor

→ Kiểm tra best practices (chi phí, security, service limits), không phải tracing/debug.

❌ Amazon CloudWatch

→ Cho metric & log, có thể giúp debug cơ bản nhưng không phải tracing end-to-end như X-Ray.

❌ AWS CloudTrail

→ Dùng để audit API calls trong AWS (ai gọi API nào, từ đâu), không dùng để trace code trong Lambda.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Logs/metrics → CloudWatch.

  • Tracing & performance bottleneck → X-Ray.

  • Audit API calls → CloudTrail.

  • Best practice check → Trusted Advisor.

📖 Reference:

https://blog.cloudmentor.pro/blog/aws/aws-x-ray-from-scratch

questions.q:
A company has a serverless application that uses Amazon API Gateway backed by AWS Lambda proxy integration. The company is developing several backend APIs. The company needs a landing page to provide an overview of navigation to the APIs.

A developer creates a new/LandingPage resource and a new GET method that uses mock integration.

What should the developer do next to meet these requirements?
o: Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HMTL code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.

Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có serverless app dùng API Gateway + Lambda (proxy integration).

  • Công ty cần tạo một Landing Page (GET method, mock integration) để hiển thị HTML tham chiếu tới các API backend.

  • Yêu cầu: Cấu hình mock integration sao cho API Gateway trả về HTML (chứ không phải JSON).

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.

  • Với mock integration, request mapping template thường chỉ cần định nghĩa application/json và statusCode.

  • Response mapping mới là nơi ta format output, cần trả về HTML ⇒ Content-Type text/html.

  • HTML code của Landing Page được viết trong integration response mapping template.

Integration request:

Integration response:

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration response mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs.
→ Sai vì Content-Type response phải là text/html, không phải application/json.

❌ Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of application/json. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HMTL code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of text/html and statusCode of 200.
→ Sai vì HTML không nên nằm trong request mapping (chỉ để mock input), mà phải ở response mapping.

❌ Configure the integration request mapping template with Content-Type of text/html. In the integration request mapping template, include the LandingPage HTML code that references the APIs. Configure the integration response mapping template with Content-Type of application/json and statusCode of 200.
→ Sai vì Content-Type response phải là text/html, không phải application/json.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Mock integration trong API Gateway:

    • Request mapping template: định nghĩa input giả định + statusCode.

    • Response mapping template: định nghĩa output, format Content-Type.

  • Trả về HTML → dùng text/html ở integration response.

📖 Reference:

Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway
Mapping template transformations for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora database.

A developer is adding a caching layer to the application. The caching strategy must ensure that the application always uses the most recent value for each data item.

Which caching strategy will meet these requirements?
o: Implement a TTL strategy for every item that is saved in the cache.
Implement a write-through strategy for every item that is created and updated.
Implement a lazy loading strategy for every item that is loaded.
Implement a read-through strategy for every item that is loaded.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng ecommerce chạy trên AWS, dữ liệu lưu trong Aurora.

  • Developer thêm caching layer.

  • Yêu cầu: Cache phải luôn có giá trị mới nhất cho từng item (data consistency).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Implement a write-through strategy for every item that is created and updated.

  • Write-through caching: mọi khi write/update vào DB, thì dữ liệu cũng được ghi ngay lập tức vào cache.

  • Đảm bảo cache luôn đồng bộ với DB, tức luôn chứa giá trị mới nhất.

  • Phù hợp với yêu cầu “always most recent value”.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Implement a TTL strategy for every item that is saved in the cache.

→ Trong TTL có thể dữ liệu đã bị cũ, không đảm bảo “always up-to-date”.

❌ Implement a lazy loading strategy for every item that is loaded.

→ Lazy loading chỉ load vào cache khi đọc lần đầu, nhưng nếu DB thay đổi mà chưa có read mới → cache có thể stale (không mới nhất).

❌ Implement a read-through strategy for every item that is loaded.

→ Read-through giống lazy loading nhưng cache provider lo việc fetch từ DB. Vẫn có khả năng cache chứa dữ liệu cũ trước khi refresh.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Luôn cần dữ liệu mới nhất → chọn write-through.

  • Chấp nhận dữ liệu cũ 1 thời gian → TTL hoặc lazy loading.

📖 Reference:

Caching patterns

questions.q:
A company hosts its application in the us-west-1 Region. The company wants to add redundancy in the us-east-1 Region.

The application secrets are stored in AWS Secrets Manager in us-west-1. A developer needs to replicate the secrets to us-east-1.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Configure secret replication for each secret. Add us-east-1 as a replication Region. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

Create a new secret in us-east-1 for each secret. Configure secret replication in us-east-1. Set the source to be the corresponding secret in us-west-1. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-west-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

Create a replication rule for each secret. Set us-east-1 as the destination Region. Configure the rule to run during secret rotation. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.
Create a Secrets Manager lifecycle rule to replicate each secret to a new Amazon S3 bucket in us-west-1. Configure an S3 replication rule to replicate the secrets to us-east-1.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy ở us-west-1, muốn có redundancy ở us-east-1.

  • Secrets lưu trong AWS Secrets Manager ở us-west-1.

  • Dev cần replicate secrets sang us-east-1.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure secret replication for each secret. Add us-east-1 as a replication Region. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

  • Secrets Manager hỗ trợ multi-Region secrets replication native.

  • Chỉ cần bật replication cho từng secret, chọn Region đích và KMS key ở Region đó.

  • Secrets sẽ được sync tự động, có cùng ARN khác Region, và luôn sẵn sàng cho failover.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new secret in us-east-1 for each secret. Configure secret replication in us-east-1. Set the source to be the corresponding secret in us-west-1. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-west-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

→ Replication config phải bắt đầu từ Region gốc (us-west-1), không làm ngược lại từ Region đích.

❌ Create a replication rule for each secret. Set us-east-1 as the destination Region. Configure the rule to run during secret rotation. Choose an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key in us-east-1 to encrypt the replicated secrets.

→ Không cần gắn replication vào rotation, Secrets Manager đã có replication cơ chế riêng.

❌ Create a Secrets Manager lifecycle rule to replicate each secret to a new Amazon S3 bucket in us-west-1. Configure an S3 replication rule to replicate the secrets to us-east-1.

→ Secrets Manager không có lifecycle rule → và không bao giờ replicate secrets qua S3, sai hoàn toàn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Multi-Region app → dùng Secrets Manager replication (native feature).

Mỗi Region cần KMS key riêng để mã hóa secrets replicated.

📖 Reference:

How to replicate secrets in AWS Secrets Manager to multiple Regions

questions.q:
A developer needs to modify an application architecture to meet new functional requirements. Application data is stored in Amazon DynamoDB and processed for analysis in a nightly batch. The system analysts do not want to wait until the next day to view the processed data and have asked to have it available in near-real time.

Which application architecture pattern would enable the data to be processed as it is received?
o: Event driven
Client-server driven
Fan-out driven
Schedule driven
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App đang lưu data trong DynamoDB và xử lý bằng batch ban đêm.

  • Analyst không muốn chờ đến hôm sau, mà muốn dữ liệu được xử lý gần real-time.

  • Yêu cầu: kiến trúc phải xử lý ngay khi dữ liệu đến.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Event driven

  • Với event-driven dữ liệu được xử lý ngay khi có sự kiện mới (ví dụ: DynamoDB Streams + Lambda).

  • Điều này cho phép phân tích gần như real-time, thay vì batch ban đêm.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Client-server driven

→ Mô hình cơ bản client gửi request, server trả response. Không phải kiến trúc để xử lý event real-time.

❌ Fan-out driven

→ Fan-out pattern thường áp dụng khi 1 event cần gửi đến nhiều consumer (SNS → nhiều Lambda/SQS). Không giải quyết yêu cầu “real-time analytics” trừ khi kết hợp với event-driven.

❌ Schedule driven

→ Schedule = batch theo lịch (như nightly batch). Đây chính là cách cũ đang gây chậm.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DynamoDB + near real-time processing → bật DynamoDB Streams + Lambda → event-driven architecture.

  • Nếu cần phân tích lớn hơn → stream vào Kinesis hoặc Firehose để xử lý thêm.

📖 Reference:

AWS Event-driven Architecture Patterns (DynamoDB Streams + Lambda).

questions.q:
A company is working on a new serverless application. A developer needs to find an automated way to deploy AWS Lambda functions and the dependent infrastructure with minimum coding effort. The application also needs to be reliable.

Which method will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Manually upload the .zip files to the AWS Management Console.
Build the application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). Use a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline and the SAM CLI to deploy the Lambda functions.

Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Upload the .zip files. Deploy the .zip files as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

Build a container for each Lambda function. Store the container images in AWS CodeArtifact. Deploy the containers as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty cần 1 ứng dụng serverless.

  • Dev muốn triển khai Lambda + hạ tầng liên quan tự động, ít effort code nhất, và đáng tin cậy.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Build the application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). Use a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline and the SAM CLI to deploy the Lambda functions.

  • AWS SAM define hạ tầng bằng infrastructure as code (IaC) chuyên cho serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, …).

  • SAM CLI + CI/CD = tự động build, package, deploy → ít effort code nhất, reliable.

  • Tích hợp natively với CloudFormation, đảm bảo rollback, repeatable deployment.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Manually upload the .zip files to the AWS Management Console.

→ Manual upload = nhiều effort thủ công, không reliable, không automation.

❌ Build the application by using shell scripts to create .zip files for each Lambda function. Upload the .zip files. Deploy the .zip files as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

→ Có automation hơn manual, nhưng vẫn phải tự viết nhiều script ⇒ nhiều effort hơn SAM.

❌ Build a container for each Lambda function. Store the container images in AWS CodeArtifact. Deploy the containers as Lambda functions by using the AWS CLI in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.

→ Không hợp lý: Lambda container image nên lưu ở Amazon ECR, không phải CodeArtifact.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Serverless app → dùng SAM hoặc CDK để quản lý hạ tầng IaC.

📖 Reference:

Automate the deployment of your AWS SAM application

Implementing cross-account CI/CD with AWS SAM for container-based Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer has written a distributed application that uses microservices. The microservices are running on Amazon EC2 instances. Because of message volume, the developer is unable to match log output from each microservice to a specific transaction. The developer needs to analyze the message flow to debug the application.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
o: Download the AWS X-Ray daemon. Install the daemon on an EC2 instance. Ensure that the EC2 instance allows UDP traffic on port 2000.
Configure an interface VPC endpoint to allow traffic to reach the global AWS X-Ray daemon on TCP port 2000.
Enable AWS X-Ray. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to push logs to X-Ray.
Add the AWS X-Ray software development kit (SDK) to the microservices. Use X-Ray to trace requests that each microservice makes.
Set up Amazon CloudWatch metric streams to collect streaming data from the microservices.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng distributed chạy microservices trên EC2.

  • Vấn đề: log quá nhiều, khó trace theo transaction.

  • Yêu cầu: cần phân tích message flow để debug.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Download the AWS X-Ray daemon. Install the daemon on an EC2 instance. Ensure that the EC2 instance allows UDP traffic on port 2000.

  • Trên EC2 phải có X-Ray daemon để nhận trace data từ SDK và gửi về service X-Ray.

  • X-Ray daemon lắng nghe UDP 2000.

Add the AWS X-Ray software development kit (SDK) to the microservices. Use X-Ray to trace requests that each microservice makes.

  • SDK tích hợp vào code để tạo segment/subsegment → trace xuyên suốt microservices.

  • Giúp nối các log theo transaction, hiển thị flow end-to-end.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure an interface VPC endpoint to allow traffic to reach the global AWS X-Ray daemon on TCP port 2000.

→ X-Ray daemon không chạy global, không chạy TCP 2000; nó chạy local trên host với UDP 2000.

❌ Enable AWS X-Ray. Configure Amazon CloudWatch to push logs to X-Ray.

→ CloudWatch không đẩy log sang X-Ray. X-Ray chỉ nhận trace, không ingest log từ CloudWatch.

❌ Set up Amazon CloudWatch metric streams to collect streaming data from the microservices.

→ Metric streams = CloudWatch → Kinesis, không liên quan đến tracing theo transaction.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Muốn trace transaction xuyên microservices → X-Ray SDK + Daemon.

  • EC2 cần mở UDP 2000 cho daemon.

📖 Reference:

Running the X-Ray daemon on Amazon EC2

questions.q:
A developer is creating AWS CloudFormation templates to manage an application's deployment in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) through AWS CodeDeploy. The developer wants to automatically deploy new versions of the application to a percentage of users before the new version becomes available for all users.

How should the developer manage the deployment of the new version?
o: Modify the CloudFormation template to include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.
Deploy the new version in a new CloudFormation stack. After testing is complete, update the application's DNS records for the new stack.
Run CloudFormation stack updates on the application stack to deploy new application versions when they are available.
Create a nested stack for the new version. Include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên ECS, deployment quản lý bằng CodeDeploy qua CloudFormation.

  • Yêu cầu: khi deploy version mới → rollout dần theo % user (canary/linear) trước khi public toàn bộ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the CloudFormation template to include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.

  • CloudFormation hỗ trợ blue/green deployments cho ECS qua CodeDeploy hook.

  • Khi thêm Transform: AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen và cấu hình lifecycle hooks → CodeDeploy quản lý traffic shifting theo % (linear/canary).

  • Đây là cách native, tự động, ít effort nhất.

Blue/green deployment template example:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Parameters:
  Vpc:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPC::Id'
  Subnet1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id'
  Subnet2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id'
Transform:
  - 'AWS::CodeDeployBlueGreen'
Hooks:
  CodeDeployBlueGreenHook:
    Type: 'AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen'
    Properties:
      TrafficRoutingConfig:
        Type: TimeBasedCanary
        TimeBasedCanary:
          StepPercentage: 15
          BakeTimeMins: 5
      Applications:
        - Target:
            Type: 'AWS::ECS::Service'
            LogicalID: ECSDemoService
          ECSAttributes:
            TaskDefinitions:
              - BlueTaskDefinition
              - GreenTaskDefinition
            TaskSets:
              - BlueTaskSet
              - GreenTaskSet
            TrafficRouting:
              ProdTrafficRoute:
                Type: 'AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener'
                LogicalID: ALBListenerProdTraffic
              TargetGroups:
                - ALBTargetGroupBlue
                - ALBTargetGroupGreen
Resources:
  .......

Traffic shifting status:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Deploy the new version in a new CloudFormation stack. After testing is complete, update the application's DNS records for the new stack.

→ Đây là thủ công, không phải traffic shifting theo % user. DNS cutover = all-or-nothing.

❌ Run CloudFormation stack updates on the application stack to deploy new application versions when they are available.

→ Stack update chỉ replace ECS task definition, không có traffic shifting theo % → downtime risk.

❌ Create a nested stack for the new version. Include a Transform section and the AWS::CodeDeploy::BlueGreen hook.

→ Không cần nested stack. BlueGreen hook chỉ cần ở main stack, không liên quan nested.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • ECS + CodeDeploy + CloudFormation = hỗ trợ Blue/Green deployments native.

  • Canary/linear rollout = dùng CodeDeploy traffic shifting.

📖 Reference:

Create an Amazon ECS blue/green deployment through AWS CloudFormation

Blue/green deployment template example

questions.q:
A developer is designing a fault-tolerant environment where client sessions will be saved.

How can the developer ensure that no sessions are lost if an Amazon EC2 instance fails?
o: Use sticky sessions with an Elastic Load Balancer target group.
Use Amazon SQS to save session data.
Use Amazon DynamoDB to perform scalable session handling.
Use Elastic Load Balancer connection draining to stop sending requests to failing instances.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần thiết kế hệ thống fault-tolerant, trong đó session client phải được lưu an toàn.

  • Yêu cầu: nếu 1 EC2 instance bị fail thì session không bị mất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon DynamoDB to perform scalable session handling.

  • Lưu session vào DynamoDB (hoặc một kho dữ liệu shared, durable) thay vì chỉ lưu trong EC2 memory.

  • Khi instance fail, session data vẫn tồn tại và có thể truy cập từ instance khác.

  • DynamoDB còn scalable, HA, phù hợp cho session store.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use sticky sessions with an Elastic Load Balancer target group.

→ Sticky session (session affinity) giữ user gắn với 1 EC2. Nếu EC2 chết → mất session.

❌ Use Amazon SQS to save session data.

→ SQS = message queue, không phải session store. Không hỗ trợ truy cập random session state.

❌ Use Elastic Load Balancer connection draining to stop sending requests to failing instances.

→ Connection draining chỉ giúp request hiện tại hoàn tất khi instance bị deregistered. Không đảm bảo session persistence nếu instance crash bất ngờ.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn session fault-tolerant → lưu ở DynamoDB or ElastiCache Redis.

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that is invoked by messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The messages represent customer data updates from a customer relationship management (CRM) system

The developer wants the Lambda function to process only the messages that pertain to email address changes. Additional subscribers to the SNS topic will process any other messages.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST development effort?
o: Use Lambda event filtering to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.
Use an SNS filter policy on the Lambda function subscription to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.

Subscribe an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to the SNS topic. Configure the SQS queue with a filter policy to allow only messages that are related to email address changes.Connect the SQS queue to the Lambda function.

Configure the Lambda code to check the received message. If the message is not related to an email address change, configure the Lambda function to publish the message back to the SNS topic for the other subscribers to process.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda được invoke bởi SNS topic chứa nhiều loại message từ CRM.

  • Yêu cầu: Lambda chỉ xử lý message liên quan đến thay đổi email, các message khác để subscriber khác xử lý.

  • Mục tiêu: ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use an SNS filter policy on the Lambda function subscription to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.

  • SNS hỗ trợ filter policy ngay trên subscription.

  • Filter policy sẽ kiểm tra thuộc tính message và chỉ chuyển đến Lambda nếu match.

  • Giải pháp native, no-code, ít effort nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Lambda event filtering to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.

→ Event filtering hiện có ở SQS → Lambda, EventBridge → Lambda, không có trực tiếp với SNS → Lambda.

❌ Subscribe an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to the SNS topic. Configure the SQS queue with a filter policy to allow only messages that are related to email address changes.Connect the SQS queue to the Lambda function.

→ Có thể làm được, nhưng phức tạp hơn (thêm SQS layer), không “least effort”.

❌ Configure the Lambda code to check the received message. If the message is not related to an email address change, configure the Lambda function to publish the message back to the SNS topic for the other subscribers to process.

→ Bắt Lambda parse & republish → tốn code, không hiệu quả, tăng chi phí invoke.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

SNS → Lambda muốn lọc message → dùng SNS subscription filter policy.

📖 Reference:

Amazon SNS example filter policies

questions.q:
A developer wrote an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to asynchronously generate short videos based on requests from customers. This video generation can take up to 10 minutes. After the video is generated, a URL to download the video is pushed to the customer's web browser. The customer should be able to access these videos for at least 3 hours after generation.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Store the video in the /tmp folder within the Lambda execution environment. Push a Lambda function URL to the customer.
Store the video in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system attached to the function. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
Store the video in Amazon S3. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
Store the video in an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda async generate video (mất tới 10 phút).

  • Sau khi generate xong → gửi URL để khách download.

  • Video phải truy cập được ít nhất 3 giờ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the video in Amazon S3. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.

  • S3 là storage bền vững, rẻ, tích hợp tốt với Lambda.

  • Có thể tạo pre-signed URL với TTL custom (vd: 3h).

  • Đáp ứng yêu cầu: scale tốt, khách hàng có thể download trong 3h, Lambda không phải giữ file.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the video in the /tmp folder within the Lambda execution environment. Push a Lambda function URL to the customer.

→ /tmp ephemeral, chỉ tồn tại trong lifecycle container, có thể bị xóa bất kỳ lúc nào, không đảm bảo 3h.

❌ Store the video in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system attached to the function. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.

→ EFS phù hợp internal share, không phải để deliver file cho khách.

❌ Store the video in an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.

→ CloudFront presigned URL có thể dùng, nhưng vẫn cần backend storage như S3.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • File output của Lambda (>= vài phút xử lý, cần giữ vài giờ) → lưu S3 + pre-signed URL.

  • /tmp = ephemeral storage (512MB mặc định, 10GB max) chỉ tồn tại trong lifecycle container.

  • EFS = shared file system, không phù hợp public sharing.

📖 Reference:

Sharing objects with presigned URLs

Secure file sharing solutions in AWS

questions.q:
A developer is creating a web application for a school that stores data in Amazon DynamoDB. The ExamScores table has the following attributes: student_id, subject_name, and top_score.

Each item in the ExamScores table is identified with student_id as the partition key and subject_name as the sort key. The web application needs to display the student _id for the top scores for each school subject. The developer needs to increase the speed of the queries to retrieve the student_id for the top scorer for each school subject.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
Create a local secondary index (LSI) with top_score as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Bảng ExamScores (DynamoDB) có:

    • PK = student_id

    • SK = subject_name

    • Mỗi item = điểm cao nhất (top_score) của 1 học sinh trong 1 môn.

  • Ứng dụng cần truy vấn theo từng môn học → tìm student_id có top_score cao nhất.

  • Yêu cầu: tăng tốc độ query.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.

  • Dùng subject_name làm PK → gom tất cả học sinh theo môn học.

  • Dùng top_score làm SK → có thể query theo sort order (DESC) và lấy record đầu tiên = highest scorer.

  • Đây là design tối ưu để tìm “top scorer by subject”.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a local secondary index (LSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.

→ LSI chỉ cho phép thay đổi sort key, partition key vẫn là student_id. Không giải quyết được yêu cầu truy vấn theo subject_name.

❌ Create a local secondary index (LSI) with top_score as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.

→ LSI chỉ cho phép thay đổi sort key, partition key vẫn là student_id. Không giải quyết được yêu cầu truy vấn theo subject_name.

❌ Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.

→ Có thể group theo subject, nhưng không thể sort theo điểm để tìm nhanh top scorer.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • LSI = thay đổi sort key (cùng PK).

  • GSI = thay đổi cả PK và SK → phù hợp cho query mới.

📖 Reference:

General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer manages an application that writes customer orders to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The orders use customer_id as the partition key, order_id as the sort key, and order_date as an attribute. A new access pattern requires accessing data by order_date and order_id. The developer needs to implement a new AWS Lambda function to support the new access pattern.

How should the developer support the new access pattern in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Add a new local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new LSI index.
Write the new Lambda function to scan the DynamoDB table. In the Lambda function, write a method to retrieve and combine results by order_date and order_id.
Add a new global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new GSI index.
Enable DynamoDB Streams on the table. Choose the new and old images information to write to the DynamoDB stream. Write the new Lambda function to query the DynamoDB stream
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application lưu customer orders trong DynamoDB table

  • Partition key = customer_id, Sort key = order_id, Attribute = order_date

  • New access pattern: cần query bằng order_date và order_id

  • Cần solution MOST operationally efficient

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a new global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new GSI index.

  • GSI cho phép tạo alternative partition key và sort key khác với base table

  • Query GSI rất hiệu quả, sử dụng index thay vì scan toàn bộ table

  • order_date làm partition key cho phép query theo date range

  • order_id làm sort key cho phép sort và filter thêm trong partition

  • Operational efficient vì GSI tự động maintain và sync với base table

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a new local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new LSI index.

→ LSI phải share cùng partition key với base table (customer_id). Không thể dùng order_date làm partition key trong LSI.

❌ Write the new Lambda function to scan the DynamoDB table. In the Lambda function, write a method to retrieve and combine results by order_date and order_id.

→ Scan toàn bộ table rất inefficient (không hiệu quả), tốn throughput capacity và slow performance khi data lớn.

❌ Enable DynamoDB Streams on the table. Choose the new and old images information to write to the DynamoDB stream. Write the new Lambda function to query the DynamoDB stream.

→ DynamoDB Streams dùng để capture changes real-time, không phải để query historical data. Streams chỉ retain data 24 giờ.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "New access pattern with different keys" → GSI (Global Secondary Index)

  • LSI vs GSI:

    • LSI = same partition key, different sort key

    • GSI = completely different partition key và sort key

  • "Query by attribute (không phải partition/sort key hiện tại)" → cần GSI

  • "Operationally efficient" → loại Scan (rất không hiệu quả)

  • DynamoDB Streams = real-time change capture, không phải query tool

📖 Reference:

  • Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB

  • Improving data access with secondary indexes

questions.q:
A developer is writing an application, which stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer wants to query the DynamoDB table by using the partition key and a different sort key value. The developer needs the latest data with all recent write operations.

How should the developer write the DynamoDB query?
o: Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using eventually consistent reads.
Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using strongly consistent reads.
Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using eventually consistent reads.
Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using strongly consistent reads.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer muốn query DynamoDB table bằng partition key và sort key value khác (không phải sort key hiện tại)

  • Cần latest data với tất cả recent write operations

  • Hỏi: cách query DynamoDB như thế nào?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using strongly consistent reads.

  • LSI cho phép dùng cùng partition key nhưng với sort key khác

  • Strongly consistent reads đảm bảo đọc được latest data với tất cả recent writes

  • LSI hỗ trợ strongly consistent reads (khác với GSI chỉ hỗ trợ eventually consistent)

  • LSI phải được tạo during table creation, không thể add sau

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using eventually consistent reads.

→ Eventually consistent reads có thể không trả về latest data ngay lập tức. Không đáp ứng yêu cầu "latest data with all recent write operations".

❌ Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using eventually consistent reads.

→ GSI chỉ hỗ trợ eventually consistent reads. Không đáp ứng yêu cầu latest data.

❌ Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using strongly consistent reads.

→ GSI không hỗ trợ strongly consistent reads, chỉ có eventually consistent reads.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Same partition key + different sort key" → LSI (Local Secondary Index)

  • "Latest data/recent writes" → Strongly consistent reads

  • LSI vs GSI về consistency:

    • LSI = hỗ trợ cả strongly consistent và eventually consistent reads

    • GSI = chỉ hỗ trợ eventually consistent reads

  • "Latest data" keyword → loại bỏ eventually consistent options

  • LSI phải tạo lúc create table, GSI có thể add sau

📖 Reference:

  • Local Secondary Indexes

You can query a local secondary index using either eventually consistent or strongly consistent reads.

  • Read Consistency for DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer is building an ecommerce application. When there is a sale event, the application needs to concurrently call three third-party systems to record the sale. The developer wrote three AWS Lambda functions. There is one Lambda function for each third-party system, which contains complex integration logic.

These Lambda functions are all independent. The developer needs to design the application so each Lambda function will run regardless of others' success or failure.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the three Lambda functions to poll the queue.
Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the three Lambda functions to be triggered by the SNS topic.
Publish the sale event from the application to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Add the three Lambda functions as ALB targets.
Publish the sale event from the application to an AWS Step Functions state machine. Move the logic from the three Lambda functions into the Step Functions state machine.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ecommerce application cần concurrently call three third-party systems khi có sale event

  • Có three Lambda functions (mỗi function cho một third-party system)

  • Complex integration logic trong mỗi Lambda

  • Các Lambda functions là independent (độc lập)

  • Yêu cầu: mỗi Lambda phải run bất kể success hay failure của Lambda khác

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the three Lambda functions to be triggered by the SNS topic.

  • SNS topic là fan-out pattern, gửi message đến tất cả subscribers đồng thời

  • Mỗi Lambda function là một independent subscriber

  • Concurrent execution - 3 Lambda chạy song song, không phụ thuộc nhau

  • Nếu một Lambda fail, không ảnh hưởng đến execution của hai Lambda còn lại

  • SNS đảm bảo mỗi subscriber nhận được message độc lập

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the three Lambda functions to poll the queue.

→ SQS queue là one-to-one model. Mỗi message chỉ được consume bởi một consumer. Không thể có ba Lambda functions cùng process một message.

❌ Publish the sale event from the application to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Add the three Lambda functions as ALB targets.

→ ALB sẽ route request đến một target dựa trên load balancing algorithm, không gửi đến tất cả targets đồng thời. Không đáp ứng yêu cầu concurrent execution.

❌ Publish the sale event from the application to an AWS Step Functions state machine. Move the logic from the three Lambda functions into the Step Functions state machine.

→ Yêu cầu move complex integration logic ra khỏi Lambda vào Step Functions. Đây là major refactoring, không cần thiết và phức tạp hơn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Concurrently call multiple systems" + "independent execution" → SNS fan-out pattern

  • SNS vs SQS:

    • SNS = one-to-many (pub-sub), gửi đến tất cả subscribers

    • SQS = one-to-one, mỗi message chỉ một consumer

  • ALB không phải giải pháp cho fan-out pattern

  • Step Functions tốt cho orchestration nhưng tạo dependencies giữa các steps

📖 Reference:

  • Invoking Lambda functions with Amazon SNS notifications

questions.q:
A company has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process data. A developer must implement encryption in transit for all sensitive configuration data, such as API keys, that is stored in the application. The developer creates an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.

What should the developer do next to meet the encryption requirement?
o: Create parameters of the String type in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. For each parameter, specify the KMS key ID to encrypt the parameter in transit. Reference the GetParameter API call in the Lambda environment variables.

Create secrets in AWS Secrets Manager by using the customer managed KMS key. Create a new Lambda function and set up a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer to retrieve the values from Secrets Manager.

Create objects in Amazon S3 for each sensitive data field. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the object. Configure the Lambda function to retrieve the objects from Amazon S3 during data processing.

Create encrypted Lambda environment variables. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the variables. Enable encryption helpers for encryption in transit. Grant permission to the Lambda function's execution role to access the KMS key.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company có application dùng Lambda function để process data

  • Cần implement encryption in transit cho sensitive configuration data (API keys, etc.)

  • Developer đã tạo AWS KMS customer managed key

  • Hỏi: bước tiếp theo để đáp ứng yêu cầu encryption?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create encrypted Lambda environment variables. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the variables. Enable encryption helpers for encryption in transit. Grant permission to the Lambda function's execution role to access the KMS key.

  • Lambda environment variables là cách đơn giản nhất để lưu configuration data cho Lambda

  • Encryption helpers cung cấp encryption in transit - decrypt data trong Lambda code, không phải khi Lambda startup

  • Customer managed KMS key được dùng để encrypt/decrypt environment variables

  • Execution role permission cần thiết để Lambda có quyền sử dụng KMS key

  • Đáp ứng đủ yêu cầu: encryption in transit + sử dụng KMS key đã tạo

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create parameters of the String type in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. For each parameter, specify the KMS key ID to encrypt the parameter in transit. Reference the GetParameter API call in the Lambda environment variables.

  • Parameter Store encrypt data at rest, không phải in transit

  • Reference API call trong environment variables không hợp lý về architecture

❌ Create secrets in AWS Secrets Manager by using the customer managed KMS key. Create a new Lambda function and set up a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer to retrieve the values from Secrets Manager.

  • Secrets Manager encrypt at rest, không có encryption in transit tự động

  • Tạo new Lambda function và Lambda layer là over-complicated, không cần thiết

❌ Create objects in Amazon S3 for each sensitive data field. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the object. Configure the Lambda function to retrieve the objects from Amazon S3 during data processing.

  • S3 encryption là at rest

  • Dùng S3 cho configuration data là anti-pattern, quá phức tạp

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Encryption in transit" → Lambda encryption helpers với environment variables

  • "Configuration data cho Lambda" → Environment variables (đơn giản nhất)

  • At rest vs In transit:

    • Parameter Store / Secrets Manager / S3 = at rest

    • Lambda encryption helpers = in transit

  • KMS key + Lambda → cần grant permission cho execution role

📖 Reference:

  • Using AWS Lambda environment variables

  • Securing Lambda environment variables

questions.q:
A developer is working on an app for a company that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table named Orders to store customer orders. The table uses OrderID as the partition key and there is no sort key. The table contains more than 100,000 records. The developer needs to add a functionality that will retrieve all Orders records that contain an OrderSource attribute with the MobileApp value.

Which solution will improve the user experience in the MOST efficient way?
o: Perform a Scan operation on the Orders table. Provide a QueryFilter condition to filter to only the items where the OrderSource attribute is equal to the MobileApp value.
Create a local secondary index (LSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the sort key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table Orders có 100,000+ records

  • Partition key = OrderID, không có sort key

  • Cần retrieve tất cả records có OrderSource attribute = MobileApp

  • Tìm solution MOST efficient để improve user experience

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.

  • GSI với OrderSource làm partition key cho phép query trực tiếp theo OrderSource value

  • Query operation rất hiệu quả, chỉ scan partition cụ thể thay vì toàn bộ table

  • Efficient với large dataset (100,000+ records) vì chỉ truy cập data cần thiết

  • OrderSource làm partition key (không phải sort key) cho phép query exact match

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Perform a Scan operation on the Orders table. Provide a QueryFilter condition to filter to only the items where the OrderSource attribute is equal to the MobileApp value.

  • Scan operation phải đọc toàn bộ 100,000+ records, rất kém hiệu quả

  • Tốn throughput capacity và slow performance

  • QueryFilter chỉ filter sau khi scan, không giảm data đã đọc

❌ Create a local secondary index (LSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.

  • LSI không thể thay đổi partition key, phải dùng cùng partition key với base table (OrderID)

  • Không thể set OrderSource làm partition key trong LSI

❌ Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the sort key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.

  • OrderSource làm sort key thì phải có partition key khác

  • Không thể query chỉ bằng sort key, phải có partition key trước

  • Architecture không đúng cho use case này

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Query by attribute (không phải current key)" + "large dataset" → GSI

  • "Most efficient" → loại Scan (luôn kém hiệu quả với large data)

  • Query pattern: cần attribute làm partition key của GSI, không phải sort key

  • LSI không thể thay đổi partition key

  • Scan + Filter = đọc toàn bộ data rồi mới filter → rất tốn kém

📖 Reference:

  • Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB

  • Best practices for querying and scanning data in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer is publishing critical log data to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The log group was created 2 months ago. The developer must encrypt the log data by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key so that future data can be encrypted to comply with the company's security policy.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST effort?
o: Use the AWS Encryption SDK for encryption and decryption of the data before writing to the log group.
Use the AWS KMS console to associate the KMS key with the log group.
Use the AWS CLI aws logs create-log-group command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
Use the AWS CLI aws logs associate-kms-key command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer publish critical log data vào CloudWatch Logs log group

  • Log group đã được tạo 2 tháng trước

  • Cần encrypt log data bằng AWS KMS key để future data comply với security policy

  • Tìm solution với LEAST effort

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the AWS CLI aws logs associate-kms-key command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

  • associate-kms-key command cho phép associate KMS key với existing log group

  • Đơn giản nhất - chỉ cần 1 command AWS CLI

  • Encrypt future log data automatically sau khi associate key

  • Không cần modify application code hoặc recreate log group

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the AWS Encryption SDK for encryption and decryption of the data before writing to the log group.

  • Require modify application code để encrypt/decrypt data

  • Phức tạp và tốn effort hơn nhiều so với native CloudWatch Logs encryption

  • Developer phải manage encryption logic manually

❌ Use the AWS KMS console to associate the KMS key with the log group.

  • AWS Console không hỗ trợ associate KMS key với existing log group

  • Chỉ có thể set KMS key khi create log group mới

  • Không đáp ứng yêu cầu cho log group đã tồn tại

❌ Use the AWS CLI aws logs create-log-group command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

  • create-log-group sẽ tạo log group mới, không associate key với existing log group

  • Yêu cầu recreate log group và migrate data

  • Tốn nhiều effort hơn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Existing resource + add encryption" → dùng associate command

  • "LEAST effort" → loại solutions require code changes hoặc recreate resources

  • CloudWatch Logs encryption:

    • Create → set KMS key khi create

    • After created → dùng associate-kms-key command

  • Console vs CLI: Console không support associate key cho existing log group

📖 Reference:

  • Encrypt log data in CloudWatch Logs using AWS Key Management Service

  • AssociateKmsKey

  • associate-kms-key

questions.q:
A developer is implementing an AWS Lambda function that will be invoked when an object is uploaded to Amazon S3. The developer wants to test the Lambda function in a local development machine before publishing the function to a production AWS account.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Upload an object to Amazon S3 by using the aws s3api put-object CLI command. Wait for the local Lambda invocation from the S3 event.
Create a sample JSON text file for a put object S3 event. Invoke the Lambda function locally. Use the aws lambda invoke CLI command with the JSON file and Lambda function name as arguments.

Use the sam local start-lambda CLI command to start Lambda. Use the sam local generate-event s3 put CLI command to create the Lambda test JSON file. Use the sam local invoke CLI command with the JSON file as the argument to invoke the Lambda function.
Create a JSON string for the put object S3 event. In the AWS Management Console, use the JSON string to create a test event for the local Lambda function. Perform the test.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer implement Lambda function sẽ được invoke khi object uploaded to S3

  • Muốn test Lambda function locally trên development machine trước khi publish to production

  • Tìm solution với LEAST operational overhead

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the sam local start-lambda CLI command to start Lambda. Use the sam local generate-event s3 put CLI command to create the Lambda test JSON file. Use the sam local invoke CLI command with the JSON file as the argument to invoke the Lambda function.

  • AWS SAM CLI được thiết kế đặc biệt cho local Lambda testing

  • sam local generate-event tự động tạo sample event data (không cần tạo manual)

  • sam local invoke chạy Lambda locally với event generated

  • Native workflow cho local Lambda development và testing

  • LEAST overhead vì tất cả steps được automate bởi SAM CLI

To use sam local start-lambda

  1. From the root directory of your project, run the following:

sam local start-lambda <options>

  1. The AWS SAM CLI builds your Lambda functions in a local Docker container. It then outputs the local address to your HTTP server endpoint. The following is an example:

sam local start-lambda
Initializing the lambda functions containers.
Local image is up-to-date
Using local image: public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.9-rapid-x86_64.

Mounting /Users/.../sam-app/hello_world as /var/task:ro,delegated, inside runtime container
Containers Initialization is done.
Starting the Local Lambda Service. You can now invoke your Lambda Functions defined in your template through the endpoint.
2023-04-13 07:25:43 WARNING: This is a development server. Do not use it in a production deployment. Use a production WSGI server instead.
 * Running on http://127.0.0.1:3001
2023-04-13 07:25:43 Press CTRL+C to quit

  1. Use the AWS CLI or SDKs to invoke your Lambda function locally.

The following is an example using the AWS CLI:

aws lambda invoke --function-name "HelloWorldFunction" --endpoint-url "http://127.0.0.1:3001" --no-verify-ssl out.txt
    
StatusCode: 200
(END)

The following is an example using the AWS SDK for Python:

import boto3
from botocore.config import Config
from botocore import UNSIGNED

lambda_client = boto3.client('lambda',
                             endpoint_url="http://127.0.0.1:3001",
                             use_ssl=False,
                             verify=False,
                             config=Config(signature_version=UNSIGNED,
                                           read_timeout=1,
                                           retries={'max_attempts': 0}
                                           )
                            )
lambda_client.invoke(FunctionName="HelloWorldFunction")

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Upload an object to Amazon S3 by using the aws s3api put-object CLI command. Wait for the local Lambda invocation from the S3 event.

  • Upload to S3 sẽ trigger Lambda trong AWS cloud, không phải local machine

  • Không đáp ứng yêu cầu test locally

  • Local Lambda không thể receive events từ AWS S3

❌ Create a sample JSON text file for a put object S3 event. Invoke the Lambda function locally. Use the aws lambda invoke CLI command with the JSON file and Lambda function name as arguments.

  • aws lambda invoke chỉ invoke Lambda functions trong AWS cloud

  • Không support local Lambda testing

  • Phải manually create JSON file (tốn effort hơn SAM generate-event)

❌ Create a JSON string for the put object S3 event. In the AWS Management Console, use the JSON string to create a test event for the local Lambda function. Perform the test.

  • AWS Console chỉ test Lambda functions trong AWS cloud, không phải local

  • Không đáp ứng yêu cầu test on local development machine

  • Require access to AWS account

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Local Lambda testing" → AWS SAM CLI (Serverless Application Model)

  • SAM CLI commands:

    • sam local invoke = test Lambda locally

    • sam local generate-event = tạo sample event data

  • aws lambda invoke = chỉ cho cloud Lambda, không support local

  • "LEAST overhead" + "local testing" → dùng tools có automation (SAM)

📖 Reference:

  • Introduction to testing with sam local start-lambda

questions.q:
A developer is writing a web application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances behind an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The developer must add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB. The developer also must ensure that customer data from outside the VPC is encrypted in transit.

Which combination of CloudFront configuration settings should the developer use to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Restrict viewer access by using signed URLs.
Set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to Match Viewer.
Enable field-level encryption.
Enable automatic object compression.
Set the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Web application trên EC2 instances behind internet-facing ALB

  • Developer phải thêm CloudFront distribution phía trước ALB

  • Yêu cầu: đảm bảo customer data from outside VPC được encrypted in transit

  • Chọn 2 đáp án

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to Match Viewer.

  • Origin Protocol Policy = Match Viewer đảm bảo connection từ CloudFront đến ALB (origin) dùng same protocol như viewer request

  • Nếu viewer dùng HTTPS, CloudFront sẽ dùng HTTPS đến origin

  • Encrypt data between CloudFront and ALB (inside AWS network nhưng outside VPC)

Set the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

  • Viewer Protocol Policy = Redirect HTTP to HTTPS force tất cả viewers phải dùng HTTPS

  • Đảm bảo connection between users and CloudFront được encrypted

  • Automatically redirect HTTP requests sang HTTPS

Kết hợp 2 settings → encrypted in transit cho cả 2 đường: viewer-to-CloudFront và CloudFront-to-origin

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Restrict viewer access by using signed URLs.

  • Signed URLs dùng cho access control/authorization, không liên quan đến encryption in transit

  • Không giải quyết yêu cầu encrypt data

❌ Enable field-level encryption.

  • Field-level encryption chỉ encrypt specific sensitive fields trong POST requests

  • Không encrypt toàn bộ data in transit

  • Quá specific cho use case này

❌ Enable automatic object compression.

  • Object compression giúp reduce bandwidth và improve performance

  • Không liên quan đến encryption in transit

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Encryption in transit" → focus vào protocol policies (HTTP vs HTTPS)

  • CloudFront encryption có 2 legs:

    • Viewer → CloudFront = Viewer Protocol Policy

    • CloudFront → Origin = Origin Protocol Policy

  • Redirect HTTP to HTTPS = force encryption cho viewers

  • Match Viewer = maintain same protocol từ viewer đến origin

  • Signed URLs = authorization, không phải encryption

📖 Reference:

  • Require HTTPS for communication between CloudFront and your custom origin

questions.q:
A developer is running an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. When the application tries to read an Amazon S3 bucket, the application fails. The developer notices that the associated IAM role is missing the S3 read permission. The developer needs to give the application the ability to read the S3 bucket.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST application disruption?
o: Add the permission to the role. Terminate the existing EC2 instance. Launch a new EC2 instance.
Add the permission to the role so that the change will take effect automatically.
Add the permission to the role. Hibernate and restart the existing EC2 instance.
Add the permission to the S3 bucket. Restart the EC2 instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application chạy trên EC2 instance cần read S3 bucket

  • Application fails vì IAM role thiếu S3 read permission

  • Cần give application ability to read S3 bucket

  • Tìm solution với LEAST application disruption

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add the permission to the role so that the change will take effect automatically.

  • IAM role permissions update ngay lập tức và apply automatically

  • Không cần restart EC2 instance hoặc application

  • Zero downtime - application tiếp tục chạy trong khi permission được update

  • EC2 instance tự động nhận updated permissions từ IAM role

  • LEAST disruption - không gián đoạn application

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add the permission to the role. Terminate the existing EC2 instance. Launch a new EC2 instance.

  • Terminate và launch new instance gây maximum disruption

  • Application downtime trong quá trình terminate và launch

  • Hoàn toàn không cần thiết vì IAM role updates tự động

❌ Add the permission to the role. Hibernate and restart the existing EC2 instance.

  • Hibernate và restart gây application downtime

  • Không cần thiết vì IAM role permission changes apply automatically

  • Tốn thời gian và disrupt application

❌ Add the permission to the S3 bucket. Restart the EC2 instance.

  • Thêm permission vào S3 bucket policy không giải quyết vấn đề IAM role thiếu permission

  • Restart EC2 gây disruption không cần thiết

  • Không address root cause (IAM role missing permission)

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "IAM role permission changes" → automatic, no restart needed

  • "LEAST disruption" → loại solutions require restart, terminate, hoặc hibernate

  • EC2 với IAM role: permission updates apply ngay lập tức
