  • Restart/terminate EC2 không bao giờ cần thiết cho IAM permission changes

📖 Reference:

  • IAM roles for Amazon EC2

questions.q:
A developer at a company writes an AWS CloudFormation template. The template refers to subnets that were created by a separate AWS CloudFormation template that the company's network team wrote. When the developer attempts to launch the stack for the first time, the launch fails.

Which template coding mistakes could have caused this failure? (Choose two.)
o: The developer's template does not use the Ref intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
The developer's template does not use the ImportValue intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
The Mappings section of the developer's template does not refer to the subnets.
The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Outputs section.
The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Mappings section.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer viết CloudFormation template cần reference subnets

  • Subnets được tạo bởi separate CloudFormation template của network team

  • Stack launch fails lần đầu tiên

  • Lỗi coding nào trong template có thể gây ra failure này? (Chọn 2 đáp án)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The developer's template does not use the ImportValue intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.

  • ImportValue là function bắt buộc để import values từ other CloudFormation stacks

  • Để reference resources từ separate stack, phải dùng ImportValue, không phải Ref

  • Ref chỉ dùng cho resources trong cùng stack

The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Outputs section.

  • Outputs section với Export là bắt buộc để share values với other stacks

  • Network team phải export subnet IDs trong Outputs section

  • Nếu không export, developer không thể ImportValue

🛠️ Cách thực hiện đúng:

Network Team's Template (Stack A - Export subnets):

Resources:
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1a

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1b

Outputs:
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: NetworkStack-PublicSubnet1    # Export name

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: NetworkStack-PublicSubnet2    # Export name

Developer's Template (Stack B - Import subnets):

Resources:
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Subnets:
        - !ImportValue NetworkStack-PublicSubnet1    # Import từ Stack A
        - !ImportValue NetworkStack-PublicSubnet2    # Import từ Stack A
      Scheme: internet-facing

  AutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !ImportValue NetworkStack-PublicSubnet1
        - !ImportValue NetworkStack-PublicSubnet2
      MinSize: 2
      MaxSize: 4

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The developer's template does not use the Ref intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.

  • Ref chỉ dùng cho resources trong cùng một stack

  • Không thể dùng Ref để reference resources từ separate stack

  • Phải dùng ImportValue cho cross-stack references

❌ The Mappings section of the developer's template does not refer to the subnets.

  • Mappings section dùng để define static lookup tables, không phải cho cross-stack references

  • Không liên quan đến việc import values từ other stacks

❌ The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Mappings section.

  • Mappings không được dùng để export values

  • Outputs section với Export là cách đúng để share values cross-stack

  • Mappings chỉ là static data trong stack

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Separate/different CloudFormation stacks" → Cross-stack references

  • Cross-stack reference pattern:

    • Stack A: Export values trong Outputs section

    • Stack B: ImportValue để consume exported values

  • Ref vs ImportValue:

    • Ref = same stack

    • ImportValue = cross-stack

  • Mappings = static lookup tables, không dùng cho cross-stack sharing

📖 Reference:

  • Get exported outputs from a deployed CloudFormation stack

questions.q:
A developer is working on a web application that requires selective activation of specific features. The developer wants to keep the features hidden from end users until the features are ready for public access.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppSync. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
Store prerelease data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams in the table. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using DynamoDB Streams.
Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
Store prerelease data in AWS Amplify DataStore. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using Amplify DataStore cloud synchronization.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer làm web application cần selective activation of specific features (kích hoạt có chọn lọc các tính năng cụ thể)

  • Muốn keep features hidden from end users cho đến khi ready for public access

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.

  • AWS AppConfig được thiết kế đặc biệt cho feature flag management

  • Configuration profile cho phép store và manage feature flag values centrally

  • Activate/deactivate feature flags dynamically không cần redeploy application

  • Real-time updates - changes apply ngay lập tức

  • Built-in validation và deployment strategies đảm bảo safe rollout

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppSync. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.

  • AWS AppSync là managed GraphQL service, không phải feature flag management tool

  • AppSync không có feature flag configuration profile

  • Sai service cho use case này

❌ Store prerelease data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams in the table. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using DynamoDB Streams.

  • DynamoDB Streams capture data changes, không phải tool để manage feature flags

  • Require custom implementation, phức tạp và không có built-in feature flag capabilities

  • DynamoDB không được thiết kế cho feature flag management

❌ Store prerelease data in AWS Amplify DataStore. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using Amplify DataStore cloud synchronization.

  • Amplify DataStore dùng cho offline-first data synchronization, không phải feature flag management

  • Không có built-in feature flag toggle mechanism

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Feature flags/toggles" → AWS AppConfig

  • "Activate/deactivate features dynamically" → AppConfig feature flags

  • AppSync = GraphQL, không phải feature flags

  • DynamoDB Streams = data change capture, không phải feature management

  • Amplify DataStore = offline data sync, không phải feature flags

📖 Reference:

  • Using AWS AppConfig feature flags

questions.q:
A company has an internal website that contains sensitive data. The company wants to make the website public. The company must ensure that only employees who authenticate through the company's OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP) can access the website. A developer needs to implement authentication without editing the website.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Create a public Network Load Balancer.
Create a public Application Load Balancer.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTP port 80. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default AWS Lambda action providing an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to a Lambda authentication function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company có internal website chứa sensitive data, muốn make public

  • Chỉ employees authenticate qua company's OIDC IdP mới được access

  • Developer cần implement authentication without editing the website

  • Hỏi: combination of steps nào đáp ứng yêu cầu? (Chọn 2 đáp án)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a public Application Load Balancer.

  • ALB hỗ trợ built-in authentication với OIDC IdP

  • Có thể authenticate users trước khi forward traffic đến backend

  • Không cần modify website code - authentication được handle ở load balancer layer

Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.

  • HTTPS port 443 đảm bảo secure connection cho sensitive data

  • Authenticate action với OIDC IdP configuration integrate trực tiếp với company IdP

  • Default action apply authentication cho tất cả requests

  • ALB tự động redirect users đến OIDC IdP để authenticate

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a public Network Load Balancer.

  • NLB hoạt động ở Layer 4 (TCP/UDP), không hỗ trợ application-layer features như authentication

  • NLB không có built-in OIDC authentication capability

  • Chỉ ALB (Layer 7) mới support authentication

❌ Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTP port 80. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.

  • HTTP port 80 không encrypted, không phù hợp cho sensitive data

  • Authentication credentials sẽ bị expose qua plaintext

  • Phải dùng HTTPS port 443 cho secure communication

❌ Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default AWS Lambda action providing an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to a Lambda authentication function.

  • Require custom Lambda function để implement authentication logic

  • Phức tạp hơn và require code development

  • ALB đã có native OIDC authentication, không cần Lambda

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Authentication without editing website" → ALB built-in authentication

  • "OIDC IdP" → ALB hỗ trợ native OIDC integration

  • "Sensitive data" → phải dùng HTTPS (port 443), không dùng HTTP

  • ALB vs NLB:

    • ALB (Layer 7) = support authentication, routing rules

    • NLB (Layer 4) = TCP/UDP only, no authentication

  • ALB authenticate action = no code changes needed

📖 Reference:

  • Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer - Configure user authentication

questions.q:
A company wants to migrate applications from its on-premises servers to AWS. As a first step, the company is modifying and migrating a non-critical application to a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application will store information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to follow security best practices when deploying the application on AWS.

Which approach should the company take to allow the application to interact with Amazon S3?
o: Create an IAM role that has administrative access to AWS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

Create an IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.
Create an IAM role that has the necessary access to Amazon S3. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

Create an IAM user. Attach a policy that provides the necessary access to Amazon S3. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company migrate application từ on-premises lên single EC2 instance

  • Application cần store information in S3 bucket

  • Phải follow security best practices

  • Cách approach nào để allow application interact with S3?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an IAM role that has the necessary access to Amazon S3. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

  • IAM role là best practice cho EC2 để access AWS services

  • Temporary credentials tự động rotate, không cần manage access keys

  • Principle of least privilege - chỉ grant necessary S3 permissions

  • Không lưu credentials trong code hoặc EC2 instance

  • Secure - credentials không bao giờ exposed hoặc hardcoded

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM role that has administrative access to AWS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.

  • Administrative access vi phạm principle of least privilege

  • Grant quá nhiều permissions không cần thiết

  • Security risk nếu EC2 bị compromise

  • Chỉ cần S3 access, không cần admin access

❌ Create an IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.

  • IAM user với access keys không phải best practice cho EC2

  • Hardcoded credentials trong code là security risk

  • AdministratorAccess vi phạm least privilege

  • Access keys có thể bị leaked, không tự động rotate

❌ Create an IAM user. Attach a policy that provides the necessary access to Amazon S3. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.

  • Tuy có đúng permissions (S3 only), nhưng vẫn dùng hardcoded access keys

  • IAM user không phải best practice cho EC2 instances

  • Access keys phải manage manually và có thể bị expose

  • IAM role tốt hơn vì tự động rotate credentials

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "EC2 access AWS services" → IAM role, không dùng IAM user

  • "Security best practices" → loại options có:

    • Hardcoded access keys

    • Administrative/excessive permissions

  • IAM role vs IAM user cho EC2:

    • IAM role = temporary credentials, auto-rotate, best practice

    • IAM user = long-term credentials, manual management, security risk

  • "Necessary access" = principle of least privilege, chỉ grant S3 permissions cần thiết

📖 Reference:

  • IAM roles for Amazon EC2

questions.q:
A developer needs temporary access to resources in a second account.

What is the MOST secure way to achieve this?
o: Use the Amazon Cognito user pools to get short-lived credentials for the second account.
Create a dedicated IAM access key for the second account, and send it by mail.
Create a cross-account access role, and use sts:AssumeRole API to get short-lived credentials.
Establish trust, and add an SSH key for the second account to the IAM user.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần temporary access đến resources trong second account

  • Hỏi: cách nào là MOST secure?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a cross-account access role, and use sts:AssumeRole API to get short-lived credentials.

  • Cross-account IAM role là AWS best practice cho cross-account access

  • sts:AssumeRole API trả về temporary security credentials (tự động expire)

  • Short-lived credentials tự động rotate, giảm security risk

  • Không cần share long-term credentials giữa accounts

  • Centralized access control - có thể revoke access bằng cách modify role trust policy

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the Amazon Cognito user pools to get short-lived credentials for the second account.

  • Cognito user pools dùng cho end-user authentication (mobile/web apps), không phải cross-account access cho developers

  • Không phải solution thiết kế cho cross-account AWS resource access

  • Sai use case

❌ Create a dedicated IAM access key for the second account, and send it by mail.

  • Send credentials by email là severe security risk

  • Long-term access keys không tự động expire

  • Vi phạm security best practices

❌ Establish trust, and add an SSH key for the second account to the IAM user.

  • SSH keys dùng cho EC2 instance access, không phải AWS API access

  • Không giải quyết cross-account access cho AWS resources

  • Sai approach hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Temporary access" + "second account" → Cross-account IAM role + sts:AssumeRole

  • "MOST secure" → loại options có:

    • Long-term credentials (access keys)

    • Send credentials qua email/insecure channels

  • Cross-account access pattern: IAM role trong account B + trust policy cho account A

  • Cognito = end-user auth, không phải cross-account AWS access

  • SSH keys = EC2 access, không phải AWS API access

📖 Reference:

  • Tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles

questions.q:
A company is developing a serverless application by using AWS Lambda functions. One of the Lambda functions needs to access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The DB instance is in a private subnet inside a VPC.

The company creates a role that includes the necessary permissions to access the DB instance. The company then assigns the role to the Lambda function. A developer must take additional action to give the Lambda function access to the DB instance.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Assign a public IP address to the DB instance. Modify the security group of the DB instance to allow inbound traffic from the IP address of the Lambda function.
Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution to create a secure connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
Configure the Lambda function to connect to the private subnets in the VPC. Add security group rules to allow traffic to the DB instance from the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application dùng Lambda function cần access RDS DB instance

  • DB instance nằm trong private subnet inside VPC

  • Company đã create role với necessary permissions và assign cho Lambda

  • Developer cần additional action để Lambda access DB instance

  • Developer nên làm gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the Lambda function to connect to the private subnets in the VPC. Add security group rules to allow traffic to the DB instance from the Lambda function.

  • Lambda VPC configuration cho phép Lambda function access resources trong private subnet

  • Attach Lambda to VPC với private subnets nơi DB instance đang chạy

  • Security group rules cần allow inbound traffic từ Lambda security group đến DB instance

  • Network connectivity được establish giữa Lambda và private RDS

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Assign a public IP address to the DB instance. Modify the security group of the DB instance to allow inbound traffic from the IP address of the Lambda function.

  • Assign public IP cho DB instance vi phạm security best practice

  • DB instance trong private subnet không nên expose ra internet

  • Lambda không có fixed IP address để whitelist

❌ Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.

  • Direct Connect dùng cho on-premises to AWS connectivity, không phải Lambda to VPC

  • Over-complicated và không cần thiết

  • Lambda và RDS đều trong AWS, không cần Direct Connect

❌ Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution to create a secure connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.

  • CloudFront là CDN service, không dùng để connect Lambda với RDS

  • Hoàn toàn sai use case

  • CloudFront không provide database connectivity

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda access private subnet resource" → Configure Lambda VPC settings

  • Lambda VPC configuration steps:

    • Attach Lambda to VPC

    • Select private subnets

    • Configure security groups

  • "Private subnet DB" → không assign public IP (security risk)

  • Direct Connect = on-premises connectivity, không phải Lambda use case

  • CloudFront = CDN, không phải database connectivity solution

📖 Reference:

  • Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC

questions.q:
A developer is writing an application to analyze the traffic to a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances run behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). An HTTP server runs on each of the EC2 instances, logging all requests to a log file.

The developer wants to capture the client public IP addresses. The developer analyzes the log files and notices only the IP address of the ALB.

What must the developer do to capture the client public IP addresses in the log file?
o: Add a Host header to the HTTP server log configuration file.
Install the Amazon CloudWatch Logs agent on each EC2 instance. Configure the agent to write to the log file.
Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on each EC2 instance. Configure the daemon to write to the log file.
Add an X-Forwarded-For header to the HTTP server log configuration file.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application phân tích traffic đến fleet of EC2 instances behind public ALB

  • HTTP server trên mỗi EC2 instance log tất cả requests vào log file

  • Developer muốn capture client public IP addresses

  • Hiện tại log files chỉ thấy IP address of the ALB

  • Developer phải làm gì để capture client public IP?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add an X-Forwarded-For header to the HTTP server log configuration file.

  • X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header chứa original client IP address

  • ALB tự động thêm XFF header vào mỗi request forward đến backend EC2

  • HTTP server cần configure log format để log XFF header thay vì source IP

  • Source IP trong request là ALB IP, nhưng XFF header chứa client IP thực

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a Host header to the HTTP server log configuration file.

  • Host header chứa domain name, không phải client IP address

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề cần capture client IP

❌ Install the Amazon CloudWatch Logs agent on each EC2 instance. Configure the agent to write to the log file.

  • CloudWatch Logs agent chỉ ship logs đến CloudWatch, không thay đổi log content

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề ALB IP thay vì client IP trong logs

❌ Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on each EC2 instance. Configure the daemon to write to the log file.

  • X-Ray dùng cho distributed tracing, không phải logging client IPs

  • X-Ray daemon không modify HTTP server logs

  • Sai use case hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "ALB + client IP" → X-Forwarded-For header

  • ALB behavior: tự động thêm XFF header chứa original client IP

  • Host header = domain name, không phải IP

  • CloudWatch Logs agent = ship logs, không modify content

  • X-Ray = tracing, không phải IP logging

📖 Reference:

  • HTTP headers and Application Load Balancers

questions.q:
A company is building a serverless application. The application uses an API key to authenticate with a third-party application. The company wants to store the external API key as a part of an AWS Lambda configuration. The company needs to have full control over the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys that will encrypt the API key and should be visible only to authorized entities.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Store the API key in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a string parameter. Use the default AWS KMS key that AWS provides to encrypt the API key.
Store the API key in AWS Lambda environment variables. Create an AWS KMS customer managed key to encrypt the API key.
Store the API key in the code repository. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the code repository.
Store the API key as an Amazon DynamoDB table record. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the API key.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company build serverless application dùng API key để authenticate với third-party application

  • Muốn store external API key trong Lambda configuration

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Full control over KMS keys để encrypt API key

    • Chỉ các entities được phân quyền mới thấy được API key

  • Solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the API key in AWS Lambda environment variables. Create an AWS KMS customer managed key to encrypt the API key.

  • Lambda environment variables là part of Lambda configuration (đáp ứng yêu cầu "store as part of Lambda config")

  • Customer managed KMS key cho phép full control over key (rotation, policies, access)

  • Có thể restrict ai có quyền decrypt bằng KMS key policy

  • API key visible only to authorized entities thông qua KMS key permissions

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the API key in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a string parameter. Use the default AWS KMS key that AWS provides to encrypt the API key.

  • Parameter Store không phải part of Lambda configuration

  • Default AWS KMS key không cho full control (AWS managed, không customize được)

  • Không đáp ứng yêu cầu "full control over KMS keys"

❌ Store the API key in the code repository. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the code repository.

  • Store credentials trong code repository vi phạm security best practices

  • AWS managed key không cho full control

  • API key có thể bị expose trong version control history

❌ Store the API key as an Amazon DynamoDB table record. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the API key.

  • DynamoDB không phải part of Lambda configuration

  • AWS managed key không cho full control

  • Thêm complexity không cần thiết

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Full control over KMS keys" → Customer managed key (không phải AWS managed key)

  • "Part of Lambda configuration" → Lambda environment variables

  • KMS key types:

    • AWS managed key = AWS quản lý, no full control

    • Customer managed key = full control (policies, rotation, access)

  • "Visible only to authorized entities" → KMS key policy control access

  • Parameter Store/DynamoDB = external storage, không phải "Lambda configuration"

📖 Reference:

  • Securing Lambda environment variables

KMS Key Policy - Chỉ cho phép authorized entities decrypt API key

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "Enable IAM User Permissions",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"
      },
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "Allow Lambda execution role to decrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MyLambdaExecutionRole"
      },
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:DescribeKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "Allow specific developers to decrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": [
          "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/developer1",
          "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/developer2"
        ]
      },
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:DescribeKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}

Giải thích:

✅ Authorized entities (được phép decrypt):

  • Lambda execution role (để Lambda function decrypt API key)

  • Developer1 và Developer2 (specific users được authorize)

❌ Unauthorized entities:

  • Bất kỳ IAM user/role nào không nằm trong policy → không thể decrypt

Kết quả:

  • Chỉ Lambda function và 2 developers được chỉ định mới xem được API key

  • Tất cả entities khác bị deny

questions.q:
A developer uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to interact with the AWS CLI and AWS SDKs on a local workstation. API calls to AWS services were working when the SSO access was first configured. However, the developer is now receiving Access Denied errors. The developer has not changed any configuration files or scripts that were previously working on the workstation.

What is the MOST likely cause of the developer's access issue?
o: The access permissions to the developer's AWS CLI binary file have changed.
The permission set that is assumed by IAM Identity Center does not have the necessary permissions to complete the API call.
The credentials from the IAM Identity Center federated role have expired.
The developer is attempting to make API calls to the incorrect AWS account.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO) để interact với AWS CLI và SDKs trên local workstation

  • API calls hoạt động bình thường khi SSO access first configured

  • Hiện tại developer nhận Access Denied errors

  • Developer không thay đổi bất kỳ config files hoặc scripts

  • MOST likely cause của access issue?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The credentials from the IAM Identity Center federated role have expired.

  • IAM Identity Center credentials là temporary credentials có thời hạn (thường 1-12 giờ)

  • Credentials tự động expire sau thời gian nhất định

  • Developer cần re-authenticate (aws sso login) để refresh credentials

  • Đây là behavior bình thường của SSO, không phải lỗi configuration

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The access permissions to the developer's AWS CLI binary file have changed.

  • File permissions của AWS CLI binary không liên quan đến Access Denied từ AWS API

  • Nếu CLI binary không có execute permission, sẽ có OS error, không phải AWS Access Denied

❌ The permission set that is assumed by IAM Identity Center does not have the necessary permissions to complete the API call.

  • Nếu permission set thiếu permissions, API calls sẽ không bao giờ hoạt động từ đầu

  • Đề bài nói "API calls were working" ban đầu, nên không phải vấn đề permissions

❌ The developer is attempting to make API calls to the incorrect AWS account.

  • Developer không thay đổi config files/scripts nên không thể call sai account

  • Nếu sai account từ đầu thì API calls đã fail ngay lập tức

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Previously working" + "now Access Denied" + "no config changes" → Credentials expired

  • IAM Identity Center (SSO) = temporary credentials với expiration time

  • Solution: Run aws sso login để refresh credentials

  • Permission set issues = fail ngay từ đầu, không phải "previously working"

📖 Reference:

  • Configuring IAM Identity Center authentication with the AWS CLI

Cách setting thời gian SESSION

Tại Management Account (Acccount setting IAM Identity Center)

Lấy thông tin temporary credentials từ UI

questions.q:
A developer is creating a new application for a pet store. The application will manage customer rewards points. The developer will use Amazon DynamoDB to store the data for the application. The developer needs to optimize query performance and limit partition overload before actual performance analysis.

Which option should the developer use for a partition key to meet these requirements?
o: A randomly generated universally unique identifier (UUID)
The customer's full name
The date when the customer signed up for the rewards program
The name of the customer's pet
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo application cho pet store để manage customer rewards points

  • Dùng DynamoDB để store data

  • Cần optimize query performance và limit partition overload trước khi có actual performance analysis

  • Option nào nên dùng làm partition key?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

A randomly generated universally unique identifier (UUID)

  • UUID có high cardinality (độ phân tán cao), mỗi customer có unique value

  • Evenly distributed across partitions, tránh hot partition

  • Prevent partition overload vì data được spread đều

  • Optimal query performance khi access by customer ID

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The customer's full name

  • Low cardinality - nhiều customers có thể cùng tên (John Smith, Maria Garcia, etc.)

  • Tạo hot partitions cho common names

❌ The date when the customer signed up for the rewards program

  • Very low cardinality - nhiều customers sign up cùng ngày

  • Tạo severe hot partition problem

❌ The name of the customer's pet

  • Extremely low cardinality - rất nhiều pets cùng tên (Max, Bella, Charlie, etc.)

  • BAD choice cho partition key

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Limit partition overload" → cần high cardinality partition key

  • High cardinality keys: UUID, email, customer ID

  • Low cardinality keys: date, name, status, country

  • Hot partition = nhiều data/requests tập trung vào vài partitions → performance issue

📖 Reference:

  • Best practices for designing and using partition keys effectively in DynamoDB

  • Choosing the right DynamoDB partition key

questions.q:
A developer is building a new containerized application by using AWS Copilot. The developer uses the AWS Copilot command line interface (CLI) to deploy the application during development. The developer committed the application code to a new AWS CodeCommit repository. The developer must create an automated deployment process before releasing the new application to production.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Create a buildspec file that invokes the AWS Copilot CLI commands to build and deploy the application. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to create an AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository in the source stage and AWS CodeBuild in the build stage.

Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to bootstrap and initialize an AWS CodePipeline configuration. Use the CodeCommit repository as the source. Invoke the AWS Copilot CLI to build and deploy the application.
Use the AWS Copilot CLI to define the AWS Copilot pipeline and to deploy the AWS CodePipeline. Select CodeCommit as the source for the AWS CodePipeline.
Define an AWS CloudFormation template for an AWS CodePipeline with CodeCommit as the source. Configure the template as an AWS Copilot CLI add-on. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to deploy the application.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build containerized application bằng AWS Copilot

  • Dùng Copilot CLI để deploy application during development

  • Code đã commit vào CodeCommit repository

  • Cần tạo automated deployment process before releasing to production

  • Hỏi: cách nào MOST operationally efficient?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the AWS Copilot CLI to define the AWS Copilot pipeline and to deploy the AWS CodePipeline. Select CodeCommit as the source for the AWS CodePipeline.

  • Copilot CLI native pipeline feature được thiết kế đặc biệt cho use case này

  • Single command (copilot pipeline init) để tạo và deploy pipeline

  • Native integration với CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy

  • Least operational overhead - Copilot tự động generate pipeline configuration

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a buildspec file that invokes the AWS Copilot CLI commands to build and deploy the application. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to create an AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository in the source stage and AWS CodeBuild in the build stage.

  • Manual buildspec creation và custom CodePipeline setup phức tạp hơn

  • Copilot CLI có native pipeline feature đơn giản hơn

❌ Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to bootstrap and initialize an AWS CodePipeline configuration. Use the CodeCommit repository as the source. Invoke the AWS Copilot CLI to build and deploy the application.

  • SAM CLI dùng cho serverless applications, không phải containerized apps với Copilot

  • Mix 2 tools khác nhau tạo complexity không cần thiết

❌ Define an AWS CloudFormation template for an AWS CodePipeline with CodeCommit as the source. Configure the template as an AWS Copilot CLI add-on. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to deploy the application.

  • Manual CloudFormation template tốn effort hơn

  • Copilot đã có built-in pipeline capability

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "AWS Copilot" + "automated deployment" → Copilot native pipeline feature

  • "MOST operationally efficient" → dùng native tools thay vì custom solutions

  • Copilot pipeline commands: copilot pipeline init, copilot pipeline deploy

  • SAM = serverless, Copilot = containers

📖 Reference:

  • Creating and configuring pipelines with AWS Copilot

questions.q:
A company uses an AWS Lambda function to call a third-party service. The third-party service has a limit of requests each minute. If the number of requests exceeds the limit, the third-party service returns rate-limiting errors.

A developer needs to configure the Lambda function to avoid receiving rate limiting errors from the third-party service.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Set the reserved concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
Decrease the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
Set the provisioned concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
Increase the timeout value that is specified on the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function call third-party service

  • Third-party service có limit of requests each minute

  • Nếu exceed limit → third-party service returns rate-limiting errors

  • Developer cần configure Lambda để tránh rate limiting errors

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the reserved concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.

  • Reserved concurrency limit số concurrent executions của Lambda function

  • Throttle requests ở Lambda level trước khi gọi third-party service

  • Prevent exceeding third-party service rate limit

  • Ví dụ: nếu third-party cho phép 10 requests/minute → set reserved concurrency = 10

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Decrease the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.

  • Memory allocation không liên quan đến rate limiting

  • Chỉ ảnh hưởng performance và cost

❌ Set the provisioned concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.

  • Provisioned concurrency dùng để reduce cold start, không limit concurrent executions

  • Không prevent Lambda từ việc exceed third-party rate limit

❌ Increase the timeout value that is specified on the Lambda function.

  • Timeout chỉ tăng thời gian Lambda được chạy

  • Không giảm số requests gửi đến third-party service

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Rate limiting" + "limit concurrent requests" → Reserved concurrency

  • Reserved concurrency = limit max concurrent executions (throttle)

  • Provisioned concurrency = pre-warmed instances (reduce cold start)

  • Memory/Timeout = performance tuning, không liên quan rate limiting

📖 Reference:

  • Configuring reserved concurrency for a function

questions.q:
A developer is deploying an application in the AWS Cloud by using AWS CloudFormation. The application will connect to an existing Amazon RDS database. The hostname of the RDS database is stored in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a plaintext value. The developer needs to incorporate the database hostname into the CloudFormation template to initialize the application when the stack is created.

How should the developer reference the parameter that contains the database hostname?
o: Use the ssm dynamic reference.
Use the Ref intrinsic function.
Use the Fn::ImportValue intrinsic function.
Use the ssm-secure dynamic reference.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer deploy application bằng CloudFormation

  • Application sẽ connect đến existing RDS database

  • RDS hostname được store trong Systems Manager Parameter Store as plaintext value

  • Cần liên kết database hostname vào CloudFormation template để initialize application khi stack created

  • Cách nào reference parameter chứa database hostname?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the ssm dynamic reference.

  • SSM dynamic reference cho phép CloudFormation retrieve values từ Parameter Store during stack operations

  • Syntax: {{resolve:ssm:parameter-name:version}}

  • Dùng cho plaintext parameters trong Parameter Store

  • Values được resolve tại runtime khi stack create/update

Example:

Ví dụ sau tạo một EC2 launch template reference đến custom AMI ID được lưu trong Parameter Store. Dynamic reference sẽ lấy AMI ID từ version 2 của parameter golden-ami mỗi khi một instance được launch từ launch template.

Resources:
  MyLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties: 
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-launch-template
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:golden-ami:2}}'
        InstanceType: t2.micro

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the Ref intrinsic function.

  • Ref chỉ reference resources/parameters trong cùng CloudFormation template

  • Không thể reference external systems như Parameter Store

❌ Use the Fn::ImportValue intrinsic function.

  • ImportValue dùng để import exported values từ other CloudFormation stacks

  • Không dùng cho Parameter Store

❌ Use the ssm-secure dynamic reference.

  • ssm-secure dùng cho SecureString parameters (encrypted)

  • Đề bài nói plaintext value nên dùng ssm, không phải ssm-secure

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Parameter Store" + "CloudFormation" → Dynamic references

  • SSM dynamic reference types:

    • {{resolve:ssm:param-name}} = plaintext parameters

    • {{resolve:ssm-secure:param-name}} = SecureString parameters

  • Ref = same template, ImportValue = cross-stack

  • "Plaintext value" → ssm, "Encrypted/SecureString" → ssm-secure

📖 Reference:

  • Get values stored in other services using dynamic references

questions.q:
A developer has observed an increase in bugs in the AWS Lambda functions that a development team has deployed in its Node.js application. To minimize these bugs, the developer wants to implement automated testing of Lambda functions in an environment that closely simulates the Lambda environment.

The developer needs to give other developers the ability to run the tests locally. The developer also needs to integrate the tests into the team‚Äôs continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline before the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) deployment.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create automated test scripts that use the cdk local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

Install a unit testing framework that reproduces the Lambda execution environment. Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Invoke the handler function by using a unit testing framework. Check the response. Document how to run the unit testing framework for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the unit testing framework.

Install the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI tool. Use the sam local generate-event command to generate sample events for the automated tests. Create automated test scripts that use the sam local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create a Docker container from the Node.js base image to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document how to run the Docker container for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the Docker container.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer thấy tăng bugs trong Lambda functions của Node.js application

  • Muốn implement automated testing trong môi trường giả lập gần với Lambda environment

  • Yêu cầu:

    • Other developers có thể run tests locally

    • Integrate tests vào CI/CD pipeline trước AWS CDK deployment

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Install the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI tool. Use the sam local generate-event command to generate sample events for the automated tests. Create automated test scripts that use the sam local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

  • SAM CLI được thiết kế đặc biệt cho local Lambda testing

  • sam local invoke chạy Lambda trong Docker container simulating Lambda environment

  • sam local generate-event tạo sample events cho nhiều AWS services

  • Easy to install và document cho team members

  • CI/CD integration đơn giản với SAM CLI commands

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create automated test scripts that use the cdk local invoke command to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document the test scripts for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the test scripts.

  • cdk local invoke không tồn tại - CDK không có native local testing commands

  • CDK focus vào infrastructure deployment, không phải local testing

❌ Install a unit testing framework that reproduces the Lambda execution environment. Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Invoke the handler function by using a unit testing framework. Check the response. Document how to run the unit testing framework for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the unit testing framework.

  • Unit testing framework (Jest, Mocha) không simulate Lambda environment đầy đủ

  • Thiếu Lambda runtime environment, permissions, và integrations

❌ Create sample events based on the Lambda documentation. Create a Docker container from the Node.js base image to invoke the Lambda functions. Check the response. Document how to run the Docker container for the other developers on the team. Update the CI/CD pipeline to run the Docker container.

  • Custom Docker container require nhiều manual setup và maintenance

  • Không replicate Lambda environment chính xác như SAM CLI

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Local Lambda testing" + "simulate Lambda environment" → AWS SAM CLI

  • SAM CLI key commands:

    • sam local invoke = test Lambda locally

    • sam local generate-event = tạo sample events

    • sam local start-api = test API Gateway locally

  • CDK = infrastructure, SAM = serverless testing/deployment

  • Unit testing frameworks không fully simulate Lambda runtime

📖 Reference:

  • Introduction to testing with the sam local command

questions.q:
A company stores all personally identifiable information (PII) in an Amazon DynamoDB table named PII in Account A. Developers are working on an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances in Account B. The application in Account B requires access to the PII table.

An administrator in Account A creates an IAM role named AccessPII that has permission to access the PII table. The administrator also creates a trust policy that specifies Account B as a principal that can assume the role.

Which combination of steps should the developers take in Account B to allow their application to access the PII table? (Choose two.)
o: Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to assume the AccessPII role.
Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to access the PII table.
Include the AWS API in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials from the EC2 IAM role to access the PII table.
Include the AssumeRole API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.
Include the GetSessionToken API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company store PII trong DynamoDB table ở Account A

  • Developers working on application trên EC2 instances ở Account B

  • Application trong Account B cần access PII table

  • Administrator trong Account A đã:

    • Tạo IAM role AccessPII có permission access PII table

    • Tạo trust policy specify Account B as principal có thể assume role

  • Hỏi: developers trong Account B cần làm gì? (Chọn 2 đáp án)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to assume the AccessPII role.

  • EC2 instance role trong Account B cần sts:AssumeRole permission để assume AccessPII role

  • IAM policy phải grant quyền assume cross-account role

Include the AssumeRole API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.

  • Application code phải call sts:AssumeRole API để assume AccessPII role

  • Nhận temporary credentials từ assumed role để access DynamoDB table

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Allow the EC2 IAM role the permission to access the PII table.

  • EC2 role không thể directly access table trong Account A

  • Phải assume cross-account role trước

❌ Include the AWS API in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials from the EC2 IAM role to access the PII table.

  • "AWS API" quá mơ hồ, không nói cụ thể là AssumeRole

  • EC2 role credentials không đủ để access cross-account resources

❌ Include the GetSessionToken API operation in the application code logic to obtain temporary credentials to access the PII table.

  • GetSessionToken dùng cho MFA authentication, không phải cross-account access

  • Phải dùng AssumeRole cho cross-account scenario

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Cross-account access" → AssumeRole API

  • Cross-account access pattern:

    1. Account A: create role + trust policy

    2. Account B: grant sts:AssumeRole permission

    3. Application: call AssumeRole API

  • GetSessionToken = MFA, không phải cross-account

  • Direct access không work cho cross-account resources

📖 Reference:

  • Tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles

questions.q:
A company is using AWS CloudFormation templates to deploy AWS resources. The company needs to update one of its AWS CloudFormation stacks.

What can the company do to find out how the changes will impact the resources that are running?
o: Investigate the change sets.
Investigate the stack policies.
Investigate the Metadata section.
Investigate the Resources section.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng CloudFormation templates để deploy AWS resources

  • Cần update một CloudFormation stack

  • Hỏi: làm thế nào để find out how changes will impact running resources?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Investigate the change sets.

  • Change sets cho phép preview changes trước khi apply

  • Hiển thị detailed impact của modifications lên existing resources

  • Show which resources will be updated, replaced, hoặc deleted

  • Có thể review và approve trước khi execute changes

Ví dụ:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Investigate the stack policies.

  • Stack policies dùng để ngăn chặn những update không mong muốn (protection), không phải preview changes

  • Không show impact của changes

❌ Investigate the Metadata section.

  • Metadata section chứa information tuỳ ý, không show impact của updates

  • Không phải tool để preview changes

❌ Investigate the Resources section.

  • Resources section define các resources trong template

  • Không show impact của changes lên running resources

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Preview changes impact" → Change sets

  • Change sets = preview trước khi execute stack updates

  • Stack policies = protection, không phải preview

  • Metadata = additional info, không phải impact analysis

📖 Reference:

  • Update CloudFormation stacks using change sets

questions.q:
A developer has an application that asynchronously invokes an AWS Lambda function. The developer wants to store messages that resulted in failed invocations of the Lambda function so that the application can retry the call later.

What should the developer do to accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Set up Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups to filter and store the messages in an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the messages in Lambda. Run the Lambda function again.
Configure Amazon EventBridge to send the messages to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to initiate the Lambda function again.
Implement a dead-letter queue for discarded messages. Set the dead-letter queue as an event source for the Lambda function.
Send Amazon EventBridge events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to pull messages from the SQS queue. Run the Lambda function again.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer có application asynchronously invokes Lambda function

  • Muốn store messages that resulted in failed invocations

  • Application có thể retry call sau

  • Solution nào với LEAST operational overhead?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Implement a dead-letter queue for discarded messages. Set the dead-letter queue as an event source for the Lambda function.

  • Dead-letter queue (DLQ) là native feature của Lambda cho async invocations

  • Automatic capture failed messages without custom code

  • Set DLQ as event source → Lambda automatically retry messages từ DLQ

  • LEAST overhead - minimal configuration, no custom logic needed

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups to filter and store the messages in an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the messages in Lambda. Run the Lambda function again.

  • Require nhiều manual steps: filter logs, export to S3, import, retry

  • High operational overhead với custom implementation

❌ Configure Amazon EventBridge to send the messages to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to initiate the Lambda function again.

  • EventBridge không tự động capture failed Lambda invocations

  • Thêm complexity với SNS integration không cần thiết

❌ Send Amazon EventBridge events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function to pull messages from the SQS queue. Run the Lambda function again.

  • Require thay đổi invocation pattern từ async sang SQS polling

  • Thêm operational overhead với SQS management

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Async Lambda failures" + "retry" → Dead-letter queue (DLQ)

  • DLQ options: SQS queue hoặc SNS topic

  • DLQ as event source = automatic retry mechanism

  • LEAST overhead → dùng native Lambda features (DLQ)

📖 Reference:

  • Adding a dead-letter queue

Adding a dead-letter queue:

Như một alternative cho on-failure destination, bạn có thể configure function với dead-letter queue để save discarded events cho further processing.

Dead-letter queue hoạt động giống on-failure destination:

  • Được dùng khi event fails tất cả processing attempts hoặc expires mà không được processed

Khác biệt:

  • DLQ: chỉ có thể add/remove ở function level (không phải version/alias level)

  • On-failure destinations: support nhiều target types hơn và include details về function's response

Reprocess events từ DLQ:

Có 2 cách:

  1. Set DLQ as event source cho Lambda function → Lambda tự động retry

  2. Manually retrieve events từ DLQ

Lựa chọn DLQ type:

Amazon SQS queue (Standard):

  • Queue holds failed events cho đến khi retrieved

  • Choose SQS nếu expect single entity (1 Lambda function hoặc CloudWatch alarm) xử lý failed event

Amazon SNS topic (Standard):

  • Topic relays failed events đến multiple destinations

  • Choose SNS nếu expect multiple entities xử lý failed event

  • Ví dụ: send đến email + Lambda function + HTTP endpoint

⚠️ FIFO queues và SNS FIFO topics KHÔNG được supported

Permissions required:

Function's execution role cần permissions để:

  • Send events đến queue/topic

  • Nếu target encrypted bằng customer managed KMS key → cần KMS permissions

questions.q:
A company with multiple branch locations has an analytics and reporting application. Each branch office pushes a sales report to a shared Amazon S3 bucket at a predefined time each day. The company has developed an AWS Lambda function that analyzes the reports from all branch offices in a single pass. The Lambda function stores the results in a database.

The company needs to start the analysis once each day at a specific time.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Configure an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function when a branch office uploads a sales report.
Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.
Configure the Lambda function to run continuously and to begin analysis only at the predefined time each day.
Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company có multiple branch locations với analytics and reporting application

  • Mỗi branch office push sales report vào shared S3 bucket at thời gian cụ thể mỗi ngày

  • Lambda function analyze tất cả reports từ all branches trong 1 lần

  • Cần start analysis once each day at specific time

  • Hỏi: solution nào MOST cost-effectively?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.

  • EventBridge scheduled rule (cron expression) invoke Lambda đúng thời gian quy định

  • Single invocation per day - chạy 1 lần để analyze all reports

  • Cost-effective - chỉ pay cho 1 Lambda invocation/day

  • Simple configuration - no additional services needed

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure an S3 event notification to invoke the Lambda function when a branch office uploads a sales report.

  • Lambda sẽ chạy multiple times (mỗi branch upload = 1 invocation)

  • Higher cost - nhiều invocations thay vì 1 lần/day

  • Không đáp ứng requirement "analyze all reports in single pass"

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions state machine that invokes the Lambda function once each day at the predefined time.

  • Step Functions add cost so với EventBridge

  • Over-complicated cho simple scheduling task

  • EventBridge đơn giản và rẻ hơn

❌ Configure the Lambda function to run continuously and to begin analysis only at the predefined time each day.

  • Lambda continuously running = extremely high cost

  • Lambda không được thiết kế để run continuously

  • Lãng phí tài nguyên lớn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Once per day at specific time" → EventBridge scheduled rule

  • "MOST cost-effective" + "scheduled task" → EventBridge (không phải Step Functions)

  • S3 event notification = multiple invocations, không phải single pass

  • Continuously running Lambda = anti-pattern, very expensive

📖 Reference:

  • Tutorial: Create an EventBridge scheduled rule for AWS Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer is using an AWS CodePipeline pipeline to provide continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) support for a Java application. The developer needs to update the pipeline to support the introduction of a new application dependency .jar file. The pipeline must start a build when a new version of the .jar file becomes available.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the dependency .jar file. Publish the dependency .jar file to the S3 bucket. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.
Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an ECR source action to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.
Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng CodePipeline cho CI/CD của Java application

  • Cần update pipeline để support new application dependency .jar file

  • Pipeline phải start build khi new version của .jar file becomes available

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

  • CodeArtifact được thiết kế đặc biệt cho artifact management (Maven, npm, etc.)

  • Native support cho .jar files và Java dependencies

  • EventBridge integration có thể detect new package versions và trigger CodePipeline

  • Best practice cho managing application dependencies

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the dependency .jar file. Publish the dependency .jar file to the S3 bucket. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

  • S3 không phải artifact repository cho dependencies

  • SNS notification require custom setup, không native integration

❌ Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an ECR source action to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

  • ECR dùng cho container images, không phải .jar files

  • ECR không phải artifact repository cho Java dependencies

❌ Create an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private repository. Publish the dependency .jar file to the repository. Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to start a CodePipeline pipeline build.

  • ECR không phù hợp cho .jar files

  • SNS notification không phải standard approach

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Java .jar dependencies" → AWS CodeArtifact

  • "Trigger pipeline on new artifact version" → EventBridge rule

  • ECR = container images, CodeArtifact = packages/dependencies

  • CodeArtifact support Maven, Gradle, npm, pip, NuGet

📖 Reference:

  • What is AWS CodeArtifact

  • Working with Maven packages in CodeArtifact

questions.q:
A company's application has an AWS Lambda function that processes messages from IoT devices. The company wants to monitor the Lambda function to ensure that the Lambda function is meeting its required service level agreement (SLA).

A developer must implement a solution to determine the application's throughput in near real time. The throughput must be based on the number of messages that the Lambda function receives and processes in a given time period. The Lambda function performs initialization and post-processing steps that must not factor into the throughput measurement.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Use the Lambda function's ConcurrentExecutions metric in Amazon CloudWatch to measure the throughput.
Modify the application to log the calculated throughput to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke a separate Lambda function to process the logs on a schedule.
Modify the application to publish custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics when the Lambda function receives and processes each message. Use the metrics to calculate the throughput.
Use the Lambda function's Invocations metric and Duration metric to calculate the throughput in Amazon CloudWatch.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company's application có Lambda function xử lý messages from IoT devices

  • Cần monitor Lambda để ensure meeting SLA (Thỏa thuận mức dịch vụ)

  • Developer phải implement solution để xác định application's throughput in near real time

  • Throughput dựa trên number of messages received và processed in given time period

  • Lambda function có initialization và post-processing steps phải KHÔNG tính vào throughput measurement

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the application to publish custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics when the Lambda function receives and processes each message. Use the metrics to calculate the throughput.

  • Custom metrics cho phép track chính xác message processing, exclude initialization/post-processing

  • Publish metric khi receive message và khi complete processing

  • Near real-time visibility với CloudWatch metrics

  • Flexible calculation - có thể define throughput metrics theo business logic

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the Lambda function's ConcurrentExecutions metric in Amazon CloudWatch to measure the throughput.

  • ConcurrentExecutions measure number of concurrent invocations (số lượng invoke đồng thời), không phải message throughput

  • Không phân biệt giữa message processing và initialization/post-processing

❌ Modify the application to log the calculated throughput to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke a separate Lambda function to process the logs on a schedule.

  • Logs processing không phải near real-time

  • Thêm complexity với separate Lambda function

  • EventBridge schedule thêm delay

❌ Use the Lambda function's Invocations metric and Duration metric to calculate the throughput in Amazon CloudWatch.

  • Invocations count function calls, không phải messages processed

  • Duration bao gồm cả initialization/post-processing - vi phạm requirement

  • Không accurate cho message-level throughput

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Exclude specific steps" + "custom calculation" → Custom CloudWatch metrics

  • "Near real-time throughput" → publish metrics during processing

  • Built-in Lambda metrics (Invocations, Duration) không flexible cho custom requirements

  • Custom metrics = PutMetricData API

📖 Reference:

  • Publishing custom metrics from Lambda

  • Types of metrics for Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer is building an event-driven application by using AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge. The Lambda function needs to push events to an EventBridge event bus. The developer uses an SDK to run the PutEvents EventBridge action and specifies no credentials in the code. After deploying the Lambda function, the developer notices that the function is failing and there are AccessDeniedException errors in the logs.

How should the developer resolve this issue?
o: Configure a VPC peering connection between the Lambda function and EventBridge.
Modify their AWS credentials to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.
Modify the Lambda function execution role to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.
Add a resource-based policy to the Lambda function to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build event-driven application dùng Lambda và EventBridge

  • Lambda function cần push events đến EventBridge event bus

  • Developer dùng SDK chạy PutEvents action và specifies no credentials trong code

  • Sau deploy, function failing với AccessDeniedException errors trong logs

  • Hỏi: cách resolve issue?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the Lambda function execution role to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.

  • Lambda function dùng execution role để access AWS services

  • No credentials trong code = Lambda tự động dùng execution role credentials

  • AccessDeniedException = execution role thiếu PutEvents permission

  • Add events:PutEvents permission vào Lambda execution role

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a VPC peering connection between the Lambda function and EventBridge.

  • VPC peering không liên quan đến permissions

  • EventBridge là managed service, không cần VPC peering

❌ Modify their AWS credentials to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.

  • Code không specify credentials nên không dùng developer's personal credentials

  • Lambda dùng execution role, không phải user credentials

❌ Add a resource-based policy to the Lambda function to include permissions for the PutEvents EventBridge action.

  • Resource-based policy control who can invoke Lambda, không grant Lambda permissions to access other services

  • Cần modify execution role (identity-based policy)

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda access AWS service" → Lambda execution role

  • "No credentials in code" → Lambda tự động dùng execution role

  • AccessDeniedException → thiếu permissions trong execution role

  • Resource-based policy = who can invoke

  • Execution role = what Lambda can do

questions.q:
A company recently deployed a new serverless user portal. Users have reported that part of the portal is slow. The initial analysis found a single Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is responsible for the performance issues. The endpoint integrates with an AWS Lambda function. However, the Lambda function interacts with other APIs and AWS services.

How can a developer find the source of the increased response time by using operational best practices?
o: Update the Lambda function by adding logging statements with high-precision timestamps before and after each external request. Deploy the updated Lambda function. After accumulating enough usage data, examine the Amazon CloudWatch logs for the Lambda function to determine the likely sources for the increased response time.

Instrument the Lambda function with the AWS X-Ray SDK. Add HTTP and HTTPS interceptors and SDK client handlers. Deploy the updated Lambda function. Turn on X-Ray tracing. After accumulating enough usage data, use the X-Ray service map to examine the average response times to determine the likely sources.

Review the Lambda function's Amazon CloudWatch metrics by using the metrics explorer. Apply anomaly detection to the Duration metric and the Throttles metric. Review the anomalies to determine the likely sources.

Use Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to create a new canary. Turn on AWS X-Ray tracing on the canary. Configure the canary to scan the user portal. After accumulating enough usage data, use the CloudWatch Synthetics canary dashboard to view the metrics from the canary.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company deploy serverless user portal, users report portal is slow

  • Analysis tìm thấy single API Gateway endpoint gây performance issues

  • Endpoint integrates với Lambda function

  • Lambda function interacts với other APIs và AWS services

  • Hỏi: làm thế nào để xác định nguyên nhân làm tăng response time theo best practices về operations?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Instrument the Lambda function with the AWS X-Ray SDK. Add HTTP and HTTPS interceptors and SDK client handlers. Deploy the updated Lambda function. Turn on X-Ray tracing. After accumulating enough usage data, use the X-Ray service map to examine the average response times to determine the likely sources.

  • X-Ray được thiết kế đặc biệt cho distributed tracing và performance analysis

  • Service map visualize toàn bộ request flow và response times của từng service

  • Interceptors và SDK handlers tự động trace external API calls và AWS service calls

  • Operational best practice cho troubleshooting distributed applications

Ví dụ Service map

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update the Lambda function by adding logging statements with high-precision timestamps before and after each external request. Deploy the updated Lambda function. After accumulating enough usage data, examine the Amazon CloudWatch logs for the Lambda function to determine the likely sources for the increased response time.

  • Manual logging không phải best practice, require nhiều code changes

  • Khó phân tích và liên kết dữ liệu từ nhiều services

  • Không có visualization như X-Ray service map

❌ Review the Lambda function's Amazon CloudWatch metrics by using the metrics explorer. Apply anomaly detection to the Duration metric and the Throttles metric. Review the anomalies to determine the likely sources.

  • CloudWatch metrics chỉ show overall Lambda performance, không break down theo external calls

  • Không identify được which specific API/service gây bottleneck

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to create a new canary. Turn on AWS X-Ray tracing on the canary. Configure the canary to scan the user portal. After accumulating enough usage data, use the CloudWatch Synthetics canary dashboard to view the metrics from the canary.

  • Synthetics canary dùng cho monitoring availability, không phải troubleshooting existing performance issues

  • Không trace internal Lambda function calls

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Find source of latency" + "distributed system" → AWS X-Ray

  • X-Ray service map = visualize request flow và response times

  • Operational best practice = X-Ray tracing, không phải manual logging

  • CloudWatch metrics = overall metrics, X-Ray = detailed tracing

📖 Reference:

  • Visualize Lambda function invocations using AWS X-Ray

questions.q:
A company uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to decouple its microservices architecture. Some messages in an SQS queue contain sensitive information. A developer must implement a solution that encrypts all the data at rest.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Enable server-side encryption for the SQS queue by using an SQS managed encryption key (SSE-SQS).
Use the aws:SecureTransport condition in the queue policy to ensure that only HTTPS (TLS) is used for all requests to the SQS queue.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to generate an SSL/TLS certificate. Reference the certificate when messages are sent to the queue.
Set a message attribute in the SQS SendMessage request for messages that are sent to the queue. Set the Name to ENCRYPT. Set the Value to TRUE.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng SQS để decouple microservices architecture

  • Some messages trong SQS queue chứa sensitive information

  • Developer phải implement solution encrypts all data at rest

  • Solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable server-side encryption for the SQS queue by using an SQS managed encryption key (SSE-SQS).

  • SSE-SQS encrypt data at rest automatically

  • SQS managed key không cần quản lý key rotation

  • Đáp ứng đúng requirement "encrypt all data at rest"

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the aws:SecureTransport condition in the queue policy to ensure that only HTTPS (TLS) is used for all requests to the SQS queue.

  • HTTPS/TLS encrypt data in transit, không phải data at rest

  • Không đáp ứng yêu cầu encrypt at rest

❌ Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to generate an SSL/TLS certificate. Reference the certificate when messages are sent to the queue.

  • ACM certificates dùng cho encryption in transit, không phải at rest

  • SQS không require custom SSL certificates

❌ Set a message attribute in the SQS SendMessage request for messages that are sent to the queue. Set the Name to ENCRYPT. Set the Value to TRUE.

  • Message attributes không tự động encrypt data

  • Đây không phải valid encryption method

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Encrypt data at rest" → Server-side encryption (SSE)

  • "Encrypt data in transit" → HTTPS/TLS

  • SQS encryption options:

    • SSE-SQS (SQS managed key)

    • SSE-KMS (customer managed key)

  • ACM certificates = in transit, không phải at rest

📖 Reference:

  • Encryption at rest in Amazon SQS

questions.q:
A company deploys a new application to AWS. The company is streaming application logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company's development team must receive notification by email when the word "ERROR" appears in any log lines. A developer sets up an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and subscribes the development team to the topic.

What should the developer do next to meet the requirements?
o: Select the appropriate log group. Create a CloudWatch metric filter with "ERROR" as the search term. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.

In CloudWatch Logs Insights, select the appropriate log group. Create a metric query to search for the term "ERROR" in the logs. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.
Select the appropriate log group. Create an SNS subscription filter with "ERROR" as the filter pattern. Select the SNS topic as the destination.
Create a CloudWatch alarm that includes "ERROR" as a filter pattern, a log group dimension that defines the appropriate log group, and a destination that notifies the SNS topic.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company streaming application logs đến CloudWatch Logs

  • Development team cần receive email notification khi từ "ERROR" xuất hiện trong log lines

  • Developer đã setup SNS topic và subscribe development team

  • Hỏi: developer nên làm gì tiếp theo?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Select the appropriate log group. Create a CloudWatch metric filter with "ERROR" as the search term. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.

  • Metric filter quét logs và đếm số lần xuất hiện của pattern "ERROR"

  • CloudWatch alarm monitor metric và trigger khi đạt threshold (≥1)

  • SNS notification gửi email khi alarm triggers

  • Đây là standard pattern cho log-based alerting

Architecture:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ In CloudWatch Logs Insights, select the appropriate log group. Create a metric query to search for the term "ERROR" in the logs. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.

  • Logs Insights dùng để query dữ liệu theo nhu cầu (ad-hoc), không phải giám sát real-time

  • Không thể tạo alarm trực tiếp từ Logs Insights query

❌ Select the appropriate log group. Create an SNS subscription filter with "ERROR" as the filter pattern. Select the SNS topic as the destination.

  • Subscription filters stream logs đến destinations (Lambda, Kinesis, Firehose, OpenSearch), không tạo metrics

  • Không có CloudWatch alarm để kiểm soát notifications

❌ Create a CloudWatch alarm that includes "ERROR" as a filter pattern, a log group dimension that defines the appropriate log group, and a destination that notifies the SNS topic.

  • CloudWatch alarms không directly support filter patterns

  • Phải create metric filter trước, rồi mới create alarm on metric

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Log-based alerting" → Metric filter + CloudWatch alarm

  • Pattern: Log group → Metric filter → Metric → Alarm → SNS

  • Logs Insights = querying, không phải monitoring

  • Subscription filters = streaming, không phải alerting

📖 Reference:

  • Creating CloudWatch metric filters

questions.q:
A developer is storing many objects in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to optimize the S3 bucket for high request rates.

How should the developer store the objects to meet this requirement?
o: Store the objects by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
Store the objects at the root of the S3 bucket.
Store the objects by using object key names distributed across multiple prefixes.
Store each object with an object tag named "prefix" that contains a unique value.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer storing many objects trong single S3 bucket

  • Cần optimize S3 bucket for high request rates

  • Hỏi: cách nào để store objects đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the objects by using object key names distributed across multiple prefixes.

  • Multiple prefixes phân tán requests across multiple partitions trong S3

  • S3 tự động scale performance theo số prefixes

  • 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE và 5,500 GET/HEAD requests per second per prefix

  • Nhiều prefixes = tăng tổng throughput

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the objects by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

  • Intelligent-Tiering là storage class để optimize costs, không phải performance

  • Không ảnh hưởng đến request rates

❌ Store the objects at the root of the S3 bucket.

  • Root level (single prefix) bị giới hạn performance

  • Không phân tán requests, không optimize cho high request rates

❌ Store each object with an object tag named "prefix" that contains a unique value.

  • Object tags dùng cho organization và lifecycle policies, không ảnh hưởng performance

  • Tags không phân tán requests

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "High request rates" + "S3 optimization" → Multiple prefixes

  • S3 performance limits: 3,500-5,500 requests/second per prefix

  • Prefix examples: /images/, /videos/, /2024/01/, /user-123/
