  • Intelligent-Tiering = cost optimization, không phải performance

📖 Reference:

  • Best practices design patterns: optimizing Amazon S3 performance

questions.q:
A developer is working on an ecommerce platform that communicates with several third-party payment processing APIs. The third-party payment services do not provide a test environment.

The developer needs to validate the ecommerce platform's integration with the third-party payment processing APIs. The developer must test the API integration code without invoking the third-party payment processing APIs.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a gateway response configured for status code 200. Add response templates that contain sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

Set up an AWS AppSync GraphQL API with a data source configured for each third-party API. Specify an integration type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

Create an AWS Lambda function for each third-party API. Embed responses captured from the real third-party API. Configure Amazon Route 53 Resolver with an inbound endpoint for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API for each third-party API. Specify an integration request type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer làm ecommerce platform communicate với several third-party payment processing APIs

  • Third-party services không provide test environment

  • Cần validate integration với third-party APIs

  • Phải test API integration code WITHOUT invoking third-party APIs

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API for each third-party API. Specify an integration request type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

  • API Gateway Mock integration trả về responses định sẵn mà không gọi backend

  • Không invoke third-party APIs

  • Configure responses với sample data từ real API

  • Cho phép test integration code với responses thực tế

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a gateway response configured for status code 200. Add response templates that contain sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

  • Gateway responses dùng cho error handling (4xx, 5xx), không phải mock normal API responses

  • Không phù hợp cho testing integration code

❌ Set up an AWS AppSync GraphQL API with a data source configured for each third-party API. Specify an integration type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

  • AppSync là GraphQL service, không phù hợp cho REST-based payment APIs

  • Third-party payment APIs thường là REST, không phải GraphQL

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function for each third-party API. Embed responses captured from the real third-party API. Configure Amazon Route 53 Resolver with an inbound endpoint for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

  • Quá phức tạp với Lambda functions và Route 53

  • Route 53 Resolver không dùng cho API mocking

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Test without invoking external APIs" → API Gateway Mock integration

  • Mock integration = return responses được xác định trước, không call backend

  • Gateway responses = error handling, không phải mocking

  • AppSync = GraphQL, payment APIs thường là REST

📖 Reference:

  • Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company is using Amazon API Gateway to invoke a new AWS Lambda function. The company has Lambda function versions in its PROD and DEV environments. In each environment, there is a Lambda function alias pointing to the corresponding Lambda function version. API Gateway has one stage that is configured to point at the PROD alias.

The company wants to configure API Gateway to enable the PROD and DEV Lambda function versions to be simultaneously and distinctly available.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Enable a Lambda authorizer for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create API Gateway stage variables for the PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda authorizer to the DEV Lambda authorizer.
Set up a gateway response in API Gateway for the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create gateway responses in API Gateway for PROD and DEV Lambda aliases.

Use an environment variable for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API gateway environment variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias to the DEV Lambda function alias.

Use an API Gateway stage variable to configure the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API Gateway stage variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias and to the DEV Lambda function alias.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng API Gateway invoke Lambda function

  • Có Lambda function versions trong PROD và DEV environments

  • Mỗi environment có Lambda alias pointing đến version tương ứng

  • API Gateway có one stage configured point đến PROD alias

  • Muốn configure API Gateway để PROD và DEV versions đồng thời available và riêng biệt

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use an API Gateway stage variable to configure the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API Gateway stage variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias and to the DEV Lambda function alias.

  • Stage variables cho phép reference different resources (Lambda aliases) per stage

  • Create separate stages (PROD và DEV) trong API Gateway

  • Each stage variable point đến corresponding Lambda alias (PROD alias hoặc DEV alias)

  • Simultaneously available - cả hai stages có thể được invoke riêng biệt

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Enable a Lambda authorizer for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create API Gateway stage variables for the PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda authorizer to the DEV Lambda authorizer.

  • Lambda authorizer dùng cho authentication/authorization, không phải routing đến different Lambda versions

  • Sai use case

❌ Set up a gateway response in API Gateway for the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create gateway responses in API Gateway for PROD and DEV Lambda aliases.

  • Gateway responses dùng cho customize error responses, không phải routing

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề PROD/DEV separation

❌ Use an environment variable for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API gateway environment variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias to the DEV Lambda function alias.

  • API Gateway không có "environment variables" feature

  • Phải dùng stage variables, không phải environment variables

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Different resources per API Gateway stage" → Stage variables

  • Stage variables use case: point to different Lambda aliases, endpoints, parameters

  • Lambda authorizer = auth, Gateway responses = errors

  • API Gateway không có environment variables - chỉ có stage variables

📖 Reference:

  • Use stage variables for a REST API in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company runs a payment application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balance. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to retrieve application secrets during the application startup and export the secrets as environment variables. These secrets must be encrypted at rest and need to be rotated every month.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Save the secrets in a text file and store the text file in Amazon S3. Provision a customer managed key. Use the key for secret encryption in Amazon S3. Read the contents of the text file and read the export as environment variables. Configure S3 Object Lambda to rotate the text file every month.

Save the secrets as strings in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the secrets in Parameter Store every month.

Save the secrets as base64 encoded environment variables in the application properties. Retrieve the secrets during the application startup. Reference the secrets in the application code. Write a script to rotate the secrets saved as environment variables.

Store the secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Provision a new customer master key. Use the key to encrypt the secrets. Enable automatic rotation. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to programmatically retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Payment application chạy trên EC2 instances behind ALB

  • EC2 trong Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs

  • Application cần retrieve secrets during startup và export as environment variables

  • Secrets phải encrypted at rest và rotated every month

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST development effort?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Provision a new customer master key. Use the key to encrypt the secrets. Enable automatic rotation. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to programmatically retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables.

  • Secrets Manager được thiết kế đặc biệt cho secrets management

  • Automatic rotation built-in - chỉ cần enable, không cần custom code

  • Encrypted at rest by default với KMS

  • User data script retrieve secrets khi EC2 startup

  • LEAST effort - Secrets Manager handle rotation automatically

Ví dụ: User Data Script (Bash)

#!/bin/bash

# Install AWS CLI (nếu chưa có)
yum install -y aws-cli

# Retrieve secret từ Secrets Manager
SECRET_JSON=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
    --secret-id prod/payment-app/credentials \
    --region us-east-1 \
    --query SecretString \
    --output text)

# Parse JSON và export as environment variables
export DB_USERNAME=$(echo $SECRET_JSON | jq -r '.username')
export DB_PASSWORD=$(echo $SECRET_JSON | jq -r '.password')
export API_KEY=$(echo $SECRET_JSON | jq -r '.api_key')

# Write vào /etc/environment để persist
echo "DB_USERNAME=$DB_USERNAME" >> /etc/environment
echo "DB_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD" >> /etc/environment
echo "API_KEY=$API_KEY" >> /etc/environment

# Start application
cd /opt/payment-app
./start-app.sh

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Save the secrets in a text file and store the text file in Amazon S3. Provision a customer managed key. Use the key for secret encryption in Amazon S3. Read the contents of the text file and read the export as environment variables. Configure S3 Object Lambda to rotate the text file every month.

  • S3 không phải secrets management solution

  • S3 Object Lambda không dùng cho rotation, require custom implementation

  • High development effort

❌ Save the secrets as strings in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the secrets in Parameter Store every month.

  • Parameter Store không có automatic rotation feature

  • Require custom Lambda function để rotate - more development effort

  • Secrets Manager tốt hơn cho secrets với rotation requirements

❌ Save the secrets as base64 encoded environment variables in the application properties. Retrieve the secrets during the application startup. Reference the secrets in the application code. Write a script to rotate the secrets saved as environment variables.

  • Base64 encoding không phải encryption

  • Not encrypted at rest

  • Require custom rotation script - high development effort

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Secrets + automatic rotation" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager:

    • Parameter Store = no built-in rotation

    • Secrets Manager = automatic rotation built-in

  • "LEAST development effort" + "rotation" → Secrets Manager

  • Base64 encoding ≠ encryption

📖 Reference:

  • Rotating AWS Secrets Manager secrets

User data script chỉ chạy 1 lần khi FIRST LAUNCH, không chạy lại khi stop/start. Vậy nếu stop và start thì làm sao để lấy được biên môi trường.

  1. Application retrieve secrets at runtime (Best Practice)

  2. Use systemd service to run script on every boot

questions.q:
A company runs an application on AWS. The application stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Some queries are taking a long time to run. These slow queries involve an attribute that is not the table's partition key or sort key.

The amount of data that the application stores in the DynamoDB table is expected to increase significantly. A developer must increase the performance of the queries.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Increase the page size for each request by setting the Limit parameter to be higher than the default value. Configure the application to retry any request that exceeds the provisioned throughput.
Create a global secondary index (GSI). Set query attribute to be the partition key of the index.
Perform a parallel scan operation by issuing individual scan requests. In the parameters, specify the segment for the scan requests and the total number of segments for the parallel scan.
Turn on read capacity auto scaling for the DynamoDB table. Increase the maximum read capacity units (RCUs).
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application stores data trong DynamoDB table

  • Some queries taking long time - queries liên quan đến attribute không phải partition key hoặc sort key

  • Data trong table dự kiến increase significantly (tăng đáng kể)

  • Developer phải increase performance of queries

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a global secondary index (GSI). Set query attribute to be the partition key of the index.

  • GSI cho phép query hiệu quả bằng attributes khác ngoài partition/sort key của base table

  • Set query attribute làm partition key của GSI → enable fast queries

  • Scalable khi data increase significantly

  • Best practice cho query patterns khác với base table key structure

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the page size for each request by setting the Limit parameter to be higher than the default value. Configure the application to retry any request that exceeds the provisioned throughput.

  • Tăng page size không giải quyết root cause (query attribute không phải key)

  • Vẫn phải scan nhiều items để find matches

  • Không improve query performance khi data tăng

❌ Perform a parallel scan operation by issuing individual scan requests. In the parameters, specify the segment for the scan requests and the total number of segments for the parallel scan.

  • Scan operations rất không hiệu quả, đọc toàn bộ table

  • Parallel scan vẫn consume nhiều throughput và slow khi data lớn

  • Không phải solution cho query optimization

❌ Turn on read capacity auto scaling for the DynamoDB table. Increase the maximum read capacity units (RCUs).

  • Tăng RCUs không giải quyết hiệu quả cho query pattern

  • Vẫn phải scan items nếu không có index thích hợp

  • Tốn cost mà không improve query efficiency

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Query by non-key attribute" → Global Secondary Index (GSI)

  • "Query taking long time" + "non-key attribute" → thiếu index

  • GSI = alternative partition key và optional sort key

  • Scan = inefficient, Query with GSI = efficient

  • Auto scaling RCUs không fix lỗi truy vấn kém

📖 Reference:

  • Improving data access with secondary indexes

  • Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB

📊 Tình huống: Ecommerce Order Table

Base Table Structure:

  • Partition Key: OrderID

  • Sort Key: (Không setting)

  • Attributes

    • CustomerEmail

    • OrderDate

    • Status

    • TotalAmount

Sample Data:

OrderID: ORD-001, CustomerEmail: john@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-15, Status: shipped
OrderID: ORD-002, CustomerEmail: mary@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-16, Status: pending
OrderID: ORD-003, CustomerEmail: john@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-17, Status: shipped
OrderID: ORD-004, CustomerEmail: jane@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-18, Status: delivered

Vấn đề:

Query requirement: "Tìm tất cả orders của customer có email = john@email.com"

Với base table hiện tại:

# ❌ SLOW - Phải SCAN toàn bộ table
response = table.scan(
    FilterExpression=Attr('CustomerEmail').eq('john@email.com')
)

Tại sao slow?

  • DynamoDB phải scan toàn bộ table (đọc tất cả items)

  • Nếu có 1 triệu orders → phải đọc 1 triệu items để find 2 items của John

  • Very inefficient và expensive!

Giải pháp: Tạo GSI

Create Global Secondary Index:

GSI Name: CustomerEmailIndex

  • GSI Partition Key: CustomerEmail

  • GSI Sort Key: OrderDate

  • Projected Attributes: ALL

Sau khi tạo GSI:

GSI Data (automatically maintained by DynamoDB):

CustomerEmail: john@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-15, OrderID: ORD-001, Status: shipped
CustomerEmail: john@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-17, OrderID: ORD-003, Status: shipped
CustomerEmail: mary@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-16, OrderID: ORD-002, Status: pending
CustomerEmail: jane@email.com, OrderDate: 2024-01-18, OrderID: ORD-004, Status: delivered

Query với GSI:

# ✅ FAST - Query trực tiếp bằng CustomerEmail
response = table.query(
    IndexName='CustomerEmailIndex',
    KeyConditionExpression=Key('CustomerEmail').eq('john@email.com')
)

Tại sao fast?

  • DynamoDB chỉ đọc items có CustomerEmail = john@email.com

  • Không cần scan toàn bộ table

  • Highly efficient!

questions.q:
A developer is building a containerized application on AWS. The application communicates with a third-party service by using API keys. The developer needs a secure way to store the API keys and pass the API keys to the containerized application.

Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Store the API keys as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Parameter Store.
Store the API keys in AWS CloudFormation templates by using base64 encoding. Pass the API keys to the application through container definition environment variables.
Add a new AWS CloudFormation parameter to the CloudFormation template. Pass the API keys to the application by using the container definition environment variables.
Embed the API keys in the application. Build the container image on-premises. Upload the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Store the API keys as a SecretString parameter in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Secrets Manager.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build containerized application trên AWS

  • Application communicate với third-party service bằng API keys

  • Cần secure way để store API keys và pass đến containerized application

  • Hỏi: solutions nào đáp ứng yêu cầu? (Chọn 2 đáp án)

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the API keys as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Parameter Store.

  • Parameter Store SecureString encrypt API keys at rest bằng KMS

  • Application retrieve secrets at runtime thông qua IAM permissions

  • Secure - không hardcode trong code/images

Store the API keys as a SecretString parameter in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Secrets Manager.

  • Secrets Manager được thiết kế đặc biệt cho secrets (API keys, passwords)

  • Encrypted at rest, support automatic rotation

  • Application retrieve secrets securely at runtime

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the API keys in AWS CloudFormation templates by using base64 encoding. Pass the API keys to the application through container definition environment variables.

  • Base64 encoding không phải encryption, dễ decode

  • CloudFormation templates có thể được view bởi nhiều users

  • Không secure

❌ Add a new AWS CloudFormation parameter to the CloudFormation template. Pass the API keys to the application by using the container definition environment variables.

  • CloudFormation parameters không encrypted by default

  • Environment variables trong container definitions được nhìn thấy trong console/logs

  • Không secure cho sensitive data

❌ Embed the API keys in the application. Build the container image on-premises. Upload the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

  • Hardcoded API keys trong container image là severe security risk

  • Image có thể bị pull và reverse-engineer để extract keys

  • Không thể rotate keys mà không rebuild image

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Secure API keys for containers" → Parameter Store SecureString hoặc Secrets Manager

  • Base64 encoding ≠ encryption

  • Never hardcode secrets trong code/images/environment variables

  • Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager: cả hai đều OK, Secrets Manager có thêm rotation feature

  • CloudFormation parameters không secure cho secrets

📖 Reference:

  • Pass Systems Manager parameters through Amazon ECS environment variables

Add the environment variable to the container definition

{
  "containerDefinitions": [{
    "secrets": [{
      "name": "environment_variable_name",
      "valueFrom": "arn:aws:ssm:region:aws_account_id:parameter/parameter_name"
    }]
  }]
}

  • Pass Secrets Manager secrets through Amazon ECS environment variables

Example container definitions

{
  "containerDefinitions": [{
    "secrets": [{
      "name": "environment_variable_name",
      "valueFrom": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:region:aws_account_id:secret:secret_name-AbCdEf"
    }]
  }]
}

questions.q:
A developer is building a microservices-based application by using Python on AWS and several AWS services. The developer must use AWS X-Ray. The developer views the service map by using the console to view the service dependencies. During testing, the developer notices that some services are missing from the service map.

What can the developer do to ensure that all services appear in the X-Ray service map?
o: Modify the X-Ray Python agent configuration in each service to increase the sampling rate.
Instrument the application by using the X-Ray SDK for Python. Install the X-Ray SDK for all the services that the application uses.
Enable X-Ray data aggregation in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for all the services that the application uses.
Increase the X-Ray service map timeout value in the X-Ray console.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build microservices application bằng Python trên AWS

  • Phải sử dụng AWS X-Ray

  • Developer view service map trong console để xem service dependencies

  • During testing: some services missing from service map

  • Hỏi: làm gì để ensure all services appear (xuất hiện) trong X-Ray service map?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Instrument the application by using the X-Ray SDK for Python. Install the X-Ray SDK for all the services that the application uses.

  • X-Ray SDK instrument code để send trace data đến X-Ray

  • Missing services = chưa được instrumented với X-Ray SDK

  • Phải install và configure X-Ray SDK trong tất cả services để chúng xuất hiện trên service map

  • SDK capture requests, responses, và calls đến downstream services

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Modify the X-Ray Python agent configuration in each service to increase the sampling rate.

  • Sampling rate control bao nhiêu % requests được traced, không phải services nào được xuất hiện

  • Nếu service chưa instrumented, tăng sampling rate không giúp service xuất hiện

❌ Enable X-Ray data aggregation in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for all the services that the application uses.

  • X-Ray không require CloudWatch Logs aggregation để show services trên service map

  • Missing services do thiếu instrumentation, không phải logs configuration

❌ Increase the X-Ray service map timeout value in the X-Ray console.

  • Service map timeout không liên quan đến missing services

  • Không có setting như vậy trong X-Ray console

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Services missing from X-Ray service map" → Chưa instrumented với X-Ray SDK

  • X-Ray SDK phải được install và configured trong every service

  • Sampling rate = % of requests traced, không ảnh hưởng service visibility

  • CloudWatch Logs không required cho X-Ray service map

📖 Reference:

  • Instrumenting Python code in AWS Lambda

questions.q:
A developer is creating a simple proof-of-concept demo by using AWS CloudFormation and AWS Lambda functions. The demo will use a CloudFormation template to deploy an existing Lambda function. The Lambda function uses deployment packages and dependencies stored in Amazon S3. The developer defined an AWS::Lambda::Function resource in a CloudFormation template. The developer needs to add the S3 bucket to the CloudFormation template.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Add the function code in the CloudFormation template inline as the code property.
Add the function code in the CloudFormation template as the ZipFile property.
Find the S3 key for the Lambda function. Add the S3 key as the ZipFile property in the CloudFormation template.
Add the relevant key and bucket to the S3Bucket and S3Key properties in the CloudFormation template.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo proof-of-concept demo bằng CloudFormation và Lambda

  • Demo sẽ dùng CloudFormation template để deploy existing Lambda function

  • Lambda function dùng deployment packages và dependencies stored trong S3

  • Developer đã define AWS::Lambda::Function resource trong CloudFormation template

  • Cần add S3 bucket vào CloudFormation template

  • Hỏi: cách nào với LEAST development effort?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add the relevant key and bucket to the S3Bucket and S3Key properties in the CloudFormation template.

  • S3Bucket và S3Key properties reference existing deployment package trong S3

  • LEAST effort - chỉ cần specify bucket name và object key

  • Không cần copy/embed code vào template

  • Lambda function đã có deployment package sẵn trong S3

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add the function code in the CloudFormation template inline as the code property.

  • Inline code chỉ support cho simple functions, không support dependencies

  • Đề bài nói function có dependencies stored in S3

  • High effort - phải copy code vào template

❌ Add the function code in the CloudFormation template as the ZipFile property.

  • ZipFile dùng cho inline code (simple functions without dependencies)

  • Không support external dependencies từ S3

  • Không phù hợp với existing deployment package

❌ Find the S3 key for the Lambda function. Add the S3 key as the ZipFile property in the CloudFormation template.

  • ZipFile property không accept S3 key

  • ZipFile chỉ dùng cho inline code string

  • Syntax sai

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda deployment package in S3" → S3Bucket và S3Key properties

  • Code property types:

    • Inline/ZipFile = simple code without dependencies

    • S3Bucket/S3Key = deployment package in S3 (with dependencies)

  • "LEAST effort" + "existing package in S3" → reference S3 location

  • ZipFile ≠ S3 key - ZipFile là inline code

📖 Reference:

  • AWS::Lambda::Function Code property

Ví dụ:

CloudFormation Template (YAML)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploy Lambda function from S3

Resources:
  MyLambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: MyDemoFunction
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: lambda_function.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt MyLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: my-lambda-deployments-bucket      # S3 Bucket name
        S3Key: functions/my-function-v1.0.zip       # S3 Object key
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: Lambda Function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MyLambdaFunction.Arn

Structure của S3 deployment package:

my-lambda-deployments-bucket/
└── functions/
    └── my-function-v1.0.zip
        ├── lambda_function.py       # Main handler
        ├── requirements.txt
        └── dependencies/            # External libraries
            ├── requests/
            └── boto3/

Deployment Steps:

  1. Upload deployment package lên S3:

aws s3 cp my-function-v1.0.zip s3://my-lambda-deployments-bucket/functions/

  1. Deploy CloudFormation stack:

aws cloudformation create-stack \
  --stack-name lambda-demo-stack \
  --template-body file://template.yaml \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM

  1. Done! Lambda function deployed từ S3 package!

questions.q:
A company runs its website on AWS. The company posts daily polls on its website and publishes the poll results next day. The website stores user responses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. After the poll results are published, the company does not need to keep the user responses.

A developer needs to implement a solution that will automatically remove old user responses from the DynamoDB table. The developer adds a new expiration_date attribute to the DynamoDB table. The developer plans to use the expiration_date attribute for the automation.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Lambda function daily.

Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task daily.
Create an AWS Glue job to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an AWS Glue trigger schedule to run the job daily.
Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table and specify the expiration_date attribute. Expire old user responses by using DynamoDB TTL.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company runs website trên AWS, post daily polls

  • User responses stored trong DynamoDB table

  • Sau khi poll results published, không cần keep old user responses

  • Developer adds expiration_date attribute vào DynamoDB table

  • Cần implement solution automatically remove old user responses

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST development effort?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table and specify the expiration_date attribute. Expire old user responses by using DynamoDB TTL.

  • DynamoDB TTL (Time To Live) tự động delete expired items

  • Zero code - chỉ cần enable TTL và specify attribute name

  • LEAST development effort - native DynamoDB feature, không cần Lambda/Fargate/Glue

  • DynamoDB tự động delete items khi expiration_date timestamp passed

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Lambda function daily.

  • Require viết Lambda code để scan và delete items

  • Require setup EventBridge schedule

  • Higher development effort so với native TTL

❌ Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task daily.

  • Quá phức tạp với Fargate và ECS

  • Require containerize deletion logic

  • Very high development effort

❌ Create an AWS Glue job to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an AWS Glue trigger schedule to run the job daily.

  • AWS Glue dùng cho ETL workloads, không phù hợp cho simple deletion task

  • Require setup Glue job và trigger

  • High development effort

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Automatically delete expired items" + "DynamoDB" → DynamoDB TTL

  • "LEAST development effort" → dùng native features thay vì custom code

  • TTL = zero code solution, chỉ enable và specify attribute

📖 Reference:

  • Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer built an application that calls an external API to obtain data, processes the data, and saves the result to Amazon S3. The developer built a container image with all of the necessary dependencies to run the application as a container.

The application runs locally and requires minimal CPU and RAM resources. The developer has created an Amazon ECS cluster. The developer needs to run the application hourly in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of infrastructure management overhead?
o: Add a capacity provider to manage instances.
Add an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the application.
Define a task definition with an AWS Fargate launch type.
Create an Amazon ECS cluster and add the managed node groups feature to run the application.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build application gọi external API, process data, save đến S3

  • Developer đã build container image với all dependencies

  • Application chạy locally, require minimal CPU và RAM

  • Developer đã tạo ECS cluster

  • Cần run application hourly trong ECS

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST infrastructure management overhead?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Define a task definition with an AWS Fargate launch type.

  • Fargate là serverless compute engine cho containers

  • Zero infrastructure management - không cần manage EC2 instances

  • Pay per task - chỉ pay khi task chạy (hourly execution pattern)

  • LEAST overhead - chỉ cần define task definition, Fargate handle infrastructure

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a capacity provider to manage instances.

  • Capacity provider vẫn require manage EC2 instances

  • Infrastructure management overhead

  • Không phải serverless

❌ Add an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the application.

  • Phải manage EC2 instances (patching, scaling, monitoring)

  • High infrastructure overhead

  • Không cost-effective cho hourly tasks (instance chạy 24/7)

❌ Create an Amazon ECS cluster and add the managed node groups feature to run the application.

  • Managed node groups vẫn require manage underlying EC2 instances

  • Infrastructure management overhead

  • Không phải serverless solution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "LEAST infrastructure management" + "ECS" → AWS Fargate

  • Fargate vs EC2 launch type:

    • Fargate = serverless, zero infrastructure management

    • EC2 = manage instances, higher overhead

  • "Hourly tasks" + "minimal resources" → Fargate cost-effective

  • Capacity provider và managed node groups vẫn require manage EC2

📖 Reference:

  • AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS

questions.q:
A developer is creating a publicly accessible enterprise website consisting of only static assets. The developer is hosting the website in Amazon S3 and serving the website to users through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The users of this application must not be able to access the application content directly from an S3 bucket. All content must be served through the Amazon CloudFront distribution.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a new origin access control (OAC) in CloudFront. Configure the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the new OAC. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront OAC with read and write access to access Amazon S3 as the origin.

Update the S3 bucket settings. Enable the block all public access setting in Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFront distribution's with Amazon S3 as the origin. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront write access.
Update the S3 bucket's static website settings. Enable static website hosting and specifying index and error documents. Update the CloudFront origin to use the S3 bucket's website endpoint.

Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to send a custom header. Update the S3 bucket policy with a condition by using the aws:RequestTag/tag-key key. Configure the tag-key as the custom header name, and the value being matched is the header's value.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo publicly accessible website với only static assets

  • Hosting website trong S3 và serve qua CloudFront distribution

  • Users must NOT access content trực tiếp từ S3 bucket

  • All content phải served qua CloudFront distribution

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new origin access control (OAC) in CloudFront. Configure the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the new OAC. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront OAC with read and write access to access Amazon S3 as the origin.

  • OAC (Origin Access Control) cho phép CloudFront access S3 mà không cần public S3 bucket

  • Block direct S3 access - users chỉ có thể access qua CloudFront

  • S3 bucket policy grant permissions chỉ cho CloudFront OAC

  • Recommended approach - OAC là successor của OAI (Origin Access Identity)

Ví dụ bucket policy:

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowCloudFrontOAC",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "Service": "cloudfront.amazonaws.com"
      },
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-website-bucket/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "AWS:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudfront::123456789012:distribution/EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update the S3 bucket settings. Enable the block all public access setting in Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFront distribution's with Amazon S3 as the origin. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront write access.

  • Block public access là đúng nhưng thiếu OAC configuration

  • Không specify cách CloudFront authenticate với S3

  • CloudFront không cần write access cho static website (chỉ cần read)

❌ Update the S3 bucket's static website settings. Enable static website hosting and specifying index and error documents. Update the CloudFront origin to use the S3 bucket's website endpoint.

  • S3 website endpoint là public, không thể restrict access

  • Users vẫn có thể access trực tiếp qua S3 website URL

  • Không đáp ứng requirement "prevent direct access"

❌ Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to send a custom header. Update the S3 bucket policy with a condition by using the aws:RequestTag/tag-key key. Configure the tag-key as the custom header name, and the value being matched is the header's value.

  • Custom header approach không secure - users có thể giả mạo headers

  • aws:RequestTag không dùng cho validate custom headers

  • Không phải best practice

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "CloudFront + S3 + prevent direct access" → Origin Access Control (OAC)

  • OAC vs OAI:

    • OAC = newer, recommended (support SSE-KMS, dynamic requests)

    • OAI = legacy (still works but OAC preferred)

  • S3 website endpoint = public, không restrict được access

  • Custom headers không secure cho authentication

📖 Reference:

  • Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin

questions.q:
A company is releasing a new feature. Users can request early access to the new feature by using an application form. The company expects a surge of requests when the application form becomes available. Each request will be stored as an item in an Amazon DynamoDB table.

Each item will contain the user's username, the submission date, and a validation status of UNVALIDATED. VALID, or NOT VALID. Each item also will contain the user's rating of the process on a scale of 1 to 5.

Each user can submit one request. For the DynamoDB table, the developer must choose a partition key that will give the workload well-distributed records across partitions.

Which DynamoDB attribute will meet these requirements?
o: Username
Submission date
Validation status
Rating of the process on a scale of 1 to 5
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company release new feature với application form

  • Expect gia tăng nhanh chóng requests khi form available

  • Mỗi request lưu trong DynamoDB table với attributes: Username, Submission date, Validation status (UNVALIDATED, VALID, NOT VALID), Rating (1-5)

  • Each user chỉ submit one request

  • Hỏi: attribute nào làm partition key cho well-distributed records?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Username

  • Username có high cardinality - mỗi user unique

  • Well-distributed across partitions vì mỗi username khác nhau

  • Tránh hot partition - requests được phân bổ đều

  • Perfect cho "one request per user" access pattern

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Submission date

  • Low cardinality - nhiều users submit cùng time (đặc biệt khi request gia tăng)

  • Tạo hot partition khi requests cluster cùng lúc

❌ Validation status

  • Very low cardinality - chỉ 3 values

  • Ban đầu tất cả UNVALIDATED → severe hot partition

❌ Rating of the process on a scale of 1 to 5

  • Very low cardinality - chỉ 5 possible values

  • Poor distribution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Well-distributed partition key" → High cardinality attribute

  • Good partition keys: Username/UserID, UUID = unique

  • Bad partition keys: Status, Date, Rating = few values

  • "Each user one request" → Username ideal choice

  • Tránh attributes với limited values (status, rating, category)

📖 Reference:

  • Choosing the Right DynamoDB Partition Key

questions.q:
A company is using Amazon API Gateway to develop an API for its application on AWS. A developer needs to test and generate API responses. Other teams are required to test the API immediately.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Set up a mock integration request in API Gateway. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a response with a given status code.
Set up the request validators in the API's OpenAPI definition file. Import the OpenAPI definitions into API Gateway to test the API.
Set up a gateway response for the API in API Gateway. Configure response headers with hardcoded HTTP status codes and responses.
Set up a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer to control access to the API. Configure the Lambda function with the necessary mapping template.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company sử dụng API Gateway để develop API

  • Developer cần test và generate API responses

  • Other teams cần test API immediately (ngay lập tức)

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set up a mock integration request in API Gateway. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a response with a given status code.

  • Mock integration cho phép return hardcoded responses without backend

  • Test API immediately - không cần wait backend implementation

  • Configure status codes và responses ngay trong API Gateway

  • Perfect cho testing và prototyping trước khi backend ready

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up the request validators in the OpenAPI definition file. Import the OpenAPI definitions into API Gateway to test the API.

  • Request validators chỉ validate input, không generate responses

  • Không giúp test API responses

❌ Set up a gateway response for the API in API Gateway. Configure response headers with hardcoded HTTP status codes and responses.

  • Gateway responses dùng cho error responses (4xx, 5xx) từ API Gateway

  • Không phải mock responses cho testing normal API behavior

❌ Set up a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer to control access to the API. Configure the Lambda function with the necessary mapping template.

  • Lambda authorizer dùng cho authorization/authentication

  • Không liên quan đến generate test responses

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Test API" + "immediately" + "no backend" → Mock integration

  • Mock integration = hardcoded responses trong API Gateway

  • Use cases cho mock:

    • Prototype API trước khi backend ready

    • Test API structure và responses

    • Share API với teams để test ngay

📖 Reference:

  • Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company uses an AWS Lambda function that reads messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The Lambda function makes an HTTP call to a third-party API for each message. The company wants to ensure that the Lambda function does not overwhelm the third-party API with more than two concurrent requests.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure a provisioned concurrency of two on the Lambda function.
Configure a batch size of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.
Configure Lambda event filtering to process two messages from Amazon SQS at every invocations.
Configure a maximum concurrency of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function reads messages từ SQS standard queue

  • Lambda makes HTTP call to third-party API cho mỗi message

  • Company muốn ensure không áp đảo third-party API với nhiều hơn 2 requests đồng thời

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure a maximum concurrency of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.

  • Maximum concurrency limit số Lambda function instances chạy đồng thời

  • Setting = 2 → tối đa 2 concurrent Lambda invocations

  • Direct control để prevent áp đảo third-party API

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a provisioned concurrency of two on the Lambda function.

  • Provisioned concurrency dùng để keep warm instances, giảm cold start

  • Không limit concurrent executions - vẫn có thể scale beyond 2

  • Không ngẵn chặn việc áp đảo third-party API

❌ Configure a batch size of two on the Amazon SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function.

  • Batch size control số messages trong 1 lần Lambda được invoke, không phải concurrent invocations

  • Lambda vẫn có thể chạy nhiều invocations đồng thời với batch size 2

  • Không giới hạn concurrency

❌ Configure Lambda event filtering to process two messages from Amazon SQS at every invocations.

  • Event filtering dùng để filter messages based on tiêu chuẩn

  • Không control concurrency

  • Không giới hạn số concurrent invocations

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Limit concurrent requests/invocations" → Maximum concurrency

  • SQS + Lambda concurrency settings:

    • Maximum concurrency = limit concurrent function instances

    • Batch size = messages nhận trong 1 lần invoke

    • Provisioned concurrency = warm instances, không limit scale

  • "Ngăn chặn áp đảo API" → limit concurrency

📖 Reference:

  • Configuring reserved concurrency for a function

questions.q:
A company built an online event platform. For each event, the company organizes quizzes and generates leaderboards that are based on the quiz scores. The company stores the leaderboard data in Amazon DynamoDB and retains the data for 30 days after an event is complete. The company then uses a scheduled job to delete the old leaderboard data.

The DynamoDB table is configured with a fixed write capacity. During the months when many events occur, the DynamoDB write API requests are throttled when the scheduled delete job runs.

A developer must create a long-term solution that deletes the old leaderboard data and optimizes write throughput.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Configure a TTL attribute for the leaderboard data.
Use DynamoDB Streams to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.
Use AWS Step Functions to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.
Set a higher write capacity when the scheduled delete job runs.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company build online event platform với quizzes và leaderboards

  • Leaderboard data lưu trong DynamoDB, retain 30 days sau event complete

  • Sử dụng scheduled job to delete old data

  • DynamoDB table có fixed write capacity

  • Write API requests bị throttled khi scheduled delete job runs (tháng có nhiều events)

  • Hỏi: long-term solution để delete old data và optimize write throughput?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure a TTL attribute for the leaderboard data.

  • DynamoDB TTL tự động delete expired items without consuming (tiêu thụ) write capacity

  • Zero cost và không impact throughput - runs in background

  • Set TTL = event completion date + 30 days

  • Long-term solution - không cần maintain scheduled job

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use DynamoDB Streams to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.

  • DynamoDB Streams capture data modifications, không phải scheduling tool

  • Vẫn cần custom code để delete - consume write capacity

  • Không optimize throughput

❌ Use AWS Step Functions to schedule and delete the leaderboard data.

  • Step Functions orchestrate workflows nhưng delete operation vẫn consume write capacity

  • Không giải quyết throttling issue

  • Vẫn impact throughput khi delete nhiều items

❌ Set a higher write capacity when the scheduled delete job runs.

  • Tăng cost với higher provisioned capacity

  • Không phải long-term optimal solution

  • Lãng phí capacity khi không chạy delete job

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Delete old data" + "DynamoDB" + "optimize throughput" → TTL

  • "Throttled during delete" → delete operations consume write capacity

  • TTL benefits:

    • Không tiêu thụ write capacity

    • Automatic deletion

    • No scheduled job maintenance

  • DynamoDB Streams ≠ scheduling mechanism

  • Tăng capacity = giải pháp tạm thời, không optimize

📖 Reference:

  • Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer works for a company that only has a single pre-production AWS account with an AWS CloudFormation AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) stack. The developer made changes to an existing AWS Lambda function specified in the AWS SAM template and additional Amazon Simple Notification service (Amazon SNS) topics.

The developer wants to do a one-time deploy of the changes to test if the changes are working. The developer does not want to impact the existing pre-production application that is currently being used by other team members as part of the release pipeline.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to the pre-production AWS account. Specify the debug parameter.
Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and create a change set against the pre-production AWS account. Execute the change set in a new AWS account designated for a development environment.
Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.
Update the CloudFormation stack in the pre-production account. Add a separate stage that points to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer làm việc trong company chỉ có single pre-production AWS account

  • Developer thay đổi existing Lambda function và thêm SNS topics trong SAM template

  • Developer muốn one-time deploy để test changes

  • Không được impact existing pre-production application đang được team members khác sử dụng

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.

  • Deploy vào separate AWS account → hoàn toàn isolated (cô lập), không impact pre-production

  • SAM CLI package và deploy vào dev account

  • One-time deploy để test safely

  • Best practice - tách biệt environments

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and deploy the SAM application to the pre-production AWS account. Specify the debug parameter.

  • Deploy vào pre-production account → có thể impact existing application

  • Debug parameter không tạo isolation

  • Vi phạm requirement "không impact pre-production"

❌ Use the AWS SAM CLI to package and create a change set against the pre-production AWS account. Execute the change set in a new AWS account designated for a development environment.

  • Không thể execute change set từ account này sang account khác

  • Change set phải execute trong cùng account nơi nó được tạo

  • Technically không khả thi

❌ Update the CloudFormation stack in the pre-production account. Add a separate stage that points to a new AWS account designated for a development environment.

  • CloudFormation stack không thể deploy cross-account bằng cách add stage

  • Vẫn modify pre-production stack

  • Không phải cách deploy sang separate account

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Không impact existing environment" + "test changes" → Deploy to separate account/environment

  • SAM deployment isolation:

    • Same account = risk impact existing resources

    • Separate account = complete isolation (hoàn toàn cô lập)

  • Best practice: Dev → Pre-prod → Prod (separate accounts)

📖 Reference:

  • Introduction to deploying with AWS SAM

questions.q:
A company has a mobile app. The app includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API that invokes AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda functions process data from the app.

The company needs to test updated Lambda functions that have new features. The company must conduct these tests with a subset of users before deployment. The tests must not affect other users of the app.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational effort?
o: Create a new version of each Lambda function with a weighted alias. Configure a weight value for each version of the Lambda function. Update the new weighted alias Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the REST API.

Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.
Create a new version of each Lambda function. Integrate a predefined canary deployment in AWS CodeDeploy to slowly shift the traffic to the new versions automatically.

Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda non-proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Specify the necessary parameters and properties in API Gateway. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company có mobile app sử dụng API Gateway REST API invoke Lambda functions

  • Cần test updated Lambda functions với new features

  • Test với subset of users trước khi deploy

  • Không được affect other users

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST operational effort?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a new version of each Lambda function with a weighted alias. Configure a weight value for each version of the Lambda function. Update the new weighted alias Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the REST API.

  • Lambda weighted alias cho phép route traffic giữa 2 versions (vd: 90% v1, 10% v2)

  • Chỉ cần update alias ARN trong API Gateway - không cần tạo new REST API

  • LEAST effort - simple configuration, không cần CodeDeploy hay canary deployment

  • Built-in Lambda feature để test với subset users

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.

  • Tạo new REST API là unnecessary - higher effort

  • API Gateway canary dùng cho API stages, không phải Lambda versions

  • More complex setup

❌ Create a new version of each Lambda function. Integrate a predefined canary deployment in AWS CodeDeploy to slowly shift the traffic to the new versions automatically.

  • CodeDeploy thêm complexity - cần setup deployment configuration

  • More operational effort so với Lambda weighted alias

  • Overkill cho simple testing

❌ Create a new REST API in API Gateway. Set up a Lambda non-proxy integration to connect to multiple Lambda functions. Specify the necessary parameters and properties in API Gateway. Enable canary settings on the deployment stage. Specify a smaller percentage of API traffic to go to the new version of the Lambda function.

  • Tạo new REST API và non-proxy integration = highest effort

  • Non-proxy integration require define request/response mapping

  • Very complex setup

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Test với subset users" + "Lambda" → Weighted alias

  • "LEAST operational effort" → Built-in feature > External tools

  • Lambda traffic shifting options:

    • Weighted alias = simple, built-in

    • CodeDeploy = more features but more setup

    • API Gateway canary = for API stages, not Lambda versions

  • Tạo new REST API = unnecessary effort khi chỉ test Lambda

  • Weighted alias: allocate % traffic between versions (90/10, 80/20, etc.)

📖 Reference:

  • Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias

questions.q:
A company hosts its application on AWS. The application runs on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses AWS Fargate. The cluster runs behind an Application Load Balancer. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora database. A developer encrypts and manages database credentials inside the application.

The company wants to use a more secure credential storage method and implement periodic credential rotation.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Migrate the secret credentials to Amazon RDS parameter groups. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant AWS KMS permissions to access Amazon RDS.

Migrate the credentials to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager.

Migrate the credentials to ECS Fargate environment variables. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager.

Migrate the credentials to AWS Secrets Manager. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager by using keys.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application chạy trên ECS Fargate behind ALB

  • Data stored trong Amazon Aurora database

  • Developer hiện đang encrypt và manage credentials inside application

  • Company muốn secure credential storage và periodic credential rotation (thay đổi định kỳ)

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST operational overhead?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Migrate the credentials to AWS Secrets Manager. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager by using keys.

  • Secrets Manager được thiết kế cho database credentials với automatic rotation built-in

  • Native integration với Aurora - hỗ trợ automatic rotation cho RDS/Aurora

  • Encrypted by default với KMS key

  • LEAST overhead - chỉ cần enable rotation, Secrets Manager tự động rotate và update credentials

  • ECS Fargate retrieve credentials từ Secrets Manager khi startup

Ví dụ setting rotation:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Migrate the secret credentials to Amazon RDS parameter groups. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant AWS KMS permissions to access Amazon RDS.

  • RDS parameter groups dùng cho database configuration, không phải credentials storage

  • Không có built-in rotation cho parameter groups

  • Sai use case

❌ Migrate the credentials to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Encrypt the parameter by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager.

  • Parameter Store không có automatic rotation feature

  • Cần custom Lambda function để rotate - more overhead

  • Đề bài grant permissions to Secrets Manager nhưng store trong Parameter Store - không nhất quán

❌ Migrate the credentials to ECS Fargate environment variables. Encrypt the credentials by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Turn on secret rotation. Use IAM policies and roles to grant Amazon ECS Fargate permissions to access to AWS Secrets Manager by using keys.

  • Environment variables không support automatic rotation

  • Phải redeploy task khi credentials thay đổi

  • Không secure bằng Secrets Manager

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Database credentials" + "automatic rotation" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager = built-in rotation

  • Parameter Store = cần custom Lambda

  • Secrets Manager có native support cho RDS/Aurora credentials

  • Environment variables = static, không rotation

📖 Reference:

  • Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets

questions.q:
A company has built a serverless application for its ecommerce website. The application includes a REST API in Amazon API Gateway that invokes an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function processes data and stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB table. The Lambda function calls a third-party stock application API to process the order. After the ordered is processed, the Lambda function returns an HTTP 200 status code with no body to the client.

During peak usage when the API calls exceeds a certain threshold, the third-party stock application sometimes fails to process the data and responds with error messages. The company needs a solution that will not overwhelm the third-party stock application.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into DynamoDB. Configure a DynamoDB intrinsic function to perform the transformation. Set up a DynamoDB stream to call the third-party stock application API with each new row. Delete the Lambda function.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function with a reserved concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set Lambda function to process the messages from the SQS queue.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure the Lambda function with a provisioned concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set the Lambda function to process the messages from the SNS topic.

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into Amazon Athena. Configure the transformation of the data by using SQL with multiple query result locations set up to point to the DynamoDB table and the third-party stock fulfilment application API. Delete the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application: API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB

  • Lambda function calls third-party stock application API để process order

  • Lambda returns HTTP 200 với no body sau khi processed

  • During peak usage, third-party API sometimes fails khi API calls exceeds threshold

  • Hỏi: solution để không áp đảo third-party application?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda function with a reserved concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set Lambda function to process the messages from the SQS queue.

  • SQS queue decouple và buffer requests - tránh áp đảo third-party API

  • Reserved concurrency limit số Lambda instances chạy đồng thời = third-party threshold (ngưỡng)

  • Lambda process messages từ queue với controlled rate

  • SQS retry failed messages tự động - không mất data khi third-party fails

  • Async processing pattern - API Gateway trả response ngay, Lambda xử lý sau

Amazon API Gateway to SQS to Lambda

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into DynamoDB. Configure a DynamoDB intrinsic function to perform the transformation. Set up a DynamoDB stream to call the third-party stock application API with each new row. Delete the Lambda function.

  • DynamoDB không có "intrinsic function" để call external APIs

  • DynamoDB Streams không control concurrency đến third-party API

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề áp đảo third-party

❌ Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure the Lambda function with a provisioned concurrency equal to the third-party stock application's threshold. Set the Lambda function to process the messages from the SNS topic.

  • Provisioned concurrency dùng để giảm cold start, không limit concurrent executions

  • SNS không buffer messages như SQS - vẫn có thể overwhelm

  • Cần reserved concurrency để limit, không phải provisioned concurrency

❌ Configure the REST API in API Gateway to write the requests directly into Amazon Athena. Configure the transformation of the data by using SQL with multiple query result locations set up to point to the DynamoDB table and the third-party stock fulfilment application API. Delete the Lambda function.

  • Athena dùng cho analytics/querying, không phải message processing

  • Không thể call third-party API từ Athena query

  • Sai use case hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Prevent overwhelming external API" + "peak usage" → SQS queue + Reserved concurrency

  • SQS = buffer/decouple requests, control processing rate

  • Reserved concurrency = limit concurrent Lambda executions

  • Provisioned concurrency = warm instances (giảm cold start), không limit scale

  • SNS = push immediately, không buffer | SQS = queue và buffer

  • Pattern: API Gateway → SQS → Lambda (async processing)

📖 Reference:

  • Configuring reserved concurrency for a function

  • Using Lambda with Amazon SQS

  • Integrate Amazon API Gateway with Amazon SQS to handle asynchronous REST APIs

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that invokes AWS Lambda functions asynchronously to process events. The developer notices that a Lambda function fails to process some events at random times. The developer needs to investigate the failed events and capture the events that the Lambda function fails to process.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Add an Amazon EventBridge rule for the Lambda function. Configure the EventBridge rule to react to failed events and to store the events in an Amazon DynamoDB table.
Configure the Lambda function with a dead-letter queue based in Amazon Kinesis. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.
Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.
Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build application invoke Lambda functions asynchronously

  • Lambda function fails to process some events at random times

  • Developer cần investigate failed events và capture events mà Lambda fails to process

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.

  • Dead-letter queue (DLQ) capture failed events từ async Lambda invocations

  • SQS DLQ lưu trữ events mà Lambda fail to process sau retry attempts

  • Developer có thể investigate failed events trong SQS queue

  • Lambda execution role cần permissions để send messages đến SQS DLQ

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add an Amazon EventBridge rule for the Lambda function. Configure the EventBridge rule to react to failed events and to store the events in an Amazon DynamoDB table.

  • EventBridge không automatically capture Lambda failed events

  • Cần custom configuration và không phải standard pattern cho DLQ

  • More complex setup

❌ Configure the Lambda function with a dead-letter queue based in Amazon Kinesis. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.

  • Lambda async invocation DLQ không support Kinesis

  • Valid destinations: SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda, EventBridge only

  • Kinesis không phải valid DLQ destination

❌ Configure the Lambda function with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO dead-letter queue. Update the Lambda function's execution role with the required permissions.

  • Lambda DLQ chỉ support SQS standard queue, không support FIFO

  • FIFO queue không phải valid destination cho Lambda DLQ

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Async Lambda" + "capture failed events" → Dead-letter queue (DLQ)

  • Lambda async DLQ destinations: SQS (standard only), SNS, S3, Lambda, EventBridge

  • SQS FIFO không support cho Lambda DLQ

  • Kinesis không phải valid DLQ destination

  • SQS standard queue = simplest và most common cho DLQ

📖 Reference:

  • Capturing records of Lambda asynchronous invocations

questions.q:
A company is adopting serverless computing for some of its new services. A development team needs to create a serverless infrastructure by using AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). All infrastructure must be deployed by using AWS CloudFormation templates.

What should the development team do to meet these requirements?
o: Add a Resources section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Lambda::Function resources.
Add a Mappings section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Serverless::Function and AWS::Serverless::API.
Add a Transform section to the CloudFormation templates. Use the AWS SAM syntax to define the resources.
Add a Parameters section to the CloudFormation templates that specifies the relevant AWS SAM Globals section.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company adopting serverless computing

  • Development team cần tạo serverless infrastructure bằng AWS SAM

  • All infrastructure phải deployed bằng CloudFormation templates

  • Hỏi: development team phải làm gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a Transform section to the CloudFormation templates. Use the AWS SAM syntax to define the resources.

  • AWS SAM là extension của CloudFormation, require Transform section với value AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31

  • Transform section cho phép sử dụng SAM syntax (AWS::Serverless::Function, AWS::Serverless::API) trong CloudFormation template

  • CloudFormation tự động transform SAM syntax thành standard CloudFormation resources khi deploy

  • Đây là cách chính thức để integrate SAM với CloudFormation

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a Resources section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Lambda::Function resources.

  • AWS::Lambda::Function là standard CloudFormation resource, không phải SAM

  • Đề bài yêu cầu dùng AWS SAM, không phải plain CloudFormation

  • SAM resource types bắt đầu với AWS::Serverless::, không phải AWS::Lambda::

❌ Add a Mappings section to the CloudFormation templates that contains AWS::Serverless::Function and AWS::Serverless::API.

  • Mappings section dùng để define key-value pairs, không phải define resources

  • SAM resources phải define trong Resources section, không phải Mappings

  • Sai syntax và structure

❌ Add a Parameters section to the CloudFormation templates that specifies the relevant AWS SAM Globals section.

  • Parameters section dùng để pass values vào template

  • Globals section là SAM-specific config, không liên quan đến Parameters

  • Không đủ để enable SAM syntax - vẫn cần Transform section

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "AWS SAM" + "CloudFormation template" → Transform section với AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31

  • SAM template structure: Transform + Resources (với AWS::Serverless:: types)

  • Transform section convert SAM syntax → standard CloudFormation

  • SAM resource types: AWS::Serverless::Function, AWS::Serverless::API, AWS::Serverless::SimpleTable

  • Không có Transform = không thể dùng SAM syntax

📖 Reference:

  • AWS SAM template anatomy

questions.q:
A company needs to deploy all its cloud resources by using AWS CloudFormation templates. A developer must create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) automatic notification to help enforce this rule. The developer creates an SNS topic and subscribes the email address of the company's security team to the SNS topic.

The security team must receive a notification immediately if an IAM role is created without the use of CloudFormation.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to invoke the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Fargate task to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task every 15 minutes.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that includes a script to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the script to publish to the SNS topic. Create a cron job to run the script on tile EC2 instance every 15 minutes.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Specify the SNS topic as the target of the EventBridge rule.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company cần deploy all resources bằng CloudFormation templates

  • Developer tạo SNS topic để enforce rule này

  • Security team phải nhận notification immediately nếu IAM role created without CloudFormation

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Specify the SNS topic as the target of the EventBridge rule.

  • EventBridge rule monitor CloudTrail events real-time cho IAM role creation

  • Filter events dựa trên CloudFormation tag hoặc principal để detect non-CloudFormation creation

  • Notification immediately khi event match - không có delay

  • Serverless, zero infrastructure management

  • EventBridge directly publish đến SNS topic

EventBridge directly publish đến SNS topic

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to invoke the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

  • Scheduled Lambda chạy mỗi 15 phút - không immediate notification

  • Delay lên đến 15 phút trước khi detect

  • Vi phạm requirement "immediately"

❌ Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the Fargate task to publish to the SNS topic. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task every 15 minutes.

  • Scheduled task mỗi 15 phút - không immediate

  • Overkill với Fargate cho simple event filtering

  • Higher cost và complexity

❌ Launch an Amazon EC2 instance that includes a script to filter events from CloudTrail if a role was created without CloudFormation. Configure the script to publish to the SNS topic. Create a cron job to run the script on tile EC2 instance every 15 minutes.

  • EC2 với cron job = highest operational overhead

  • Scheduled mỗi 15 phút - không immediate

  • Cần manage EC2 instance

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Immediate notification" + "CloudTrail events" → EventBridge rule

  • EventBridge = real-time event processing, không có delay

  • Scheduled checks (Lambda/Fargate/EC2 mỗi 15 phút) ≠ immediate

  • EventBridge native integration với CloudTrail và SNS

  • Pattern: CloudTrail → EventBridge → SNS (serverless, real-time)

📖 Reference:

  • Tutorial: Create an EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS API calls via CloudTrail

questions.q:
A developer needs to deploy an application in three AWS Regions by using AWS CloudFormation. Each Region will use an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment with an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The developer wants to use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to deploy SSL certificates to each ALB.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create a certificate in ACM in any one of the Regions. Import the certificate into the ALB that is in each Region.
Create a global certificate in ACM. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the global certificate to each ALB.
Create a certificate in ACM in each Region. Import the certificate into the ALB for each Region.
Create a certificate in ACM in the us-east-1 Region. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the certificate to each ALB.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần deploy application trong three AWS Regions bằng CloudFormation

  • Mỗi Region sử dụng Elastic Beanstalk với ALB

  • Developer muốn dùng ACM để deploy SSL certificates đến mỗi ALB

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a certificate in ACM in each Region. Import the certificate into the ALB for each Region.

  • ACM certificates là regional resources - chỉ available trong Region nơi certificate được tạo

  • ALB chỉ có thể sử dụng ACM certificate trong cùng Region

  • Phải tạo separate certificate trong mỗi Region để attach vào ALB ở Region đó

  • CloudFormation template có thể automate việc tạo certificate trong mỗi Region

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a certificate in ACM in any one of the Regions. Import the certificate into the ALB that is in each Region.

  • ACM certificate không thể share/import cross-region cho ALB

  • Certificate chỉ available trong Region nơi nó được tạo

  • ALB ở Region khác không thể sử dụng certificate này

❌ Create a global certificate in ACM. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the global certificate to each ALB.

  • Không có "global certificate" trong ACM

  • ACM certificates luôn regional (except CloudFront certificates ở us-east-1)

❌ Create a certificate in ACM in the us-east-1 Region. Update the CloudFormation template to deploy the certificate to each ALB.

  • us-east-1 certificates chỉ dùng cho CloudFront, không phải ALB ở regions khác

  • ALB require certificate trong cùng Region

  • Không work cho multi-region ALB deployment

🔑 Tips and tricks:
