  • ACM certificates = regional resources

  • ALB certificate requirement: ACM certificate phải trong cùng Region

  • Exception: CloudFront có thể dùng certificates từ us-east-1

  • Multi-region deployment → cần separate certificate cho mỗi Region

  • Không có "global certificate" cho ALB

📖 Reference:

  • https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html#acm-regions

Certificates in ACM are regional resources. To use a certificate with Elastic Load Balancing for the same fully qualified domain name (FQDN) or set of FQDNs in more than one AWS region, you must request or import a certificate for each region. For certificates provided by ACM, this means you must revalidate each domain name in the certificate for each region. You cannot copy a certificate between regions.

To use an ACM certificate with Amazon CloudFront, you must request or import the certificate in the US East (N. Virginia) region. ACM certificates in this region that are associated with a CloudFront distribution are distributed to all the geographic locations configured for that distribution.

questions.q:
A developer is building an application on AWS. The application includes an AWS Lambda function that processes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

The Lambda function sometimes fails or times out. The developer needs to figure out why the Lambda function fails to process some messages.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Increase the maximum timeout of the Lambda function to 15 minutes. Check the AWS CloudTrail event history for error details.
Increase the visibility timeout of the SQS queue. Check logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for error details.
Create a dead-letter queue. Configure the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the dead-letter queue.
Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the DynamoDB table.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer build application với Lambda function process messages từ SQS queue

  • Lambda function sometimes fails hoặc times out

  • Developer cần figure out why Lambda fails to process messages

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST operational overhead?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a dead-letter queue. Configure the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the dead-letter queue.

  • Dead-letter queue (DLQ) capture failed messages sau khi Lambda retry hết

  • Developer có thể analyze failed messages trong DLQ để understand patterns

  • LEAST overhead - simple configuration, không cần modify code

  • Combined với CloudWatch Logs để see exact errors

  • Standard pattern cho Lambda + SQS error handling

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the maximum timeout of the Lambda function to 15 minutes. Check the AWS CloudTrail event history for error details.

  • CloudTrail không log Lambda execution errors

  • Tăng timeout không giải quyết root cause của failures

  • CloudTrail chỉ track API calls, không phải application errors

❌ Increase the visibility timeout of the SQS queue. Check logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for error details.

  • Tăng visibility timeout giúp ngăn chặn duplicate processing nhưng không capture failed messages

  • CloudWatch Logs có errors nhưng messages failed vẫn lost nếu không có DLQ

  • Không preserve failed messages để investigate

❌ Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the Lambda function to send the failed messages to the DynamoDB table.

  • Require modify Lambda code

  • Higher operational overhead - cần manage DynamoDB table

  • DLQ là standard solution, không cần custom implementation

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda fails + investigate why" → Dead-letter queue (DLQ)

  • DLQ preserve failed messages để analysis

  • Combine DLQ + CloudWatch Logs = complete error investigation

  • SQS DLQ vs Lambda DLQ: cả 2 có thể dùng, context này là Lambda DLQ

  • Standard pattern: SQS → Lambda → DLQ (for failed messages)

📖 Reference:

  • https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-aws-lambda-error-handling-patterns/

questions.q:
A developer uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy an Amazon API Gateway API and an AWS Step Functions state machine. The state machine must reference the API Gateway API after the CloudFormation template is deployed. The developer needs a solution that uses the state machine to reference the API Gateway endpoint.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Configure the CloudFormation template to reference the API endpoint in the DefinitionSubstitutions property for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource.

Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in an environment variable for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource. Configure the state machine to reference the environment variable.
Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.
Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::AppConfig::ConfigurationProfile resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng CloudFormation deploy API Gateway và Step Functions state machine

  • State machine phải reference API Gateway API endpoint sau khi template deployed

  • Hỏi: solution nào MOST cost-effectively?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the CloudFormation template to reference the API endpoint in the DefinitionSubstitutions property for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource.

  • DefinitionSubstitutions cho phép pass dynamic values vào state machine definition khi deploy

  • CloudFormation automatically substitute API endpoint vào state machine

  • MOST cost-effective - zero cost, built-in CloudFormation feature

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in an environment variable for the AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine resource. Configure the state machine to reference the environment variable.

  • Step Functions state machines không support environment variables

  • Environment variables chỉ available cho Lambda functions

  • Không phải valid solution

❌ Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.

  • Secrets Manager có monthly cost per secret

  • Overkill cho public API endpoint (không phải sensitive data)

  • Không cost-effective

❌ Configure the CloudFormation template to store the API endpoint in a standard AWS::AppConfig::ConfigurationProfile resource. Configure the state machine to reference the resource.

  • AppConfig thêm complexity và potential cost

  • Không cần thiết cho static endpoint reference

  • DefinitionSubstitutions đơn giản hơn và free

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Step Functions reference values" + "CloudFormation" → DefinitionSubstitutions

  • DefinitionSubstitutions = inject dynamic values vào state machine definition

  • Step Functions không có environment variables (khác với Lambda)

📖 Reference:

  • AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine DefinitionSubstitutions

Code mẫu cho câu đúng

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: API Gateway and Step Functions with DefinitionSubstitutions

Resources:
  MyApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: MyAPI

  MyApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt MyApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: items
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi

  MyApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref MyApiResource
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  MyApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: MyApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MyApi
      StageName: prod

  MyStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: MyStateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        ApiEndpoint: !Sub "https://${MyApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/items"
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Example using DefinitionSubstitutions",
          "StartAt": "ProcessData",
          "States": {
            "ProcessData": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "ApiEndpoint": "${ApiEndpoint}"
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Value: !Sub "https://${MyApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/items"
  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref MyStateMachine

questions.q:
A company is building a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company wants to deploy the application to its development, test, and production environments.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Use API Gateway stage variables and create Lambda aliases to reference environment-specific resources.
Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to deploy the application to the environments.
Duplicate the code for each environment. Deploy the code to a separate API Gateway stage.
Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the application to the environments.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company build serverless application với API Gateway và Lambda

  • Muốn deploy application vào development, test, và production environments

  • Hỏi: solution với LEAST development effort?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use API Gateway stage variables and create Lambda aliases to reference environment-specific resources.

  • API Gateway stage variables cho phép configure environment-specific values (dev/test/prod)

  • Lambda aliases point đến specific versions cho mỗi environment

  • LEAST effort - single codebase, deploy một lần, sử dụng variables để differentiate environments

  • Stage variables pass values đến Lambda (vd: environment name, resource ARNs)

  • Best practice cho serverless multi-environment deployment

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to deploy the application to the environments.

  • ECS dùng cho container-based applications, không phải serverless Lambda

  • Đề bài đã dùng Lambda - không cần migrate sang ECS

❌ Duplicate the code for each environment. Deploy the code to a separate API Gateway stage.

  • Code duplication = high maintenance effort

  • Phải update code ở 3 places khi có changes

  • Không phải best practice

❌ Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the application to the environments.

  • Elastic Beanstalk không phải optimal cho serverless Lambda applications

  • Thêm unnecessary complexity

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Multi-environment" + "serverless" + "LEAST effort" → Stage variables + Lambda aliases

  • API Gateway stages: dev, test, prod với different stage variables

  • Lambda aliases: dev → version 1, prod → version 2

  • Pattern: Single codebase → multiple environments via configuration

📖 Reference:

  • API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A developer must analyze performance issues with production-distributed applications written as AWS Lambda functions. These distributed Lambda applications invoke other components that make up the applications.

How should the developer identify and troubleshoot the root cause of the performance issues in production?
o: Add logging statements to the Lambda functions, then use Amazon CloudWatch to view the logs.
Use AWS CloudTrail and then examine the logs.
Use AWS X-Ray, then examine the segments and errors.
Run Amazon Inspector agents and then analyze performance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer phải analyze performance issues với production distributed applications

  • Applications là Lambda functions invoke other components

  • Hỏi: làm sao xác định và troubleshoot root cause của performance issues?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS X-Ray, then examine the segments and errors.

  • X-Ray thiết kế cho distributed tracing - track requests qua multiple services

  • Segments show execution time của mỗi component, xác định bottlenecks

  • Service map visualize dependencies và request flow end-to-end

  • Best tool cho troubleshooting performance trong distributed systems

Example X-Ray service map

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add logging statements to the Lambda functions, then use Amazon CloudWatch to view the logs.

  • CloudWatch Logs show các thực thi đơn lẽ, không trace distributed requests

  • Khó liên kết logs từ nhiều services với nhau

❌ Use AWS CloudTrail and then examine the logs.

  • CloudTrail track API calls, không đo đạc performance hay execution time

❌ Run Amazon Inspector agents and then analyze performance.

  • Inspector dùng cho security assessment (scan vulnerabilities, compliance checks)

  • Không phải performance monitoring tool, không measure execution time

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Distributed applications" + "performance troubleshooting" → AWS X-Ray

  • X-Ray = distributed tracing + service map + segments

  • CloudWatch Logs = single service logs

  • CloudTrail = API tracking

  • Inspector = security

📖 Reference:

  • What is AWS X-Ray?

questions.q:
A company is using Amazon OpenSearch Service to implement an audit monitoring system. A developer needs to create an AWS CloudFormation custom resource that is associated with an AWS Lambda function to configure the OpenSearch Service domain. The Lambda function must access the OpenSearch Service domain by using OpenSearch Service internal master user credentials.

What is the MOST secure way to pass these credentials to the Lambda function?
o: Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function’s environment variable. Set the NoEcho attribute to true.

Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and to create a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the NoEcho attribute to true. Create an IAM role that has the ssm:GetParameter permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the parameter name as the Lambda function’s environment variable. Resolve the parameter’s value at runtime.

Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function’s environment variable. Encrypt the parameter’s value by using the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypt command.

Use CloudFormation to create an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Use a CloudFormation dynamic reference to retrieve the secret’s value for the OpenSearch Service domain’s MasterUserOptions. Create an IAM role that has the secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the secret’s name as the Lambda function’s environment variable. Resolve the secret’s value at runtime.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng OpenSearch Service để implement audit monitoring

  • Developer cần tạo CloudFormation custom resource với Lambda function configure OpenSearch domain

  • Lambda function phải access OpenSearch bằng internal master user credentials

  • Hỏi: cách MOST secure để pass credentials đến Lambda function?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use CloudFormation to create an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Use a CloudFormation dynamic reference to retrieve the secret's value for the OpenSearch Service domain's MasterUserOptions. Create an IAM role that has the secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the secret's name as the Lambda function's environment variable. Resolve the secret's value at runtime.

  • Secrets Manager thiết kế cho sensitive credentials management

  • Credentials stored encrypted và không hardcoded anywhere

  • Lambda retrieve credentials at runtime từ Secrets Manager - không store trong environment variables

  • Most secure - credentials rotation support, audit logging, fine-grained access control

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain's MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function's environment variable. Set the NoEcho attribute to true.

  • Environment variables expose credentials (visible trong Lambda console)

  • NoEcho chỉ hide trong CloudFormation, không encrypt storage

❌ Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain's MasterUserOptions and to create a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the NoEcho attribute to true. Create an IAM role that has the ssm:GetParameter permission. Assign the role to the Lambda function. Store the parameter name as the Lambda function's environment variable. Resolve the parameter's value at runtime.

  • Parameter Store có thể work nhưng Secrets Manager tốt hơn cho credentials (rotation support)

  • Secrets Manager là best practice cho database/service credentials

❌ Use a CloudFormation parameter to pass the master user credentials at deployment to the OpenSearch Service domain's MasterUserOptions and the Lambda function's environment variable. Encrypt the parameter's value by using the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypt command.

  • Vẫn store encrypted value trong environment variables - less secure

  • Không có rotation capability như Secrets Manager

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "MOST secure" + "credentials" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager > Parameter Store cho database credentials (rotation support)

  • Environment variables = less secure (visible, no rotation)

  • Best practice: retrieve credentials at runtime, không store trong env vars

📖 Reference:

  • Secrets Manager best practices

questions.q:
A developer is building a serverless application on AWS for a workflow that processes high volumes of data. In the workflow, an AWS Step Functions state machine invokes several AWS Lambda functions.

One of the Lambda functions occasionally fails because of timeout errors during periods of high demand. The developer must ensure that the workflow automatically retries the failed function invocation if a timeout error occurs.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Add a Retry field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts and the timeout error type to retry on.
Add a Timeout field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.
Add a Fail state to the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.

Update the Step Functions state machine to pass the invocation request to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe a Lambda function to the SNS topic. Configure the Lambda function with the maximum number of retry attempts for a timeout error type.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application với Step Functions state machine invokes multiple Lambda functions

  • Một Lambda function occasionally fails vì timeout errors during high demand

  • Developer phải ensure workflow automatically retries failed function nếu timeout error occurs

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a Retry field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts and the timeout error type to retry on.

  • Retry field trong Step Functions cho phép configure automatic retry logic

  • Specify error type (States.Timeout) và max retry attempts

  • Built-in Step Functions feature cho error handling và retry

  • Simple và effective - không cần thêm services

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a Timeout field in the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.

  • Timeout field set execution timeout limit, không configure retry logic

  • Không phải cơ chế cho automatic retry

❌ Add a Fail state to the Step Functions state machine definition. Configure the state machine with the maximum number of retry attempts.

  • Fail state terminate execution với error, không retry

  • Không có retry configuration trong Fail state

❌ Update the Step Functions state machine to pass the invocation request to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe a Lambda function to the SNS topic. Configure the Lambda function with the maximum number of retry attempts for a timeout error type.

  • Over-engineered solution - thêm SNS không cần thiết

  • Step Functions đã có built-in retry, không cần external services

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Step Functions" + "automatic retry" → Retry field

  • Retry field configure: ErrorEquals, MaxAttempts, IntervalSeconds, BackoffRate

  • Timeout field ≠ Retry (Timeout = limit time, Retry = handle errors)

  • Built-in error handling > external services (SNS)

📖 Reference:

  • Handling errors in Step Functions workflows

questions.q:
A developer needs approval from a product owner before the developer can deploy code for an application to production. The developer uses AWS CodePipeline to deploy the application. The developer configures an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications to the product owner.

Which solution is the MOST operationally efficient way for the developer to receive approval from the product owner?
o: Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add a manual approval action to the new stage. Add a new notification rule in the pipeline settings. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to notify the product owner.

Develop an AWS Step Functions state machine that sends a notification to the product owner and accepts an approval. Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add the state machine as a Step Functions action to the new stage.
Add a manual approval action to the existing production deployment stage in CodePipeline. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) while configuring the new manual approval action.

Edit the settings in CodePipeline. Create a new notification rule. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Create a new notification target. Specify the SNS topic to notify the product owner. Save the notification rule.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần approval from product owner trước khi deploy code to production

  • Developer dùng CodePipeline để deploy application

  • Developer đã configure SNS topic để send notifications đến product owner

  • Hỏi: solution nào MOST operationally efficient để receive approval?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add a manual approval action to the new stage. Add a new notification rule in the pipeline settings. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to notify the product owner.

  • Manual approval action trong CodePipeline là built-in feature cho approval workflow

  • New stage trước production đảm bảo approval happens trước deployment

  • Notification rule tự động trigger SNS khi approval needed

  • Most efficient - native CodePipeline functionality, không cần external services

Tham khảo: Building a CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub and AWS Services

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Develop an AWS Step Functions state machine that sends a notification to the product owner and accepts an approval. Add a new stage to CodePipeline before the production deployment. Add the state machine as a Step Functions action to the new stage.

  • Over-engineered - cần develop custom Step Functions state machine

  • CodePipeline đã có built-in manual approval, không cần Step Functions

❌ Add a manual approval action to the existing production deployment stage in CodePipeline. Specify the SNS topic's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) while configuring the new manual approval action.

  • Approval trong same production stage không safe - nên có stage riêng

  • Thiếu notification rule configuration

❌ Edit the settings in CodePipeline. Create a new notification rule. Specify manual approval as the event that initiates the notification. Create a new notification target. Specify the SNS topic to notify the product owner. Save the notification rule.

  • Chỉ tạo notification rule mà không có manual approval action

  • Notification alone không block deployment, cần manual approval action

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Manual approval" + "CodePipeline" → Manual approval action + separate stage

  • Separate approval stage trước production = best practice

  • Manual approval action + notification rule = complete approval workflow

📖 Reference:

  • Add a manual approval action to a pipeline in CodePipeline

questions.q:
A company introduced a new feature that should be accessible to only a specific group of premium customers. A developer needs the ability to turn the feature on and off in response to performance and feedback. The developer needs a solution to validate and deploy these configurations quickly without causing any disruptions.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Use AWS AppConfig to manage the feature configuration and to validate and deploy changes. Use feature flags to turn the feature on and off.
Use AWS Secrets Manager to securely manage and validate the feature configurations. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.
Use AWS Config to manage the feature configuration and validation. Set up AWS Config rules to turn the feature on and off based on predefined conditions.
Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and validate the configuration settings for the feature. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company giới thiệu new feature cho specific group of premium customers

  • Developer cần ability turn feature on and off in response to performance và feedback

  • Cần solution để validate và deploy configurations quickly without disruptions

  • Hỏi: developer phải làm gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS AppConfig to manage the feature configuration and to validate and deploy changes. Use feature flags to turn the feature on and off.

  • AWS AppConfig thiết kế cho dynamic configuration management và feature flags

  • Built-in validation để ensure configurations đúng trước khi deploy

  • Feature flags turn on/off features ngày lập tức without code deployment

  • Best tool cho feature toggles và configuration management

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS Secrets Manager to securely manage and validate the feature configurations. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.

  • Secrets Manager cho credentials/secrets, không phải feature flags

  • Không có lifecycle rules để turn features on/off

  • Sai use case

❌ Use AWS Config to manage the feature configuration and validation. Set up AWS Config rules to turn the feature on and off based on predefined conditions.

  • AWS Config monitor resource compliance (tuân thủ), không phải application configuration

  • Config rules đánh giá compliance, không control feature flags

  • Không phải tool cho feature management

❌ Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and validate the configuration settings for the feature. Enable lifecycle rules to turn the feature on and off.

  • Parameter Store store parameters nhưng không có built-in validation như AppConfig

  • Không có lifecycle rules cho feature toggling

  • Thiếu deployment strategy và validation features

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Feature flags" + "turn on/off" + "validate" → AWS AppConfig

  • AppConfig = feature flags + validation + safe deployment

  • Secrets Manager = credentials | Parameter Store = simple parameters | AppConfig = feature management

  • AppConfig supports gradual rollout và rollback

📖 Reference:

  • Using AWS AppConfig Feature Flags

questions.q:
A company has an analytics application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process transaction data asynchronously. A developer notices that asynchronous invocations of the Lambda function sometimes fail. When failed Lambda function invocations occur, the developer wants to invoke a second Lambda function to handle errors and log details.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure a Lambda function destination with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing on the initial Lambda function. Configure X-Ray to capture stack traces of the failed invocations. Invoke the error-handling Lambda function by including the stack traces in the event object.
Configure a Lambda function trigger with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

Create a status check alarm on the initial Lambda function. Configure the alarm to invoke the error-handling Lambda function when the alarm is initiated. Ensure that the alarm passes the stack trace in the event object.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Analytics application dùng Lambda function process transaction data asynchronously

  • Developer notices asynchronous invocations sometimes fail

  • Khi failed, developer muốn invoke second Lambda function để handle errors và log details

  • Hỏi: solution nào đáp ứng yêu cầu?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure a Lambda function destination with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

  • Lambda destinations cho async invocations support on-failure routing

  • Automatically invoke error-handling Lambda khi original function fails

  • Built-in feature cho async invocation error handling

  • Destinations pass error details và context đến target function

Introducing AWS Lambda Destinations

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing on the initial Lambda function. Configure X-Ray to capture stack traces of the failed invocations. Invoke the error-handling Lambda function by including the stack traces in the event object.

  • X-Ray trace và monitor, không automatically invoke error-handling function

❌ Configure a Lambda function trigger with a failure condition. Specify Lambda function as the destination type. Specify the error-handling Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as the resource.

  • Không có "Lambda function trigger with failure condition"

  • Sai terminology - phải dùng "destination", không phải "trigger"

❌ Create a status check alarm on the initial Lambda function. Configure the alarm to invoke the error-handling Lambda function when the alarm is initiated. Ensure that the alarm passes the stack trace in the event object.

  • CloudWatch alarms không invoke Lambda for individual failed invocations

  • Alarms trigger based on metrics aggregation, không real-time per-invocation

  • Không pass stack trace automatically

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Async Lambda" + "handle failures" → Lambda destinations (on-failure)

  • Destinations = SQS, SNS, Lambda, EventBridge

  • Destinations khác DLQ (destinations include success/failure routing)

  • X-Ray = tracing, không phải error routing

📖 Reference:

  • Introducing AWS Lambda Destinations

questions.q:
A company has on-premises data centers that run an image processing service. The service consists of containerized applications that run on Kubernetes clusters. All the applications have access to the same NFS share for files and data storage.

The company is running out of NFS capacity in the data centers and needs to migrate to AWS as soon as possible. The Kubernetes clusters must be highly available on AWS.

Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.

Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.

Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume at the required path for the container images.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty đang chạy dịch vụ xử lý ảnh trên Kubernetes on-prem, tất cả app chia sẻ cùng một NFS.

  • Dung lượng NFS sắp hết nên cần migrate sang AWS nhanh, cụm Kubernetes trên AWS phải HA.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

  • EFS là dịch vụ file system chuẩn NFS, multi-AZ, HA theo Region → thay thế trực tiếp NFS on-prem.

  • ECR là registry native để lưu container images, tích hợp tốt với EKS.

Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume at the required path for the container images.

  • EKS cung cấp Kubernetes managed, multi-AZ, dễ mở rộng.

  • Dùng EFS CSI driver để mount EFS vào Pod/Node → đáp ứng nhu cầu shared storage như NFS giữa nhiều Pods/Nodes.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Transfer the information that is in the NFS share to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Upload the container images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
→ EBS gắn theo AZ/instance, không đảm bảo chia sẻ đồng thời & HA đa AZ như yêu cầu.

❌ Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.
→ EBS gắn theo AZ/instance, không đảm bảo chia sẻ đồng thời & HA đa AZ như yêu cầu.

❌ Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to run the applications. Configure each node of the cluster to mount the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume at the required path for the container images.
→ EBS gắn theo AZ/instance, không đảm bảo chia sẻ đồng thời & HA đa AZ như yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • NFS on-prem → EFS trên AWS.

  • Kubernetes → EKS (multi-AZ).

  • Container images → ECR.

  • Shared storage giữa Pods/Nodes → EFS CSI driver (Persisted, multi-AZ, HA).

📖 Reference:

Use elastic file system storage with Amazon EFS

Amazon EFS on Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate

questions.q:
A developer created an AWS Lambda function that performs a series of operations that involve multiple AWS services. The function's duration time is higher than normal. To determine the cause of the issue, the developer must investigate traffic between the services without changing the function code.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing in the Lambda function. Review the logs in X-Ray.
Configure AWS CloudTrail. View the trail logs that are associated with the Lambda function.
Review the AWS Config logs in Amazon CloudWatch.
Review the Amazon CloudWatch logs that are associated with the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer có Lambda function gọi nhiều AWS services.

  • Thời gian chạy (duration) cao hơn bình thường.

  • Cần điều tra nguyên nhân → phải phân tích traffic giữa các service, nhưng không được sửa code.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable AWS X-Ray active tracing in the Lambda function. Review the logs in X-Ray.

  • AWS X-Ray cho phép trace toàn bộ luồng request giữa Lambda và các service khác (S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, …).

  • Chỉ cần bật active tracing trong Lambda console (không cần sửa code).

  • Có thể phân tích chi tiết latency, bottleneck. Đây là công cụ chuẩn cho performance troubleshooting.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure AWS CloudTrail. View the trail logs that are associated with the Lambda function.

→ CloudTrail chỉ log API call (audit, security), không phân tích performance hay traffic latency.

❌ Review the AWS Config logs in Amazon CloudWatch.

→ AWS Config = compliance tool (theo dõi resource config change). Không liên quan đến performance hoặc tracing request.

❌ Review the Amazon CloudWatch logs that are associated with the Lambda function.

→ CloudWatch logs chỉ log output và error từ function. Không trace chi tiết traffic giữa các service.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Troubleshoot latency / bottleneck giữa các AWS services → dùng X-Ray.

  • Audit / Security → dùng CloudTrail.

📖 Reference:

Visualize Lambda function invocations using AWS X-Ray

questions.q:
A company has a social media application that receives large amounts of traffic. User posts and interactions are continuously updated in an Amazon RDS database. The data changes frequently, and the data types can be complex. The application must serve read requests with minimal latency.

The application's current architecture struggles to deliver these rapid data updates efficiently. The company needs a solution to improve the application's performance.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.
Set up Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on the RDS database to enhance the speed of data transfer from the databases to the application.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.
Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use a write-through caching strategy and read the data from Redis.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App social media → traffic lớn, dữ liệu lưu trong RDS, thay đổi liên tục, data phức tạp.

  • Yêu cầu: phục vụ read request với latency thấp.

  • Hiện tại RDS struggle → cần giải pháp cải thiện performance.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use a write-through caching strategy and read the data from Redis.

  • ElastiCache for Redis phù hợp cho caching dữ liệu thay đổi nhanh, phức tạp, cung cấp sub-millisecond latency.

  • Write-through caching đảm bảo dữ liệu trong cache luôn đồng bộ với RDS.

  • Đây là pattern chuẩn để giảm tải RDS và tăng tốc read.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.

→ DAX chỉ dùng cho DynamoDB, không thể gắn trực tiếp với RDS.

❌ Set up Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on the RDS database to enhance the speed of data transfer from the databases to the application.

→ Transfer Acceleration chỉ dùng cho S3 object uploads/downloads, không liên quan đến RDS.

❌ Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the RDS database to provide a caching layer for the high volume of rapidly changing data.

→ CloudFront là CDN cho static/dynamic web content, không thể cache query database được.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • RDS + cần cache nhanh → ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached).

  • DynamoDB + cache → DAX.

  • Static content → CloudFront.

📖 Reference:

Write-Through

Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis

questions.q:
A company's developer has deployed an application in AWS by using AWS CloudFormation. The CloudFormation stack includes parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store that the application uses as configuration settings. The application can modify the parameter values.

When the developer updated the stack to create additional resources with tags, the developer noted that the parameter values were reset and that the values ignored the latest changes made by the application. The developer needs to change the way the company deploys the CloudFormation stack. The developer also needs to avoid resetting the parameter values outside the stack.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Modify the CloudFormation stack to set the deletion policy to Retain for the Parameter Store parameters.

Create an Amazon DynamoDB table as a resource in the CloudFormation stack to hold configuration data for the application. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the DynamoDB table.

Create an Amazon RDS DB instance as a resource in the CloudFormation stack. Create a table in the database for parameter configuration. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the configuration table.
Modify the CloudFormation stack policy to deny updates on Parameter Store parameters.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App deploy bằng CloudFormation, Stack tạo tham số trong SSM Parameter Store làm config.

  • Khi update stack để thêm resource/tags thì giá trị tham số bị reset về theo template, bỏ qua thay đổi của app.

  • Cần đổi cách deploy để không bị reset các tham số ngoài stack, với ít effort dev nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the CloudFormation stack policy to deny updates on Parameter Store parameters.

  • CloudFormation khi update stack sẽ “áp” lại property theo template và làm reset SSM Parameter.

  • Đặt stack policy để deny Update cho các tài nguyên SSM Parameter trong stack → lần tạo đầu tiên vẫn tạo được, về sau mọi lần update stack sẽ bỏ qua cập nhật các Parameter

Example stack policy:

{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "Update:*",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "Update:*",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Resource": "LogicalResourceId/ProdDbPasswordParam"
    }
  ]
}

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Modify the CloudFormation stack to set the deletion policy to Retain for the Parameter Store parameters.

→ DeletionPolicy: Retain chỉ tác dụng khi xóa stack/resource, không ngăn việc update làm reset giá trị.

❌ Create an Amazon DynamoDB table as a resource in the CloudFormation stack to hold configuration data for the application. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the DynamoDB table.

→ Chuyển sang DynamoDB đòi hỏi đổi code app, migrate dữ liệu, tăng độ phức tạp. Không phải “least effort”.

❌ Create an Amazon RDS DB instance as a resource in the CloudFormation stack. Create a table in the database for parameter configuration. Migrate the parameters that the application is modifying from Parameter Store to the configuration table.

→ Quá overhead: vận hành DB, schema, đổi code app. Không phù hợp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Config do ứng dụng tự thay đổi + bị CloudFormation “áp” lại khi update → dùng Stack Policy để chặn Update lên resource đó.

  • Cần chỉnh Stack Policy JSON: cho phép Create, Delete nếu cần, nhưng deny Update cho các logical ID của SSM Parameter.

📖 Reference:

Prevent updates to stack resources

questions.q:
A developer is deploying a company's application to Amazon EC2 instances. The application generates gigabytes of data files each day. The files are rarely accessed, but the files must be available to the application's users within minutes of a request during the first year of storage. The company must retain the files for 7 years.

How can the developer implement the application to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class after 1 year.
Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 1 year.
Store the files on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to create snapshots of the EBS volumes and to store those snapshots in Amazon S3.

Store the files on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) mount. Configure EFS lifecycle management to transition the files to the EFS Standard- Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class after 1 year.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EC2 tạo GB dữ liệu mỗi ngày, rất ít truy cập nhưng trong năm đầu nếu có request thì phải có sẵn trong vài phút.

  • Phải giữ 7 năm.

  • Cần giải pháp tiết kiệm chi phí nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class after 1 year.

  • Glacier Instant Retrieval: chi phí thấp hơn S3 Standard cho dữ liệu ít truy cập, truy cập gần như tức thì (ms) – đáp ứng yêu cầu “trong vài phút” của năm đầu.

  • Sau 1 năm, chuyển sang Glacier Deep Archive để tối ưu chi phí lưu trữ dài hạn (7 năm).

  • Kết hợp S3 Lifecycle tự động hóa, tối ưu chi phí toàn vòng đời.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the files to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 1 year.

→ Năm đầu dùng S3 Standard là đắt cho workload ít truy cập; Instant Retrieval rẻ hơn và vẫn đáp ứng SLA truy cập nhanh.

❌ Store the files on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to create snapshots of the EBS volumes and to store those snapshots in Amazon S3.

→ EBS/Snapshot không tối ưu chi phí cho khối lượng lớn, lưu trữ lâu dài; quy trình phức tạp hơn S3 lifecycle.

❌ Store the files on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) mount. Configure EFS lifecycle management to transition the files to the EFS Standard- Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class after 1 year.

→ EFS tối ưu cho file system truy cập thường xuyên/qua NFS, không phải giải pháp lưu trữ dài hạn rẻ cho dữ liệu ít truy cập nhiều năm.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Ít truy cập + cần truy cập nhanh → S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.

  • Lưu trữ dài hạn → chuyển Glacier Deep Archive bằng Lifecycle.

  • Tránh dùng S3 Standard/EBS/EFS cho dữ liệu archive lâu năm.

📖 Reference:

Transitioning objects using Amazon S3 Lifecycle

questions.q:
A developer is investigating an issue in part of a company's application. In the application, messages are sent to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The AWS Lambda function polls messages from the SQS queue and sends email messages by using Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES). Users have been receiving duplicate email messages during periods of high traffic.

Which reasons could explain the duplicate email messages? (Choose two.)
o: Standard SQS queues support at-least-once message delivery.
Standard SQS queues support exactly-once processing, so the duplicate email messages are because of user error.
Amazon SES has the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) authentication incorrectly configured.
The SQS queue's visibility timeout is lower than or the same as the Lambda function's timeout.
The Amazon SES bounce rate metric is too high.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App flow: App → SQS queue → Lambda (poll SQS) → SES (send mail).

  • Vấn đề: user nhận duplicate emails khi traffic cao.

  • Cần tìm nguyên nhân.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Standard SQS queues support at-least-once message delivery.

→ Standard SQS chỉ đảm bảo at-least-once → có thể gửi duplicate messages.

The SQS queue's visibility timeout is lower than or the same as the Lambda function's timeout.

→ Nếu visibility timeout ≤ Lambda timeout, message có thể “reappear” trong queue trước khi Lambda xử lý xong → Lambda khác sẽ lấy lại message → duplicate processing.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Standard SQS queues support exactly-once processing, so the duplicate email messages are because of user error.

→ Chỉ FIFO queue mới hỗ trợ exactly-once + ordering. Standard queue chỉ at-least-once.

❌ Amazon SES has the DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) authentication incorrectly configured.

→ DKIM sai thì email có thể bị đánh spam/reject, không gây duplicate email.

❌ The Amazon SES bounce rate metric is too high.

→ Bounce rate cao chỉ ảnh hưởng đến reputation và quota, không sinh ra duplicate emails.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • SQS Standard = at-least-once → app cần thiết kế idempotent consumer.

  • Visibility timeout phải > Lambda processing time để tránh xử lý trùng lặp.

📖 Reference:

Amazon SQS standard queues

questions.q:
A data visualization company wants to strengthen the security of its core applications. The applications are deployed on AWS across its development, staging, pre-production, and production environments. The company needs to encrypt all of its stored sensitive credentials. The sensitive credentials need to be automatically rotated. A version of the sensitive credentials need to be stored for each environment.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Configure AWS Secrets Manager versions to store different copies of the same credentials across multiple environments.
Create a new parameter version in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for each environment. Store the environment-specific credentials in the parameter version.
Configure the environment variables in the application code. Use different names for each environment type.
Configure AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret for each environment type. Store the environment-specific credentials in the secret.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

Công ty có nhiều môi trường (dev, staging, pre-prod, prod). Cần:

  • Mã hóa sensitive credentials.

  • Tự động rotate credentials.

  • Mỗi môi trường có 1 secret riêng.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret for each environment type. Store the environment-specific credentials in the secret.

  • Secrets Manager hỗ trợ encryption bằng KMS, auto rotation built-in (ví dụ RDS password, API keys, custom Lambda rotation).

  • Tạo secret riêng cho từng environment → dễ quản lý, không bị ghi đè.

  • Đáp ứng cả yêu cầu security + operational efficiency.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure AWS Secrets Manager versions to store different copies of the same credentials across multiple environments.

→ Version trong một secret chỉ dùng cho rotation của 1 credential, không để tách nhiều environment.

❌ Create a new parameter version in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for each environment.

→ Parameter Store có thể lưu credentials, nhưng rotation không native (phải custom Lambda). Không tối ưu effort như Secrets Manager.

❌ Configure the environment variables in the application code. Use different names for each environment type.

→ Env vars không được mã hóa, không có rotation, quản lý kém an toàn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Secrets Manager = auto rotation, KMS encryption → chọn khi có sensitive creds.

  • Parameter Store = config management, rotation manual.

📖 Reference:

Managed rotation for AWS Secrets Manager secrets

questions.q:
A company runs an application on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that is configured with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue called high priority queue as the event source. A developer is updating the Lambda function with another SQS queue called low priority queue as the event source. The Lambda function must always read up to 10 simultaneous messages from the high priority queue before processing messages from low priority queue. The Lambda function must be limited to 100 simultaneous invocations.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Set the event source mapping batch size to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.
Set the delivery delay to 0 seconds for the high priority queue and to 10 seconds for the low priority queue.
Set the event source mapping maximum concurrency to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.
Set the event source mapping batch window to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App có Lambda function đọc message từ 2 SQS queue:

    • High priority queue → phải luôn đọc tối đa 10 message song song trước.

    • Low priority queue → chỉ xử lý sau đó.

  • Lambda phải giới hạn 100 concurrent invocations.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the event source mapping maximum concurrency to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.

  • Mỗi event source mapping (SQS → Lambda) có thể config Maximum concurrency.

  • Với High Priority Queue → set max 10 ⇒ Lambda chỉ xử lý tối đa 10 concurrent.

  • Với Low Priority Queue → set max 90 ⇒ phần còn lại.

  • Tổng cộng = 100 concurrent invocations.

  • Đảm bảo High Priority luôn được ưu tiên xử lý trước.

Maximum concurrency is set to 10 for High Priority Queue:

Setting maximum concurrency for SQS as an event source:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set the event source mapping batch size to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.

→ Batch size = số message/lần invoke, không điều khiển concurrency hay ưu tiên queue.

❌ Set the delivery delay to 0 seconds for the high priority queue and to 10 seconds for the low priority queue.

→ Delivery delay chỉ ảnh hưởng thời điểm message vào queue, không ảnh hưởng concurrency hay ưu tiên đọc.

❌ Set the event source mapping batch window to 10 for the high priority queue and to 90 for the low priority queue.

→ Batch window = thời gian chờ để gom message, không đảm bảo concurrency hay ưu tiên queue.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Nhiều SQS → Lambda → dùng event source mapping max concurrency để chia resource.

  • Batch size = số message mỗi invoke, Batch window = thời gian gom batch.

  • Ưu tiên xử lý queue quan trọng hơn → config concurrency phù hợp.

📖 Reference:

Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping

Introducing maximum concurrency of AWS Lambda functions when using Amazon SQS as an event source

questions.q: When using the AWS Encryption SDK, how does the developer keep track of the data encryption keys used to encrypt data?
o: The developer must manually keep track of the data encryption keys used for each data object.
The SDK encrypts the data encryption key and stores it (encrypted) as part of the returned ciphertext.
The SDK stores the data encryption keys automatically in Amazon S3.
The data encryption key is stored in the Userdata for the EC2 instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Câu hỏi về AWS Encryption SDK.

  • Khi mã hóa dữ liệu, cần biết cơ chế SDK quản lý Data Encryption Key (DEK) thế nào để có thể giải mã sau này.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
The SDK encrypts the data encryption key and stores it (encrypted) as part of the returned ciphertext.

  • AWS Encryption SDK sẽ tự động tạo Data Encryption Key (DEK), dùng DEK để mã hóa dữ liệu.

  • Sau đó, DEK này được wrap/encrypt bằng Customer Master Key (CMK) và gắn kèm trong ciphertext.

  • Khi cần giải mã, SDK sẽ lấy DEK đã được mã hóa trong ciphertext, giải mã nó bằng CMK, và dùng DEK để giải mã dữ liệu.

  • Developer không cần tự quản lý DEK.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ The developer must manually keep track of the data encryption keys used for each data object.
→ Không cần, SDK lo phần này.

❌ The SDK stores the data encryption keys automatically in Amazon S3.
→ Sai, SDK không lưu DEK ở S3. Ciphertext có chứa DEK đã được mã hóa.

❌ The data encryption key is stored in the Userdata for the EC2 instance.
→ Hoàn toàn sai, không liên quan. Userdata không phải nơi lưu DEK.

🔑 Tips and tricks:
Encryption SDK = Envelope Encryption. DEK được wrap bằng CMK và gắn trong ciphertext.

📖 Reference:
Concepts in the AWS Encryption SDK

questions.q:
A developer is creating an Amazon DynamoDB table by using the AWS CLI. The DynamoDB table must use server-side encryption with an AWS owned encryption key.

How should the developer create the DynamoDB table to meet these requirements?
o: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create an AWS owned key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.
Create the DynamoDB table with the default encryption options.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo DynamoDB table bằng AWS CLI.

  • Yêu cầu: bật server-side encryption (SSE) với AWS owned key.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create the DynamoDB table with the default encryption options.

  • DynamoDB mặc định luôn bật SSE.

  • Nếu không chỉ định KMSMasterKeyId, DynamoDB sẽ dùng AWS owned key.

  • Đây là cách đơn giản và đúng yêu cầu, không cần thao tác thêm.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.

→ Customer managed key ≠ AWS owned key. Đây là lựa chọn nâng cao, không đúng yêu cầu đề.

❌ Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.

→ AWS managed key (do AWS quản lý trong KMS) khác với AWS owned key (không expose cho user).

❌ Create an AWS owned key. Provide the key's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the KMSMasterKeyId parameter during creation of the DynamoDB table.

→ AWS owned key không có ARN, user không thể tham chiếu trực tiếp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DynamoDB SSE luôn bật theo mặc định dùng AWS owned key.

📖 Reference:

AWS DynamoDB Encryption at Rest

questions.q:
A developer is creating a serverless application that uses an AWS Lambda function. The developer will use AWS CloudFormation to deploy the application. The application will write logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The developer has created a log group in a CloudFormation template for the application to use. The developer needs to modify the CloudFormation template to make the name of the log group available to the application at runtime.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Use the AWS::Include transform in CloudFormation to provide the log group's name to the application.
Pass the log group's name to the application in the user data section of the CloudFormation template.
Use the CloudFormation template's Mappings section to specify the log group's name for the application.
Pass the log group's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as an environment variable to the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo serverless app dùng AWS Lambda, deploy bằng CloudFormation.

  • App ghi log vào CloudWatch Logs.

  • Developer đã tạo log group trong template và cần truyền tên log group cho Lambda để dùng lúc runtime.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Pass the log group's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) as an environment variable to the Lambda function.

  • Lambda có thể nhận tham số runtime thông qua environment variables trong CloudFormation.

  • Khi tạo log group trong template, có thể tham chiếu ARN (hoặc tên) và set làm env var cho Lambda.

  • Đây là cách chính thống để truyền giá trị động từ CloudFormation sang Lambda.

CloudFormation template:

Resources:
  MyLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-log-group"

  MyLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: MyFunction
      Handler: app.handler
      Runtime: python3.13
      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-role/MyLambdaRole
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_GROUP_ARN: !GetAtt MyLogGroup.Arn
      # TODO: code cho Lambda (S3 code package hoặc ZipFile) khi deploy thật:
      # Code:
      #   S3Bucket: your-bucket
      #   S3Key: your-key

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the AWS::Include transform in CloudFormation to provide the log group's name to the application.

→ AWS::Include dùng để import snippets (macro), không để truyền giá trị runtime cho Lambda.

❌ Pass the log group's name to the application in the user data section of the CloudFormation template.

→ UserData chỉ dùng cho EC2 instance bootstrap, không áp dụng cho Lambda.

❌ Use the CloudFormation template's Mappings section to specify the log group's name for the application.

→ Mappings là static lookup (ví dụ Region → AMI ID), không tự động inject vào Lambda runtime.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda runtime config → dùng Environment variables.

  • CloudFormation hỗ trợ tham chiếu tài nguyên trong template để gán cho environment variables.

📖 Reference:

AWS::Lambda::Function Environment

questions.q:
A developer wants to deploy a new version of an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application. During deployment, the application must maintain full capacity and avoid service interruption. Additionally, the developer must minimize the cost of additional resources that support the deployment.

Which deployment method should the developer use to meet these requirements?
o: All at once
Rolling with additional batch
Blue/green
Immutable
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:
Dev muốn deploy version mới cho ứng dụng Elastic Beanstalk.
Yêu cầu:

  • Giữ nguyên full capacity (không downtime).

  • Không gián đoạn service.

  • Giảm thiểu chi phí tài nguyên bổ sung khi deploy.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Rolling with additional batch

  • Cách này deploy theo từng batch, tạo thêm một batch instance tạm thời để thay thế, rồi terminate batch cũ sau khi xong.

  • Đảm bảo luôn đủ capacity (vì có thêm batch phụ tạm thời).

  • Chi phí tăng nhẹ (ít hơn blue/green hoặc immutable).

  • Đáp ứng tốt yêu cầu: không downtime + chi phí phụ ít nhất.

Các đáp án sai:
❌ All at once
→ Deploy đồng loạt → downtime vì toàn bộ instance update cùng lúc. Không đáp ứng "no interruption".

❌ Blue/green
→ Tạo full environment mới rồi switch traffic. Không downtime, nhưng chi phí cao vì phải nhân đôi.

❌ Immutable
→ Tạo toàn bộ instance mới rồi redirect traffic. Không downtime nhưng chi phí cao gần như gấp đôi .

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Elastic Beanstalk deploy methods:

  • All at once → nhanh, có downtime.

  • Rolling → no downtime, lâu.

  • Rolling with additional batch → no downtime, chi phí vừa phải, lâu.

  • Immutable / Blue-green → no downtime, chi phí cao.

📖 Reference:
Deploying applications to Elastic Beanstalk environments

questions.q:
An AWS Lambda function requires read access to an Amazon S3 bucket and requires read/write access to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The correct IAM policy already exists.

What is the MOST secure way to grant the Lambda function access to the S3 bucket and the DynamoDB table?
o: Attach the existing IAM policy to the Lambda function.
Create an IAM role for the Lambda function. Attach the existing IAM policy to the role. Attach the role to the Lambda function.
Create an IAM user with programmatic access. Attach the existing IAM policy to the user. Add the user access key ID and secret access key as environment variables in the Lambda function.
Add the AWS account root user access key ID and secret access key as encrypted environment variables in the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda cần quyền read S3 bucket và read/write DynamoDB table.

  • IAM policy đúng đã tồn tại.

  • Hỏi: cách cấp quyền bảo mật nhất?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an IAM role for the Lambda function. Attach the existing IAM policy to the role. Attach the role to the Lambda function.

  • Lambda nên chạy với IAM execution role, không dùng access key.

  • Policy gắn vào Role, rồi gán Role cho Lambda ⇒ AWS tự cấp temporary credentials.

  • Đây là best practice của AWS về security & least privilege.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Attach the existing IAM policy to the Lambda function.

→ Lambda không gắn policy trực tiếp, chỉ gắn Role.

❌ Create an IAM user with programmatic access. Attach the existing IAM policy to the user. Add the user access key ID and secret access key as environment variables in the Lambda function.

→ Dùng IAM user + access key hardcode là bad practice, dễ lộ credentials.

❌ Add the AWS account root user access key ID and secret access key as encrypted environment variables in the Lambda function.

→ Rất nguy hiểm. Root user không bao giờ dùng cho ứng dụng.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda → luôn dùng IAM Role, không dùng access key.

  • Root user chỉ dành cho quản trị ban đầu, tuyệt đối không gắn cho resource.

📖 Reference:

AWS Lambda Execution Role

questions.q:
A developer designed an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application makes API requests to objects in an Amazon S3 bucket.

Which combination of steps will ensure that the application makes the API requests in the MOST secure manner? (Choose two.)
o: Create an IAM user that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Add the user to an IAM group.
Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket.
Add the IAM role to an instance profile. Attach the instance profile to the EC2 instance.
Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Assign the role to an IAM group.
Store the credentials of the IAM user in the environment variables on the EC2 instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên EC2, cần gọi API tới S3 bucket.

  • Yêu cầu: cách bảo mật nhất để app gọi API.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket.

Add the IAM role to an instance profile. Attach the instance profile to the EC2 instance.

  • Đây là best practice: gán IAM Role cho EC2 thông qua Instance Profile.

  • AWS cấp temporary credentials tự động, không cần lưu secret key.

  • Ứng dụng có thể gọi S3 API bằng SDK/AWS CLI mà không cần hardcode credentials.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM user that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Add the user to an IAM group.

→ IAM user = static credentials, dễ lộ, không phải secure nhất.

❌ Create an IAM role that has permissions to the S3 bucket. Assign the role to an IAM group.

→ IAM role không thể gán vào IAM group, chỉ gán cho resource (EC2, Lambda, …).

❌ Store the credentials of the IAM user in the environment variables on the EC2 instance.

→ Dùng access key trong env variables = bad practice, dễ compromise.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • EC2 quyền truy cập AWS resource → luôn dùng IAM Role via Instance Profile.

  • Tránh hardcode hoặc lưu IAM User credentials.

📖 Reference:

Using an IAM Role to Grant Permissions to Applications Running on Amazon EC2

questions.q:
A developer must use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is in another AWS account.

Which AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) API operation should the developer use with the MFA information to meet this requirement?
o: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
GetFederationToken
AssumeRoleWithSAML
AssumeRole
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần truy cập S3 bucket ở account khác.

  • Yêu cầu: phải dùng MFA để được cấp quyền truy cập.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

AssumeRole

  • Khi cross-account access, dùng IAM Role ở account chứa S3 bucket.

  • AssumeRole hỗ trợ truyền MFA token.

  • STS sẽ trả temporary credentials → dùng để truy cập S3.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity

→ Dùng cho federated login từ web identity provider (OIDC như Google, Facebook, Cognito), không phải MFA IAM.

❌ GetFederationToken

→ Cho phép user federation trong cùng account, không hỗ trợ MFA cross-account role.

❌ AssumeRoleWithSAML

→ Dùng cho federated login qua SAML IdP (ADFS, Okta...), không phải MFA token trực tiếp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cross-account + MFA → AssumeRole.

  • Federation (SAML/WebIdentity) chỉ khi user đến từ IdP bên ngoài.

📖 Reference:

AWS STS AssumeRole API

Assume an IAM role that requires an MFA token with AWS STS using an AWS SDK

How Do I Protect Cross-Account Access Using MFA?

questions.q:
A developer is testing a RESTful application that is deployed by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. When the developer tests the user login by using credentials that are not valid, the developer receives an HTTP 405: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED error. The developer has verified that the test is sending the correct request for the resource.

Which HTTP error should the application return in response to the request?
o: HTTP 401
HTTP 404
HTTP 503
HTTP 505
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App RESTful dùng API Gateway + Lambda.

  • Khi login bằng credentials không hợp lệ, dev nhận về 405: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (sai).

  • Hỏi: response HTTP code đúng trong trường hợp login fail (credentials invalid) là gì?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

HTTP 401

→ 401 Unauthorized nghĩa là request hợp lệ nhưng credentials không đúng hoặc không cung cấp.

→ Đây là code chuẩn khi user login bằng username/password sai.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ HTTP 404

→ “Not Found”: dùng khi resource không tồn tại, không liên quan đến login.

❌ HTTP 503

→ “Service Unavailable”: dùng khi server tạm thời quá tải hoặc maintenance, không phải login fail.

❌ HTTP 505

→ “HTTP Version Not Supported”: dùng khi server không hỗ trợ version HTTP request, không liên quan.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Auth fail (login sai) → 401 Unauthorized.

📖 Reference:

Gateway response types for API Gateway

questions.q:
A developer creates a static website for their department. The developer deploys the static assets for the website to an Amazon S3 bucket and serves the assets with Amazon CloudFront. The developer uses origin access control (OAC) on the CloudFront distribution to access the S3 bucket.

The developer notices users can access the root URL and specific pages but cannot access directories without specifying a file name. For example, /products/index.html works, but /products/ returns an error. The developer needs to enable accessing directories without specifying a file name without exposing the S3 bucket publicly.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Update the CloudFront distribution's settings to index.html as the default root object is set.

Update the Amazon S3 bucket settings and enable static website hosting. Specify index.html as the Index document. Update the S3 bucket policy to enable access. Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the S3 website endpoint.

Create a CloudFront function that examines the request URL and appends index.html when directories are being accessed. Add the function as a viewer request CloudFront function to the CloudFront distribution's behavior.

Create a custom error response on the CloudFront distribution with the HTTP error code set to the HTTP 404 Not Found response code and the response page path to /index.html. Set the HTTP response code to the HTTP 200 OK response code.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev host website tĩnh trên S3 + CloudFront, dùng OAC (bucket private).

  • Truy cập /products/index.html OK nhưng /products/ báo lỗi.

  • Cần enable truy cập dạng thư mục (tự thêm index.html) mà vẫn giữ S3 không public.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create a CloudFront function that examines the request URL and appends index.html when directories are being accessed. Add the function as a viewer request CloudFront function to the CloudFront distribution's behavior.

  • Với OAC, origin dùng S3 REST endpoint (không phải website endpoint), nên S3 không tự “điền” index.html cho từng thư mục.

  • Dùng CloudFront Function (hoặc Lambda@Edge) ở Viewer Request để rewrite URI: nếu URL kết thúc bằng / (hoặc không có đuôi file), tự động append index.html.

  • Giữ được bucket private (OAC vẫn hoạt động), không cần bật S3 static website hosting.

CloudFront Function example:

async function handler(event) {
    var request = event.request;
    var uri = request.uri;
    
    // Check whether the URI is missing a file name.
    if (uri.endsWith('/')) {
        request.uri += 'index.html';
    } 
    // Check whether the URI is missing a file extension.
    else if (!uri.includes('.')) {
        request.uri += '/index.html';
    }
    return request;
}

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Update the CloudFront distribution's settings to index.html as the default root object is set.
→ Default Root Object chỉ áp dụng cho root path /, không tự áp cho các subdirectory như /products/.

❌ Update the Amazon S3 bucket settings and enable static website hosting. Specify index.html as the Index document. Update the S3 bucket policy to enable access. Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the S3 website endpoint.
→ Website endpoint không hỗ trợ OAC và thường yêu cầu bucket public/policy cho public read → trái yêu cầu “không expose S3 publicly”.

❌ Create a custom error response on the CloudFront distribution with the HTTP error code set to the HTTP 404 Not Found response code and the response page path to /index.html. Set the HTTP response code to the HTTP 200 OK response code.
→ Đây chỉ trả về root index.html, không phục vụ đúng products/index.html. Còn gây sai mã lỗi/SEO và không giải quyết logic index theo thư mục.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Dùng CloudFront Function (Viewer Request) để URL rewrite (append index.html) khi origin là S3 REST + OAC.

📖 Reference:

Add index.html to request URLs without a file name in a CloudFront Functions viewer request event

Introducing CloudFront Functions

questions.q:
A company has built an AWS Lambda function to convert large image files into output files that can be used in a third-party viewer application. The company recently added a new module to the function to improve the output of the generated files. However, the new module has increased the bundle size and has increased the time that is needed to deploy changes to the function code.

How can a developer increase the speed of the Lambda function deployment?
o: Use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the function code.
Use Lambda layers to package and load dependencies.
Increase the memory size of the function.
Use Amazon S3 to host the function dependencies.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function convert image files.

  • Thêm module mới → bundle size lớn, deploy chậm.

  • Hỏi: cách tăng tốc deployment Lambda code?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Lambda layers to package and load dependencies.

  • Lambda layer tách dependencies (lib, module) khỏi function code.

  • Khi deploy, chỉ cần update function code nhỏ gọn, không phải upload toàn bộ dependencies nữa.

  • Giúp giảm bundle size, nhanh hơn khi deploy và dễ tái sử dụng giữa nhiều function.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the function code.

→ CodeDeploy quản lý deployment strategy (linear, canary, all-at-once), không giải quyết vấn đề bundle size/deploy speed.

❌ Increase the memory size of the function.

→ Chỉ ảnh hưởng đến runtime performance, không ảnh hưởng tốc độ deploy code.

❌ Use Amazon S3 to host the function dependencies.

→ Lambda không tự load dependencies từ S3. Phải đóng gói và upload cùng function hoặc layer.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda deploy chậm thường do package lớn → Lambda Layers để tách dependencies.

📖 Reference:

AWS Lambda Layers

questions.q:
A photo sharing application uses Amazon S3 to store image files. All user images are manually audited for inappropriate content by a third-party company. The audits are completed 1-24 hours after user upload and the results are written to an Amazon DynamoDB table, which uses the S3 object key as a primary key. The database items can be queried by using a REST API created by the third-party company.

An application developer needs to implement an automated process to tag all S3 objects with the results of the content audit.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Write the S3 key to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a visibility timeout of 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to read items from the queue. Retrieve the results for each item from the DynamoDB table. Tag each S3 object accordingly.

Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Integrate the function into an AWS Step Functions standard workflow. Define an AWS Step Functions Wait state and set the value to 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to retrieve the audit results and tag the S3 objects accordingly after the Wait state is over.

Create an AWS Lambda function to load all untagged S3 objects. Retrieve the results for each item from the REST API and tag each S3 object accordingly. Create and configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to run at regular intervals. Set the Lambda function as a target for the EventBridge rule.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Deploy a script to the EC2 instance to use the external database results to tag the S3 objects accordingly. Configure a crontab file to run the script at regular intervals.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App lưu ảnh lên S3.

  • Bên thứ ba audit nội dung, hoàn tất sau 1–24h và ghi kết quả vào DynamoDB (key = S3 object key), expose qua REST API.

  • Mục tiêu: tự động gắn tag cho mọi object S3 theo kết quả audit, vận hành ít tốn công nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS Lambda function to load all untagged S3 objects. Retrieve the results for each item from the REST API and tag each S3 object accordingly. Create and configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to run at regular intervals. Set the Lambda function as a target for the EventBridge rule.

  • Dùng EventBridge schedule gọi 1 Lambda định kỳ (ví dụ mỗi 30–60 phút) để: liệt kê object chưa có tag kết quả → gọi REST API (của bên thứ ba) lấy kết quả → S3 PutObjectTagging.

  • Kiến trúc đơn giản, không cần chờ đợi theo-object, không phải giữ state/queue/timer 24h.

  • Chi phí thấp, ít vận hành.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Write the S3 key to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a visibility timeout of 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to read items from the queue. Retrieve the results for each item from the DynamoDB table. Tag each S3 object accordingly.

→ SQS visibility timeout tối đa 12 giờ, không đáp ứng yêu cầu “tới 24h”. Còn tăng complexity với 2 Lambda + queue.
