❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to run in response to the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Integrate the function into an AWS Step Functions standard workflow. Define an AWS Step Functions Wait state and set the value to 24 hours. Create and configure a second Lambda function to retrieve the audit results and tag the S3 objects accordingly after the Wait state is over.

→ Chờ cố định 24h gây trễ không cần thiết (audit có thể xong sau 1h). Step Functions giữ state lâu, tăng chi phí và độ phức tạp.

❌ Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Deploy a script to the EC2 instance to use the external database results to tag the S3 objects accordingly. Configure a crontab file to run the script at regular intervals.

→ Dùng EC2 + cron làm tăng vận hành (patching, scaling, HA) so với serverless. Không “operationally efficient”.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Batch theo lịch (EventBridge) phù hợp quy trình hoàn tất không đồng bộ (1–24h).

  • Tagging S3: dùng PutObjectTagging.

📖 Reference:

Invoke a Lambda function on a schedule

questions.q:
A company has a web application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are configured to stream logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company needs to receive an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when the number of application error messages exceeds a defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Rewrite the application code to stream application logs to Amazon SNS. Configure an SNS topic to send a notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.
Configure a subscription filter on the CloudWatch Logs log group. Configure the filter to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

Install and configure the Amazon Inspector agent on the EC2 instances to monitor for errors. Configure Amazon Inspector to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

Create a CloudWatch metric filter to match the application error pattern in the log data. Set up a CloudWatch alarm based on the new custom metric. Configure the alarm to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EC2, log đẩy vào CloudWatch Logs.

  • Cần nhận thông báo SNS khi số error messages vượt ngưỡng trong 5 phút.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a CloudWatch metric filter to match the application error pattern in the log data. Set up a CloudWatch alarm based on the new custom metric. Configure the alarm to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

  • Dùng CloudWatch Logs metric filter để chuyển số lỗi thành custom metric.

  • Tạo CloudWatch Alarm với period = 5 minutes & threshold phù hợp.

  • Alarm notify qua SNS khi vượt ngưỡng.

  • Đây là giải pháp native, event-driven, ít vận hành.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Rewrite the application code to stream application logs to Amazon SNS. Configure an SNS topic to send a notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

→ SNS không có chức năng đếm/threshold theo thời gian; việc sửa code là không cần thiết và sai hướng.

❌ Configure a subscription filter on the CloudWatch Logs log group. Configure the filter to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

→ Subscription filter chỉ để stream log (tới Lambda/Kinesis/Firehose), không tự đếm và so ngưỡng theo thời gian.

❌ Install and configure the Amazon Inspector agent on the EC2 instances to monitor for errors. Configure Amazon Inspector to send an SNS notification when the number of errors exceeds the defined threshold within a 5-minute period.

→ Amazon Inspector là dịch vụ bảo mật/vulnerability, không dùng để phân tích log hay đặt ngưỡng lỗi.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

CloudWatch Logs metric filter để chuyển số lỗi thành custom metric → CloudWatch Alarm → SNS

📖 Reference:

Example: Count log events

Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms

questions.q:
A developer is designing a serverless application for a game in which users register and log in through a web browser. The application makes requests on behalf of users to a set of AWS Lambda functions that run behind an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API.

The developer needs to implement a solution to register and log in users on the application's sign-in page. The solution must minimize operational overhead and must minimize ongoing management of user identities.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create Amazon Cognito user pools for external social identity providers. Configure IAM roles for the identity pools.
Program the sign-in page to create users' IAM groups with the IAM roles attached to the groups.
Create an Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance to store the users and manage the permissions to the backend resources in AWS.
Configure the sign-in page to register and store the users and their passwords in an Amazon DynamoDB table with an attached IAM policy.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng game serverless, user đăng ký & đăng nhập qua web → gọi API Gateway → Lambda.

  • Yêu cầu: quản lý user login/registration, ít vận hành, không phải tự quản lý user identities.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create Amazon Cognito user pools for external social identity providers. Configure IAM roles for the identity pools.

  • Cognito User Pool: quản lý đăng ký/đăng nhập, lưu trữ user, tích hợp social login (Google, Facebook, Apple…).

  • Cognito Identity Pool: cấp IAM role tạm thời cho user đã auth để gọi API Gateway/Lambda.

  • Đây là dịch vụ managed, serverless, không tự quản lý user identities → đúng yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Program the sign-in page to create users' IAM groups with the IAM roles attached to the groups.

→ IAM dành cho quản trị AWS account, không dành cho quản lý end-user ứng dụng.

❌ Create an Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance to store the users and manage the permissions to the backend resources in AWS.

→ RDS yêu cầu vận hành DB, backup, scaling. Quản lý user/password thủ công → overhead cao và sai hướng.

❌ Configure the sign-in page to register and store the users and their passwords in an Amazon DynamoDB table with an attached IAM policy.

→ Không có built-in auth (hash, reset password, MFA, social login), phải tự build auth logic → rủi ro bảo mật cao.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Auth cho end-user app → luôn nghĩ đến Amazon Cognito (User Pool + Identity Pool).

  • IAM chỉ dành cho quản trị AWS account, không dùng trực tiếp cho user app.

📖 Reference:

Amazon Cognito User Pools

Access AWS services with a user pool and an identity pool

questions.q:
A developer needs to implement a custom machine learning (ML) library in an application. The size of the library is 15 GB. The size of the library is increasing. The application uses AWS Lambda functions. All the Lambda functions must have access to the library.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Save the library in Lambda layers. Attach the layers to all Lambda functions.
Save the library in Amazon S3. Download the library from Amazon S3 inside the Lambda function.
Save the library as a Lambda container image. Redeploy the Lambda functions with the new image.
Save the library in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all the Lambda functions.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng dùng AWS Lambda, cần dùng thư viện ML 15 GB (còn tăng thêm).

  • Tất cả Lambda function phải truy cập thư viện này.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Save the library in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all the Lambda functions.

  • Amazon EFS hỗ trợ lưu trữ shared, không giới hạn dung lượng lớn, mount trực tiếp cho nhiều Lambda function

  • Truy cập library ngay, đúng yêu cầu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Save the library in Lambda layers. Attach the layers to all Lambda functions.

→ Layer size max 250 MB → không thể chứa 15 GB.

❌ Save the library in Amazon S3. Download the library from Amazon S3 inside the Lambda function.

→ Overhead cao, mỗi lần Lambda cold start phải download 15 GB → cực chậm & tốn chi phí.

❌ Save the library as a Lambda container image. Redeploy the Lambda functions with the new image.

→ Container image giới hạn 10 GB → không chứa được 15 GB.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda cần thư viện > 10 GB → chỉ có Amazon EFS là phù hợp.

📖 Reference:

Using Amazon EFS with AWS Lambda

questions.q:
A developer supports an application that accesses data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. One of the item attributes is expirationDate in the timestamp format. The application uses this attribute to find items, archive them, and remove them from the table based on the timestamp value.

The application will be decommissioned soon, and the developer must find another way to implement this functionality. The developer needs a solution that will require the least amount of code to write.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Create a DynamoDB stream. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the deleted items. Create a DynamoDB trigger for the Lambda function.

Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create a DynamoDB stream. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB stream and process them.

Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the Lambda functions. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB table and process them.

Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Specify an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue as the target to delete the items. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the items.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App đang dùng thuộc tính expirationDate (timestamp) trong DynamoDB để tìm → lưu trữ (archive) → xóa item.

  • App sắp bị retire, cần cách khác ít phải viết code nhất để duy trì chức năng này.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Create a DynamoDB stream. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the deleted items. Create a DynamoDB trigger for the Lambda function.

  • Bật DynamoDB TTL trên expirationDate để tự động xóa item khi hết hạn (best-effort).

  • TTL deletions xuất hiện trên DynamoDB Streams (eventName = REMOVE, userIdentity = dynamodb.amazonaws.com).

  • Gắn Lambda trigger vào stream để xử lý/archiving các item vừa bị TTL xóa.

  • Ít code nhất: không cần tự viết logic xóa hay lịch chạy.

Enable time to live:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create a DynamoDB stream. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB stream and process them.

→ Tự viết logic xóa bằng DeleteItem + đọc stream bằng API → nhiều code và vận hành hơn so với TTL + trigger.

❌ Create two AWS Lambda functions: one to delete the items and one to process the items. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke the Lambda functions. Use the DeleteItem API operation to delete the items based on the expirationDate attribute. Use the GetRecords API operation to get the items from the DynamoDB table and process them.

→ Cron + quét + DeleteItem + đọc bảng để xử lý ⇒ nặng vận hành và tốn chi phí (scan/queries), không tối ưu.

❌ Enable TTL on the expirationDate attribute in the table. Specify an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) dead-letter queue as the target to delete the items. Create an AWS Lambda function to process the items.

→ TTL không hỗ trợ cấu hình SQS DLQ làm “target”. TTL chỉ xóa và (nếu bật) ghi vào Streams.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cần auto delete theo timestamp trong DynamoDB → nghĩ ngay TTL.

📖 Reference:

Enable time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB

Using DynamoDB Streams and Lambda to archive TTL deleted items

questions.q:
A company is preparing to migrate an application to the company's first AWS environment. Before this migration, a developer is creating a proof-of-concept application to validate a model for building and deploying container-based applications on AWS.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to deploy the containerized proof-of-concept application with the LEAST operational effort? (Choose two.)
o: Package the application into a .zip file by using a command line tool. Upload the package to Amazon S3.
Package the application into a container image by using the Docker CLI. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
Deploy the application to an Amazon EC2 instance by using AWS CodeDeploy.
Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on AWS Fargate.
Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty chuẩn bị migrate app lên AWS, dev cần làm PoC container-based app để validate mô hình.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Package the application into a container image by using the Docker CLI. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).

→ Docker build → push ECR: chuẩn best practice cho container image.

Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.

→ ECS + Fargate: serverless container runtime → không cần quản lý cluster/EC2 node → ít vận hành nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Package the application into a .zip file by using a command line tool. Upload the package to Amazon S3.

→ Dùng cho Lambda chứ không phải container-based app.

❌ Deploy the application to an Amazon EC2 instance by using AWS CodeDeploy.

→ Phải quản lý EC2 server + CodeDeploy config → nhiều effort vận hành.

❌ Deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on AWS Fargate.

→ EKS cần setup cluster, nodegroup, RBAC, manifest… → overhead cao hơn ECS.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Container PoC → chọn Elastic Container Registry (ECR) + ECS Fargate (serverless, fully managed).

📖 Reference:

Fargate launch type for Amazon ECS

Using Amazon ECR images with Amazon ECS

questions.q:
A company is building an application on AWS. The application's backend includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API. The company's frontend application developers cannot continue work until the backend API is ready for integration. The company needs a solution that will allow the frontend application developers to continue their work.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
o: Configure mock integrations for API Gateway API methods.
Integrate a Lambda function with API Gateway and return a mocked response.
Add new API endpoints to the API Gateway stage and returns a mocked response.
Configure a proxy resource for API Gateway API methods.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Frontend dev chưa thể tiếp tục vì backend API Gateway REST API chưa sẵn sàng.

  • Cần giải pháp cho phép frontend tiếp tục dev/test.

  • Yêu cầu: ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure mock integrations for API Gateway API methods.

  • API Gateway có sẵn mock integration → không cần Lambda, backend hay proxy.

  • Cho phép định nghĩa request/response mẫu để frontend test ngay.

  • Native, ít vận hành nhất, chỉ cấu hình trong API Gateway.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Integrate a Lambda function with API Gateway and return a mocked response.

→ Phải viết & deploy Lambda code → thêm overhead không cần thiết.

❌ Add new API endpoints to the API Gateway stage and returns a mocked response.

→ Không có khái niệm "add stage endpoint để trả mock" trong API Gateway. Sai kiến thức.

❌ Configure a proxy resource for API Gateway API methods.

→ Proxy resource forward request đến backend (ví dụ Lambda, HTTP endpoint) → không giải quyết yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Nếu backend chưa sẵn → API Gateway Mock Integration là best practice.

📖 Reference:

Enable mock integration using the API Gateway console

questions.q:
An Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue serves as an event source for an AWS Lambda function. In the SQS queue, each item corresponds to a video file that the Lambda function must convert to a smaller resolution. The Lambda function is timing out on longer video files, but the Lambda function's timeout is already configured to its maximum value.

What should a developer do to avoid the timeouts without additional code changes?
o: Increase the memory configuration of the Lambda function.
Increase the visibility timeout on the SQS queue.
Increase the instance size of the host that runs the Lambda function.
Use multi-threading for the conversion.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda xử lý SQS event → convert video.

  • Với video dài, Lambda bị timeout, dù đã set max timeout (15 phút).

  • Cần tránh timeout mà không thay đổi code.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the memory configuration of the Lambda function.

  • Trong Lambda, CPU power tỉ lệ với memory.

  • Tăng memory → tăng CPU → tăng tốc độ xử lý video → có thể hoàn thành trong 15 phút.

  • Không cần chỉnh code, chỉ update config.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the visibility timeout on the SQS queue.

→ Đã set max timeout (15 phút). Không giúp Lambda tránh timeout.

❌ Increase the instance size of the host that runs the Lambda function.

→ Lambda không cho chọn instance size. Compute power scale theo memory allocation.

❌ Use multi-threading for the conversion.

→ Yêu cầu thay đổi code → vi phạm điều kiện "không code changes".

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lambda compute power = function(memory).

📖 Reference:

Configure Lambda function memory

questions.q:
A company has an application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores objects in an Amazon S3 bucket and allows users to download objects from the S3 bucket. A developer turns on S3 Block Public Access for the S3 bucket. After this change, users report errors when they attempt to download objects. The developer needs to implement a solution so that only users who are signed in to the application can access objects in the S3 bucket.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way? (Choose two.)
o: Create an EC2 instance profile and role with an appropriate policy. Associate the role with the EC2 instances.
Create an IAM user with an appropriate policy. Store the access key ID and secret access key on the EC2 instances.
Modify the application to use the S3 GeneratePresignedUrl API call.
Modify the application to use the S3 GetObject API call and to return the object handle to the user.
Modify the application to delegate requests to the S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EC2, lưu object ở S3 và cho user tải về.

  • Bật S3 Block Public Access làm user không tải được nữa.

  • Cần giải pháp để chỉ user đã đăng nhập trong app mới tải được object S3.

  • Mục tiêu: bảo mật nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an EC2 instance profile and role with an appropriate policy. Associate the role with the EC2 instances.

  • Dùng IAM Role (instance profile) cho EC2 để ứng dụng có quyền truy cập S3 an toàn, không dùng access key.

  • Gán quyền tối thiểu cần thiết (ví dụ s3:GetObject cho đúng bucket/prefix).

Modify the application to use the S3 GeneratePresignedUrl API call.

  • Ứng dụng (chạy trên EC2 với role) sẽ tạo pre-signed URL có thời hạn ngắn sau khi xác thực user

  • client tải trực tiếp từ S3 mà không public bucket.

  • Cơ chế này đảm bảo chỉ user đã đăng nhập mới nhận được URL hợp lệ trong thời gian ngắn

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM user with an appropriate policy. Store the access key ID and secret access key on the EC2 instances.

→ Lưu access key trên EC2 là không an toàn, khó xoay vòng; trái với best practice (nên dùng IAM role).

❌ Modify the application to use the S3 GetObject API call and to return the object handle to the user.

→ “Trả object handle” sẽ buộc app proxy dữ liệu qua EC2 → tốn băng thông/chi phí.

❌ Modify the application to delegate requests to the S3 bucket.

→ Mơ hồ và không giải quyết được yêu cầu kiểm soát truy cập ở phía client.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • S3 Block Public Access + pre-signed URL = cho tải an toàn mà không cần mở public.

  • Ưu tiên IAM role cho EC2 thay vì access key tĩnh.

  • Đặt expiry ngắn cho pre-signed URL (ví dụ 5–15 phút) và lọc quyền theo prefix/user nếu cần.

📖 Reference:

Sharing objects with presigned URLs

questions.q:
A company notices that credentials that the company uses to connect to an external software as a service (SaaS) vendor are stored in a configuration file as plaintext.

The developer needs to secure the API credentials and enforce automatic credentials rotation on a quarterly basis.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?
o: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the configuration file. Decrypt the configuration file when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor. Enable rotation.
Retrieve temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) every 15 minutes. Use the temporary credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.
Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager and enable rotation. Configure the API to have Secrets Manager access.
Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and enable rotation. Retrieve the credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Thông tin đăng nhập API gọi tới SaaS bên ngoài đang lưu plaintext trong file config.

  • Cần bảo mật và tự động rotate hàng quý.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager and enable rotation. Configure the API to have Secrets Manager access.

  • AWS Secrets Manager lưu trữ bí mật an toàn, mã hóa bằng KMS, có native rotation.

  • Tích hợp quyền truy cập qua IAM để app gọi Secrets Manager lấy secret khi cần, không cần lưu plaintext.

  • Có audit, version, policy fine-grained → bảo mật & vận hành tối thiểu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the configuration file. Decrypt the configuration file when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor. Enable rotation.

→ KMS không quản lý secret lifecycle và không tự rotate secret.

❌ Retrieve temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) every 15 minutes. Use the temporary credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.

→ STS cấp AWS temporary creds để gọi AWS services, không dành cho SaaS external. Không giải quyết việc lưu/rotate secret SaaS.

❌ Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and enable rotation. Retrieve the credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.

→ Parameter Store (SecureString) lưu được secret nhưng không có rotation.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Secret của ứng dụng (API key, token SaaS) → Secrets Manager (lưu trữ + rotation).

📖 Reference:

Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets

questions.q:
A developer is optimizing an AWS Lambda function and wants to test the changes in production on a small percentage of all traffic. The Lambda function serves requests to a REST API in Amazon API Gateway. The developer needs to deploy their changes and perform a test in production without changing the API Gateway URL.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish the API to the canary stage.

Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy a new API Gateway stage.

Define an alias on the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function alias. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish to the canary stage.

Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy the API to the production API Gateway stage.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda sau API Gateway (REST API).

  • Dev muốn thử code tối ưu trên một phần nhỏ traffic ngay trên production nhưng không đổi URL API Gateway.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish the API to the canary stage.

  • Sử dụng API Gateway Stage Canary để chuyển một phần (%) traffic production sang deployment canary trỏ vào code mới ($LATEST / version mới).

  • Giữ nguyên URL (cùng stage), không cần tạo stage mới.

  • Đây là cách ít vận hành để canary test trực tiếp trên production.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy a new API Gateway stage.

→ Tạo stage mới sẽ có URL khác → vi phạm yêu cầu “không đổi URL”.

❌ Define an alias on the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function alias. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish to the canary stage.

→ Pha trộn Lambda alias với API Gateway canary nhưng lại yêu cầu chuyển endpoint sang $LATEST, gây rủi ro đẩy toàn bộ traffic về bản mới.

❌ Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy the API to the production API Gateway stage.

→ Không có canary (không chia % traffic) → không đáp ứng yêu cầu test trên một phần nhỏ traffic.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • REST API hỗ trợ Stage Canary (chia traffic giữa 2 deployments cùng stage).

  • Thực tế hay làm: publish Lambda version mới → tạo deployment mới (integration trỏ version mới) → bật canary trên prod stage và đặt percentage.

📖 Reference:

Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that consumes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The developer notices that the Lambda function processes some messages multiple times.

How should developer resolve this issue MOST cost-effectively?
o: Change the Amazon SQS standard queue to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue by using the Amazon SQS message deduplication ID.
Set up a dead-letter queue.
Set the maximum concurrency limit of the AWS Lambda function to 1.
Change the message processing to use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams instead of Amazon SQS.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda đọc message từ SQS Standard queue.

  • Dev thấy message đôi khi bị xử lý nhiều lần.

  • Cần giải pháp tiết kiệm chi phí nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Change the Amazon SQS standard queue to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue by using the Amazon SQS message deduplication ID.

  • SQS Standard chỉ đảm bảo at-least-once delivery → message có thể bị gửi lặp.

  • Phải dùng FIFO queue + deduplication ID để đảm bảo exactly-once processing.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up a dead-letter queue.

→ DLQ dùng cho message không xử lý thành công, không giải quyết vấn đề duplicate delivery.

❌ Set the maximum concurrency limit of the AWS Lambda function to 1.

→ Chỉ làm chậm throughput, không loại bỏ việc Standard Queue gửi trùng. Message vẫn bị duplicate.

❌ Change the message processing to use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams instead of Amazon SQS.

→ Kinesis có use case riêng (event streaming, ordered partition). Thay thế SQS chỉ để tránh duplicate là không cost-effective, phức tạp và sai use case.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • SQS Standard = at-least-once, best-effort order.

  • SQS FIFO = exactly-once (khi dùng deduplication ID).

  • Khi gặp duplicate processing với SQS Standard → hoặc design idempotent consumer, hoặc đổi sang FIFO nếu business bắt buộc exactly-once.

📖 Reference:

Using the message deduplication ID in Amazon SQS

Exactly-once processing in Amazon SQS

questions.q:
A developer is updating the production version of an AWS Lambda function to fix a defect. The developer has tested the updated code in a test environment. The developer wants to slowly roll out the updates to a small subset of production users before rolling out the changes to all users. Only 10% of the users should be initially exposed to the new code in production.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function trigger. Configure the traffic weights in the trigger between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

Create a new Lambda function that uses the updated code. Create a Lambda alias for the production Lambda function. Configure the Lambda alias to send 90% of the traffic to the production Lambda function, and send 10% of the traffic to the test Lambda function.

Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda proxy integration. Configure the Lambda proxy to split traffic between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function alias. Configure the traffic weights in the Lambda alias between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev muốn deploy bản fix Lambda lên production theo kiểu canary rollout

  • Ban đầu chỉ 10% traffic được dùng code mới, còn 90% vẫn chạy code cũ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function alias. Configure the traffic weights in the Lambda alias between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

  • Lambda Alias hỗ trợ traffic shifting (weighted aliases) giữa nhiều versions.

  • Đây là cơ chế native, chính thức cho rollout dần trong Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function trigger. Configure the traffic weights in the trigger between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

→ Trigger (S3, API Gateway, SQS…) không có traffic weighting. Việc weighted chỉ làm được qua Lambda alias.

❌ Create a new Lambda function that uses the updated code. Create a Lambda alias for the production Lambda function. Configure the Lambda alias to send 90% of the traffic to the production Lambda function, and send 10% of the traffic to the test Lambda function.

→ Alias hoạt động trên versions của cùng một function, không dùng để chia traffic giữa hai Lambda khác nhau.

❌ Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda proxy integration. Configure the Lambda proxy to split traffic between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

→ Proxy (ví dụ API Gateway/LB) phải config thêm logic chia traffic → phức tạp & tốn effort.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda alias = pointer tới version, có thể chia traffic giữa nhiều version.

  • Canary/linear rollout cho Lambda → dùng alias weighted traffic shifting.

📖 Reference:

AWS Lambda Aliases and Traffic Shifting

Building well-architected serverless applications: Approaching application lifecycle management

questions.q:
A company is building a compute-intensive application that will run on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storing data. The Amazon EBS volumes will be created at time of initial deployment. The application will process sensitive information. All of the data must be encrypted. The solution should not impact the application's performance.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure the fleet of EC2 instances to use encrypted EBS volumes to store data.
Configure the application to write all data to an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.
Configure a custom encryption algorithm for the application that will encrypt and decrypt all data.
Configure an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that has an encrypted root volume and store the data to ephemeral disks.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng compute-intensive chạy trên EC2, dữ liệu lưu trên EBS volumes (tạo khi deploy).

  • Dữ liệu nhạy cảm → phải encrypt nhưng không ảnh hưởng hiệu năng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure the fleet of EC2 instances to use encrypted EBS volumes to store data.

  • EBS encryption được hỗ trợ native, sử dụng AWS KMS + AES-256.

  • Tích hợp ở storage layer, hoàn toàn transparently với ứng dụng.

  • Không ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến performance vì encryption/decryption được xử lý bởi hardware acceleration.

  • Đúng yêu cầu: bảo mật + hiệu năng + ít effort.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the application to write all data to an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.

→ App đang thiết kế dùng EBS volumes, không phải S3. Bắt buộc rewrite logic → không phù hợp.

❌ Configure a custom encryption algorithm for the application that will encrypt and decrypt all data.

→ Tốn effort dev + overhead CPU xử lý encryption trong app layer → ảnh hưởng performance và không cần thiết.

❌ Configure an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that has an encrypted root volume and store the data to ephemeral disks.

→ Ephemeral disks (Instance Store) không hỗ trợ encryption mặc định. Hơn nữa data sẽ mất khi stop/terminate instance → không phù hợp cho dữ liệu nhạy cảm cần persist.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Yêu cầu encrypt dữ liệu trên EBS → luôn nhớ EBS encryption (at-rest).

📖 Reference:

Amazon EBS encryption

Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default

questions.q:
An application that runs on AWS receives messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and processes the messages in batches. The application sends the data to another SQS queue to be consumed by another legacy application. The legacy system can take up to 5 minutes to process some transaction data.

A developer wants to ensure that there are no out-of-order updates in the legacy system. The developer cannot alter the behavior of the legacy system.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the visibility timeout value.
Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the DelaySeconds values.
Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the visibility timeout value.
Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the DelaySeconds value.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng đọc batch messages từ SQS và gửi qua SQS khác cho legacy app.

  • Legacy app mất đến 5 phút để xử lý một số transaction.

  • Yêu cầu: đảm bảo không có out-of-order updates trong legacy system.

  • Dev không thể chỉnh sửa legacy app.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the visibility timeout value.

  • SQS FIFO: đảm bảo exactly-once processing + ordered delivery.

  • Legacy app xử lý chậm (5 phút) ⇒ cần set visibility timeout ≥ 5 phút để message chưa bị re-deliver sớm gây out-of-order.

  • Kết hợp FIFO + visibility timeout ⇒ đảm bảo không bị mất thứ tự.

SQS FIFO queue:

Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the DelaySeconds values.

→ Standard queue không đảm bảo ordering, DelaySeconds chỉ trì hoãn delivery, không giải quyết ordering.

❌ Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the visibility timeout value.

→ Visibility timeout chỉ tránh xử lý lại quá sớm, nhưng Standard queue không đảm bảo ordering.

❌ Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the DelaySeconds value.

→ FIFO đảm bảo ordering, nhưng DelaySeconds chỉ trì hoãn việc gửi message, không liên quan tới việc xử lý chậm trong 5 phút.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Out-of-order updates → luôn nghĩ đến SQS FIFO.

  • Legacy system xử lý chậm → chỉnh visibility timeout ≥ processing time.

  • Standard queue = at-least-once, best-effort order → không phù hợp khi cần strict order.

📖 Reference:

Solving Complex Ordering Challenges with Amazon SQS FIFO Queues

Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout

questions.q:
A company is building a new application that runs on AWS and uses Amazon API Gateway to expose APIs. Teams of developers are working on separate components of the application in parallel. The company wants to publish an API without an integrated backend so that teams that depend on the application backend can continue the development work before the API backend development is complete.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to MOCK. Configure the method integration request and integration response to associate a response with an HTTP status code. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.
Create an AWS Lambda function that returns mocked responses and various HTTP status codes. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS_PROXY. Deploy the API.
Create an EC2 application that returns mocked HTTP responses. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.

Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value set to HTTP_PROXY. Add mapping templates and deploy the API. Create an AWS Lambda layer that returns various HTTP status codes. Associate the Lambda layer with the API deployment.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty build app mới trên AWS, dùng API Gateway để expose API.

  • Nhiều team phát triển song song.

  • Yêu cầu: publish API trước khi backend sẵn sàng để các team khác tiếp tục dev/test.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to MOCK. Configure the method integration request and integration response to associate a response with an HTTP status code. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.

  • API Gateway Mock Integration cho phép API trả về mocked responses (HTTP status, body) mà không cần backend.

  • Cho phép nhiều team phát triển song song, trong khi backend chưa sẵn sàng.

  • Native, ít vận hành nhất (không cần Lambda, EC2, proxy).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function that returns mocked responses and various HTTP status codes. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS_PROXY. Deploy the API.

→ Có thể mock response, nhưng phải viết & deploy Lambda → nhiều effort hơn. Không tối ưu.

❌ Create an EC2 application that returns mocked HTTP responses. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.

→ Phải quản lý EC2 instance chỉ để trả mock response → quá phức tạp và tốn chi phí.

❌ Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value set to HTTP_PROXY. Add mapping templates and deploy the API. Create an AWS Lambda layer that returns various HTTP status codes. Associate the Lambda layer with the API deployment.

→ HTTP proxy integration cần backend thực sự. Lambda layer không thể tự “trả response” cho API Gateway.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway MOCK integration = best practice khi backend chưa sẵn.

  • Đặt sẵn mapping templates & status codes → cho team frontend test sớm.

📖 Reference:

Enable mock integration using the API Gateway console

questions.q:
A developer manages three AWS accounts. Each account contains an Amazon RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The developer needs to define users in each database in a consistent way. The developer must ensure that the same users are created and updated later in all three accounts.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?
o: Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Declare the users in the template. Attach the users to the database. Deploy the template in each account.
Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a custom resource to create the users in the database. Deploy the template in each account.
Write a script that creates the users. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance in each account to run the script on the databases. Run the script in each account.
Implement an AWS Lambda function that creates the users in the database. Provide the function with the details of all three accounts.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • 3 AWS accounts, mỗi account có 1 RDS DB instance trong private subnet.

  • Cần tạo và cập nhật users trong DB theo cách nhất quán ở cả 3 account.

  • Ưu tiên giải pháp ít effort vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a custom resource to create the users in the database. Deploy the template in each account.

  • CloudFormation không quản lý user-level bên trong DB trực tiếp, nên cần Custom Resource (Lambda) để chạy SQL (CREATE/ALTER user) một cách idempotent.

  • Mọi thay đổi về user được quản trị qua CloudFormation change set → dễ lặp lại, versioned, audit được.

  • Chỉ cần “deploy template” là đồng bộ user across accounts/regions. (Nếu muốn mở rộng, có thể dùng StackSets cho multi-account.)

Các đáp án sai:
❌ Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Declare the users in the template. Attach the users to the database. Deploy the template in each account.
→ CloudFormation không có resource natively để “khai báo user DB” và “attach” vào RDS.

❌ Write a script that creates the users. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance in each account to run the script on the databases. Run the script in each account.
→ Vận hành overhead: phải quản lý EC2, patching, secret, lịch chạy, idempotency, retry…

❌ Implement an AWS Lambda function that creates the users in the database. Provide the function with the details of all three accounts.
→ Cross-account + private subnet làm phức tạp network (VPC peering/Transit Gateway, security group, routing). Khó vận hành và rủi ro bảo mật/secret hơn so với triển khai local-per-account qua CFN.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Quản trị nội dung bên trong DB (users/roles/schema) qua CloudFormation Custom Resource (Lambda) để đảm bảo idempotent + repeatable.

  • Multi-account triển khai đồng bộ → cân nhắc StackSets để giảm thao tác thủ công.

📖 Reference:

How custom resources work

AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource

Automate post-database creation scripts or steps in an Amazon RDS

questions.q:
A company wants to test its web application more frequently. The company deploys the application by using a separate AWS CloudFormation stack for each environment. The company deploys the same CloudFormation template to each stack as the application progresses through the development lifecycle.

A developer needs to build in notifications for the quality assurance (QA) team. The developer wants the notifications to occur for new deployments in the final preproduction environment.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the QA team to the Amazon SNS topic. Update the CloudFormation stack options to point to the SNS topic in the pre-production environment.

Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function on the default event bus. Filter the events on the CloudFormation service and on the CloudFormation stack Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors the metrics from CloudFormation. Filter the metrics on the stack name and the stack status. Configure the CloudWatch alarm to notify the QA team.

Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Configure the event source mapping to receive events from CloudFormation. Specify the filtering values to limit invocations to the desired CloudFormation stack.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty deploy app bằng CloudFormation, mỗi môi trường = 1 stack.

  • QA team cần nhận thông báo khi có deployment mới ở môi trường pre-production cuối cùng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function on the default event bus. Filter the events on the CloudFormation service and on the CloudFormation stack Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

  • CloudFormation phát events khi stack được tạo/cập nhật.

  • EventBridge có thể filter theo service = CloudFormation + ARN stack pre-prod → chỉ bắt sự kiện ở môi trường này.

  • Lambda chỉ cần gửi thông báo (SNS/email/Slack).

  • Đây là cách event-driven, serverless, ít vận hành nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the QA team to the Amazon SNS topic. Update the CloudFormation stack options to point to the SNS topic in the pre-production environment.

→ CloudFormation không linh hoạt filter chính xác chỉ cho pre-prod. Không native bằng EventBridge rule.

❌ Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors the metrics from CloudFormation. Filter the metrics on the stack name and the stack status. Configure the CloudWatch alarm to notify the QA team.

→ CloudFormation không xuất metrics chi tiết cho từng deployment/stack update.

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function that notifies the QA team. Configure the event source mapping to receive events from CloudFormation. Specify the filtering values to limit invocations to the desired CloudFormation stack.

→ CloudFormation không phải event source để mapping trực tiếp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn “notify khi stack thay đổi” → CloudFormation events → EventBridge rule → Lambda/SNS.

📖 Reference:

Monitoring CloudFormation and Git sync events with EventBridge

questions.q:
A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances open connections to an Amazon RDS for SQL Server database. A developer needs to store and access the credentials and wants to automatically rotate the credentials. The developer does not want to store the credentials for the database in the code.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?
o: Create an IAM role that has permissions to access the database. Attach the IAM role to the EC2 instances.
Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database. Retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager as needed.

Store the credentials in an encrypted text file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instance launch template to download the credentials from Amazon S3 as the instance launches. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database.
Store the credentials in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Events rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to periodically update the secrets and database.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên EC2, kết nối đến RDS for SQL Server.

  • Cần lưu trữ credentials an toàn, có tự động rotation, và không hardcode trong code.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database. Retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager as needed.

  • AWS Secrets Manager: dịch vụ chuyên để quản lý secret (DB password, API key).

  • Hỗ trợ native rotation cho Amazon RDS (bao gồm SQL Server) thông qua Lambda rotation function.

  • App chỉ cần gọi Secrets Manager API để lấy credentials, không cần lưu cứng trong code.

  • Đây là giải pháp an toàn nhất & ít effort nhất.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM role that has permissions to access the database. Attach the IAM role to the EC2 instances.

→ IAM role cấp quyền đến AWS services, không dùng để auth trực tiếp với RDS SQL Server (trừ khi RDS là Aurora với IAM DB Auth, nhưng SQL Server không hỗ trợ).

❌ Store the credentials in an encrypted text file in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instance launch template to download the credentials from Amazon S3 as the instance launches. Create an AWS Lambda function to update the secrets and the database.

→ Tự build cơ chế rotate + Lambda update DB + S3 update. Overhead cao và không secure bằng Secrets Manager.

❌ Store the credentials in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Events rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to periodically update the secrets and database.

→ DynamoDB không chuyên lưu secret. Tự build rotation logic → phức tạp & không best practice.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Với RDS, Secrets Manager luôn là best practice cho credential + rotation.

📖 Reference:

How to connect to AWS Secrets Manager service within a Virtual Private Cloud

questions.q:
A developer is writing an application that will retrieve sensitive data from a third-party system. The application will format the data into a PDF file. The PDF file could be more than 1 MB. The application will encrypt the data to disk by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The application will decrypt the file when a user requests to download it. The retrieval and formatting portions of the application are complete.

The developer needs to use the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the PDF file so that the PDF file can be decrypted later. The developer needs to use an AWS KMS symmetric customer managed key for encryption.

Which solutions will meet these requirements?
o: Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.
Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev viết app lấy dữ liệu nhạy cảm từ hệ thống bên thứ 3, format thành PDF (>1MB).

  • File PDF cần được mã hóa bằng AWS KMS (CMK symmetric).

  • Quy trình:

    • GenerateDataKey → nhận về Plaintext key + Encrypted key.

    • Dùng Plaintext key để mã hóa file (file lớn nên không mã hóa trực tiếp bằng KMS).

    • Lưu Encrypted key để giải mã về sau.

  • Yêu cầu: chọn giải pháp đúng để mã hóa/decrypt file PDF.

✅ Đáp án đúng:
Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
→ Đây là cách chuẩn:

  • Plaintext key: dùng ngay để encrypt file PDF bằng AES256 (hoặc symmetric algo).

  • Encrypted key: lưu trữ an toàn để sau này dùng KMS Decrypt khôi phục plaintext key.

  • File lớn → phải dùng client-side encryption, không gọi KMS Encrypt trực tiếp cho file.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API and a symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt the file.
→ Sai: Không bao giờ lưu plaintext key xuống disk. Encrypted key không thể dùng trực tiếp để encrypt file.

❌ Write the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the plaintext key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.
→ Sai: KMS Encrypt API chỉ dùng cho data nhỏ (<4KB). Không thể dùng Encrypt API cho file PDF >1MB.

❌ Write the plain text key from the GenerateDataKey API to disk for later use. Use the encrypted key from the GenerateDataKey API to encrypt the file by using the KMS Encrypt API.
→ Sai: plaintext key không được lưu xuống disk. Encrypted key không thể dùng để encrypt file.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • File lớn → dùng Envelope Encryption với GenerateDataKey.

  • Plaintext key → mã hóa file.

  • Encrypted key → lưu trữ, để giải mã plaintext key khi cần.

📖 Reference:

Generate data keys

Client-side encryption with AWS KMS

questions.q:
A developer is creating an application that reads and writes to multiple Amazon S3 buckets. The application will be deployed to an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer wants to make secure API requests from the EC2 instances without the need to manage the security credentials for the application. The developer needs to apply the principle of least privilege.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an IAM user. Create access keys and secret keys for the user. Associate the user with an IAM policy that allows s3:* permissions.
Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an IAM policy that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions for specific S3 buckets.
Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an AmazonS3FullAccess AWS managed policy.
Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions to the EC2 instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev viết app chạy trên EC2, cần đọc/ghi nhiều S3 bucket.

  • Yêu cầu: bảo mật (không quản lý key thủ công) + principle of least privilege.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an IAM policy that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions for specific S3 buckets.

  • EC2 nên dùng IAM Role thay vì hardcode access key (không phải quản lý credentials).

  • Chỉ cấp quyền tối thiểu (least privilege) cho các bucket cần dùng: s3:ListBucket, s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject...

  • Đây là best practice chuẩn AWS.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM user. Create access keys and secret keys for the user. Associate the user with an IAM policy that allows s3:* permissions.
→ Hardcode key trên EC2: không an toàn. Quyền s3:* = quá rộng, vi phạm nguyên tắc least privilege.

❌ Associate the EC2 instance with an IAM role that has an AmazonS3FullAccess AWS managed policy.
→ Policy AmazonS3FullAccess cho phép full access → quá nhiều quyền, không phải least privilege.

❌ Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket that allows s3:ListBucket and s3:*Object permissions to the EC2 instance.
→ Bucket policy không thể gán trực tiếp cho EC2 instance (bucket policy chỉ áp dụng cho principal = user/role).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • EC2 → S3: ưu tiên dùng IAM Role (thông qua Instance Profile).

  • Nguyên tắc least privilege: chỉ cấp quyền cụ thể cho bucket và hành động cần thiết.

📖 Reference:
Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances

questions.q:
A developer is migrating an application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The developer migrates the application to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) with an EKS cluster. As part of the application migration to a new backend, the developer creates a new AWS account. The developer makes configuration changes to the application to point the application to the new AWS account and to use new backend resources. The developer successfully tests the changes within the application by deploying the pipeline.

The Docker image build and the pipeline deployment are successful, but the application is still connecting to the old backend. The developer finds that the application's configuration is still referencing the original EKS cluster and not referencing the new backend resources.

Which reason can explain why the application is not connecting to the new resources?
o: The developer did not successfully create the new AWS account.
The developer added a new tag to the Docker image.
The developer did not update the Docker image tag to a new version.
The developer pushed the changes to a new Docker image tag.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App chạy trên EKS, image lưu ở ECR.

  • Dev migrate sang AWS account mới và backend mới.

  • Pipeline build & deploy thành công, nhưng app vẫn kết nối backend cũ.

  • Nguyên nhân: do app config vẫn tham chiếu cluster cũ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The developer did not update the Docker image tag to a new version.

  • Nếu dev build lại image nhưng push cùng tag cũ (ví dụ latest), EKS có thể vẫn pull cached image hoặc pod chưa redeploy đúng version.

  • Kết quả: app chạy image cũ với config cũ, tiếp tục kết nối backend cũ.

  • Best practice: mỗi lần build phải update tag (semantic version, commit hash, build number) để tránh reuse image cũ.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The developer did not successfully create the new AWS account.

→ Không liên quan: account đã tạo thành công (backend mới đã được test ok).

❌ The developer added a new tag to the Docker image.

→ Thêm tag mới là đúng practice. Vấn đề ở đây là không update tag khi build.

❌ The developer pushed the changes to a new Docker image tag.

→ Nếu dev đã push tag mới và pipeline deploy đúng tag, app sẽ dùng backend mới.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Luôn sử dụng tag versioning cho Docker image (v1, v2, v3...) thay vì chỉ dùng latest.

  • Sau khi push image mới → update manifest (Deployment YAML) để pull tag mới.

📖 Reference:

Pushing an image to an Amazon ECR private repository

questions.q:
A developer is building an application that will use an Amazon API Gateway API with an AWS Lambda backend. The team that will develop the frontend requires immediate access to the API endpoints to build the UI. To prepare the backend application for integration, the developer needs to set up endpoints. The endpoints need to return predefined HTTP status codes and JSON responses for the frontend team. The developer creates a method for an API resource.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Set the integration type to AWS_PROXY. Provision Lambda functions to return hardcoded JSON data.
Set the integration type to MOCK. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a JSON responses with specific HTTP status codes.
Set the integration type to HTTP_PROXY. Configure API Gateway to pass all requests to an external placeholder API, which the team will build.
Set the integration type to MOCK. Use a method request to define HTTP status codes. Use an integration request to define JSON responses.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev cần tạo API Gateway để frontend có endpoint test UI ngay lập tức.

  • Backend (Lambda) chưa xong nên cần tạo API trả về sẵn HTTP status code + JSON response giả định.

  • Yêu cầu: tạo mock endpoint, trả về JSON cứng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the integration type to MOCK. Configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a JSON responses with specific HTTP status codes.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ MOCK integration cho phép trả về response giả định mà không cần backend.

  • Có thể định nghĩa sẵn mapping: HTTP status code → JSON response.

  • Giúp frontend có thể dùng endpoint ngay mà không cần Lambda hay backend.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set the integration type to AWS_PROXY. Provision Lambda functions to return hardcoded JSON data.

→ Có thể làm nhưng phải viết và deploy Lambda ⇒ tốn effort không cần thiết. MOCK đơn giản hơn.

❌ Set the integration type to HTTP_PROXY. Configure API Gateway to pass all requests to an external placeholder API, which the team will build.

→ Phải có external API thật sự, không phù hợp vì mục tiêu là mock nội bộ.

❌ Set the integration type to MOCK. Use a method request to define HTTP status codes. Use an integration request to define JSON responses.

→ Method request không định nghĩa response, nó chỉ validate input. Response phải được cấu hình ở integration response, không phải method request.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Khi cần mock API cho frontend → dùng API Gateway MOCK integration.

📖 Reference:

Enable mock integration using the API Gateway console

Mapping template transformations for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A developer is building a serverless application that runs on AWS. The developer wants to create an accelerated development workflow that deploys incremental changes to AWS for testing. The developer wants to deploy the incremental changes but does not want to fully deploy the entire application to AWS for every code commit.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam sync command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam init command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk synth command to deploy the incremental changes.
Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk bootstrap command to deploy the incremental changes.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev muốn phát triển ứng dụng serverless trên AWS.

  • Yêu cầu: cần workflow phát triển nhanh, deploy incremental changes (thay đổi nhỏ) để test, không muốn redeploy toàn bộ mỗi lần commit.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam sync command to deploy the incremental changes.

  • sam sync cho phép deploy chỉ những thay đổi mới (incremental) lên AWS.

  • Hữu ích khi làm dev/test vì tiết kiệm thời gian, không phải build & deploy lại toàn bộ stack.

  • Đây là tính năng của SAM Accelerate.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build the application. Use the sam init command to deploy the incremental changes.

→ sam init chỉ dùng để khởi tạo project mới, không phải deploy incremental changes.

❌ Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk synth command to deploy the incremental changes.

→ cdk synth chỉ tạo CloudFormation template, không deploy lên AWS.

❌ Use the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to build the application. Use the cdk bootstrap command to deploy the incremental changes.

→ cdk bootstrap chỉ tạo resource cần thiết cho CDK (S3 bucket, roles…), không deploy incremental changes.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Incremental deploy cho serverless app → SAM Accelerate với sam sync.

📖 Reference:

Introduction to using sam sync to sync to AWS Cloud

Accelerating serverless development with AWS SAM Accelerate

Speeding up incremental changes with AWS SAM Accelerate and nested stacks

questions.q:
A company runs a batch processing application by using AWS Lambda functions and Amazon API Gateway APIs with deployment stages for development, user acceptance testing, and production. A development team needs to configure the APIs in the deployment stages to connect to third-party service endpoints.

Which solution will meet this requirement?
o: Store the third-party service endpoints in Lambda layers that correspond to the stage.
Store the third-party service endpoints in API Gateway stage variables that correspond to the stage.
Encode the third-party service endpoints as query parameters in the API Gateway request URL.
Store the third-party service endpoint for each environment in AWS AppConfig.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty có app batch dùng API Gateway + Lambda, có nhiều stage (dev, UAT, prod).

  • Yêu cầu: cấu hình endpoint service bên thứ 3 khác nhau cho từng stage.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the third-party service endpoints in API Gateway stage variables that correspond to the stage.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ stage variables, cho phép cấu hình endpoint (URL, ARN…) riêng cho từng stage (dev/UAT/prod).

  • Dễ dàng thay đổi mà không cần chỉnh code Lambda.

  • Đây là cách native, phù hợp để quản lý config theo stage.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the third-party service endpoints in Lambda layers that correspond to the stage.

→ Lambda layer dùng để chia sẻ code/thư viện, không phù hợp để quản lý config endpoint.

❌ Encode the third-party service endpoints as query parameters in the API Gateway request URL.

→ Không an toàn và khó maintain. Endpoint không nên truyền qua query string.

❌ Store the third-party service endpoint for each environment in AWS AppConfig.

→ AppConfig thường dùng cho cấu hình động trong ứng dụng (feature flags, runtime config) → phức tạp

🔑 Tips and tricks:

API Gateway nhiều stage → dùng Stage Variables để quản lý config endpoint.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A developer is creating a machine learning (ML) pipeline in AWS Step Functions that contains AWS Lambda functions. The developer has configured an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to deliver ML model parameters to the ML pipeline to train ML models. The developer uploads the trained models are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket.

The developer needs a solution that can locally test the ML pipeline without making service integration calls to Amazon SQS and Amazon S3.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use the Amazon CodeGuru Profiler to analyze the Lambda functions used in the AWS Step Functions pipeline.
Use the AWS Step Functions Local Docker Image to run and locally test the Lambda functions.
Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to run and locally test the Lambda functions.
Use AWS Step Functions Local with mocked service integrations.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev xây dựng ML pipeline bằng Step Functions + Lambda.

  • Có SQS gửi tham số, S3 lưu model.

  • Yêu cầu: test local pipeline mà không gọi SQS/S3 thật.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS Step Functions Local with mocked service integrations.

  • Step Functions Local cho phép chạy state machine trên máy local.

  • Có thể mock các integration (SQS, S3…) → test logic pipeline mà không cần gọi dịch vụ AWS thật.

  • Đây là giải pháp chính thức từ AWS cho local testing Step Functions.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use the Amazon CodeGuru Profiler to analyze the Lambda functions used in the AWS Step Functions pipeline.

→ CodeGuru chỉ để phân tích hiệu năng code (profiling), không phải để mock/test pipeline.

❌ Use the AWS Step Functions Local Docker Image to run and locally test the Lambda functions.

→ Có thể test Lambda integration, nhưng không giải quyết mock SQS/S3.

❌ Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to run and locally test the Lambda functions.

→ SAM CLI dùng để test/deploy serverless app (Lambda, API Gateway…), không phải test state machine của Step Functions.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Test Step Functions local (không gọi AWS service) → Step Functions Local + Mock integrations.

📖 Reference:

Using mocked service integrations for testing in Step Functions Local

Mocking service integrations with AWS Step Functions Local

questions.q:
A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 instances. Automatic scaling is working well for the application user interface. However, the process to deliver shipping requests to the company’s warehouse staff is encountering issues. Duplicate shipping requests are arriving, and some requests are lost or arrive out of order.

The company must avoid duplicate shipping requests and must process the requests in the order that the requests arrive. Requests are never more than 250 KB in size and take 5-10 minutes to process. A developer needs to rearchitect the application to improve the reliability of the delivery and processing of the requests.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to process the requests. Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Modify the application to write the requests to the Kinesis data stream.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Modify the application to write the requests to the SNS topic.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên EC2.

  • Phần UI scale ổn nhưng luồng gửi yêu cầu giao hàng đến kho bị trùng lặp, mất yêu cầu, sai thứ tự.

  • Ràng buộc: payload ≤ 250 KB, xử lý 5–10 phút.

  • Cần kiến trúc lại để không trùng, đúng thứ tự.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.

  • SQS FIFO đảm bảo đúng thứ tự (First-In-First-Out) và tránh trùng lặp (dedup bằng MessageDeduplicationId hoặc content-based dedup).

  • Kích thước 250 KB phù hợp giới hạn SQS (256 KB).

  • Lambda xử lý 5–10 phút nằm trong timeout tối đa 15 phút; đặt visibility timeout > thời gian xử lý để tránh xử lý lặp.

  • Đáp ứng yêu cầu “không trùng + đúng thứ tự” một cách native, đáng tin cậy.

SQS FIFO queue:

Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to process the requests. Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Modify the application to write the requests to the Kinesis data stream.

  • Kinesis Data Streams chỉ đảm bảo thứ tự trong shard, nhưng vẫn có thể gặp retries/duplicates, và không native “exactly-once” cho consumer

  • Cần tự viết consumer, quản lý checkpoint → phức tạp

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic. Modify the application to write the requests to the SNS topic.

→ SNS là pub/sub, không đảm bảo thứ tự và có thể gửi trùng, không đảm bảo “đúng thứ tự + không trùng”.

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to process the requests. Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. Set the SQS queue as an event source for the Lambda function. Modify the application to write the requests to the SQS queue.

→ SQS Standard chỉ đảm bảo at-least-once và best-effort ordering (không đảm bảo thứ tự).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Cần ordering + dedup ⇒ nghĩ ngay SQS FIFO (+ Lambda event source).

  • Đặt VisibilityTimeout > max processing time để tránh xử lý lại.

  • Dùng Message Group ID để giữ thứ tự trong từng nhóm; một nhóm = một luồng tuần tự.

📖 Reference:

Solving Complex Ordering Challenges with Amazon SQS FIFO Queues

Amazon SQS Visibility Timeout

questions.q:
A company’s developer is creating an application that uses Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to ensure that only users in the Sales department can use the application. The users authenticate to the application by using federated credentials from a third-party identity provider (IdP) through Amazon Cognito. The developer has set up an attribute mapping to map an attribute that is named Department and to pass the attribute to a custom AWS Lambda authorizer.

To test the access limitation, the developer sets their department to Engineering in the IdP and attempts to log in to the application. The developer is denied access. The developer then updates their department to Sales in the IdP and attempts to log in. Again, the developer is denied access. The developer checks the logs and discovers that access is being denied because the developer’s access token has a department value of Engineering.

Which of the following is a possible reason that the developer’s department is still being reported as Engineering instead of Sales?
o: Authorization caching is enabled in the custom Lambda authorizer.
Authorization caching is enabled on the Amazon Cognito user pool.
The IAM role for the custom Lambda authorizer does not have a Department tag.
The IAM role for the Amazon Cognito user pool does not have a Department tag.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng dùng API Gateway + Cognito (federated IdP).

  • Yêu cầu: chỉ user thuộc Sales mới truy cập được.

  • Dev đổi attribute Department trong IdP từ Engineering → Sales nhưng access token vẫn hiển thị Engineering.

  • Access bị từ chối do token chưa cập nhật giá trị mới.

  • Hỏi: nguyên nhân tại sao?

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Authorization caching is enabled in the custom Lambda authorizer.

  • API Gateway Lambda authorizer có cache authorization result (theo authorization token hoặc request params).

  • Khi bật caching, nếu user thay đổi attribute trong IdP, token/response cũ vẫn được dùng cho đến khi cache hết hạn.

  • Vì vậy access token tiếp tục báo Engineering mặc dù IdP đã đổi sang Sales.

Lambda authorizer authorization workflow:

Authorization caching:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Authorization caching is enabled on the Amazon Cognito user pool.

→ Cognito user pool không có khái niệm cache authorizer, mà là API Gateway authorizer mới có.

❌ The IAM role for the custom Lambda authorizer does not have a Department tag.

→ IAM role không liên quan đến attribute Department, chỉ để cấp quyền cho Lambda.

❌ The IAM role for the Amazon Cognito user pool does not have a Department tag.

→ IAM role của user pool không ảnh hưởng tới mapping attribute IdP → token.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Khi test attribute-based access, nếu thấy giá trị không update → kiểm tra authorizer cache trong API Gateway.

  • Có thể disable cache hoặc giảm TTL khi test.

📖 Reference:

Use API Gateway Lambda authorizers

Configure an API Gateway Lambda authorizer

questions.q:
A developer has created a data collection application that uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3. The application’s users periodically upload data files and wait for the validation status to be reflected on a processing dashboard. The validation process is complex and time-consuming for large files.

Some users are uploading dozens of large files and have to wait and refresh the processing dashboard to see if the files have been validated. The developer must refactor the application to immediately update the validation result on the user’s dashboard without reloading the full dashboard.

What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
o: Integrate the client with an API Gateway WebSocket API. Save the user-uploaded files with the WebSocket connection ID. Push the validation status to the connection ID when the processing is complete to initiate an update of the user interface.

Launch an Amazon EC2 micro instance, and set up a WebSocket server. Send the user-uploaded file and user detail to the EC2 instance after the user uploads the file. Use the WebSocket server to send updates to the user interface when the uploaded file is processed.

Save the user’s email address along with the user-uploaded file. When the validation process is complete, send an email notification through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to the user who uploaded the file.

Save the user-uploaded file and user detail to Amazon DynamoDB. Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams with Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) push notifications to send updates to the browser to update the user interface.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng API Gateway + Lambda + S3 để upload file.

  • Validation phức tạp, mất thời gian.

  • User phải refresh dashboard để thấy kết quả.

  • Yêu cầu: cập nhật real-time validation result lên UI mà không cần reload dashboard.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Integrate the client with an API Gateway WebSocket API. Save the user-uploaded files with the WebSocket connection ID. Push the validation status to the connection ID when the processing is complete to initiate an update of the user interface.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ WebSocket API cho 2-way communication.

  • Client mở kết nối WebSocket → server có thể push kết quả validation ngay khi hoàn tất.

  • Cách native, serverless, ít vận hành nhất (không cần tự host WebSocket server).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Launch an Amazon EC2 micro instance, and set up a WebSocket server. Send the user-uploaded file and user detail to the EC2 instance after the user uploads the file. Use the WebSocket server to send updates to the user interface when the uploaded file is processed.

→ Tốn effort quản lý EC2 + scaling WebSocket server. Không operationally efficient.

❌ Save the user’s email address along with the user-uploaded file. When the validation process is complete, send an email notification through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to the user who uploaded the file.

→ Email không phù hợp cho real-time update dashboard, và không update trực tiếp UI.

❌ Save the user-uploaded file and user detail to Amazon DynamoDB. Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams with Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) push notifications to send updates to the browser to update the user interface.

→ DynamoDB Streams không thể push trực tiếp đến trình duyệt. Cần service trung gian → Phức tạp

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Yêu cầu realtime update UI từ backend → API Gateway WebSocket API.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway WebSocket APIs

WebSocket API

Create a WebSocket chat app with a WebSocket API, Lambda and DynamoDB

questions.q:
A company uses AWS CloudFormation to deploy an application that uses an Amazon API Gateway REST API with AWS Lambda function integration. The application uses Amazon DynamoDB for data persistence. The application has three stages: development, testing, and production. Each stage uses its own DynamoDB table.

The company has encountered unexpected issues when promoting changes to the production stage. The changes were successful in the development and testing stages.
