A developer needs to route 20% of the traffic to the new production stage API with the next production release. The developer needs to route the remaining 80% of the traffic to the existing production stage. The solution must minimize the number of errors that any single customer experiences.

Which approach should the developer take to meet these requirements?
o: Update 20% of the planned changes to the production stage. Deploy the new production stage. Monitor the results. Repeat this process five times to test all planned changes.

Update the Amazon Route 53 DNS record entry for the production stage API to use a weighted routing policy. Set the weight to a value of 80. Add a second record for the production domain name. Change the second routing policy to a weighted routing policy. Set the weight of the second policy to a value of 20. Change the alias of the second policy to use the testing stage API.

Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the REST API. Change the production API Amazon Route 53 record to point traffic to the ALB. Register the production and testing stages as targets of the ALB with weights of 80% and 20%, respectively.
Configure canary settings for the production stage API. Change the percentage of traffic directed to canary deployment to 20%. Make the planned updates to the production stage. Deploy the changes
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App dùng API Gateway (REST) + Lambda + DynamoDB, có 3 stage (dev/test/prod).

  • Khi lên prod hay phát sinh lỗi dù dev/test OK.

  • Yêu cầu release mới: route 20% traffic sang phiên bản mới của production stage, 80% giữ nguyên; giảm thiểu lỗi lặp lại cho 1 khách hàng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure canary settings for the production stage API. Change the percentage of traffic directed to canary deployment to 20%. Make the planned updates to the production stage. Deploy the changes

  • API Gateway Stage Canary cho phép chia traffic (weighted) ngay trong cùng một stage.

  • Có thể đặt 20% canary / 80% current để giảm rủi ro; người dùng ít bị gặp lỗi lặp lại vì phân phối theo request chứ không bắt buộc “theo người dùng”.

  • Tích hợp sẵn, không cần thay đổi DNS hay thêm hạ tầng.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Update 20% of the planned changes to the production stage. Deploy the new production stage. Monitor the results. Repeat this process five times to test all planned changes.

→ Không phải traffic splitting. Vẫn deploy toàn bộ cho tất cả người dùng → rủi ro cao.

❌ Update the Amazon Route 53 DNS record entry for the production stage API to use a weighted routing policy. Set the weight to a value of 80. Add a second record for the production domain name. Change the second routing policy to a weighted routing policy. Set the weight of the second policy to a value of 20. Change the alias of the second policy to use the testing stage API.

→ Trỏ 20% sang testing stage (khác DynamoDB table) có thể gây lệch dữ liệu/logic.

❌ Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the REST API. Change the production API Amazon Route 53 record to point traffic to the ALB. Register the production and testing stages as targets of the ALB with weights of 80% and 20%, respectively.

→ API Gateway REST API không phải target chuẩn của ALB; thêm ALB làm phức tạp kiến trúc, không cần thiết.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Muốn canary/blue-green ở API Gateway → dùng Stage Canary Settings (ví dụ 10–20%).

📖 Reference:

Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment

questions.q:
A developer needs to use Amazon DynamoDB to store customer orders. The developer’s company requires all customer data to be encrypted at rest with a key that the company generates.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Create the DynamoDB table with encryption set to None. Code the application to use the key to decrypt the data when the application reads from the table. Code the application to use the key to encrypt the data when the application writes to the table.
Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS customer managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.

Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Create the DynamoDB table with default encryption. Include the kms:Encrypt parameter with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key when using the DynamoDB software development kit (SDK).
Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS AWS managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty yêu cầu lưu customer orders trong DynamoDB.

  • Bắt buộc: dữ liệu phải encrypt at rest bằng key do công ty tự tạo (không dùng key mặc định AWS).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS customer managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.

  • DynamoDB hỗ trợ encryption at rest bằng AWS KMS CMK (customer managed key).

  • Có thể chọn KMS key do công ty tự tạo và quản lý (customer managed key).

  • Đây chính là yêu cầu “key that the company generates”.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create the DynamoDB table with encryption set to None. Code the application to use the key to decrypt the data when the application reads from the table. Code the application to use the key to encrypt the data when the application writes to the table.

→ Không cần thiết, vì DynamoDB hỗ trợ encryption at rest natively với KMS.

❌ Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Create the DynamoDB table with default encryption. Include the kms:Encrypt parameter with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key when using the DynamoDB software development kit (SDK).

→ Default encryption = AWS owned key, không phải key do công ty tạo.

❌ Store the key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Choose an AWS KMS AWS managed key during creation of the DynamoDB table. Provide the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key.

→ AWS managed key là do AWS quản lý, không phải key do công ty tự tạo.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

DynamoDB encryption at rest yêu cầu “company generates the key” → luôn chọn Customer Managed CMK.

📖 Reference:

AWS DynamoDB Encryption at Rest

questions.q:
A company is using AWS Elastic Beanstalk to manage web applications that are running on Amazon EC2 instances. A developer needs to make configuration changes. The developer must deploy the changes to new instances only.

Which types of deployment can the developer use to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
o: All at once
Immutable
Rolling
Blue/green
Rolling with additional batch
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng Elastic Beanstalk để quản lý web app trên EC2.

  • Yêu cầu: deploy config thay đổi nhưng chỉ áp dụng cho instance mới, không update instance cũ.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Immutable

→ Tạo một nhóm instance mới với version mới, test xong thì chuyển traffic. Instance cũ giữ nguyên.

Blue/green

→ Tạo môi trường mới (green) với thay đổi, chạy song song môi trường cũ (blue). Sau đó swap CNAME để redirect traffic. Cũ vẫn giữ nguyên, mới nhận thay đổi.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ All at once

→ Thay đổi áp dụng ngay lên tất cả instance hiện có → không tạo instance mới.

❌ Rolling

→ Update lần lượt từng batch instance trong môi trường → vẫn thay đổi instance cũ.

❌ Rolling with additional batch

→ Tương tự rolling, chỉ khác là thêm batch tạm thời để đảm bảo capacity, nhưng vẫn update instance cũ.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Muốn deploy thay đổi chỉ trên instance mới → chọn Immutable hoặc Blue/Green.

  • Các deployment kiểu Rolling hay All at once đều tác động trực tiếp lên instance cũ.

📖 Reference:

Deploying applications to Elastic Beanstalk environments

questions.q:
A company deploys a photo-processing application to an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to process each photo in less than 5 seconds. If processing takes longer than 5 seconds, the company’s development team must receive a notification.

How can a developer implement the required time measurement and notification with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is based on a static threshold of 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the queue. Create an application to consume from the queue and to determine whether any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if the average of values is greater than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by sending an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) message.

Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the data stream. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App xử lý ảnh trên EC2.

  • Mỗi ảnh phải xử lý < 5 giây.

  • Nếu > 5 giây thì team dev phải nhận thông báo.

  • Mục tiêu: ít vận hành nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is based on a static threshold of 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

  • App gửi thời gian xử lý lên CloudWatch custom metric.

  • Tạo CloudWatch Alarm với static threshold = 5s .

  • Alarm → SNS topic để thông báo cho team.

  • Serverless, cấu hình đơn giản, overhead tối thiểu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the queue. Create an application to consume from the queue and to determine whether any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

→ Phải xây thêm consumer để đọc queue và kiểm tra ngưỡng → tăng công vận hành không cần thiết.

❌ Create an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time as a metric value. Create a CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if the average of values is greater than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by sending an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) message.

→ Dùng average có thể bỏ sót trường hợp một ảnh > 5s nhưng bị “trung bình hoá”, SES không cần thiết

❌ Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Each time a photo is processed, publish the processing time to the data stream. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters ALARM state if any values are more than 5 seconds. Notify the development team by using an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

→ Kinesis không cần cho use case này; vẫn phải xử lý thêm để tạo alarm → phức tạp, dư thừa.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Muốn bắt bất kỳ ảnh nào > 5s: set Alarm với statistic = Maximum, period phù hợp với tần suất gửi metric.

  • Thông báo nhanh gọn qua SNS (email/Slack/Webhook, v.v.).

📖 Reference:

Collect metrics, logs, and traces using the CloudWatch agent

questions.q:
An online sales company is developing a serverless application that runs on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that calculates order success rates and stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. A developer wants an efficient way to invoke the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?
o: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has a rate expression that will run the rule every 15 minutes. Add the Lambda function as the target of the EventBridge rule.
Create an AWS Systems Manager document that has a script that will invoke the Lambda function on Amazon EC2. Use a Systems Manager Run Command task to run the shell script every 15 minutes.
Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Configure the state machine to invoke the Lambda function execution role at a specified interval by using a Wait state. Set the interval to 15 minutes.
Provision a small Amazon EC2 instance. Set up a cron job that invokes the Lambda function every 15 minutes.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App serverless dùng Lambda để tính tỉ lệ đơn hàng thành công và lưu vào DynamoDB.

  • Yêu cầu: gọi Lambda mỗi 15 phút, ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that has a rate expression that will run the rule every 15 minutes. Add the Lambda function as the target of the EventBridge rule.

  • EventBridge (Schedule/Rule) hỗ trợ rate(15 minutes) native, không cần viết thêm code hay hạ tầng.

  • Tích hợp trực tiếp với Lambda, vận hành tối thiểu.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an AWS Systems Manager document that has a script that will invoke the Lambda function on Amazon EC2. Use a Systems Manager Run Command task to run the shell script every 15 minutes.

→ Cần script + cấu hình Run Command; phức tạp hơn EventBridge, không tối ưu cho serverless.

❌ Create an AWS Step Functions state machine. Configure the state machine to invoke the Lambda function execution role at a specified interval by using a Wait state. Set the interval to 15 minutes.

→ Dùng Step Functions chỉ để schedule là dư thừa, tốn chi phí và cấu hình hơn so với EventBridge.

❌ Provision a small Amazon EC2 instance. Set up a cron job that invokes the Lambda function every 15 minutes.

→ Phải quản lý EC2, bảo trì, tốn chi phí standby ⇒ không “serverless”, overhead cao.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Lên lịch gọi Lambda định kỳ → EventBridge Schedule (rate/cron) là lựa chọn mặc định, gọn nhẹ nhất.

📖 Reference:

Invoke a Lambda function on a schedule

questions.q:
A developer is building a new application that will be deployed on AWS. The developer has created an AWS CodeCommit repository for the application. The developer has initialized a new project for the application by invoking the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) cdk init command.

The developer must write unit tests for the infrastructure as code (IaC) templates that the AWS CDK generates. The developer also must run a validation tool across all constructs in the CDK application to ensure that critical security configurations are activated.

Which combination of actions will meet these requirements with the LEAST development overhead? (Choose two.)
o: Use a unit testing framework to write custom unit tests against the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.

Use the CDK assertions module to integrate unit tests with the application. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.
Use the CDK runtime context to set key-value pairs that must be present in the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Fail the stack synthesis if any violations are present.
Write a script that searches the application for specific key configuration strings. Configure the script to produce a report of any security violations.
Use the CDK Aspects class to create custom rules to apply to the CDK application. Fall the stack synthesis if any violations are present.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Dev dùng AWS CDK (đã cdk init) và CodeCommit.

  • Cần:

    • Viết unit test cho IaC template CDK sinh ra.

    • Chạy công cụ/luồng validate toàn bộ constructs để đảm bảo bật các cấu hình bảo mật quan trọng.

    • Mục tiêu: ít effort phát triển nhất.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use the CDK assertions module to integrate unit tests with the application. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.

  • @aws-cdk/assertions cho phép viết unit test kiểm tra template đã synth (logical resources, properties, policies…) một cách ngắn gọn, ổn định.

  • Dễ tích hợp vào pipeline CI/CD sau mỗi commit.


Use the CDK Aspects class to create custom rules to apply to the CDK application. Fall the stack synthesis if any violations are present.

  • CDK Aspects áp rules/security checks trên mọi construct trong app.

  • Có thể tự viết rule hoặc dùng thư viện như cdk-nag; thiết lập fail synth khi có vi phạm → đảm bảo cấu hình bảo mật quan trọng luôn được bật.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use a unit testing framework to write custom unit tests against the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Run the unit tests in a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline that is invoked after any commit to the repository.

→ Test trực tiếp file cdk.out (JSON) rất tốn effort hơn so với assertions.

❌ Use the CDK runtime context to set key-value pairs that must be present in the cdk.out file that the AWS CDK generates. Fail the stack synthesis if any violations are present.

→ Context dùng để truyền tham số lúc synth, không phải cơ chế quét/validate toàn bộ constructs.

❌ Write a script that searches the application for specific key configuration strings. Configure the script to produce a report of any security violations.

→ Tự viết script grep chuỗi dễ thiếu sót, fragile; Aspects cung cấp API chính thống, đáng tin cậy hơn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Test IaC CDK: dùng @aws-cdk/assertions.

  • Kiểm tra bảo mật xuyên suốt CDK app: dùng Aspects (vd. cdk-nag) và fail synth khi vi phạm.

📖 Reference:

Test AWS CDK applications

Aspects and the AWS CDK

questions.q:
An AWS Lambda function is running in a company’s shared AWS account. The function needs to perform an additional ec2:DescribeInstances action that is directed at the company’s development accounts. A developer must configure the required permissions across the accounts.

How should the developer configure the permissions to adhere to the principle of least privilege?
o: Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.

Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda chạy ở shared account cần gọi thêm ec2:DescribeInstances vào các development accounts.

  • Yêu cầu cấu hình quyền ít nhất cần thiết (least privilege), cross-account.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

  • Tạo role ở account đích (development) với chỉ quyền ec2:DescribeInstances.

  • Trust policy của role này cho phép shared account (vai trò Lambda) assume.

  • Ở shared account, bổ sung quyền iam:AssumeRole cho Lambda execution role để assume đúng role bên dev.

  • Đúng nguyên tắc least privilege và chuẩn cross-account: quyền tài nguyên ở đâu thì cấp ở account đó.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.

→ Cấp quyền ec2:DescribeInstances ở shared account không giúp gọi API trên tài nguyên của development accounts. Quyền phải được ủy quyền ở account đích.

❌ Create an IAM role in the shared account. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship between the development accounts for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the iam:AssumeRole permissions.

→ Vẫn cấp quyền EC2 ở shared account ⇒ không có hiệu lực khi mô tả EC2 ở development accounts. Vị trí cấp quyền sai.

❌ Create an IAM role in the development accounts. Add the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role. Establish a trust relationship with the shared account for this role. Update the Lambda function IAM role in the shared account by adding the ec2:DescribeInstances permission to the role.

→ Đã đúng phần role ở dev và trust; nhưng bắt Lambda role ở shared account có thêm ec2:DescribeInstances là thừa (không dùng đến). Chỉ cần iam:AssumeRole để gián tiếp nhận quyền từ role ở dev.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Cross-account: Quyền trên tài nguyên phải được cấp ở account sở hữu tài nguyên, bên gọi chỉ cần sts:AssumeRole vào role đích.

📖 Reference:

Cross account resource access in IAM

How to Use a Single IAM User to Easily Access All Your Accounts by Using the AWS CLI

questions.q:
A developer is building a serverless application by using AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) on multiple AWS Lambda functions. When the application is deployed, the developer wants to shift 10% of the traffic to the new deployment of the application for the first 10 minutes after deployment. If there are no issues, all traffic must switch over to the new version.

Which change to the AWS SAM template will meet these requirements?
o: Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.
Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng AWS SAM để deploy nhiều Lambda functions.

  • Yêu cầu: khi deploy mới → chuyển 10% traffic trong 10 phút đầu (canary deployment).

  • Nếu ok → chuyển toàn bộ traffic sang version mới.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.

  • Canary10Percent10Minutes = chuyển 10% traffic trong 10 phút đầu, sau đó 100% traffic nếu không lỗi.

  • AutoPublishAlias = SAM sẽ tự động tạo Lambda alias và map version mới với deployment preference.

  • Đây là cấu hình chuẩn xác nhất cho yêu cầu đề bài.

SAM template example:

Resources:
MyLambdaFunction:
  Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
  Properties:
    Handler: index.handler
    Runtime: nodejs20.x
    CodeUri: s3://bucket/code.zip

    AutoPublishAlias: live

    DeploymentPreference:
      Type: Canary10Percent10Minutes 
      Alarms:
        # A list of alarms that you want to monitor
        - !Ref AliasErrorMetricGreaterThanZeroAlarm
        - !Ref LatestVersionErrorMetricGreaterThanZeroAlarm
      Hooks:
        # Validation Lambda functions that are run before & after traffic shifting
        PreTraffic: !Ref PreTrafficLambdaFunction
        PostTraffic: !Ref PostTrafficLambdaFunction

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set AutoPublishAlias property to the Lambda alias.

→ Linear = tăng traffic 10% mỗi 10 phút ⇒ không phù hợp vì đề chỉ yêu cầu canary 10% trong 10 phút, sau đó full.

❌ Set the Deployment Preference Type to Canary10Percent10Minutes. Set the PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.

→ PreTraffic/PostTraffic = chỉ định Lambda hooks để test trước/sau deployment, không phải alias. Việc map alias phải dùng AutoPublishAlias.

❌ Set the Deployment Preference Type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Set PreTraffic and PostTraffic properties to the Lambda alias.

→ Sai cả kiểu deployment (Linear ≠ Canary) và sai cách dùng PreTraffic/PostTraffic.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Canary: test % nhỏ trong thời gian nhất định, sau đó full traffic.

  • Linear: tăng traffic dần dần theo từng bước.

📖 Reference:

Deploying serverless applications gradually with AWS SAM

questions.q:
A company is using AWS CodePipeline to deliver one of its applications. The delivery pipeline is triggered by changes to the main branch of an AWS CodeCommit repository and uses AWS CodeBuild to implement the test and build stages of the process and AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the application.

The pipeline has been operating successfully for several months and there have been no modifications. Following a recent change to the application’s source code, AWS CodeDeploy has not deployed the updated application as expected.

What are the possible causes? (Choose two.)
o: The change was not made in the main branch of the AWS CodeCommit repository.
One of the earlier stages in the pipeline failed and the pipeline has terminated.
One of the Amazon EC2 instances in the company’s AWS CodePipeline cluster is inactive.
The AWS CodePipeline is incorrectly configured and is not invoking AWS CodeDeploy.
AWS CodePipeline does not have permissions to access AWS CodeCommit.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty dùng AWS CodePipeline (trigger từ main branch của CodeCommit) → CodeBuild (test, build) → CodeDeploy (deploy app).

  • Trước giờ chạy ổn, gần đây có thay đổi code nhưng CodeDeploy không deploy bản mới.

  • Hỏi nguyên nhân là gì? (chọn 2).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The change was not made in the main branch of the AWS CodeCommit repository.

  • CodePipeline chỉ trigger khi có thay đổi trong main branch.

  • Nếu dev push code sang nhánh khác → pipeline không chạy.

One of the earlier stages in the pipeline failed and the pipeline has terminated.

→ Nếu CodeBuild hoặc test stage fail → pipeline stop, CodeDeploy sẽ không chạy.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ One of the Amazon EC2 instances in the company’s AWS CodePipeline cluster is inactive.

→ CodePipeline là managed service, không có “cluster EC2” để quản lý pipeline. Không liên quan.

❌ The AWS CodePipeline is incorrectly configured and is not invoking AWS CodeDeploy.

→ Pipeline đã chạy ổn nhiều tháng, không có chỉnh sửa → config không phải nguyên nhân.

❌ AWS CodePipeline does not have permissions to access AWS CodeCommit.

→ Sai. Nếu không có quyền thì pipeline đã không chạy được từ trước giờ (nhưng trước giờ chạy ổn).

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Khi CodeDeploy không trigger → luôn check:

  • Code push có đúng nhánh pipeline monitor không?

  • Các stage trước (build/test) có fail không?

📖 Reference:

Troubleshooting CodePipeline

Field Notes: How to Deploy End-to-End CI/CD in the China Regions Using AWS CodePipeline

questions.q:
A company is creating a REST service using an Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda integration. The service must run different versions for testing purposes.

What would be the BEST way to accomplish this?
o: Use an X-Version header to denote which version is being called and pass that header to the Lambda function(s).
Create an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to route API clients to the correct API version.
Create an API Gateway resource policy to isolate versions and provide context to the Lambda function(s).
Deploy the API versions as unique stages with unique endpoints and use stage variables to provide further context.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty cần tạo REST service dùng API Gateway + Lambda integration.

  • Yêu cầu: chạy nhiều version cho mục đích test.

  • Hỏi cách tốt nhất để quản lý version.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Deploy the API versions as unique stages with unique endpoints and use stage variables to provide further context.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ stages (ví dụ: dev, test, prod) với endpoint riêng.

  • Có thể dùng stage variables để map tới Lambda alias/version hoặc cấu hình khác.

  • Đây là cách chuẩn AWS khuyến nghị cho versioning & testing.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use an X-Version header to denote which version is being called and pass that header to the Lambda function(s).

→ Lambda phải parse header và xử lý logic routing → phức tạp, không chuẩn REST API Gateway versioning.

❌ Create an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to route API clients to the correct API version.

→ Lambda authorizer dùng cho auth/authorization, không để xử lý versioning/routing API.

❌ Create an API Gateway resource policy to isolate versions and provide context to the Lambda function(s).

→ Resource policy chỉ dùng để kiểm soát truy cập (IAM, VPC, accounts), không quản lý version API.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Versioning với API Gateway:Dùng stage (dev/test/prod).

  • Kết hợp stage variables để chọn Lambda alias/version.

📖 Reference:

API Gateway stage variables

questions.q:
A company recently deployed an AWS Lambda function. A developer notices an increase in the function throttle metrics in Amazon CloudWatch.

What are the MOST operationally efficient solutions to reduce the function throttling? (Choose two.)
o: Migrate the function to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).
Increase the maximum age of events in Lambda.
Increase the function’s reserved concurrency.
Add the lambda:GetFunctionConcurrency action to the execution role.
Request a service quota change for increased concurrency.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Công ty vừa deploy Lambda function.

  • Developer thấy throttle metrics tăng trong CloudWatch.

  • Hỏi cách giảm throttling với ít effort vận hành nhất (chọn 2).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Increase the function’s reserved concurrency.

  • Reserved concurrency = giới hạn tối đa số concurrent executions cho 1 function.

  • Nếu quá thấp → dễ bị throttle.

  • Tăng con số này sẽ giảm throttling.

Request a service quota change for increased concurrency.

  • Mỗi account có account-level concurrency quota (mặc định 1,000).

  • Nếu tổng usage vượt quota → tất cả function có thể bị throttle.

  • Giải pháp: request tăng quota từ AWS.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Migrate the function to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).

→ Rất tốn effort vận hành, không liên quan trực tiếp đến throttling của Lambda.

❌ Increase the maximum age of events in Lambda.

→ Maximum age chỉ ảnh hưởng đến retry & event queue, không giảm được throttling.

❌ Add the lambda:GetFunctionConcurrency action to the execution role.

→ Đây chỉ là permission để query concurrency config, không thay đổi throttling behavior.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda throttling xảy ra khi:

    • Function vượt reserved concurrency.

    • Tổng usage vượt account concurrency quota.

  • Fix nhanh: tăng reserved concurrency (per function) hoặc request tăng quota (account level).

📖 Reference:

Configuring reserved concurrency for a function

questions.q:
A developer created a web API that receives requests by using an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an HTTPS listener. The developer configures an Amazon Cognito user pool and wants to ensure that every request to the API is authenticated through Amazon Cognito.

What should the developer do to meet this requirement?
o: Add a listener rule to the listener to return a fixed response if the Authorization header is missing. Set the fixed response to 401 Unauthorized.
Create an authentication action for the listener rules of the ALB. Set the rule action type to authenticate-cognito. Set the OnUnauthenticatedRequest field to “deny.”

Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Configure all API methods to be forwarded to the ALB endpoint. Create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type. Configure every API method to use that authorizer.
Create a new target group that includes an AWS Lambda function target that validates the Authorization header by using Amazon Cognito. Associate the target group with the listener.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer có ALB (internet-facing, HTTPS listener) → nhận request cho web API.

  • Đã có Amazon Cognito user pool.

  • Yêu cầu: mọi request vào API đều phải được auth qua Cognito.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an authentication action for the listener rules of the ALB. Set the rule action type to authenticate-cognito. Set the OnUnauthenticatedRequest field to “deny.”

  • ALB hỗ trợ native authentication với Cognito user pool thông qua action authenticate-cognito.

  • Khi bật, ALB sẽ tự động redirect client sang Cognito để login, sau đó mới forward request đến target group.

  • Với OnUnauthenticatedRequest=deny → nếu chưa auth thì từ chối request.

  • Đây là giải pháp chuẩn nhất, native ALB + Cognito, không cần viết thêm code.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a listener rule to the listener to return a fixed response if the Authorization header is missing. Set the fixed response to 401 Unauthorized.

→ Chỉ check có/không header, không validate Cognito tokens → không đủ bảo mật.

❌ Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Configure all API methods to be forwarded to the ALB endpoint. Create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type. Configure every API method to use that authorizer.

→ Phức tạp và overhead vì phải thêm API Gateway, trong khi ALB đã có tính năng auth trực tiếp với Cognito.

❌ Create a new target group that includes an AWS Lambda function target that validates the Authorization header by using Amazon Cognito. Associate the target group with the listener.

→ Lambda để validate token = custom code, nhiều effort vận hành. Trong khi ALB đã hỗ trợ native auth.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway + Cognito = phổ biến cho serverless API.

  • ALB + Cognito = phù hợp khi app dùng ALB trực tiếp, hỗ trợ authenticate-cognito action native.

  • Luôn bật OnUnauthenticatedRequest=deny để enforce auth.

📖 Reference:

Authenticate users with an Application Load Balancer

Web application access control patterns using AWS services

questions.q:
A developer is working on an application that is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer needs a solution that will securely transfer files from the application to an Amazon S3 bucket.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?
o: Create an IAM user. Create an access key for the IAM user. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
Create an IAM role. Create an access key for the IAM role. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
Create an IAM role. Configure the IAM role to access the specific Amazon S3 API calls the application requires. Associate the IAM role with the EC2 instance.
Configure an S3 bucket policy for the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow access for the EC2 instance ID.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng chạy trên EC2 instance cần upload file an toàn lên S3.

  • Yêu cầu: giải pháp bảo mật nhất (MOST secure).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an IAM role. Configure the IAM role to access the specific Amazon S3 API calls the application requires. Associate the IAM role with the EC2 instance.

  • EC2 Instance Profile sẽ tự động cấp temporary credentials cho app qua Instance Metadata Service (IMDSv2).

  • Không cần lưu access key/secret key trong code hay env vars → an toàn nhất.

  • Áp dụng principle of least privilege: chỉ cấp những API cần (ví dụ: s3:PutObject).

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an IAM user. Create an access key for the IAM user. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.

→ Hardcode access key vào env ⇒ rủi ro lộ credentials. Không phải best practice.

❌ Create an IAM role. Create an access key for the IAM role. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.

→ IAM Role không có access key để cấp thủ công. Access key chỉ áp dụng cho IAM User.

❌ Configure an S3 bucket policy for the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow access for the EC2 instance ID.

→ Bucket policy không support condition trực tiếp theo EC2 instance ID. Phải kết hợp IAM Role hoặc principal, không phù hợp.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Best practice: Luôn dùng IAM Role + Instance Profile cho EC2 khi app cần truy cập AWS services.

  • Không hardcode access key/secret key trong code hoặc env.

📖 Reference:

IAM roles for Amazon EC2

questions.q:
A developer is writing an application to encrypt files outside of AWS before uploading the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. The encryption must be symmetric and must be performed inside the application.

How can the developer implement the encryption in the application to meet these requirements?
o: Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
Create a Hash-Based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
Create a data key pair in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.
Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App cần encrypt file bên ngoài AWS trước khi upload S3.

  • Yêu cầu: symmetric encryption và phải thực hiện trong application.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.

  • GenerateDataKey từ KMS cho phép tạo symmetric data key.

  • App dùng data key (plaintext) để encrypt file (AES-256).

  • Dùng AWS Encryption SDK để quản lý việc encrypt file an toàn, handle key wrapping, best practice.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a Hash-Based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.

→ HMAC = dùng để xác thực (sign/verify), không dùng để encrypt/decrypt.

❌

Create a data key pair in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.

→ Data key pair = asymmetric (RSA/ECC), không phải symmetric. Đề yêu cầu symmetric encryption.

❌ Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.

→ AWS CLI chỉ encrypt dữ liệu nhỏ (≤ 4 KB), không phù hợp để encrypt file lớn.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Symmetric file encryption ngoài AWS = GenerateDataKey + AWS Encryption SDK.

  • KMS chỉ quản lý key & generate data key, không trực tiếp encrypt file lớn.

📖 Reference:

Generate data keys

questions.q:
A company has an online web application that includes a product catalog. The catalog is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that is named DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET. The application must be able to list the objects in the S3 bucket and must be able to download objects through an IAM policy.

Which policy allows MINIMUM access to meet these requirements?
o:
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng web có product catalog lưu trong S3 bucket.

  • Yêu cầu: ứng dụng chỉ cần quyền list object (s3:ListBucket) và download object (s3:GetObject).

  • Cần IAM policy tối thiểu (least privilege).

✅ Đáp án đúng:

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

  • s3:ListBucket cho bucket để liệt kê objects.

  • s3:GetObject cho prefix /* để tải object.

  • Đúng policy least privilege.

Các đáp án sai:

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:*"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

→"Action": ["s3:*"] : Cho phép toàn bộ hành động trên object (Put, Delete, Tagging…), vượt quá yêu cầu.

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

→"Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject"] :Thừa quyền (Put, Delete).

❌

{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
    }
  ]
}

→"Effect": "Deny", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"] sẽ chặn download object → sai yêu cầu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • List bucket → cần s3:ListBucket ở bucket ARN (không có /*).

  • Truy cập nội dung object → cần s3:GetObject ở **ARN/*.

questions.q:
A company has a three-tier application that is deployed in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The application is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The application performs more database reads than writes.

During times of peak usage, the application’s performance degrades. When this performance degradation occurs, the DB instance’s ReadLatency metric in Amazon CloudWatch increases suddenly.

How should a developer modify the application to improve performance?
o: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache query results.
Scale the ECS cluster to contain more ECS instances.
Add read capacity units (RCUs) to the DB instance.
Modify the ECS task definition to increase the task memory.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • App 3-tier chạy trên Amazon ECS, DB là Amazon RDS for MySQL.

  • Khối lượng đọc nhiều hơn ghi.

  • Giờ cao điểm bị tụt hiệu năng, CloudWatch ReadLatency của DB tăng đột biến.

  • Cần cải thiện hiệu năng.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache query results.

  • App đọc nhiều → thêm cache (Redis/Memcached) để lưu kết quả truy vấn hay dùng,

  • Giúp giảm lượt đọc trực tiếp vào RDS → hạ ReadLatency, cải thiện throughput tổng thể mà không đổi cấu trúc DB.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Scale the ECS cluster to contain more ECS instances.

→ Tăng ECS instance chỉ làm app layer mạnh hơn, nhưng bottleneck đang ở DB read latency.

❌ Add read capacity units (RCUs) to the DB instance.

→ RCU là khái niệm của DynamoDB, không áp dụng cho RDS MySQL.

❌ Modify the ECS task definition to increase the task memory.

→ Tăng memory cho task không giải quyết DB ReadLatency. Vấn đề nằm ở tầng dữ liệu.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

Workload đọc nhiều + ReadLatency cao → nghĩ ngay ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached) hoặc RDS Read Replica (nếu có trong lựa chọn).

📖 Reference:

Common ElastiCache Use Cases

Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis

questions.q:
A developer is troubleshooting an application in an integration environment. In the application, an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue consumes messages and then an AWS Lambda function processes the messages. The Lambda function transforms the messages and makes an API call to a third-party service.

There has been an increase in application usage. The third-party API frequently returns an HTTP 429 Too Many Requests error message. The error message prevents a significant number of messages from being processed successfully.

How can the developer resolve this issue?
o: Increase the SQS event source’s batch size setting.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function based on the third-party API’s documented rate limits.
Increase the retry attempts and maximum event age in the Lambda function’s asynchronous configuration.
Configure maximum concurrency on the SQS event source based on the third-party service’s documented rate limits.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Ứng dụng integration: SQS queue → Lambda → call API third-party.

  • Khi usage tăng, third-party API trả về lỗi HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (rate limit exceeded).

  • Hệ quả: nhiều message không xử lý được.

  • Yêu cầu: Giải pháp để tránh bị vượt quá rate limit.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure maximum concurrency on the SQS event source based on the third-party service’s documented rate limits.

  • Nguyên nhân lỗi: Lambda scale-out quá nhanh, gửi nhiều request vượt quá rate limit của third-party API.

  • Giải pháp: Giới hạn maximum concurrency ở event source mapping (SQS → Lambda), đảm bảo số Lambda concurrent executions không vượt quá limit mà API chấp nhận.

  • Đây là cách “throttle” số request gửi ra ngoài, xử lý phù hợp với rate limit.

Architect:

Configure maximum concurrency:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the SQS event source’s batch size setting.

→ Batch size chỉ ảnh hưởng số message đọc từ queue mỗi lần gọi Lambda, không giải quyết được vấn đề rate limit.

❌ Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function based on the third-party API’s documented rate limits.

→ Provisioned concurrency = giữ sẵn Lambda execution để giảm cold start, không liên quan đến hạn chế số request đến API.

❌ Increase the retry attempts and maximum event age in the Lambda function’s asynchronous configuration.

→ Cấu hình này chỉ giúp retry nhiều hơn, nhưng vấn đề gốc vẫn là API rate limit. Retry nhiều sẽ tiếp tục bị 429.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • SQS → Lambda thường gặp vấn đề burst (scale nhanh).

  • Nếu có third-party API với rate limit → luôn dùng maximum concurrency để kiểm soát.

  • Đừng nhầm lẫn: provisioned concurrency = giảm cold start, maximum concurrency = giới hạn số concurrent executions.

📖 Reference:

Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings

questions.q:
A developer has created a large AWS Lambda function. Deployment of the function is failing because of an InvalidParameterValueException error. The error message indicates that the unzipped size of the function exceeds the maximum supported value.

Which actions can the developer take to resolve this error? (Choose two.)
o: Submit a quota increase request to AWS Support to increase the function to the required size.
Use a compression algorithm that is more efficient than ZIP.
Break up the function into multiple smaller functions.
Zip the .zip file twice to compress the file more.
Move common libraries, function dependencies, and custom runtimes into Lambda layers.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer deploy 1 Lambda function rất lớn → bị lỗi InvalidParameterValueException vì unzipped size vượt giới hạn cho phép.

  • Yêu cầu: Giải pháp hợp lệ để giảm size.

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Break up the function into multiple smaller functions.

→ Chia nhỏ logic thành nhiều Lambda functions thay vì nhồi hết vào 1 function khổng lồ.

Move common libraries, function dependencies, and custom runtimes into Lambda layers.

→ Dùng Lambda Layers để tách dependencies, library → size package chính, share layers cho nhiều Lambda.

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Submit a quota increase request to AWS Support to increase the function to the required size.

→ Giới hạn package size của Lambda là hard limit, không thể tăng bằng support request.

❌ Use a compression algorithm that is more efficient than ZIP.

→ AWS Lambda chỉ hỗ trợ .zip package (hoặc container image). Không đổi được thuật toán nén.

❌ Zip the .zip file twice to compress the file more.

→ Không có tác dụng, AWS sẽ unzip ra → size vẫn vượt limit.

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Giới hạn Lambda: 50 MB zipped (upload trực tiếp) hoặc 250 MB unzipped (bao gồm layers).

  • Tránh deploy function quá lớn: Tách dependencies ra Lambda Layer.

📖 Reference:

Lambda quotas

Managing Lambda dependencies with layers

questions.q:
A developer wants to reduce risk when deploying a new version of an existing AWS Lambda function. To test the Lambda function, the developer needs to split the traffic between the existing version and the new version of the Lambda function.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure a weighted routing policy in Amazon Route 53. Associate the versions of the Lambda function with the weighted routing policy.
Create a function alias. Configure the alias to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses the Lambda function as a target. Configure the ALB to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
Create the new version of the Lambda function as a Lambda layer on the existing version. Configure the function to split the traffic between the two layers.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer muốn deploy new version của Lambda function với reduce risk (giảm thiểu rủi ro)

  • Cần split traffic giữa existing version và new version để test

  • Tìm solution đáp ứng requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a function alias. Configure the alias to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.

  • Lambda alias hỗ trợ traffic shifting giữa các versions (routing configuration)

  • Có thể configure weight-based routing: VD 90% traffic → version 1, 10% → version 2

  • Native feature của Lambda, không cần thêm service khác

  • Thường dùng cho canary deployments và blue/green deployments

  • Dễ rollback nếu new version có vấn đề

Hình minh hoạ

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a weighted routing policy in Amazon Route 53. Associate the versions of the Lambda function with the weighted routing policy.

  • Route 53 dùng để route DNS traffic đến endpoints (như ALB, CloudFront, EC2), không thể route trực tiếp đến Lambda versions

  • Lambda versions không phải DNS endpoints

❌ Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses the Lambda function as a target. Configure the ALB to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.

  • ALB có thể invoke Lambda function nhưng không thể target nhiều versions của cùng một function

  • ALB chỉ route đến một Lambda function ARN, không support version-level routing

  • Thêm ALB cũng phức tạp và tốn chi phí không cần thiết

❌ Create the new version of the Lambda function as a Lambda layer on the existing version. Configure the function to split the traffic between the two layers.

  • Lambda layers dùng để share code/libraries giữa các functions, không phải để versioning hay traffic splitting

  • Layers không có khái niệm traffic routing

  • Sai concept hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Split traffic between Lambda versions" → Lambda Alias với weighted routing

  • Lambda deployment strategies:

    • Alias = pointer đến version + hỗ trợ traffic shifting

    • Version = immutable snapshot của function code

  • "Canary/Blue-Green deployment" → Lambda Alias

  • Route 53 không route đến Lambda versions

  • Lambda Layers = code sharing, không phải versioning/routing

📖 Reference:

  • Create an alias for a Lambda function

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that will connect to an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. The developer wants to store the database credentials. The database credentials need to be encrypted and the database password needs to be automatically rotated.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Store the database credentials as environment variables for the Lambda function. Set the environment variables to rotate automatically.
Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up managed rotation on the database credentials.
Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Set up managed rotation on the parameters.
Store the database credentials in the X-Amz-Security-Token parameter. Set up managed rotation on the parameter.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần connect đến RDS for MySQL instance

  • Developer cần store database credentials

  • Requirements:

    • Credentials phải được encrypted

    • Database password cần automatic rotation

  • Tìm solution đáp ứng cả hai requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up managed rotation on the database credentials.

  • Secrets Manager hỗ trợ automatic encryption và có managed rotation cho RDS credentials (built-in)

  • Rotation tự động update password trong cả Secrets Manager và RDS database

  • Best practice cho RDS credentials management

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the database credentials as environment variables for the Lambda function. Set the environment variables to rotate automatically.

  • Environment variables không hỗ trợ automatic rotation

  • Phải manually update và redeploy Lambda function mỗi lần đổi password

❌ Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Set up managed rotation on the parameters.

  • Parameter Store hỗ trợ encryption nhưng KHÔNG có managed rotation feature

  • Phải tự build custom rotation logic

❌ Store the database credentials in the X-Amz-Security-Token parameter. Set up managed rotation on the parameter.

  • X-Amz-Security-Token là temporary security token của STS, không phải credential storage service

  • Sai concept hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Database credentials + automatic rotation" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = credentials storage + managed rotation + versioning

    • Parameter Store = config data + encryption, KHÔNG có managed rotation

  • "RDS credentials rotation" → Secrets Manager có built-in rotation functions

  • X-Amz-Security-Token = STS temporary token, không phải storage

📖 Reference:

  • Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets

questions.q:
A developer registered an AWS Lambda function as a target for an Application Load Balancer (ALB) using a CLI command. However, the Lambda function is not being invoked when the client sends requests through the ALB.

Why is the Lambda function not being invoked?
o: A Lambda function cannot be registered as a target for an ALB.
A Lambda function can be registered with an ALB using AWS Management Console only.
The permissions to invoke the Lambda function are missing.
Cross-zone is not enabled on the ALB.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer đã register Lambda function as target cho ALB bằng CLI command

  • Client gửi requests qua ALB nhưng Lambda function không được invoke

  • Tìm nguyên nhân tại sao Lambda không được invoked

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The permissions to invoke the Lambda function are missing.

  • ALB cần Lambda invoke permissions để có thể trigger Lambda function

  • Phải thêm resource-based policy cho Lambda function cho phép ALB invoke

  • Command cần thiết: aws lambda add-permission với --principal elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  • Chỉ register Lambda làm target thôi chưa đủ, cần permission riêng

Permissions to invoke the Lambda function

aws lambda add-permission \
    --function-name lambda-function-arn-with-alias-name \ 
    --statement-id elb1 \
    --principal elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com \
    --action lambda:InvokeFunction \
    --source-arn target-group-arn \
    --source-account target-group-account-id

Các đáp án sai:

❌ A Lambda function cannot be registered as a target for an ALB.

  • Lambda CÓ THỂ được register làm target cho ALB

  • ALB hỗ trợ 4 loại targets: EC2 instances, IP addresses, ECS tasks, và Lambda functions

❌ A Lambda function can be registered with an ALB using AWS Management Console only.

  • Lambda có thể register với ALB qua CLI, Console, CloudFormation, hoặc SDK

  • CLI hoàn toàn được support

❌ Cross-zone is not enabled on the ALB.

  • Cross-zone load balancing không liên quan đến Lambda invocation

  • Cross-zone chỉ ảnh hưởng cách distribute traffic across AZs cho EC2/IP targets

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "ALB + Lambda not invoked" → kiểm tra Lambda permissions (resource-based policy)

  • ALB invoke Lambda cần 2 bước:

    • Register Lambda as target

    • Add invoke permission cho Lambda function

  • Command: aws lambda add-permission --function-name xxx --principal elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  • ALB supported targets: EC2, IP addresses, Lambda functions, ECS task

  • Cross-zone load balancing = phân phối traffic across AZs, không liên quan Lambda

📖 Reference:

  • Use Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer

questions.q:
A developer is planning to use an Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to provide a REST API. The developer will have three distinct environments to manage: development, test, and production.

How should the application be deployed while minimizing the number of resources to manage?
o: Create a separate API Gateway and separate Lambda function for each environment in the same Region.
Assign a Region for each environment and deploy API Gateway and Lambda to each Region.
Create one API Gateway with multiple stages with one Lambda function with multiple aliases.
Create one API Gateway and one Lambda function, and use a REST parameter to identify the environment.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer dùng API Gateway + Lambda để provide REST API

  • Cần manage 3 environments: development, test, production

  • Requirement: minimizing the number of resources to manage

  • Tìm deployment approach tối ưu

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create one API Gateway with multiple stages with one Lambda function with multiple aliases.

  • API Gateway stages cho phép deploy multiple versions (dev, test, prod) từ cùng một API

  • Lambda aliases point đến different versions của Lambda function cho mỗi environment

  • Map mỗi API Gateway stage đến Lambda alias tương ứng (dev stage → dev alias, prod stage → prod alias)

  • Minimize resources: chỉ cần 1 API Gateway và 1 Lambda function, dùng stages/aliases để phân biệt environments

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a separate API Gateway and separate Lambda function for each environment in the same Region.

  • Tạo 3 API Gateways và 3 Lambda functions = nhiều resources phải manage nhất

  • Không minimize resources như yêu cầu

❌ Assign a Region for each environment and deploy API Gateway and Lambda to each Region.

  • Deploy across multiple Regions tốn kém và phức tạp hơn

  • Không cần thiết cho environment separation, cross-region chỉ cần cho disaster recovery/latency

❌ Create one API Gateway and one Lambda function, and use a REST parameter to identify the environment.

  • Không có cách isolate environments properly (cùng chung code/config)

  • Khó manage permissions, configs, và testing riêng cho từng environment

  • Không phải best practice

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Multiple environments + minimize resources" → API Gateway Stages + Lambda Aliases

  • API Gateway Stages = dev, test, prod deployments của cùng một API

  • Lambda Aliases = pointers đến specific Lambda versions (stable naming cho environments)

  • Pattern phổ biến:

    • dev stage → dev alias → Lambda version X

    • prod stage → prod alias → Lambda version Y

  • Separate Regions = disaster recovery/global latency, không phải environment separation

📖 Reference:

  • Set up stage variables for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company is hosting a workshop for external users and wants to share the reference documents with the external users for 7 days. The company stores the reference documents in an Amazon S3 bucket that the company owns.

What is the MOST secure way to share the documents with the external users?
o: Use S3 presigned URLs to share the documents with the external users. Set an expiration time of 7 days.
Move the documents to an Amazon WorkDocs folder. Share the links of the WorkDocs folder with the external users.
Create temporary IAM users that have read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the access keys with the external users. Expire the credentials after 7 days.
Create a role that has read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this role with the external users.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company cần share reference documents với external users trong 7 days

  • Documents lưu trong S3 bucket của company

  • Requirement: MOST secure way to share

  • Tìm solution bảo mật nhất

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use S3 presigned URLs to share the documents with the external users. Set an expiration time of 7 days.

  • Presigned URLs cho phép temporary access đến S3 objects mà không cần AWS credentials

  • Set expiration time = 7 days, sau đó URLs tự động invalid

  • Không cần tạo IAM users/roles cho external users

  • Secure vì chỉ grant access đến specific objects và tự động expire

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Move the documents to an Amazon WorkDocs folder. Share the links of the WorkDocs folder with the external users.

  • Phải migrate documents sang WorkDocs (thêm complexity và cost)

  • WorkDocs cần setup users/permissions riêng

  • Không cần thiết khi đã có S3, presigned URLs đơn giản hơn

❌ Create temporary IAM users that have read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the access keys with the external users. Expire the credentials after 7 days.

  • Sharing access keys với external users = security risk (keys có thể bị leak)

  • Phải manually manage IAM users và cleanup sau 7 days

  • Vi phạm best practice: không nên share long-term credentials

❌ Create a role that has read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this role with the external users.

  • External users không có AWS account, không thể assume IAM role

  • Chỉ share ARN không cho phép access, cần credentials để assume role

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Temporary access to S3 + external users" → S3 Presigned URLs

  • Presigned URLs = temporary URLs với embedded credentials, không cần IAM users

  • NEVER share IAM access keys với external users (security risk)

  • IAM roles cần AWS credentials để assume, không work cho external users không có AWS account

  • Presigned URL use cases: share private objects temporarily, upload/download without AWS credentials

  • WorkDocs = document collaboration service, overkill cho simple file sharing

📖 Reference:

  • Sharing objects with presigned URLs

  • Download and upload objects with presigned URLs

questions.q:
A developer has built an application that inserts data into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The table is configured to use provisioned capacity. The application is deployed on a burstable nano Amazon EC2 instance. The application logs show that the application has been failing because of a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error.

Which actions should the developer take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)
o: Move the application to a larger EC2 instance.
Increase the number of read capacity units (RCUs) that are provisioned for the DynamoDB table.
Reduce the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by implementing exponential backoff.
Increase the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by decreasing the retry delay.
Change the capacity mode of the DynamoDB table from provisioned to on-demand.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application insert data vào DynamoDB table với provisioned capacity

  • Deploy trên burstable nano EC2 instance

  • Lỗi: ProvisionedThroughputExceededException

  • Requirement: chọn 2 actions để resolve issue

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Reduce the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by implementing exponential backoff.

  • Exponential backoff retry logic giảm request rate khi gặp throttling

  • AWS SDK best practice để handle throttling errors

  • Tự động tăng delay giữa các retries, giảm áp lực lên DynamoDB

Change the capacity mode of the DynamoDB table from provisioned to on-demand.

  • On-demand mode tự động scale theo workload, không bị throttle

  • Phù hợp cho unpredictable/bursty traffic patterns

  • Không cần manage capacity units manually

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Move the application to a larger EC2 instance.

  • Lỗi xảy ra ở DynamoDB throughput, không phải EC2 compute capacity

  • Tăng EC2 size không giải quyết DynamoDB throttling

❌ Increase the number of read capacity units (RCUs) that are provisioned for the DynamoDB table.

  • Application đang insert data = write operations, không phải reads

  • Cần tăng WCUs (Write Capacity Units), không phải RCUs

❌ Increase the frequency of requests to DynamoDB by decreasing the retry delay.

  • Tăng request frequency làm throttling TỆ HƠN, không giải quyết vấn đề

  • Ngược lại với logic cần thiết

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • ProvisionedThroughputExceededException = DynamoDB throttling do vượt quá provisioned capacity

  • Solutions cho throttling:

    • Implement exponential backoff (retry logic)

    • Increase WCUs/RCUs (nếu đúng loại operation)

    • Switch to on-demand mode

  • Insert/Write operations = cần WCUs, không phải RCUs

  • Exponential backoff = AWS SDK best practice cho retry logic

  • EC2 instance size không liên quan đến DynamoDB throughput

  • On-demand mode = auto-scaling, phù hợp unpredictable workloads

📖 Reference:

  • Retry with backoff pattern

  • DynamoDB on-demand and provisioned capacity

questions.q:
Given the following AWS CloudFormation template:

Description: Creates a new Amazon S3 bucket for shared content. Uses a random bucket name to avoid conflicts.

Resources:
  ContentBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket

Outputs:
  ContentBucketName:
    Value: !Ref ContentBucket

What is the MOST efficient way to reference the new Amazon S3 bucket from another AWS CloudFormation template?
o: Add an Export declaration to the Outputs section of the original template and use ImportValue in other templates.
Add Exported: true to the Content.Bucket in the original template and use ImportResource in other templates.
Create a custom AWS CloudFormation resource that gets the bucket name from the ContentBucket resource of the first stack.
Use Fn::Include to include the existing template in other templates and use the ContentBucket resource directly.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Có CloudFormation template tạo S3 bucket với Output = ContentBucketName

  • Output đã có Value: !Ref ContentBucket nhưng chưa có Export

  • Cần reference S3 bucket này từ another CloudFormation template

  • Requirement: MOST efficient way to reference

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add an Export declaration to the Outputs section of the original template and use ImportValue in other templates.

  • Thêm Export vào Outputs section để share value across stacks

  • Modified template: 

    Outputs:
    ContentBucketName:
      Value: !Ref ContentBucket
      Export:
        Name: SharedContentBucketName

  • Other stacks dùng Fn::ImportValue để reference: !ImportValue SharedContentBucketName

  • Native CloudFormation feature, efficient và đơn giản nhất

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add Exported: true to the Content.Bucket in the original template and use ImportResource in other templates.

  • Không có property Exported: true trong CloudFormation

  • Không có function ImportResource

  • Sai syntax hoàn toàn

❌ Create a custom AWS CloudFormation resource that gets the bucket name from the ContentBucket resource of the first stack.

  • Custom resource phức tạp, cần viết Lambda function

  • Không efficient khi có native Export/Import feature

  • Overkill cho use case đơn giản này

❌ Use Fn::Include to include the existing template in other templates and use the ContentBucket resource directly.

  • Không có function Fn::Include trong CloudFormation

  • Không thể include templates như vậy

  • Sai concept

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Reference resource across stacks" → Export/ImportValue pattern

  • Cross-stack reference pattern:

    • Stack A: Add Export trong Outputs

    • Stack B: Use Fn::ImportValue or !ImportValue

  • Export syntax cần thêm vào existing Output: 

    Export:
    Name: UniqueExportName

  • Export Name phải unique trong Region

  • Không có Exported: true, ImportResource, hay Fn::Include

📖 Reference:

  • Get exported outputs from a deployed CloudFormation stack

  • Fn::ImportValue function

questions.q:
An application is real-time processing millions of events that are received through an API.

What service could be used to allow multiple consumers to process the data concurrently and MOST cost-effectively?
o: Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS queue for each application
Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS FIFO (first-in, first-out) queue for each application
Amazon Kinesis Firehose
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application nhận millions of events qua API

  • Cần real-time processing

  • Cho phép multiple consumers process data concurrently

  • Requirement: MOST cost-effective

  • Tìm service phù hợp nhất

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

  • Built for real-time streaming với khả năng handle millions of events per second

  • Multiple consumers có thể process cùng data concurrently (Enhanced Fan-Out hoặc shared throughput)

  • Data persist trong stream (1-365 days), consumers có thể replay và process independently

  • Optimized cho high-throughput real-time processing, không phải simple messaging

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS queue for each application

  • SNS/SQS là messaging service, không phải real-time streaming platform

  • Với millions of events real-time, có higher latency so với Kinesis

  • SQS không persist data như stream, queue-based processing khác streaming processing

❌ Amazon SNS with fanout to an SQS FIFO (first-in, first-out) queue for each application

  • FIFO queue có throughput limit 300-3000 TPS, không handle được millions of events

  • Đắt hơn Standard SQS

  • Không phù hợp cho high-volume real-time streaming

❌ Amazon Kinesis Firehose

  • Firehose dùng để deliver/load data đến destinations (S3, Redshift, Elasticsearch)

  • Không support multiple consumers processing concurrently cùng real-time data

  • Use case: data delivery/ETL, không phải real-time concurrent processing

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Millions of events + real-time processing" → Kinesis Data Streams

  • Kinesis Data Streams vs SNS/SQS:

    • Kinesis = streaming platform, real-time analytics, persist data, high throughput

    • SNS/SQS = messaging service, decoupling, queue-based, không tối ưu cho streaming

  • Kinesis Data Streams vs Firehose:

    • Data Streams = processing với multiple consumers

    • Firehose = delivery đến destinations

  • "Multiple consumers + real-time" → Kinesis Enhanced Fan-Out (dedicated throughput per consumer)

  • FIFO SQS có throughput limit → không phù hợp millions of events

  • Cost-effective cho streaming = Kinesis (optimized for throughput), không phải SNS/SQS

📖 Reference:

  • Read data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

questions.q:
A web application is using Amazon Kinesis Data Streams for clickstream data that may not be consumed for up to 12 hours.

How can the developer implement encryption at rest for data within the Kinesis Data Streams?
o: Enable SSL connections to Kinesis.
Use Amazon Kinesis Consumer Library.
Encrypt the data once it is at rest with a Lambda function.
Enable server-side encryption in Kinesis Data Streams.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Web application dùng Kinesis Data Streams cho clickstream data

  • Data có thể không được consume trong 12 hours

  • Cần implement encryption at rest cho data trong Kinesis Data Streams

  • Tìm cách encrypt data at rest

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable server-side encryption in Kinesis Data Streams.

  • Kinesis Data Streams hỗ trợ server-side encryption (SSE) với AWS KMS

  • Tự động encrypt data at rest khi data được stored trong stream

  • Enable bằng cách specify KMS key khi tạo hoặc update stream

  • Encryption/decryption tự động xử lý bởi Kinesis, application không cần modify code

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Enable SSL connections to Kinesis.

  • SSL/TLS là encryption in transit, không phải encryption at rest

  • SSL chỉ protect data khi transfer giữa client và Kinesis

  • Không encrypt data khi stored trong stream

❌ Use Amazon Kinesis Consumer Library.

  • Kinesis Consumer Library (KCL) là library để build consumer applications

  • KCL không có chức năng encryption

  • KCL chỉ giúp manage consumers, checkpointing, load balancing

❌ Encrypt the data once it is at rest with a Lambda function.

  • Data "at rest" nghĩa là đã stored trong Kinesis stream

  • Không thể dùng Lambda để encrypt data sau khi đã at rest

  • Phải encrypt trước hoặc trong quá trình storing, không phải sau

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Encryption at rest" → Server-side encryption (SSE)

  • Encryption types:

    • At rest = data stored (SSE, KMS)

    • In transit = data transferring (SSL/TLS, HTTPS)

  • Kinesis encryption:

    • Enable server-side encryption với AWS KMS key

    • Automatic encryption/decryption

  • SSL/TLS = encryption in transit, không phải at rest

  • KCL = consumer library, không liên quan encryption

📖 Reference:

  • Data protection in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

  • How do I enable server-side encryption for Kinesis Data Streams

questions.q:
An application uses AWS X-Ray to generate a large amount of trace data on an hourly basis. A developer wants to use filter expressions to limit the returned results through user-specified custom attributes.

How should the developer use filter expressions to filter the results in X-Ray?
o: Add custom attributes as annotations in the segment document.
Add custom attributes as metadata in the segment document.
Add custom attributes as new segment fields in the segment document.
Create new sampling rules that are based on custom attributes.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application dùng AWS X-Ray generate large amount of trace data hourly

  • Developer muốn dùng filter expressions để limit results

  • Filter dựa trên user-specified custom attributes

  • Tìm cách implement filter expressions với custom attributes

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add custom attributes as annotations in the segment document.

  • Annotations là key-value pairs được indexed by X-Ray

  • Có thể dùng trong filter expressions để search và filter traces

  • Support filtering trong X-Ray console và API

  • Annotations phù hợp cho attributes cần searchable/filterable

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add custom attributes as metadata in the segment document.

  • Metadata là key-value pairs KHÔNG được indexed

  • Không thể dùng metadata trong filter expressions

  • Metadata chỉ để store additional info, không searchable

❌ Add custom attributes as new segment fields in the segment document.

  • Không thể tự ý thêm custom fields vào segment document structure

  • Segment document có fixed schema

  • Phải dùng annotations hoặc metadata cho custom data

❌ Create new sampling rules that are based on custom attributes.

  • Sampling rules quyết định traces nào được recorded, không phải filtering results

  • Sampling xảy ra trước khi trace được ghi, không phải lúc query

  • Không liên quan đến filter expressions để query traces

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Filter expressions + custom attributes" → Annotations

  • Annotations vs Metadata:

    • Annotations = indexed, searchable, filterable, max 50 annotations

    • Metadata = not indexed, chỉ để view, no filter support

  • Sampling vs Filtering:

    • Sampling = quyết định traces nào được recorded

    • Filtering = query/search traces đã recorded

  • X-Ray segment document structure là fixed, không custom fields

  • Use annotations cho data cần filter/search

📖 Reference:

  • https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-concepts.html#xray-concepts-annotations

  • https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-concepts.html#xray-concepts-filterexpressions

questions.q:
A developer is designing a serverless application that customers use to select seats for a concert venue. Customers send the ticket requests to an Amazon API Gateway API with an AWS Lambda function that acknowledges the order and generates an order ID. The application includes two additional Lambda functions: one for inventory management and one for payment processing. These two Lambda functions run in parallel and write the order to an Amazon Dynamo DB table.

The application must provide seats to customers according to the following requirements. If a seat is accidently sold more than once, the first order that the application received must get the seat. In these cases, the application must process the payment for only the first order. However, if the first order is rejected during payment processing, the second order must get the seat. In these cases, the application must process the payment for the second order.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic that fans out to one Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for inventory management and another SQS FIFO queue for payment processing.
Change the Lambda function that generates the order ID to initiate the Lambda function for inventory management. Then initiate the Lambda function for payment processing.
Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to the topic.
Deliver the order ID to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to poll the queue.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application cho concert seat selection

  • Flow: API Gateway → Lambda (tạo order ID) → 2 Lambda functions run in parallel:

    • Inventory management

    • Payment processing

  • Requirements phức tạp:

    • Nếu seat bị bán 2 lần (accidentally sold twice): first order nhận seat và process payment

    • Nếu first order rejected khi payment processing: second order nhận seat và process payment

    • Cần đảm bảo thứ tự (ordering guarantee) để xác định đơn hàng nào đến trước/sau

  • Tìm solution đáp ứng ordering requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic that fans out to one Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for inventory management and another SQS FIFO queue for payment processing.
