  • SNS FIFO topic giữ nghiêm ngặt ordering khi fanout messages

  • SQS FIFO queues đảm bảo messages được process theo exact order received

  • FIFO guarantee: first order arrive → process first → nếu fail thì second order process

  • Parallel processing vẫn maintain order trong mỗi queue

Hình minh hoạ:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change the Lambda function that generates the order ID to initiate the Lambda function for inventory management. Then initiate the Lambda function for payment processing.

  • Sequential invocation (inventory → payment), không phải parallel như requirement

  • Đề yêu cầu hai functions run in parallel

  • Sequential slow hơn và không match architecture hiện tại

❌ Send the order ID to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) topic. Subscribe the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to the topic.

  • Standard SNS topic không guarantee ordering

  • Messages có thể arrive out-of-order ở consumers

  • Không đảm bảo first/second order processing correctly

❌ Deliver the order ID to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the Lambda functions for inventory management and payment processing to poll the queue.

  • Chỉ có 1 queue cho 2 functions → không thể parallel processing properly

  • Message chỉ consumed một lần, không fanout được cho cả 2 functions

  • Một function consume thì function kia không nhận được message

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Ordering guarantee + parallel processing" → SNS FIFO + SQS FIFO

  • SNS FIFO fanout:

    • Maintain message ordering khi fanout

    • Mỗi SQS FIFO queue nhận messages theo đúng order

  • Standard SNS vs FIFO SNS:

    • Standard = no ordering guarantee

    • FIFO = strict ordering + exactly-once delivery

  • 1 SQS queue cho multiple consumers = không work (message consumed once)

  • Sequential Lambda invocation ≠ parallel processing

  • Pattern: SNS FIFO topic → multiple SQS FIFO queues = ordered fanout

📖 Reference:

  • Introducing Amazon SNS FIFO – First-In-First-Out Pub/Sub Messaging

questions.q:
An application needs to use the IP address of the client in its processing. The application has been moved into AWS and has been placed behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). However, all the client IP addresses now appear to be the same. The application must maintain the ability to scale horizontally.

Based on this scenario, what is the MOST cost-effective solution to this problem?
o: Remove the application from the ALB. Delete the ALB and change Amazon Route 53 to direct traffic to the instance running the application.
Remove the application from the ALCreate a Classic Load Balancer in its place. Direct traffic to the application using the HTTP protocol.
Alter the application code to inspect the X-Forwarded-For header. Ensure that the code can work properly if a list of IP addresses is passed in the header.
Alter the application code to inspect a custom header. Alter the client code to pass the IP address in the custom header.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application cần IP address of the client để processing

  • Application behind ALB

  • Hiện tại tất cả client IP addresses appear to be the same (thấy ALB IP)

  • Must maintain ability to scale horizontally

  • Requirement: MOST cost-effective solution

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Alter the application code to inspect the X-Forwarded-For header. Ensure that the code can work properly if a list of IP addresses is passed in the header.

  • ALB tự động thêm X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header chứa original client IP

  • Application chỉ cần đọc XFF header để lấy client IP

  • XFF có thể chứa list of IP addresses (qua nhiều proxies): client, proxy1, proxy2

  • Cost-effective: chỉ modify application code, không thay đổi infrastructure

  • Maintain horizontal scaling với ALB

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Remove the application from the ALB. Delete the ALB and change Amazon Route 53 to direct traffic to the instance running the application.

  • Mất khả năng horizontal scaling (không có load balancer)

  • Route 53 không thể distribute traffic và health check như ALB

  • Vi phạm requirement "maintain ability to scale horizontally"

❌ Remove the application from the ALB. Create a Classic Load Balancer in its place. Direct traffic to the application using the HTTP protocol.

  • Classic Load Balancer cũng dùng X-Forwarded-For header giống ALB

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề, vẫn cần modify code để đọc XFF

  • CLB là legacy, ALB có nhiều features hơn và cost-effective hơn

❌ Alter the application code to inspect a custom header. Alter the client code to pass the IP address in the custom header.

  • Phải modify cả client code và application code (phức tạp hơn)

  • Không cost-effective vì phải control và update clients

  • XFF header đã có sẵn từ ALB, không cần custom header

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "ALB + client IP" → X-Forwarded-For header

  • ALB automatically adds XFF header chứa original client IP

  • X-Forwarded-For format: client-ip, proxy1-ip, proxy2-ip (comma-separated list)

  • Code phải handle list of IPs, lấy first IP = original client

  • Classic vs Application Load Balancer: cả hai đều dùng XFF, ALB modern hơn

  • Remove load balancer = mất horizontal scaling capability

  • Custom header = unnecessary complexity khi đã có XFF

📖 Reference:

  • HTTP headers and Application Load Balancers

  • X-Forwarded-For header

questions.q:
A developer is receiving HTTP 400: ThrottlingException errors intermittently when calling the Amazon CloudWatch API. When a call fails, no data is retrieved.

What best practice should first be applied to address this issue?
o: Contact AWS Support for a limit increase.
Use the AWS CLI to get the metrics.
Analyze the applications and remove the API call.
Retry the call with exponential backoff.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer nhận HTTP 400: ThrottlingException errors intermittently khi call CloudWatch API

  • Khi call fails, no data is retrieved

  • Tìm best practice nên apply đầu tiên để address issue

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Retry the call with exponential backoff.

  • ThrottlingException = API rate limit exceeded, cần retry với backoff strategy

  • Exponential backoff = AWS best practice cho retry logic: tăng delay exponentially giữa retries (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s...)

  • Giảm request rate tự động khi gặp throttling

  • AWS SDKs có built-in exponential backoff, chỉ cần enable retry logic

  • Cost-effective và giải quyết intermittent throttling

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Contact AWS Support for a limit increase.

  • Limit increase chỉ cần khi throttling xảy ra consistently, không phải intermittently

  • Best practice là implement retry logic trước khi request limit increase

  • Increase limit tốn thời gian và có thể không cần thiết

❌ Use the AWS CLI to get the metrics.

  • AWS CLI cũng call same CloudWatch API, vẫn bị throttling

  • CLI không giải quyết throttling issue

  • Chỉ đổi tool, không fix root cause

❌ Analyze the applications and remove the API call.

  • Remove API call = mất functionality cần thiết

  • Throttling là temporary issue, không cần remove calls

  • Không phải solution, mà là workaround tồi

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "ThrottlingException + intermittent" → Exponential backoff retry

  • Exponential backoff pattern: delay = base_delay * (2 ^ retry_count)

  • AWS SDK auto-retry với exponential backoff (default behavior)

  • Throttling solutions theo thứ tự:

    1. Implement exponential backoff (first step)

    2. Optimize code để reduce API calls

    3. Request limit increase (last resort nếu consistently throttled)

📖 Reference:

  • Retry with backoff pattern

questions.q:
A company has an existing application that has hardcoded database credentials. A developer needs to modify the existing application. The application is deployed in two AWS Regions with an active-passive failover configuration to meet company’s disaster recovery strategy.

The developer needs a solution to store the credentials outside the code. The solution must comply with the company’s disaster recovery strategy.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?
o: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager in the primary Region. Enable secret replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

Store credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store in the primary Region. Enable parameter replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an S3 bucket in the primary Region. Enable Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to an S3 bucket in the secondary region. Update the application to access the config file from the S3 bucket, based on the Region.

Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Update the application to use the Amazon EFS file system Regional endpoints to access the config file in the primary and secondary Regions.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Existing application có hardcoded database credentials

  • Application deployed trong 2 Regions với active-passive failover (disaster recovery strategy)

  • Cần store credentials outside the code

  • Solution phải comply với disaster recovery strategy

  • Requirement: MOST secure way

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager in the primary Region. Enable secret replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

  • Secrets Manager designed specifically cho storing và managing credentials securely

  • Hỗ trợ automatic secret replication across Regions cho disaster recovery

  • Encrypted at rest với AWS KMS

  • Support automatic rotation của credentials

  • Application dùng ARN để retrieve secrets based on Region (primary hoặc secondary)

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store in the primary Region. Enable parameter replication to the secondary Region. Update the application to use the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) based on the Region.

  • Parameter Store hỗ trợ replication và encryption

  • Nhưng KHÔNG có automatic rotation cho credentials như Secrets Manager

  • Less secure cho database credentials management

❌ Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an S3 bucket in the primary Region. Enable Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to an S3 bucket in the secondary region. Update the application to access the config file from the S3 bucket, based on the Region.

  • Config file trong S3 KHÔNG secure cho credentials (dù có encryption)

  • Phải manage encryption/decryption manually

  • Không có automatic rotation

  • S3 không designed cho secrets management

❌ Store credentials in a config file. Upload the config file to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Update the application to use the Amazon EFS file system Regional endpoints to access the config file in the primary and secondary Regions.

  • EFS không support cross-region replication natively

  • Config file approach không secure

  • Không có versioning hay rotation cho credentials

  • EFS không phù hợp cho disaster recovery across Regions

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Database credentials + secure + DR" → Secrets Manager with replication

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = credentials management + automatic rotation + cross-region replication

    • Parameter Store = configuration data + SecureString, NO automatic rotation

  • "MOST secure for credentials" → Secrets Manager

  • Disaster recovery → enable replication to secondary Region

  • Config files trong S3/EFS = NOT secure cho credentials

📖 Reference:

  • Replicate AWS Secrets Manager secrets across Regions

questions.q:
A company requires that all applications running on Amazon EC2 use IAM roles to gain access to AWS services. A developer is modifying an application that currently relies on IAM user access keys stored in environment variables to access Amazon DynamoDB tables using boto, the AWS SDK for Python.

The developer associated a role with the same permissions as the IAM user to the EC2 instance, then deleted the IAM user. When the application was restarted, the AWS AccessDeniedException messages started appearing in the application logs. The developer was able to use their personal account on the server to run DynamoDB API commands using the AWS CLI.

What is the MOST likely cause of the exception?
o: IAM policies might take a few minutes to propagate to resources.
Disabled environment variable credentials are still being used by the application.
The AWS SDK does not support credentials obtained using an instance role.
The instance’s security group does not allow access to http://169.254.169.254.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application trên EC2 đang dùng IAM user access keys stored trong environment variables

  • Developer đã:

    • Associate IAM role (same permissions) với EC2 instance

    • Delete IAM user

    • Restart application

  • Kết quả: AccessDeniedException xuất hiện trong logs

  • Developer có thể run AWS CLI commands successfully trên server với personal account

  • Tìm MOST likely cause của exception

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Disabled environment variable credentials are still being used by the application.

  • Thứ tự ưu tiên credentials của AWS SDK: environment variables → instance metadata

  • Application vẫn đọc environment variables (access keys của deleted IAM user)

  • Environment variables chứa invalid credentials (user đã deleted) → AccessDeniedException

  • Phải remove/unset environment variables để boto fallback sang instance role

  • CLI works vì developer dùng personal account credentials (khác với app's env vars)

Các đáp án sai:

❌ IAM policies might take a few minutes to propagate to resources.

  • IAM policy changes thường áp dụng ngay lập tức (immediately) hoặc trong vài giây

  • Developer có thể run CLI successfully → permissions đã có hiệu lực

  • Không phải propagation delay issue

❌ The AWS SDK does not support credentials obtained using an instance role.

  • AWS SDK (boto3) FULLY supports instance roles via instance metadata

  • Instance role là recommended best practice

  • Sai hoàn toàn về SDK capabilities

❌ The instance's security group does not allow access to http://169.254.169.254.

  • Instance metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 không bị block bởi security groups

  • Metadata endpoint accessible từ instance regardless of security group rules

  • Developer có thể run CLI (cũng cần access metadata) → metadata accessible

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • AWS SDK credential chain order:

    1. Environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)

    2. Shared credentials file (~/.aws/credentials)

    3. Instance metadata (IAM role)

  • "Deleted IAM user + env vars still set" → credentials invalid nhưng still used

  • Phải unset environment variables để boto use instance role: 

    unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

  • Instance metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254 không bị security group block

  • CLI works với personal account ≠ application credentials working

📖 Reference:

  • Authentication and access credentials for the AWS CLI

questions.q:
A developer has built a market application that stores pricing data in Amazon DynamoDB with Amazon ElastiCache in front. The prices of items in the market change frequently. Sellers have begun complaining that, after they update the price of an item, the price does not actually change in the product listing.

What could be causing this issue?
o: The cache is not being invalidated when the price of the item is changed.
The price of the item is being retrieved using a write-through ElastiCache cluster.
The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient read capacity.
The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient write capacity.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Market application stores pricing data trong DynamoDB

  • ElastiCache in front of DynamoDB

  • Prices change frequently

  • Issue: sau khi sellers update price, price does not change trong product listing

  • Tìm nguyên nhân causing issue

✅ Đáp án đúng:

The cache is not being invalidated when the price of the item is changed.

  • ElastiCache đang serve stale/old data từ cache

  • Khi price update trong DynamoDB, cache không được invalidate/refresh

  • Product listing đọc từ cache (chưa update) thay vì DynamoDB (đã update)

  • Solution: implement cache invalidation khi update price trong DynamoDB

Các đáp án sai:

❌ The price of the item is being retrieved using a write-through ElastiCache cluster.

  • Write-through pattern: write to cache và database cùng lúc

  • Nếu dùng write-through, cache sẽ được update khi price change

  • Write-through giải quyết issue này, không phải nguyên nhân

❌ The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient read capacity.

  • Insufficient read capacity gây throttling errors, không phải stale data (data cũ)

  • Application vẫn đọc được data (từ cache), chỉ là data cũ

  • Không liên quan đến cache staleness

❌ The DynamoDB table was provisioned with insufficient write capacity.

  • Insufficient write capacity gây write throttling, update sẽ fail

  • Nếu update fail, sellers sẽ thấy error, không phải "price không change"

  • Issue là cache stale, không phải write failure

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Cache + data not updating" → Cache invalidation issue

  • Caching patterns:

    • Lazy loading (cache-aside): read from cache → if miss, read from DB → write to cache. Risk: stale data nếu không invalidate

    • Write-through: write to cache và DB cùng lúc → always fresh data

  • Cache invalidation strategies:

    • Invalidate cache khi update DB

    • Set TTL (Time-To-Live) cho cache entries

    • Use write-through pattern

  • Stale data = old data trong cache, DB đã update nhưng cache chưa

  • Insufficient capacity = throttling/errors, không phải stale data

📖 Reference:

  • Caching strategies with Amazon ElastiCache

questions.q:
A developer is working on an AWS Lambda function that accesses Amazon DynamoDB. The Lambda function must retrieve an item and update some of its attributes, or create the item if it does not exist. The Lambda function has access to the primary key.

Which IAM permissions should the developer request for the Lambda function to achieve this functionality?
o:
dynamodb:DeleleItem

dynamodb:GetItem

dynamodb:PutItem

dynamodb:UpdateItem

dynamodb:GetItem

dynamodb:DescribeTable

dynamodb:GetRecords

dynamodb:PutItem

dynamodb:UpdateTable

dynamodb:UpdateItem

dynamodb:GetItem

dynamodb:PutItem
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần access DynamoDB

  • Functionality requirements:

    • Retrieve item và update some attributes

    • Hoặc create item nếu item does not exist

  • Lambda có access to primary key

  • Tìm IAM permissions cần thiết

✅ Đáp án đúng:

dynamodb:UpdateItem

dynamodb:GetItem

dynamodb:PutItem

  • GetItem: retrieve item từ DynamoDB bằng primary key

  • UpdateItem: update attributes của existing item

  • PutItem: create new item nếu item không exist (hoặc replace entire item)

  • 3 permissions này đủ để implement logic: retrieve → update nếu exist, create nếu không exist

Các đáp án sai:

❌ dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem

  • DeleteItem không cần thiết cho use case này

  • Không có UpdateItem để update attributes

  • PutItem có thể replace item nhưng không phải best practice cho updating attributes

❌ dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:DescribeTable

  • DescribeTable chỉ để get metadata về table (schema, status), không thao tác data

  • Thiếu PutItem để create item khi không exist

  • DescribeTable không cần cho use case này

❌ dynamodb:GetRecords, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateTable

  • GetRecords dùng cho DynamoDB Streams, không phải get item từ table

  • UpdateTable để modify table structure (provisioned capacity, GSI), không phải data

  • Thiếu GetItem để retrieve item

  • Sai hoàn toàn về API operations

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • DynamoDB data operations:

    • GetItem = retrieve single item by primary key

    • PutItem = create new item hoặc replace entire item

    • UpdateItem = update specific attributes của existing item

    • DeleteItem = delete item

  • DynamoDB control operations:

    • DescribeTable = get table metadata

    • UpdateTable = modify table settings (capacity, indexes)

  • Pattern "retrieve + update or create":

    • Cần GetItem + UpdateItem + PutItem

    • Hoặc dùng UpdateItem với upsert behavior (tạo nếu không exist)

  • GetRecords = DynamoDB Streams API, không phải table operations

  • Principle of least privilege: chỉ grant permissions thực sự cần thiết

📖 Reference:

  • DynamoDB API actions

  • Working with items and attributes in DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer needs to manage AWS infrastructure as code and must be able to deploy multiple identical copies of the infrastructure, stage changes, and revert to previous versions.

Which approach addresses these requirements?
o: Use cost allocation reports and AWS OpsWorks to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics and alerts along with resource tagging to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần manage AWS infrastructure as code

  • Requirements:

    • Deploy multiple identical copies của infrastructure

    • Stage changes (testing changes trước khi apply)

    • Revert to previous versions

  • Tìm approach đáp ứng tất cả requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.

  • CloudFormation = Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool để define và deploy AWS resources

  • Deploy multiple identical stacks từ same template (multiple copies)

  • Version control templates trong CodeCommit → revert to previous versions dễ dàng

  • Change sets trong CloudFormation để preview/stage changes trước khi apply

  • Đáp ứng đầy đủ cả 3 requirements

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use cost allocation reports and AWS OpsWorks to deploy and manage the infrastructure.

  • Cost allocation reports để track costs, không phải Infrastructure as Code

  • OpsWorks là configuration management (Chef/Puppet), không phải thuẩn IaC như CloudFormation

  • Không phù hợp cho managing infrastructure as code với versioning

❌ Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics and alerts along with resource tagging to deploy and manage the infrastructure.

  • CloudWatch để monitoring/alerting, không phải deploy infrastructure

  • Resource tagging để organize resources, không phải IaC

  • Không có khả năng deploy hoặc version control infrastructure

❌ Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk and AWS CodeCommit to deploy and manage the infrastructure.

  • Elastic Beanstalk là PaaS cho deploying applications, không phải general infrastructure management

  • Beanstalk abstract infrastructure, không control full infrastructure as code

  • Không phù hợp cho managing arbitrary AWS infrastructure

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Infrastructure as Code (IaC)" → AWS CloudFormation (hoặc Terraform, CDK)

  • CloudFormation capabilities:

    • Define infrastructure trong templates (JSON/YAML)

    • Deploy multiple stacks từ same template

    • Change sets để preview changes

    • Stack updates với rollback capability

  • Version control IaC → store templates trong Git repositories (CodeCommit, GitHub)

  • "Multiple identical copies" → CloudFormation stacks từ same template

  • "Stage changes" → CloudFormation change sets

  • "Revert to previous versions" → Git version control + CloudFormation rollback

  • OpsWorks = configuration management, không phải pure IaC

  • Elastic Beanstalk = application deployment, không phải infrastructure management

📖 Reference:

  • What is AWS CloudFormation

questions.q:
A developer needs to launch a new Amazon EC2 instance by using the AWS CLI.

Which AWS CLI command should the developer use to meet this requirement?
o: aws ec2 bundle-instance
aws ec2 start-instances
aws ec2 confirm-product-instance
aws ec2 run-instances
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần launch a new EC2 instance bằng AWS CLI

  • Tìm AWS CLI command đúng

✅ Đáp án đúng:

aws ec2 run-instances

  • run-instances là command để launch (create) new EC2 instances

  • Specify AMI ID, instance type, security groups, key pairs, etc.

  • Tạo và start instance mới từ đầu

Example

aws ec2 run-instances \
    --image-id ami-0abcdef1234567890 \
    --instance-type t2.micro \
    --key-name MyKeyPair

Các đáp án sai:

❌ aws ec2 bundle-instance

  • bundle-instance để create instance store-backed AMI từ running instance

  • Không phải để launch new instance

  • Legacy command cho instance store instances

❌ aws ec2 start-instances

  • start-instances để start existing stopped instances

  • Không tạo new instance, chỉ start instance đã tồn tại

  • Cần instance ID của stopped instance

Example:

aws ec2 start-instances --instance-ids i-1234567890abcdef0

❌ aws ec2 confirm-product-instance

  • confirm-product-instance để verify product code associated với instance

  • Dùng cho marketplace AMIs validation

  • Không liên quan đến launching instances

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • EC2 instance lifecycle commands:

    • run-instances = launch/create new instance

    • start-instances = start stopped instance

    • stop-instances = stop running instance

    • terminate-instances = delete instance

    • reboot-instances = restart instance

  • "Launch new instance" → run-instances

  • "Start stopped instance" → start-instances

  • bundle-instance = create AMI (legacy), không phải launch

  • confirm-product-instance = marketplace verification

📖 Reference:

  • AWS CLI ec2 run-instances

questions.q:
A developer needs to troubleshoot an AWS Lambda function in a development environment. The Lambda function is configured in VPC mode and needs to connect to an existing Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance. The DB instance is deployed in a private subnet and accepts connections by using port 1433.

When the developer tests the function, the function reports an error when it tries to connect to the database.

Which combination of steps should the developer take to diagnose this issue? (Choose two.)
o: Check that the function’s security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the DB instance’s security group. Check that the DB instance’s security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the function’s security group.

Check that the function’s security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the DB instance’s security group. Check that the DB instance’s security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the function’s security group.
Check that the VPC is set up for a NAT gateway. Check that the DB instance has the public access option turned on.
Check that the function’s execution role permissions include rds:DescribeDBInstances, rds:ModifyDBInstance. and rds:DescribeDBSecurityGroups for the DB instance.
Check that the function’s execution role permissions include ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, and ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function in VPC mode cần connect đến RDS for SQL Server

  • RDS deployed trong private subnet, accept connections trên port 1433

  • Function reports error khi connect to database

  • Chọn 2 steps để chuẩn đoán issue

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Check that the function's security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the DB instance's security group. Check that the DB instance's security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the function's security group.

  • Lambda cần outbound rule trên port 1433 để connect ra ngoài

  • RDS cần inbound rule trên port 1433 để accept connections từ Lambda

  • Security groups phải allow communication 2 chiều: Lambda outbound → RDS inbound

  • Đây là common issue khi Lambda VPC không connect được database

Check that the function's execution role permissions include ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, and ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface.

  • Lambda in VPC mode cần EC2 network permissions để create ENI (Elastic Network Interface) trong VPC

  • Permissions này required cho Lambda VPC configuration

  • Nếu thiếu permissions, Lambda không thể establish network connections trong VPC

Kiến trúc tham khảo:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Check that the function's security group has inbound access on port 1433 from the DB instance's security group. Check that the DB instance's security group has outbound access on port 1433 to the function's security group.

  • Sai chiều traffic flow

  • Lambda initiate connection (outbound), RDS receive connection (inbound)

  • Không phải RDS connect đến Lambda

❌ Check that the VPC is set up for a NAT gateway. Check that the DB instance has the public access option turned on.

  • NAT gateway chỉ cần nếu Lambda cần access internet, không phải private RDS

  • RDS trong private subnet không cần public access

  • Public access là security risk, không phù hợp

❌ Check that the function's execution role permissions include rds:DescribeDBInstances, rds:ModifyDBInstance, and rds:DescribeDBSecurityGroups for the DB instance.

  • Permissions này để manage RDS resources qua AWS API

  • Không cần cho database connections (connect qua SQL protocol)

  • Lambda connect đến RDS qua network, không qua AWS API

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda VPC mode requirements:

    • Security group rules: Lambda outbound → RDS inbound

    • EC2 permissions: CreateNetworkInterface, DescribeNetworkInterfaces, DeleteNetworkInterface

    • Subnet với available IP addresses

  • Security group troubleshooting:

    • Lambda (client) = outbound rule

    • RDS (server) = inbound rule

  • NAT gateway chỉ cần cho internet access, không phải private resources

  • RDS permissions (rds:*) = API operations, không phải database connections

  • Database connections dùng network + database credentials, không phải IAM permissions

📖 Reference:

  • Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC

questions.q:
A company uses Amazon DynamoDB as a data store for its order management system. The company frontend application stores orders in a DynamoDB table. The DynamoDB table is configured to send change events to a DynamoDB stream. The company uses an AWS Lambda function to log and process the incoming orders based on data from the DynamoDB stream.

An operational review reveals that the order quantity of incoming orders is sometimes set to 0. A developer needs to create a dashboard that will show how many unique customers this problem affects each day.

What should the developer do to implement the dashboard?
o: Grant the Lambda function’s execution role permissions to upload logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Implement a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch Logs Insights query to a CloudWatch dashboard.

Use Amazon Athena to query AWS CloudTrail API logs for API calls. Implement an Athena query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the Athena query to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard.

Configure the Lambda function to send events to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add a CloudWatch dashboard as the target of the rule.

Turn on custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB stream of the DynamoDB table. Create a CloudWatch alarm that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch alarm to a CloudWatch dashboard.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table stores orders, send change events đến DynamoDB stream

  • Lambda function process incoming orders từ DynamoDB stream

  • Issue: order quantity sometimes = 0

  • Requirement: tạo dashboard hiển thị bao nhiêu unique customers bị ảnh hưởng mỗi ngày

  • Tìm solution để implement dashboard

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Grant the Lambda function's execution role permissions to upload logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Implement a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch Logs Insights query to a CloudWatch dashboard.

  • Lambda log orders với quantity = 0 (bao gồm customer ID) vào CloudWatch Logs

  • CloudWatch Logs Insights query để analyze logs: filter quantity = 0, count unique customers, group by day

  • Add query results vào CloudWatch dashboard để visualize daily metrics

  • Simple và cost-effective solution sử dụng existing Lambda processing

Kiến trúc tham khảo:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon Athena to query AWS CloudTrail API logs for API calls. Implement an Athena query that selects the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 and groups the results in 1-day periods. Add the Athena query to an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard.

  • CloudTrail logs chỉ capture AWS API calls, không chứa business data (order quantity, customer info)

  • CloudTrail không có order details từ DynamoDB stream

  • Athena query không thể access order data từ CloudTrail

❌ Configure the Lambda function to send events to Amazon EventBridge. Create an EventBridge rule that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add a CloudWatch dashboard as the target of the rule.

  • EventBridge rules không có capability để group và count unique values across time periods

  • EventBridge route events, không phải analytics/aggregation tool

  • Dashboard không phải valid EventBridge target cho aggregated metrics

❌ Turn on custom Amazon CloudWatch metrics for the DynamoDB stream of the DynamoDB table. Create a CloudWatch alarm that groups the number of unique customers for orders with order quantity equal to 0 in 1-day periods. Add the CloudWatch alarm to a CloudWatch dashboard.

  • DynamoDB streams không có built-in custom metrics cho business logic filtering

  • CloudWatch alarms dùng để alert, không phải group/count unique customers

  • Không thể turn on custom metrics directly từ DynamoDB stream

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Analyze logs + create dashboard" → CloudWatch Logs Insights + CloudWatch Dashboard

  • CloudWatch Logs Insights capabilities:

    • Query logs với SQL-like syntax

    • Count unique values (distinct customers)

    • Group by time periods

    • Visualize trong dashboard

  • CloudTrail = AWS API calls audit, không chứa application data

  • EventBridge = event routing, không phải analytics/aggregation

  • DynamoDB streams không có custom metrics cho business logic

  • Pattern: Lambda log data → CloudWatch Logs → Logs Insights query → Dashboard

📖 Reference:

  • Analyzing log data with CloudWatch Logs Insights

  • Add a query to a CloudWatch dashboard

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that will generate and export a file. The function requires 100 MB of temporary storage for temporary files while running. These files will not be needed after the function is complete.

How can the developer MOST efficiently handle the temporary files?
o: Store the files in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Copy the files to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Store the files in the /tmp directory and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.
Copy the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with a lifecycle policy to delete the files.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần 100 MB temporary storage cho temporary files

  • Files chỉ cần trong khi function running

  • Files not needed after function complete

  • Requirement: MOST efficiently handle temporary files

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the files in the /tmp directory and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.

  • Lambda có built-in /tmp directory với 512 MB - 10 GB storage (configurable)

  • /tmp persistent across invocations trong cùng execution environment (nhưng không guaranteed)

  • No additional cost cho /tmp usage

  • Cleanup /tmp at end of function để free space cho invocations tiếp theo

  • Most efficient: không cần external storage services

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Store the files in Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.

  • Lambda không thể directly attach EBS volumes

  • EBS dùng cho EC2 instances, không phải Lambda

  • Không compatible với Lambda architecture

❌ Copy the files to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) and delete the files at the end of the Lambda function.

  • EFS có thể mount vào Lambda nhưng overkill cho temporary files

  • EFS có additional cost (storage + throughput)

  • Slower performance so với /tmp (network latency)

  • Không hiệu quả cho simple temporary storage

❌ Copy the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with a lifecycle policy to delete the files.

  • S3 có additional cost (PUT requests + storage)

  • Network latency khi upload/download files

  • Lifecycle policy minimum 1 day expiration

  • Overkill và không efficient cho temporary files chỉ cần trong function execution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • Lambda /tmp directory:

    • Default 512 MB, configurable up to 10 GB

    • Ephemeral storage - có thể persist across invocations nhưng not guaranteed

    • No additional cost (included trong Lambda pricing)

  • "Temporary files during Lambda execution" → /tmp directory

  • Best practices:

    • Cleanup /tmp files at end of function

    • Check /tmp size nếu files lớn

  • Lambda KHÔNG support EBS volumes

  • EFS = persistent shared file system, overkill cho temp files

  • S3 = object storage, không efficient cho temporary runtime files

📖 Reference:

  • Configuring ephemeral storage for Lambda

questions.q:
A company uses Amazon API Gateway to expose a set of APIs to customers. The APIs have caching enabled in API Gateway. Customers need a way to invalidate the cache for each API when they test the API.

What should a developer do to give customers the ability to invalidate the API cache?
o: Ask the customers to use AWS credentials to call the InvalidateCache API operation.

Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to send a request that contains the Cache-Control:max-age=0 HTTP header when they make an API call.
Ask the customers to use the AWS SDK API Gateway class to invoke the InvalidateCache API operation.
Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to add the INVALIDATE_CACHE query string parameter when they make an API call.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng API Gateway expose APIs to customers

  • APIs có caching enabled trong API Gateway

  • Customers cần invalidate cache khi test APIs

  • Tìm cách cho customers ability to invalidate API cache

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to send a request that contains the Cache-Control:max-age=0 HTTP header when they make an API call.

  • Attach InvalidateCache policy cho phép customers invalidate cache

  • Customers gửi Cache-Control: max-age=0 header trong API request để invalidate cache

  • API Gateway check IAM permissions và header để invalidate cache cho specific request

  • Standard HTTP caching mechanism, dễ implement

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Ask the customers to use AWS credentials to call the InvalidateCache API operation.

  • InvalidateCache API operation không tồn tại trong API Gateway API

  • Customers không nên có direct access đến AWS management APIs

  • Không phải standard way để invalidate API Gateway cache

❌ Ask the customers to use the AWS SDK API Gateway class to invoke the InvalidateCache API operation.

  • Không có InvalidateCache API operation trong API Gateway SDK

  • Customers không nên dùng AWS SDK để manage API Gateway resources

  • SDK là management tool, không phải cho API consumers

❌ Attach an InvalidateCache policy to the IAM execution role that the customers use to invoke the API. Ask the customers to add the INVALIDATE_CACHE query string parameter when they make an API call.

  • INVALIDATE_CACHE query string parameter không phải valid method

  • API Gateway không recognize parameter này để invalidate cache

  • Không phải documented approach

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • API Gateway cache invalidation methods:

    • Cache-Control: max-age=0 header (per-request invalidation)

    • Console/CLI flush entire cache (admin operation)

  • Cache invalidation permissions:

    • Attach InvalidateCache policy cho IAM role

    • Permission format: execute-api:InvalidateCache

  • "Customers invalidate cache when testing" → Cache-Control header

  • Không có InvalidateCache API operation trong API Gateway

  • Query string parameters không dùng cho cache invalidation

  • Cache-Control header = standard HTTP caching mechanism

📖 Reference:

  • Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A developer is writing a serverless application that requires an AWS Lambda function to be invoked every 10 minutes.

What is an automated and serverless way to invoke the function?
o: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance based on Linux, and edit its /etc/crontab file by adding a command to periodically invoke the Lambda function.
Configure an environment variable named PERIOD for the Lambda function. Set the value to 600.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs on a regular schedule to invoke the Lambda function.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that has a subscription to the Lambda function with a 600-second timer.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần được invoked every 10 minutes

  • Requirement: automated and serverless way to invoke

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs on a regular schedule to invoke the Lambda function.

  • EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) hỗ trợ scheduled rules với cron/rate expressions

  • Serverless, fully managed service

  • Rate expression: rate(10 minutes) hoặc cron expression

  • Automatically invoke Lambda function theo schedule

  • No infrastructure management

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance based on Linux, and edit its /etc/crontab file by adding a command to periodically invoke the Lambda function.

  • EC2 instance KHÔNG serverless - phải manage infrastructure

  • Tốn chi phí chạy EC2 instance 24/7 chỉ để invoke Lambda

  • Không automated (phải maintain instance, crontab)

  • Vi phạm yêu cầu serverless

❌ Configure an environment variable named PERIOD for the Lambda function. Set the value to 600.

  • Environment variables không trigger Lambda execution

  • Environment variables chỉ để pass configuration vào function

  • Không có scheduling mechanism

  • Không giải quyết vấn đề

❌ Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that has a subscription to the Lambda function with a 600-second timer.

  • SNS không có timer/scheduling capability

  • SNS là pub/sub messaging service, không phải scheduler

  • Không thể set timer trên SNS subscription

  • Sai concept hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Invoke Lambda periodically/scheduled" → EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) scheduled rules

  • EventBridge scheduled expressions:

    • Rate expression: rate(10 minutes), rate(1 hour), rate(1 day)

    • Cron expression: cron(0/10 * * * ? *) (every 10 minutes)

  • Serverless scheduling options:

    • EventBridge rules (recommended)

    • CloudWatch Events (legacy, now EventBridge)

  • EC2 with cron = NOT serverless

  • Environment variables = configuration, NOT triggers

  • SNS = messaging, NO scheduling capability

📖 Reference:

  • Creating a rule that runs on a schedule in Amazon EventBridge

questions.q:
A developer is preparing to begin development of a new version of an application. The previous version of the application is deployed in a production environment. The developer needs to deploy fixes and updates to the current version during the development of the new version of the application. The code for the new version of the application is stored in AWS CodeCommit.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: From the main branch, create a feature branch for production bug fixes. Create a second feature branch from the main branch for development of the new version.
Create a Git tag of the code that is currently deployed in production. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version. Push the two tags to the CodeCommit repository.
From the main branch, create a branch of the code that is currently deployed in production. Apply an IAM policy that ensures no other users can push or merge to the branch.
Create a new CodeCommit repository for development of the new version of the application. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer đang develop new version của application

  • Previous version đang deployed trong production

  • Cần deploy fixes and updates to current version during development của new version

  • Code stored trong AWS CodeCommit

  • Requirement: manage cả hai versions simultaneously

✅ Đáp án đúng:

From the main branch, create a feature branch for production bug fixes. Create a second feature branch from the main branch for development of the new version.

  • Branching strategy cho phép parallel development:

    • Feature branch cho bug fixes → merge vào main → deploy to production

    • Feature branch cho new version → develop independently

  • Main branch remain stable cho production releases

  • Isolate changes giữa bug fixes và new development

  • Standard Git workflow, easy to manage

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a Git tag of the code that is currently deployed in production. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version. Push the two tags to the CodeCommit repository.

  • Git tags dùng để mark specific points in history (releases), không phải active development

  • Tags are immutable (read-only), cannot commit changes to tags

  • Không thể develop hoặc fix bugs trên tags

  • Sai use case cho tags

❌ From the main branch, create a branch of the code that is currently deployed in production. Apply an IAM policy that ensures no other users can push or merge to the branch.

  • Tạo branch cho production code là đúng

  • Nhưng IAM policy không control Git push/merge permissions trong CodeCommit

  • CodeCommit dùng IAM policies cho repository access, không phải branch-level control

  • Không có branch cho new version development

❌ Create a new CodeCommit repository for development of the new version of the application. Create a Git tag for the development of the new version.

  • Separate repository phức tạp và không cần thiết

  • Khó share code và maintain consistency giữa versions

  • Git tags không dùng cho active development

  • Không operationally efficient

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Parallel development + bug fixes" → Feature branches

  • Git branching strategies:

    • Main/Master branch = stable production code

    • Feature branches = new features hoặc bug fixes

    • Release branches = prepare releases

  • Git tags vs Branches:

    • Tags = immutable markers (v1.0, v2.0), không develop trên tags

    • Branches = active development, can commit changes

  • Workflow pattern:

    • Bug fixes → feature branch → merge to main → deploy

    • New version → feature branch → develop independently

  • IAM policies control repository access, không phải branch permissions

  • Multiple repositories = unnecessary complexity cho same application

questions.q:
A developer is building a serverless application that connects to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. The serverless application consists of hundreds of AWS Lambda functions. During every Lambda function scale out, a new database connection is made that increases database resource consumption.

The developer needs to decrease the number of connections made to the database. The solution must not impact the scalability of the Lambda functions.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure provisioned concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ProvisionedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.
Enable cluster cache management for Aurora PostgreSQL. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to point to cluster cache management.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a connection pool to manage the database connections. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to reference the proxy.
Configure reserved concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ReservedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application với hundreds of Lambda functions connect đến Aurora PostgreSQL

  • Issue: mỗi Lambda scale out tạo new database connection → tăng database resource consumption

  • Requirement:

    • Decrease số connections đến database

    • Not impact scalability của Lambda functions

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a connection pool to manage the database connections. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to reference the proxy.

  • RDS Proxy tạo connection pool giữa Lambda và Aurora

  • Connection pooling: reuse existing connections thay vì tạo new connections mỗi invocation

  • Reduce database connections drastically (hundreds → vài chục)

  • Lambda functions vẫn scale tự do, RDS Proxy manage connections hiệu quả

  • Built-in for serverless architectures với Lambda

Kiến trúc tham thảo:

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure provisioned concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ProvisionedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.

  • Provisioned concurrency giữ Lambda instances warm để reduce cold starts

  • Không giải quyết connection pooling issue

  • Tốn chi phí cho provisioned concurrency

❌ Enable cluster cache management for Aurora PostgreSQL. Change the connection string of each Lambda function to point to cluster cache management.

  • Cluster cache management không phải real feature của Aurora PostgreSQL

  • Không giải quyết database connection issue

  • Sai concept

❌ Configure reserved concurrency for each Lambda function by setting the ReservedConcurrentExecutions parameter to 10.

  • Reserved concurrency limit concurrent executions của function

  • Limit to 10 per function severely impacts scalability

  • Không giải quyết connection pooling

  • Vi phạm requirement "not impact scalability"

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda + database connections" → RDS Proxy với connection pooling

  • Provisioned/Reserved concurrency limit scalability, không giải quyết connection issue

  • RDS Proxy benefits:

    • Connection pooling

    • Reduce DB load

    • Automatic failover

📖 Reference:

  • Using Amazon RDS Proxy with Lambda

  • RDS Proxy connection considerations

questions.q:
A developer is setting up infrastructure by using AWS CloudFormation. If an error occurs when the resources described in the Cloud Formation template are provisioned, successfully provisioned resources must be preserved. The developer must provision and update the CloudFormation stack by using the AWS CLI.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Add an --enable-termination-protection command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --disable-rollback command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --parameters ParameterKey=PreserveResources,ParameterValue=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
Add a --tags Key=PreserveResources,Value=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer setup infrastructure bằng CloudFormation

  • Requirement: nếu error occurs during provisioning, successfully provisioned resources must be preserved

  • Provision và update stack bằng AWS CLI

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a --disable-rollback command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.

  • --disable-rollback ngăn chặn CloudFormation xoá những successfully created resources khi stack creation fails

  • Default behavior: CloudFormation rollback và delete all resources nếu có error

  • Với disable-rollback: successfully provisioned resources được preserved (giữ lại) để troubleshoot

  • Useful cho debugging - có thể inspect resources đã tạo thành công

create-stack command:

aws cloudformation create-stack \
--stack-name my-app-stack \
--template-body file://my-template.yaml \
--parameters ParameterKey=InstanceType,ParameterValue=t2.micro \
--disable-rollback

update-stack command:

aws cloudformation update-stack \
--stack-name my-app-stack \
--template-body file://my-template-updated.yaml \
--parameters ParameterKey=InstanceType,ParameterValue=t2.medium \
--disable-rollback

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add an --enable-termination-protection command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.

  • Termination protection ngăn chặn accidental deletion của entire stack

  • Không liên quan đến giữ lại resources khi provisioning fails

  • Không ảnh hưởng rollback behavior during stack creation errors

❌ Add a --parameters ParameterKey=PreserveResources,ParameterValue=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.

  • Parameters dùng để pass values vào CloudFormation template

  • PreserveResources không phải built-in CloudFormation parameter

  • Không có effect trên rollback behavior

❌ Add a --tags Key=PreserveResources,Value=True command line option to the create-stack command and the update-stack command.

  • Tags dùng để organize và track resources

  • Tags không control rollback behavior

  • Không preserve resources khi error occurs

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Preserve resources on failure" → --disable-rollback

  • CloudFormation rollback behavior:

    • Default: rollback và delete all resources on failure

    • --disable-rollback: keep successfully created resources

  • Termination protection = ngăn chặn stack deletion, không phải giữ lại resource khi error

  • Parameters và Tags không affect rollback behavior

📖 Reference:

  • create-stack CLI command

questions.q:
A developer is working on an application that processes operating data from IoT devices. Each IoT device uploads a data file once every hour to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer wants to immediately process each data file when the data file is uploaded to Amazon S3.

The developer will use an AWS Lambda function to process the data files from Amazon S3. The Lambda function is configured with the S3 bucket information where the files are uploaded. The developer wants to configure the Lambda function to immediately invoke after each data file is uploaded.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Add an asynchronous invocation to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add an Amazon EventBridge event to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add a trigger to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
Add a layer to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • IoT devices upload data file mỗi giờ to S3 bucket

  • Developer muốn immediately process mỗi data file khi uploaded

  • Sử dụng Lambda function để process files từ S3

  • Requirement: configure Lambda để immediately invoke after mỗi file uploaded

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a trigger to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.

  • S3 event trigger cho Lambda function tự động invoke khi có object uploaded

  • Configure S3 event notifications (ObjectCreated:Put, ObjectCreated:Post)

  • Lambda immediately invoked khi file uploaded to S3

  • Native integration giữa S3 và Lambda

Using an Amazon S3 trigger to invoke a Lambda function

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add an asynchronous invocation to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.

  • Asynchronous invocation là invocation mode của Lambda, không phải trigger mechanism

  • Không configure được S3 bucket làm source cho asynchronous invocation

  • Không tự động invoke khi file uploaded

❌ Add an Amazon EventBridge event to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.

  • S3 có thể send events đến EventBridge nhưng phải enable EventBridge integration trên S3 bucket trước

  • Direct S3 trigger đơn giản hơn và native hơn cho use case này

  • EventBridge adds unnecessary complexity

❌ Add a layer to the Lambda function. Select the S3 bucket as the source.

  • Lambda layers dùng để share code, libraries, dependencies

  • Layers không phải trigger mechanism

  • Không liên quan đến S3 events

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "S3 upload → immediately invoke Lambda" → S3 event trigger

  • S3 event types: ObjectCreated:Put, ObjectCreated:Post, ObjectCreated:, ObjectRemoved:

  • Direct S3 trigger = simplest solution cho S3 → Lambda integration

  • EventBridge có thể dùng nhưng overkill cho simple S3 → Lambda

  • Lambda layers = code sharing, không phải triggers

📖 Reference:

  • Tutorial: Using an Amazon S3 trigger to invoke a Lambda function

questions.q:
A developer is building a serverless application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The developer is currently testing the application in a development environment. When the application is nearly finished, the developer will need to set up additional testing and staging environments for a quality assurance team.

The developer wants to use a feature of the AWS SAM to set up deployments to multiple environments.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
o: Add a configuration file in TOML format to group configuration entries to every environment. Add a table for each testing and staging environment. Deploy updates to the environments by using the sam deploy command and the --config-env flag that corresponds to each environment.

Create additional AWS SAM templates for each testing and staging environment. Write a custom shell script that uses the sam deploy command and the --template-file flag to deploy updates to the environments.

Create one AWS SAM configuration file that has default parameters. Perform updates to the testing and staging environments by using the --parameter-overrides flag in the AWS SAM CLI and the parameters that the updates will override.

Use the existing AWS SAM template. Add additional parameters to configure specific attributes for the serverless function and database table resources that are in each environment. Deploy updates to the testing and staging environments by using the sam deploy command.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer building serverless app bằng AWS SAM

  • Hiện tại test trong development environment

  • Cần setup thêm testing and staging environments cho QA team

  • Requirement: sử dụng AWS SAM feature để deploy to multiple environments với LEAST development effort

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a configuration file in TOML format to group configuration entries to every environment. Add a table for each testing and staging environment. Deploy updates to the environments by using the sam deploy command and the --config-env flag that corresponds to each environment.

  • SAM configuration file (samconfig.toml) cho phép define multiple environment configs trong một file

  • Mỗi environment có dedicated section/table với specific parameters

  • Deploy dễ dàng: sam deploy --config-env dev, sam deploy --config-env staging, sam deploy --config-env prod

  • Least effort: centralized config, no custom scripts, no template duplication

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create additional AWS SAM templates for each testing and staging environment. Write a custom shell script that uses the sam deploy command and the --template-file flag to deploy updates to the environments.

  • Duplicate SAM templates cho mỗi environment = maintenance overhead

  • Custom shell script = additional development effort

  • Không phải least effort approach

❌ Create one AWS SAM configuration file that has default parameters. Perform updates to the testing and staging environments by using the --parameter-overrides flag in the AWS SAM CLI and the parameters that the updates will override.

  • --parameter-overrides phải pass parameters mỗi lần deploy (command line dài, dễ mắc lỗi)

  • Không centralized config management

  • More effort so với config file approach

❌ Use the existing AWS SAM template. Add additional parameters to configure specific attributes for the serverless function and database table resources that are in each environment. Deploy updates to the testing and staging environments by using the sam deploy command.

  • Không specify cách manage different environment configs

  • sam deploy alone không automatically deploy to different environments với different configs

  • Thiếu có chế để differentiate environments

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Multiple environments + least effort" → samconfig.toml với --config-env

  • samconfig.toml structure: 

    [dev.deploy.parameters]
stack_name = "app-dev"

[staging.deploy.parameters]
stack_name = "app-staging"

  • Deploy: sam deploy --config-env dev hoặc sam deploy --config-env staging

  • Avoid: template duplication, custom scripts, manual parameter overrides

📖 Reference:

  • AWS SAM configuration file

  • Deploying to multiple environments with SAM

questions.q:
An IT department uses Amazon S3 to store sensitive images. After more than 1 year, the company moves the images into archival storage. The company rarely accesses the images, but the company wants a storage solution that maximizes resiliency. The IT department needs access to the images that have been moved to archival storage within 24 hours.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
Use S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • IT department stores sensitive images trong S3

  • After > 1 year, move images vào archival storage

  • Company rarely accesses archived images

  • Requirements:

    • Storage solution maximizes resiliency

    • Access to archived images within 24 hours

    • MOST cost-effective

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

  • S3 Standard-IA: infrequent access, high resiliency (multi-AZ), cost-effective cho images < 1 year

  • Glacier Deep Archive: lowest cost archival storage cho rarely accessed data

  • Standard retrieval: 12 hours retrieval time, đáp ứng requirement within 24 hours

  • Standard-IA multi-AZ maximizes resiliency cho sensitive images

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

  • Bulk retrieval = 48 hours retrieval time

  • KHÔNG đáp ứng requirement "within 24 hours"

  • Vi phạm access time requirement

❌ Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

  • S3 Intelligent-Tiering có monitoring and automation fees

  • Đắt hơn Standard-IA cho known access pattern (infrequent < 1 year)

  • Không phải most cost-effective

❌ Use S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

  • One Zone-IA stores data trong single AZ, lower resiliency (khả năng phục hồi)

  • Vi phạm requirement "maximizes resiliency" cho sensitive images

  • Bulk retrieval (48 hours) không meet 24-hour requirement

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Maximize resiliency" → Multi-AZ storage (Standard-IA), NOT One Zone-IA

  • Glacier Deep Archive retrieval:

    • Standard retrieval = 12 hours

    • Bulk retrieval = 48 hours (cheapest nhưng slower)

  • "Within 24 hours" → chỉ Standard retrieval đáp ứng

  • S3 Intelligent-Tiering có monitoring fees, not cost-effective cho known patterns

📖 Reference:

  • S3 Glacier Deep Archive retrieval options

questions.q:
A developer must provide an API key to an AWS Lambda function to authenticate with a third-party system. The Lambda function will run on a schedule. The developer needs to ensure that the API key remains encrypted at rest.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Store the API key as a Lambda environment variable by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
Configure the application to prompt the user to provide the password to the Lambda function on the first run.
Store the API key as a value in the application code.
Use Lambda@Edge and only communicate over the HTTPS protocol.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần API key để authenticate với third-party system

  • Lambda function runs on a schedule (automated, no user interaction)

  • Requirement: ensure API key remains encrypted at rest

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the API key as a Lambda environment variable by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.

  • Lambda environment variables có thể encrypted at rest bằng AWS KMS

  • Customer managed KMS key cho full control over encryption key

  • Lambda automatically decrypt environment variables khi function executes

  • Secure và compliant với encryption at rest requirement

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the application to prompt the user to provide the password to the Lambda function on the first run.

  • Lambda runs on schedule = automated, no user interaction

  • Cannot prompt (nhắc nhở) user cho scheduled automated runs

  • Không khả thi cho use case này

❌ Store the API key as a value in the application code.

  • Hardcoding API key trong code = security risk

  • Code không encrypted at rest (stored trong deployment package)

  • Vi phạm security best practices

  • API key exposed trong source code

❌ Use Lambda@Edge and only communicate over the HTTPS protocol.

  • Lambda@Edge dùng để run Lambda at CloudFront edge locations

  • HTTPS = encryption in transit, không phải at rest

  • Không address việc store API key securely

  • Không giải quyết encryption at rest requirement

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Store secrets + encrypted at rest" → Lambda environment variables with KMS hoặc Secrets Manager

  • Lambda environment variables encryption:

    • Default: encrypted với AWS managed key

    • Better: encrypted với customer managed KMS key

  • Encryption types:

    • At rest = data stored (KMS, environment variables)

    • In transit = data transferring (HTTPS, TLS)

  • NEVER hardcode secrets trong application code

  • Lambda@Edge không liên quan đến secret storage

📖 Reference:

  • Securing Lambda environment variables with KMS

questions.q:
A company has an application that stores data in Amazon RDS instances. The application periodically experiences surges of high traffic that cause performance problems. During periods of peak traffic, a developer notices a reduction in query speed in all database queries.

The team’s technical lead determines that a multi-threaded and scalable caching solution should be used to offload the heavy read traffic. The solution needs to improve performance.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST complexity?
o: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to offload read requests from the main database.
Replicate the data to Amazon DynamoDSet up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
Configure the Amazon RDS instances to use Multi-AZ deployment with one standby instance. Offload read requests from the main database to the standby instance.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to offload read requests from the main database.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application stores data trong Amazon RDS

  • Định kỳ có surges of high traffic (lưu lượng tăng đột biến) gây performance problems

  • During peak traffic: query speed giảm trong all database queries

  • Requirement:

    • Multi-threaded and scalable caching solution

    • Offload heavy read traffic

    • Improve performance

    • LEAST complexity

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to offload read requests from the main database.

  • Memcached là multi-threaded caching engine (requirement match)

  • Simple key-value cache, least complexity to implement

  • Highly scalable, handle high-throughput read workloads

  • Offload read traffic từ RDS effectively

  • No data persistence needed cho cache use case

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Replicate the data to Amazon DynamoDB. Set up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.

  • Phải migrate/replicate data từ RDS sang DynamoDB = high complexity

  • DAX chỉ work với DynamoDB, không cache cho RDS

  • Maintain dual databases (RDS + DynamoDB) = operational overhead

  • Không phải least complexity

❌ Configure the Amazon RDS instances to use Multi-AZ deployment with one standby instance. Offload read requests from the main database to the standby instance.

  • Multi-AZ standby dùng cho failover, KHÔNG phải read offloading

  • Standby instance không accept read traffic (synchronous replication only)

  • Phải dùng Read Replicas cho read offloading, không phải Multi-AZ standby

  • Sai concept

❌ Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to offload read requests from the main database.

  • Redis support caching nhưng single-threaded (per core)

  • Requirement chỉ định multi-threaded solution

  • Redis có nhiều features (persistence, data structures) = more complexity so với Memcached

  • Memcached đơn giản hơn cho pure caching use case

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Multi-threaded caching" → Memcached

  • Memcached vs Redis:

    • Memcached = multi-threaded, simple key-value cache, least complexity

    • Redis = single-threaded (per core), data structures, persistence, more features

  • RDS Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas:

    • Multi-AZ = failover, standby KHÔNG serve reads

    • Read Replicas = offload read traffic

  • "Least complexity + caching" → ElastiCache Memcached

  • DynamoDB + DAX = high complexity, requires data migration

📖 Reference:

  • Choosing between Memcached and Redis

questions.q:
A company has a serverless application on AWS that uses a fleet of AWS Lambda functions that have aliases. The company regularly publishes new Lambda function by using an in-house deployment solution. The company wants to improve the release process and to use traffic shifting. A newly published function version should initially make available only to a fixed percentage of production users.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure routing on the alias of the new function by using a weighted alias.
Configure a canary deployment type for Lambda.
Configure routing on the new versions by using environment variables.
Configure a linear deployment type for Lambda.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Serverless application với fleet of Lambda functions có aliases

  • Company thường xuyên publishes new Lambda functions

  • Requirements:

    • Improve release process

    • Use traffic shifting

    • New function version ban đầu chỉ available cho fixed percentage (tỷ lệ cố định) of production users

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure routing on the alias of the new function by using a weighted alias.

  • Weighted alias cho phép split traffic giữa two Lambda versions

  • Configure weight: VD 90% traffic → version 1, 10% → version 2 (fixed percentage)

  • Manual control over traffic percentage

  • Native Lambda feature, simple to implement

Hình mình hoạ

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure a canary deployment type for Lambda.

  • Canary deployment tự động shift traffic incrementally over time (VD: 10% → 50% → 100%)

  • Không phải fixed percentage như requirement

  • Canary là feature của AWS CodeDeploy, không phải native Lambda config

  • More complex so với weighted alias

❌ Configure routing on the new versions by using environment variables.

  • Environment variables không control traffic routing

  • Environment variables chỉ pass configuration vào function

  • Không có cơ chế để traffic shifting

❌ Configure a linear deployment type for Lambda.

  • Linear deployment shift traffic gradually in equal increments (tăng dần đều) over time (VD: +10% every 10 minutes)

  • Không phải fixed percentage initially như requirement

  • Linear là CodeDeploy feature, more complex

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Fixed percentage of users" → Weighted alias

  • Lambda alias routing:

    • Weighted alias = manual traffic split (VD: 90/10, 80/20)

    • Point alias to two versions với different weights

  • CodeDeploy deployment types:

    • Canary = shift percentage, then shift rest (VD: 10% → 100%)

    • Linear = gradual increments (VD: +10% every X minutes)

    • All-at-once = immediate full shift

  • Environment variables không control routing

  • Weighted alias = simplest cho fixed percentage requirement

📖 Reference:

  • Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias

questions.q:
A developer is creating a new REST API by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The development team tests the API and validates responses for the known use cases before deploying the API to the production environment.

The developer wants to make the REST API available for testing by using API Gateway locally.

Which AWS Serverless Application Model Command Line Interface (AWS SAM CLI) subcommand will meet these requirements?
o: Sam local invoke
Sam local generate-event
Sam local start-lambda
Sam local start-api
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo REST API bằng API Gateway và Lambda

  • Team tests API và validates responses trước khi deploy to production

  • Developer muốn make REST API available for testing locally bằng API Gateway

  • Tìm AWS SAM CLI subcommand phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

sam local start-api

  • sam local start-api start local HTTP server emulating (mô phỏng) API Gateway

  • Expose REST API endpoints locally để test

  • Automatically invoke Lambda functions khi receive HTTP requests

  • Best cho testing entire API Gateway + Lambda integration locally

Các đáp án sai:

❌ sam local invoke

  • sam local invoke chỉ invoke single Lambda function locally

  • Không start API Gateway endpoint

  • Không test REST API routes/integration

  • Phù hợp cho testing individual functions, không phải API

❌ sam local generate-event

  • sam local generate-event tạo sample event payloads (S3, API Gateway, etc.)

  • Không start local API server

  • Chỉ generate test events, không run API

❌ sam local start-lambda

  • sam local start-lambda start local Lambda endpoint emulating Lambda service

  • Dùng để invoke functions qua AWS SDK/CLI locally

  • KHÔNG emulate API Gateway, không expose REST API endpoints

  • Không phù hợp cho testing REST API

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Test REST API locally" → sam local start-api

  • SAM CLI local testing commands:

    • sam local start-api = emulate API Gateway + expose REST endpoints

    • sam local start-lambda = emulate Lambda service endpoint

    • sam local invoke = invoke single function once

    • sam local generate-event = generate sample event payloads

  • start-api vs start-lambda:

    • start-api = HTTP server với API routes

    • start-lambda = Lambda service endpoint (không phải HTTP REST API)

📖 Reference:

  • AWS SAM CLI - sam local start-api

questions.q:
A developer has created an AWS Lambda function that makes queries to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. When the developer performs a test, the DB instance shows an error for too many connections.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
o: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Query the replica DB instance instead of the primary DB instance.
Migrate the data to an Amazon DynamoDB database.
Configure the Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
Create a proxy in Amazon RDS Proxy. Query the proxy instead of the DB instance.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function makes queries đến Aurora MySQL DB instance

  • Khi developer test, DB instance shows error for too many connections

  • Requirement: solution với LEAST operational effort

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a proxy in Amazon RDS Proxy. Query the proxy instead of the DB instance.

  • RDS Proxy tạo connection pool giữa Lambda và Aurora

  • Reuse existing connections thay vì mỗi Lambda invocation tạo new connection

  • Reduce số connections đến DB drastically

  • Least operational effort: managed service, minimal code changes (chỉ đổi connection string)

  • Built-in cho Lambda + RDS/Aurora integration

Hình minh họa

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a read replica for the DB instance. Query the replica DB instance instead of the primary DB instance.

  • Read replica KHÔNG giải quyết "too many connections" issue

  • Vẫn có too many connections problem trên replica

  • Read replica dùng cho read scaling, không phải connection management

❌ Migrate the data to an Amazon DynamoDB database.

  • Migration sang DynamoDB = high operational effort

  • Phải rewrite application logic, schema design

  • Không phải least operational effort

  • Overkill cho connection issue

❌ Configure the Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.

  • Multi-AZ dùng cho high availability/failover, không phải connection management

  • KHÔNG giải quyết "too many connections" problem

  • Vẫn có same connection limit

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda + too many DB connections" → RDS Proxy

  • RDS Proxy benefits:

    • Connection pooling = reuse connections

    • Reduce connection overhead

    • Automatic scaling

  • Read replica = read scaling, KHÔNG giải quyết connection limits

  • Multi-AZ = failover/HA, KHÔNG giải quyết connections

  • RDS Proxy = least effort solution cho Lambda connection issues

📖 Reference:

  • Amazon RDS Proxy

  • Using Amazon RDS Proxy with AWS Lambda

questions.q:
A company needs to set up secure database credentials for all its AWS Cloud resources. The company’s resources include Amazon RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Amazon Aurora DB instances. The company’s security policy mandates that database credentials be encrypted at rest and rotated at a regular interval.
