Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?
o: Set up IAM database authentication for token-based access. Generate user tokens to provide centralized access to RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Aurora DB instances.
Create parameters for the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the Type parameter to SecureString. Set up automatic rotation on the parameters.

Store the database access credentials as an encrypted Amazon S3 object in an S3 bucket. Block all public access on the S3 bucket. Use S3 server-side encryption to set up automatic rotation on the encryption key.

Create an AWS Lambda function by using the SecretsManagerRotationTemplate template in the AWS Secrets Manager console. Create secrets for the database credentials in Secrets Manager. Set up secrets rotation on a schedule.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company cần setup secure database credentials cho RDS, DocumentDB, Aurora

  • Security policy bắt buộc:

    • Credentials encrypted at rest

    • Rotated at regular interval

  • Requirement: MOST securely solution

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create an AWS Lambda function by using the SecretsManagerRotationTemplate template in the AWS Secrets Manager console. Create secrets for the database credentials in Secrets Manager. Set up secrets rotation on a schedule.

  • Secrets Manager designed specifically cho storing và rotating credentials

  • Automatic encryption at rest với AWS KMS

  • Built-in rotation cho RDS, DocumentDB, Aurora với rotation templates

  • Rotation tự động update credentials trong cả Secrets Manager và database

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Set up IAM database authentication for token-based access. Generate user tokens to provide centralized access to RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Aurora DB instances.

  • IAM database authentication dùng temporary tokens, không phải traditional credentials

  • DocumentDB KHÔNG support IAM authentication

  • Không satisfy requirement về storing/rotating traditional database credentials

❌ Create parameters for the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the Type parameter to SecureString. Set up automatic rotation on the parameters.

  • Parameter Store hỗ trợ encryption với SecureString

  • Nhưng Parameter Store KHÔNG có built-in automatic rotation

  • Phải tự build custom rotation logic

  • Không phải most secure solution

❌ Store the database access credentials as an encrypted Amazon S3 object in an S3 bucket. Block all public access on the S3 bucket. Use S3 server-side encryption to set up automatic rotation on the encryption key.

  • S3 KHÔNG phải secret management service

  • S3 encryption key rotation khác với credential rotation

  • Rotating encryption key không rotate database credentials

  • Không có mechanism để update credentials trong database khi rotate

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Database credentials + rotation" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = automatic rotation + versioning + audit

    • Parameter Store = config data + encryption, NO automatic rotation

  • Secrets Manager rotation:

    • Built-in templates cho RDS, DocumentDB, Aurora

    • Automatically update credentials trong database

📖 Reference:

  • Rotate Amazon RDS database credentials automatically with AWS Secrets Manager

questions.q:
A company built a new application in the AWS Cloud. The company automated the bootstrapping of new resources with an Auto Scaling group by using AWS CloudFormation templates. The bootstrap scripts contain sensitive data.

The company needs a solution that is integrated with CloudFormation to manage the sensitive data in the bootstrap scripts.

Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?
o: Put the sensitive data into a CloudFormation parameter. Encrypt the CloudFormation templates by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.
Put the sensitive data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the CloudFormation templates to download the object from Amazon S3 during bootstrap.
Put the sensitive data into AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter. Update the CloudFormation templates to use dynamic references to specify template values.
Put the sensitive data into Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Enforce EFS encryption after file system creation. Update the CloudFormation templates to retrieve data from Amazon EFS.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company automated bootstrapping của new resources với Auto Scaling group bằng CloudFormation

  • Bootstrap scripts contain sensitive data

  • Requirement: solution integrated with CloudFormation để manage sensitive data MOST securely

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Put the sensitive data into AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter. Update the CloudFormation templates to use dynamic references to specify template values.

  • Parameter Store SecureString encrypt sensitive data at rest với AWS KMS

  • CloudFormation dynamic references ({{resolve:ssm-secure:parameter-name}}) natively integrated

  • CloudFormation automatically retrieve và decrypt parameters during stack operations

  • Secure: credentials không expose trong templates hoặc stack outputs

  • Best practice cho sensitive data trong CloudFormation

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Put the sensitive data into a CloudFormation parameter. Encrypt the CloudFormation templates by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.

  • CloudFormation parameters không encrypted khi stored

  • Parameters visible trong CloudFormation console và API calls

  • Encrypting templates không encrypt parameter values in transit/at rest

  • Không secure cho sensitive data

❌ Put the sensitive data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the CloudFormation templates to download the object from Amazon S3 during bootstrap.

  • S3 có thể encrypt objects nhưng không integrated với CloudFormation natively

  • Phải manually download từ S3 trong bootstrap scripts

  • Phức tạp hơn và less secure so với Parameter Store dynamic references

  • S3 không designed cho secrets management

❌ Put the sensitive data into Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Enforce EFS encryption after file system creation. Update the CloudFormation templates to retrieve data from Amazon EFS.

  • EFS không designed cho secrets management

  • Phải mount EFS và retrieve files = complexity

  • Không có native CloudFormation integration cho secrets

  • Overkill và không secure như Parameter Store

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Sensitive data + CloudFormation" → Parameter Store + Dynamic References

  • CloudFormation dynamic references:

    • SSM Parameter: {{resolve:ssm:parameter-name:version}}

    • SSM SecureString: {{resolve:ssm-secure:parameter-name:version}}

    • Secrets Manager: {{resolve:secretsmanager:secret-id:SecretString:key}}

  • CloudFormation parameters = NOT encrypted, visible trong console

  • S3/EFS không designed cho secrets, không có native CloudFormation integration

  • Parameter Store SecureString = encrypted at rest với KMS

📖 Reference:

  • Get values stored in other services using dynamic references

Get a plaintext value from Systems Manager Parameter Store

Resources:
  MyInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-6.1-x86_64}}'
      InstanceType: t2.micro

questions.q:
A developer is setting up a deployment pipeline. The pipeline includes an AWS CodeBuild build stage that requires access to a database to run integration tests. The developer is using a buildspec.yml file to configure the database connection. Company policy requires automatic rotation of all database credentials.

Which solution will handle the database credentials MOST securely?
o: Retrieve the credentials from variables that are hardcoded in the buildspec.yml file. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure Parameter Store for automatic rotation.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Configure Secrets Manager for automatic rotation.
Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that contains the connection string in plaintext. Configure an Amazon EventBridge event to rotate the credentials.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer setup deployment pipeline với CodeBuild build stage

  • CodeBuild cần access database để run integration tests

  • Dùng buildspec.yml để configure database connection

  • Company policy requires automatic rotation của all database credentials

  • Requirement: handle credentials MOST securely

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to an AWS Secrets Manager secret. Configure Secrets Manager for automatic rotation.

  • Secrets Manager designed specifically cho database credentials với automatic rotation

  • CodeBuild environment variable link đến Secrets Manager secret

  • Built-in rotation templates cho databases (RDS, DocumentDB, etc.)

  • Rotation automatically update credentials trong cả Secrets Manager và database

  • Most secure: encryption at rest, versioning, audit logging

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Retrieve the credentials from variables that are hardcoded in the buildspec.yml file. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.

  • Hardcoding credentials trong buildspec.yml = major security risk

  • buildspec.yml stored trong source control → credentials exposed

  • Vi phạm security best practices nghiêm trọng

  • Lambda rotation không giúp nếu credentials hardcoded

❌ Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that is linked to a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure Parameter Store for automatic rotation.

  • Parameter Store hỗ trợ SecureString encryption

  • Nhưng Parameter Store KHÔNG có built-in automatic rotation

  • Phải tự build custom rotation logic

  • Không phải most secure solution

❌ Retrieve the credentials from an environment variable that contains the connection string in plaintext. Configure an Amazon EventBridge event to rotate the credentials.

  • Plaintext credentials trong environment variable = NOT secure

  • EventBridge không có built-in credential rotation capability

  • EventBridge dùng cho event routing, không phải secrets management

  • Không giải quyết security requirement

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Database credentials + automatic rotation" → AWS Secrets Manager

  • CodeBuild + Secrets:

    • Environment variables link to Secrets Manager secrets

    • CodeBuild automatically retrieve và inject secrets at runtime

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = automatic rotation + versioning

    • Parameter Store = config data, NO automatic rotation

  • NEVER hardcode credentials trong buildspec.yml hoặc code

  • Plaintext credentials = major security violation

questions.q:
A company has developed a new serverless application using AWS Lambda functions that will be deployed using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI.

Which step should the developer complete prior to deploying the application?
o: Compress the application to a .zip file and upload it into AWS Lambda.
Test the new AWS Lambda function by first tracing it in AWS X-Ray.
Bundle the serverless application using a SAM package.
Create the application environment using the eb create my-env command.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company developed new serverless application bằng AWS Lambda functions

  • Application sẽ được deployed bằng AWS SAM CLI

  • Tìm step developer phải complete prior to deploying the application

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Bundle the serverless application using a SAM package.

  • sam package (hoặc sam build) là required step trước khi deploy

  • Package command:

    • Build application code và dependencies

    • Upload artifacts (code, layers) lên S3 bucket

    • Generate CloudFormation template với S3 URIs

  • Sau đó mới chạy sam deploy để deploy stack

  • Standard SAM deployment workflow

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Compress the application to a .zip file and upload it into AWS Lambda.

  • Manual upload không phải SAM CLI workflow

  • SAM CLI automatically handle packaging và uploading

  • Không cần manually compress và upload khi dùng SAM

❌ Test the new AWS Lambda function by first tracing it in AWS X-Ray.

  • X-Ray tracing là optional monitoring feature, không phải required deployment step

  • Testing có thể làm sau deployment hoặc locally

  • Không phải prerequisite để deploy

❌ Create the application environment using the eb create my-env command.

  • eb create là Elastic Beanstalk CLI command, không phải SAM

  • SAM không dùng Elastic Beanstalk

  • Sai tool hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • SAM deployment workflow:

    1. sam build (hoặc sam package) = build và package application

    2. sam deploy = deploy CloudFormation stack

  • sam package:

    • Upload code/artifacts to S3

    • Transform SAM template to CloudFormation template

    • Replace local paths với S3 URIs

  • SAM CLI automatically handle compression và upload

  • eb create = Elastic Beanstalk, không phải SAM

📖 Reference:

  • AWS SAM CLI - sam package

  • Deploy your application and resources with AWS SAM

questions.q:
A developer is creating a mobile application that will not require users to log in.

What is the MOST efficient method to grant users access to AWS resources?
o: Use an identity provider to securely authenticate with the application.
Create an AWS Lambda function to create an IAM user when a user accesses the application.
Create credentials using AWS KMS and apply these credentials to users when using the application.
Use Amazon Cognito to associate unauthenticated users with an IAM role that has limited access to resources.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer tạo mobile application

  • Application will NOT require users to log in (unauthenticated users)

  • Requirement: MOST efficient method to grant users access to AWS resources

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon Cognito to associate unauthenticated users with an IAM role that has limited access to resources.

  • Amazon Cognito Identity Pools hỗ trợ unauthenticated identities (guest access)

  • Cognito automatically provide temporary AWS credentials cho unauthenticated users

  • Associate unauthenticated users với IAM role có limited permissions

  • Most efficient: managed service, no user management needed, automatic credential rotation

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use an identity provider to securely authenticate with the application.

  • Identity provider dùng cho authenticated users (login required)

  • Đề bài nói application will NOT require login

  • Không phù hợp với unauthenticated use case

❌ Create an AWS Lambda function to create an IAM user when a user accesses the application.

  • Tạo IAM user cho mỗi app user = security risk và không scalable

  • IAM users là long-term credentials, không phù hợp cho mobile apps

  • Quản lý và cleanup IAM users rất phức tạp

  • Không hiệu quả

❌ Create credentials using AWS KMS and apply these credentials to users when using the application.

  • AWS KMS dùng cho encryption keys, không phải user credentials

  • KMS không tạo IAM credentials hoặc temporary tokens

  • Sai use case hoàn toàn

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Unauthenticated mobile app users + AWS access" → Amazon Cognito Identity Pools (unauthenticated identities)

  • Cognito Identity Pools:

    • Authenticated identities = users logged in qua identity provider

    • Unauthenticated identities = guest access, no login required

  • Cognito provide temporary AWS credentials (STS tokens)

  • Associate với IAM role có limited permissions cho security

  • NEVER create individual IAM users cho mobile app users

  • KMS = encryption keys, không phải credentials

📖 Reference:

  • Amazon Cognito identity pools

questions.q:
A company is migrating its PostgreSQL database into the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a database that will secure and regularly rotate database credentials. The company wants a solution that does not require additional programming overhead.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company migrating PostgreSQL database to AWS Cloud

  • Requirements:

    • Database secure và regularly rotate credentials

    • Solution does NOT require additional programming overhead

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.

  • Aurora PostgreSQL = managed PostgreSQL-compatible database

  • Secrets Manager thiết kế đặc biệt cho database credentials với automatic rotation

  • Built-in rotation templates cho Aurora PostgreSQL

  • Rotation automatically update credentials trong cả Secrets Manager và database

  • No additional programming overhead: fully managed rotation

Tham khảo: AWS Secrets Manager Integration with Amazon RDS

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.

  • Aurora PostgreSQL đúng cho PostgreSQL migration

  • Nhưng Parameter Store KHÔNG có built-in automatic rotation

  • Phải tự build custom rotation logic = additional programming overhead

  • Vi phạm requirement "no additional programming overhead"

❌ Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.

  • DynamoDB là NoSQL database, không phải PostgreSQL

  • PostgreSQL → DynamoDB migration = phải rewrite application

  • Parameter Store không có automatic rotation

  • Không phù hợp cho PostgreSQL migration

❌ Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.

  • DynamoDB không phải PostgreSQL-compatible database

  • Requires significant application changes (phải thay đổi application đáng kể)

  • Không đáp ứng PostgreSQL migration requirement

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "PostgreSQL migration" → Aurora PostgreSQL (hoặc RDS PostgreSQL)

  • "Database credentials + automatic rotation + no overhead" → Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = automatic rotation cho databases, no programming needed

    • Parameter Store = NO automatic rotation, requires custom Lambda

  • Aurora PostgreSQL = PostgreSQL-compatible, managed service

  • DynamoDB = NoSQL, không compatible với PostgreSQL

📖 Reference:

  • Password management with Amazon Aurora and AWS Secrets Manager

questions.q:
A developer is testing an application that invokes an AWS Lambda function asynchronously. During the testing phase, the Lambda function fails to process after two retries.

How can the developer troubleshoot the failure?
o: Configure AWS CloudTrail logging to investigate the invocation failures.
Configure Dead Letter Queues by sending events to Amazon SQS for investigation.
Configure Amazon Simple Workflow Service to process any direct unprocessed events.
Configure AWS Config to process any direct unprocessed events.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer testing application invoke Lambda function asynchronously

  • Lambda function fails to process after two retries

  • Tìm cách troubleshoot the failure

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure Dead Letter Queues by sending events to Amazon SQS for investigation.

  • Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) capture failed events sau khi hết tất cả các lần retries

  • Configure Lambda asynchronous invocation với DLQ (SQS hoặc SNS)

  • Failed events sent to DLQ để investigate

  • DLQ giữ lại event payload và error info để troubleshoot

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure AWS CloudTrail logging to investigate the invocation failures.

  • CloudTrail logs AWS API calls, không phải Lambda execution details

  • CloudTrail không capture Lambda function errors hoặc failed event payloads

  • Phải dùng CloudWatch Logs cho Lambda execution logs, không phải CloudTrail

❌ Configure Amazon Simple Workflow Service to process any direct unprocessed events.

  • SWF là workflow orchestration service, không phải error handling mechanism

  • SWF không automatically capture failed Lambda events

  • Không liên quan cho troubleshooting Lambda failures

❌ Configure AWS Config to process any direct unprocessed events.

  • AWS Config track configuration changes của AWS resources

  • Không capture hoặc process failed Lambda events

  • Không phải troubleshooting tool cho Lambda failures

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Lambda asynchronous invocation failures" → Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)

  • Lambda DLQ:

    • Configure với SQS queue hoặc SNS topic

    • Capture events sau khi all retries Fail

    • Giữ lại event payload để investigate

  • CloudTrail vs CloudWatch Logs:

    • CloudTrail = API calls audit

    • CloudWatch Logs = Lambda execution logs và errors

  • SWF và AWS Config không relevant cho Lambda error troubleshooting

📖 Reference:

  • Capturing records of Lambda asynchronous invocations

  • Implementing AWS Lambda error handling patterns

questions.q:
A company needs to distribute firmware updates to its customers around the world.

Which service will allow easy and secure control of the access to the downloads at the lowest cost?
o: Use Amazon CloudFront with signed URLs for Amazon S3.
Create a dedicated Amazon CloudFront Distribution for each customer.
Use Amazon CloudFront with AWS Lambda@Edge.
Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to control access to an S3 bucket.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company cần distribute các bản cập nhật phần mềm đến customers around the world

  • Requirements:

    • Easy and secure control của access to downloads

    • Lowest cost

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use Amazon CloudFront with signed URLs for Amazon S3.

  • CloudFront distribute content globally với low latency (edge locations worldwide)

  • Signed URLs provide secure, time-limited access to private content

  • Control access: chỉ users có signed URL mới download được

  • Lowest cost: CloudFront + S3 standard pricing, no additional compute

  • Easy to implement: generate signed URLs programmatically

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create a dedicated Amazon CloudFront Distribution for each customer.

  • Separate distribution cho mỗi customer = cực kỳ expensive và complex

  • Hard to manage multiple distributions

  • Không scalable

  • Không phải lowest cost

❌ Use Amazon CloudFront with AWS Lambda@Edge.

  • Lambda@Edge adds compute cost cho mỗi request

  • More complex so với signed URLs

  • Overkill khi signed URLs đã đủ cho access control

  • Không phải lowest cost

❌ Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to control access to an S3 bucket.

  • API Gateway + Lambda adds thê chi phí (per request charges)

  • More complex architecture

  • API Gateway có payload size limits (10 MB), không tốt cho large firmware files

  • CloudFront better cho content distribution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Global distribution + secure access + lowest cost" → CloudFront with Signed URLs

  • CloudFront signed URLs:

    • Time-limited access to private content

    • Control who can access và when

    • No additional compute cost

  • CloudFront vs API Gateway cho file distribution:

    • CloudFront = optimized cho static content, lower cost

    • API Gateway = API requests, có payload limits

  • Lambda@Edge adds compute cost, overkill cho simple access control

  • Separate distributions per customer = không scalable

📖 Reference:

  • CloudFront signed URLs

  • Serving private content with CloudFront

questions.q:
A company has an ecommerce application. To track product reviews, the company’s development team uses an Amazon DynamoDB table.

Every record includes the following:

  • A Review ID, a 16-digit universally unique identifier (UUID)

  • A Product ID and User ID, 16-digit UUIDs that reference other tables

  • A Product Rating on a scale of 1-5

  • An optional comment from the user

The table partition key is the Review ID. The most performed query against the table is to find the 10 reviews with the highest rating for a given product.

Which index will provide the FASTEST response for this query?
o: A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key
A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Review ID as the sort key
A local secondary index (LSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key
A local secondary index (LSI) with Review ID as the partition key and Product ID as the sort key
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table tracking product reviews

  • Table schema:

    • Review ID (16-digit UUID) = partition key

    • Product ID, User ID (16-digit UUIDs)

    • Product Rating (1-5)

    • Optional comment

  • Most performed query: find 10 reviews with highest rating for a given product

  • Tìm index provide FASTEST response

✅ Đáp án đúng:

A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key

  • Query pattern: filter by Product ID + sort by Product Rating (highest first)

  • GSI với Product ID partition key cho phép query all reviews của product chỉ định

  • Product Rating sort key cho phép sort và retrieve top 10 highest ratings hiệu quả

  • Query: Query(ProductID = "xxx", SortKeyCondition: ProductRating desc, Limit: 10)

  • Fastest response vì query directly trên indexed attributes

Các đáp án sai:

❌ A global secondary index (GSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Review ID as the sort key

  • Product ID partition key đúng cho query by product

  • Nhưng Review ID sort key KHÔNG giúp sort by rating

  • Phải scan all reviews rồi mới sort by rating trong application code

  • Không efficient

❌ A local secondary index (LSI) with Product ID as the partition key and Product Rating as the sort key

  • LSI PHẢI share partition key với base table

  • Base table partition key = Review ID, không phải Product ID

  • KHÔNG THỂ dùng Product ID làm partition key trong LSI

  • Sai về LSI concept

❌ A local secondary index (LSI) with Review ID as the partition key and Product ID as the sort key

  • Review ID partition key = same as base table

  • LSI này không giúp query by Product ID

  • Phải biết Review ID trước → không phù hợp với query pattern

  • Product Rating không có trong index → cannot sort by rating

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Query by X + sort by Y" → GSI với X = partition key, Y = sort key

  • LSI vs GSI:

    • LSI = PHẢI share same partition key với base table, different sort key only

    • GSI = completely different partition key và sort key

  • Query pattern analysis:

    • "Find reviews for product X" → Product ID = partition key

    • "With highest rating" → Product Rating = sort key (desc order)

  • LSI không thể change partition key

  • Sort key cho phép range queries và sorting

📖 Reference:

  • DynamoDB Global Secondary Indexes

  • Best practices for using secondary indexes

questions.q:
A developer is storing sensitive data generated by an application in Amazon S3. The developer wants to encrypt the data at rest. A company policy requires an audit trail of when the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key was used and by whom.

Which encryption option will meet these requirements?
o: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)
Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
Server-side encryption with self-managed keys
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer storing sensitive data trong S3

  • Developer muốn encrypt data at rest

  • Company policy requires:

    • Audit trail of when KMS key was used

    • Audit trail of who used the key

  • Tìm encryption option đáp ứng requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (SSE-KMS)

  • SSE-KMS encrypt data at rest bằng AWS KMS keys

  • CloudTrail automatically logs all KMS key usage:

    • When key was used

    • Who used the key (IAM principal)

    • Which S3 operations triggered encryption/decryption

  • Provides complete audit trail như company policy yêu cầu

  • Centralized key management với KMS

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)

  • SSE-S3 encrypt data at rest nhưng S3 fully manage keys

  • KHÔNG có detailed audit trail of key usage

  • Cannot track who used keys hoặc when

  • Không đáp ứng audit trail requirement

❌ Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)

  • SSE-C requires customer provide encryption key với mỗi request

  • Keys KHÔNG managed by AWS KMS

  • NO audit trail from AWS services

  • Customer phải tự manage keys và audit trail

❌ Server-side encryption with self-managed keys

  • Self-managed keys = customer fully manage encryption keys outside AWS

  • NO integration với AWS KMS

  • NO automatic audit trail from AWS

  • Customer phải build custom audit solution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Audit trail of key usage" → SSE-KMS

  • S3 encryption options:

    • SSE-S3 = S3-managed keys, NO detailed audit

    • SSE-KMS = KMS-managed keys, full audit trail via CloudTrail

    • SSE-C = customer-provided keys, NO AWS audit

  • SSE-KMS audit capabilities:

    • CloudTrail logs: kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey

    • Track who accessed objects (IAM principal)

    • Track when keys used

  • Company compliance/audit requirements → SSE-KMS

📖 Reference:

  • Using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS)

  • Logging AWS KMS API calls with CloudTrail

questions.q:
A development team maintains a web application by using a single AWS RDS, template. The template defines web servers and an Amazon RDS database. The team uses the CloudFormation template to deploy the CloudFormation stack to different environments.

During a recent application deployment, a developer caused the primary development database to be dropped and recreated. The result of this incident was a loss of data. The team needs to avoid accidental database deletion in the future.

Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the database resource.
Update the CloudFormation stack policy to prevent updates to the database.
Modify the database to use a Multi-AZ deployment.
Create a CloudFormation stack set for the web application and database deployments.
Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the stack.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Team dùng single CloudFormation template deploy web servers và RDS database to different environments

  • Recent incident: developer accidentally dropped và recreated primary development database → loss of data

  • Requirement: avoid accidental database deletion in future

  • Chọn 2 solutions

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the database resource.

  • DeletionPolicy: Retain ngăn chặn CloudFormation từ deleting database khi stack deleted hoặc resource replaced

  • Database được retained thay vì deleted

  • Protect against accidental deletion during stack updates

  • Apply directly trên RDS database resource

Update the CloudFormation stack policy to prevent updates to the database.

  • Stack policy ngăn chặn các cập nhật không mong muốn đến resources cụ thể

  • Define policy để deny updates to database resource

  • Require explicit permission override để update database

  • Thêm protection layer chống lại accidental modifications

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Modify the database to use a Multi-AZ deployment.

  • Multi-AZ provide high availability và failover, không phải deletion protection

  • Multi-AZ không prevent accidental database deletion

  • Không address root cause của incident

❌ Create a CloudFormation stack set for the web application and database deployments.

  • Stack sets dùng để deploy same stack across multiple accounts/regions

  • Không prevent accidental deletion

  • Không liên quan đến deletion protection

❌ Add a CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute with the Retain value to the stack.

  • DeletionPolicy phải apply trên individual resource (database), không phải entire stack

  • Apply trên stack level không protect specific resources

  • Sai implementation

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Prevent accidental deletion" → DeletionPolicy: Retain + Stack Policy

  • CloudFormation DeletionPolicy:

    • Retain = keep resource khi stack deleted/updated

    • Snapshot = create snapshot before deletion (cho RDS/EBS)

    • Delete = default, delete resource

  • Stack policy prevent updates/deletes to specific resources

  • DeletionPolicy apply trên resource level, không phải stack level

  • Multi-AZ = availability, không phải deletion protection

📖 Reference:

  • CloudFormation DeletionPolicy attribute

  • Prevent updates to stack resources with stack policies

questions.q:
A developer needs to deploy an application running on AWS Fargate using Amazon ECS. The application has environment variables that must be passed to a container for the application to initialize.

How should the environment variables be passed to the container?
o: Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the service definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the task definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the task definition.
Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the service definition.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer cần deploy application trên AWS Fargate using ECS

  • Application có environment variables cần pass to container để initialize (khởi tạo)

  • Tìm cách pass environment variables to container

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the task definition.

  • Task definition define container configuration, bao gồm environment variables

  • environment parameter trong task definition cho phép specify key-value pairs

  • Format: "environment": [{"name": "KEY", "value": "VALUE"}]

  • Container automatically receive environment variables khi start

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Define an array that includes the environment variables under the environment parameter within the service definition.

  • Service definition define deployment configuration (desired count, load balancer, etc.)

  • Service definition KHÔNG chứa environment parameters

  • Environment variables phải define trong task definition, không phải service definition

❌ Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the task definition.

  • entryPoint parameter define command to run khi container starts

  • entryPoint KHÔNG dùng để pass environment variables

  • Sai parameter

❌ Define an array that includes the environment variables under the entryPoint parameter within the service definition.

  • Service definition không có entryPoint parameter

  • entryPoint không dùng cho environment variables

  • Sai cả location và parameter

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Pass environment variables to ECS container" → environment parameter trong task definition

  • ECS concepts:

    • Task definition = blueprint cho container (image, CPU, memory, environment variables)

    • Service definition = deployment config (desired count, load balancer)

  • Task definition environment format: 

    "environment": [
    {"name": "DB_HOST", "value": "localhost"},
    {"name": "PORT", "value": "3000"}
  ]

  • entryPoint = container command, không phải environment variables

📖 Reference:

  • ECS task definition - environment variables

  • Passing environment variables to containers

Đây là ví dụ về ECS task definition file với environment variables:

{
  "family": "my-app-task",
  "networkMode": "awsvpc",
  "requiresCompatibilities": ["FARGATE"],
  "cpu": "256",
  "memory": "512",
  "containerDefinitions": [
    {
      "name": "my-app-container",
      "image": "my-app:latest",
      "essential": true,
      "portMappings": [
        {
          "containerPort": 3000,
          "protocol": "tcp"
        }
      ],
      "environment": [
        {
          "name": "NODE_ENV",
          "value": "production"
        },
        {
          "name": "DB_HOST",
          "value": "mydb.example.com"
        },
        {
          "name": "DB_PORT",
          "value": "5432"
        },
        {
          "name": "APP_PORT",
          "value": "3000"
        }
      ],
      "secrets": [
        {
          "name": "DB_PASSWORD",
          "valueFrom": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:region:account:secret:db-password"
        }
      ],
      "logConfiguration": {
        "logDriver": "awslogs",
        "options": {
          "awslogs-group": "/ecs/my-app",
          "awslogs-region": "us-east-1",
          "awslogs-stream-prefix": "ecs"
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "executionRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::account:role/ecsTaskExecutionRole",
  "taskRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::account:role/ecsTaskRole"
}

questions.q:
A developer has been asked to create an AWS Lambda function that is invoked any time updates are made to items in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The function has been created, and appropriate permissions have been added to the Lambda execution role. Amazon DynamoDB streams have been enabled for the table, but the function is still not being invoked.

Which option would enable DynamoDB table updates to invoke the Lambda function?
o: Change the StreamViewType parameter value to NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES for the DynamoDB table.
Configure event source mapping for the Lambda function.
Map an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to the DynamoDB streams.
Increase the maximum runtime (timeout) setting of the Lambda function.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function cần được invoked khi updates made to DynamoDB table

  • Setup hiện tại:

    • Lambda function đã created

    • Appropriate permissions added to Lambda execution role

    • DynamoDB Streams enabled for table

  • Issue: function still NOT being invoked

  • Tìm option để enable DynamoDB updates invoke Lambda

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Configure event source mapping for the Lambda function.

  • Event source mapping là link giữa DynamoDB stream và Lambda function

  • Event source mapping tell Lambda poll DynamoDB stream và invoke function khi có new records

  • Required step để connect stream với Lambda

  • Missing piece trong current setup

Kiến trúc tham khảo

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Change the StreamViewType parameter value to NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES for the DynamoDB table.

  • StreamViewType define data included trong stream records (KEYS_ONLY, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES)

  • Changing StreamViewType KHÔNG enable invocation nếu thiếu event source mapping

  • StreamViewType chỉ ảnh hưởng đến data content, không phải cơ chế invocation

❌ Map an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to the DynamoDB streams.

  • DynamoDB Streams KHÔNG directly integrate với SNS

  • Lambda có thể directly poll DynamoDB Streams, không cần SNS intermediate

  • Adds unnecessary complexity

❌ Increase the maximum runtime (timeout) setting of the Lambda function.

  • Timeout setting ảnh hưởng đến execution duration, không phải invocation trigger

  • Function không được invoked → timeout không relevant

  • Không giải quyết missing trigger issue

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "DynamoDB Streams + Lambda" → cần Event Source Mapping

  • DynamoDB Streams integration steps:

    1. Enable DynamoDB Streams on table ✓

    2. Grant Lambda permissions (execution role) ✓

    3. Create event source mapping ← Missing step

  • Event source mapping = connection giữa stream và Lambda

  • StreamViewType = data content, không phải trigger mechanism

  • DynamoDB Streams → Lambda direct integration, không cần SNS

📖 Reference:

  • How Lambda processes records from stream and queue-based event sources

  • Event source mapping for DynamoDB

questions.q:
A company is using AWS CloudFormation to deploy a two-tier application. The application will use Amazon RDS as its backend database. The company wants a solution that will randomly generate the database password during deployment. The solution also must automatically rotate the database password without requiring changes to the application.

What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
o: Use an AWS Lambda function as a CloudFormation custom resource to generate and rotate the password.
Use an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store resource with the SecureString data type to generate and rotate the password.
Use a cron daemon on the application’s host to generate and rotate the password.
Use an AWS Secrets Manager resource to generate and rotate the password.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Company dùng CloudFormation deploy two-tier application với RDS backend

  • Requirements:

    • Randomly generate database password during deployment

    • Automatically rotate password without application changes

    • MOST operationally efficient

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use an AWS Secrets Manager resource to generate and rotate the password.

  • Secrets Manager có thể generate random password khi create secret

  • Built-in automatic rotation cho RDS databases với rotation templates

  • CloudFormation native support: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret resource

  • Rotation automatically update password trong cả Secrets Manager và RDS

  • Application retrieve password từ Secrets Manager → no code changes needed

  • Most operationally efficient: fully managed, no custom code

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use an AWS Lambda function as a CloudFormation custom resource to generate and rotate the password.

  • Phải write custom Lambda code cho generation và rotation

  • More operational overhead so với Secrets Manager

  • Phải maintain custom rotation logic

  • Không phải most operationally efficient

❌ Use an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store resource with the SecureString data type to generate and rotate the password.

  • Parameter Store có thể store encrypted passwords

  • Nhưng KHÔNG có built-in automatic rotation

  • Phải build custom rotation logic

  • Không operationally efficient

❌ Use a cron daemon on the application's host to generate and rotate the password.

  • Cron daemon = manual implementation, high operational overhead

  • Phải manage cron jobs, handle failures

  • Requires application host access

  • Least operationally efficient

  • Not CloudFormation-native

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Generate + automatically rotate password + CloudFormation" → Secrets Manager

  • Secrets Manager trong CloudFormation:

    • AWS::SecretsManager::Secret = create secret

    • GenerateSecretString = auto-generate random password

    • Built-in rotation for RDS/DocumentDB/Aurora

  • Secrets Manager vs Parameter Store:

    • Secrets Manager = automatic rotation + versioning

    • Parameter Store = NO automatic rotation

  • Cron daemon = manual, not managed, not efficient

  • Custom Lambda = more code to maintain

📖 Reference:

  • AWS::SecretsManager::Secret

questions.q:
A company is building a microservices application that consists of many AWS Lambda functions. The development team wants to use AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) templates to automatically test the Lambda functions. The development team plans to test a small percentage of traffic that is directed to new updates before the team commits to a full deployment of the application.

Which combination of steps will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way? (Choose two.)
o: Use AWS SAM CLI commands in AWS CodeDeploy to invoke the Lambda functions to test the deployment.
Declare the EventInvokeConfig on the Lambda functions in the AWS SAM templates with OnSuccess and OnFailure configurations.
Enable gradual deployments through AWS SAM templates.
Set the deployment preference type to Canary10Percent30Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.
Set the deployment preference type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Microservices application với nhiều Lambda functions

  • Development team dùng AWS SAM templates để automatically test Lambda

  • Requirements:

    • Test small percentage of traffic directed to new updates

    • Before committing to full deployment

    • MOST operationally efficient

  • Chọn 2 solutions

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Enable gradual deployments through AWS SAM templates.

  • Gradual deployments (canary/linear deployments) trong SAM cho phép shift traffic incrementally (tăng dần)

  • Configure trong SAM template với DeploymentPreference

  • SAM automatically integrate với CodeDeploy để manage traffic shifting

  • Operationally efficient: cấu hình declarative (khai báo) trong template

Set the deployment preference type to Canary10Percent30Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.

  • Canary10Percent30Minutes = shift 10% traffic first, wait 30 minutes, then shift remaining 90%

  • Test small percentage of traffic như requirement

  • Hooks (PreTraffic, PostTraffic) cho phép run automated tests before full deployment

  • Fast validation: 30 minutes để test 10% traffic, then commit to full deployment

  • Operationally efficient: built-in SAM deployment preference

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use AWS SAM CLI commands in AWS CodeDeploy to invoke the Lambda functions to test the deployment.

  • SAM CLI dùng để build/deploy, không phải invoke functions trong CodeDeploy

  • Không phải declarative approach trong templates

  • Manual invocation không phải gradual deployment

❌ Declare the EventInvokeConfig on the Lambda functions in the AWS SAM templates with OnSuccess and OnFailure configurations.

  • EventInvokeConfig configure asynchronous invocation behavior (retry, DLQ)

  • KHÔNG liên quan đến gradual deployments hoặc traffic shifting

  • OnSuccess/OnFailure dùng cho destination configuration, không phải deployment strategy

❌ Set the deployment preference type to Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes. Use hooks to test the deployment.

  • Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes = shift 10% every 10 minutes (10 increments total = 100 minutes)

  • Requirement là "test small percentage before committing to full deployment"

  • Canary pattern phù hợp hơn: test 10% → validate → commit 90%

  • Linear deployment mất nhiều thời gian hơn (100 minutes vs 30 minutes)

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Test small percentage before full deployment" → Canary deployment

  • SAM deployment preferences:

    • Canary10Percent30Minutes = 10% traffic for 30 min → then 90%

    • Linear10PercentEvery10Minutes = 10% → 20% → ... → 100% (100 min total)

    • AllAtOnce = immediate full deployment

  • Canary vs Linear:

    • Canary = test small percentage → validate → commit rest (faster validation)

    • Linear = gradual incremental rollout (slower, more conservative)

  • Hooks = PreTraffic và PostTraffic Lambda functions để run automated tests

  • EventInvokeConfig = async invocation settings, không phải deployment

📖 Reference:

  • Deploying serverless applications gradually with AWS SAM

  • Deployment preference types in SAM

questions.q:
A company developed an API application on AWS by using Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda. The API has a minimum of four requests every second. A developer notices that many API users run the same query by using the POST method. The developer wants to cache the POST request to optimize the API resources.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Configure the CloudFront cache. Update the application to return cached content based upon the default request headers.
Override the cache method in the selected stage of API Gateway. Select the POST method.
Save the latest request response in Lambda /tmp directory. Update the Lambda function to check the /tmp directory.
Save the latest request in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Modify the Lambda function to take the latest request response from Parameter Store.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • API application: CloudFront + API Gateway + Lambda

  • API có minimum 4 requests mỗi giây

  • Issue: many users run same query using POST method

  • Developer muốn cache POST request để optimize API resources

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Override the cache method in the selected stage of API Gateway. Select the POST method.

  • API Gateway hỗ trợ caching responses cho API methods

  • Default: API Gateway chỉ cache GET requests

  • Có thể override cache settings để enable caching cho POST method

  • Configure cache key parameters để cache identical POST requests

  • Direct solution tại API Gateway layer

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Configure the CloudFront cache. Update the application to return cached content based upon the default request headers.

  • CloudFront default KHÔNG cache POST requests (chỉ cache GET/HEAD)

  • CloudFront designed cho static content caching, không phải API POST caching

  • Không giải quyết POST caching requirement

❌ Save the latest request response in Lambda /tmp directory. Update the Lambda function to check the /tmp directory.

  • /tmp directory chỉ available trong single Lambda execution environment

  • KHÔNG shared across multiple Lambda invocations/instances

  • Không work cho distributed requests từ multiple users

  • Not a caching solution

❌ Save the latest request in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Modify the Lambda function to take the latest request response from Parameter Store.

  • Parameter Store KHÔNG designed cho high-frequency caching

  • API calls to Parameter Store add latency

  • Rate limits trên Parameter Store API

  • Không hiệu quả cho 4+ requests/second

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Cache POST requests in API Gateway" → Override cache method settings

  • API Gateway caching:

    • Default: cache GET requests only

    • Can enable caching cho POST/PUT/PATCH by overriding method

    • Configure cache key from request body/headers/query strings

  • CloudFront KHÔNG cache POST requests by default

  • Lambda /tmp = NOT shared across invocations

  • Parameter Store = NOT designed for high-frequency caching

📖 Reference:

  • Cache settings for REST APIs in API Gateway

  • Override API Gateway stage-level caching for method-level caching

questions.q:
A developer is troubleshooting an Amazon API Gateway API. Clients are receiving HTTP 400 response errors when the clients try to access an endpoint of the API.

How can the developer determine the cause of these errors?
o: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to receive API call logs from API Gateway. Configure Amazon CloudWatch Logs as the delivery stream’s destination.
Turn on AWS CloudTrail Insights and create a trail. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the trail for the stage of the API.
Turn on AWS X-Ray for the API stage. Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.

Turn on execution logging and access logging in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API stage. Create a CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Clients receiving HTTP 400 errors khi access API Gateway endpoint

  • Developer cần determine the cause of errors

  • Tìm solution để troubleshoot

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Turn on execution logging and access logging in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API stage. Create a CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.

  • Execution logging capture detailed logs về request/response data, errors, API Gateway processing

  • Access logging capture who accessed API và when

  • CloudWatch Logs contain error details, request parameters, validation errors → identify cause of 400 errors

  • Direct solution cho API Gateway troubleshooting

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to receive API call logs from API Gateway. Configure Amazon CloudWatch Logs as the delivery stream's destination.

  • API Gateway KHÔNG directly send logs to Kinesis Firehose

  • Firehose dùng cho streaming data delivery, không phải API Gateway logging

  • Unnecessary complexity

❌ Turn on AWS CloudTrail Insights and create a trail. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the trail for the stage of the API.

  • CloudTrail logs AWS API calls (management events), không phải application-level API requests

  • CloudTrail KHÔNG capture HTTP 400 errors từ API Gateway endpoints

  • CloudTrail Insights detect unusual API activity, không phải troubleshoot individual requests

❌ Turn on AWS X-Ray for the API stage. Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the log group for the API stage.

  • X-Ray dùng cho distributed tracing, track requests across services

  • X-Ray tốt cho performance analysis, không phải detailed error troubleshooting

  • Execution logging better cho examining HTTP 400 validation/request errors

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Troubleshoot API Gateway errors" → Enable execution logging + access logging

  • API Gateway logging types:

    • Execution logging = detailed request/response, errors, transformations

    • Access logging = who accessed, when, response codes

  • CloudTrail = AWS API calls audit, không phải application API requests

  • X-Ray = distributed tracing, performance, không phải detailed error logs

  • Kinesis Firehose không integrate directly với API Gateway logs

📖 Reference:

  • Set up CloudWatch logging for REST APIs in API Gateway

questions.q:
A company has an application that runs as a series of AWS Lambda functions. Each Lambda function receives data from an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and writes the data to an Amazon Aurora DB instance.

To comply with an information security policy, the company must ensure that the Lambda functions all use a single securely encrypted database connection string to access Aurora.

Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Use IAM database authentication for Aurora to enable secure database connections for all the Lambda functions.
Store the credentials and read the credentials from an encrypted Amazon RDS DB instance.
Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter.
Use Lambda environment variables with a shared AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for encryption.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application: Lambda functions receive data từ SNS và write to Aurora DB

  • Information security policy requirements:

    • All Lambda functions use single securely encrypted database connection string

    • Secure access to Aurora

  • Tìm solution đáp ứng requirements

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter.

  • Parameter Store SecureString encrypt credentials at rest với AWS KMS

  • Single source of truth: all Lambda functions retrieve từ same parameter

  • Lambda functions có thể securely retrieve credentials at runtime

  • Cost-effective và simple solution

  • Centralized credential management

Kiến trúc tham khảo

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use IAM database authentication for Aurora to enable secure database connections for all the Lambda functions.

  • IAM database authentication dùng temporary tokens, không phải connection string

  • Requirement specify "database connection string" → IAM auth không dùng connection string

  • Không meet specific requirement về connection string

❌ Store the credentials and read the credentials from an encrypted Amazon RDS DB instance.

  • Store credentials trong database = circular dependency (cần credentials để access database chứa credentials)

  • Bad practice: credentials không nên store trong database

  • Không logical solution

❌ Use Lambda environment variables with a shared AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for encryption.

  • Environment variables phải define từng Lambda function

  • Không phải single shared credential across all functions

  • Nếu update credentials, phải update all Lambda functions individually

  • Không operationally efficient

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Shared credentials across Lambda functions" → Parameter Store SecureString

  • Parameter Store benefits:

    • Centralized credential storage

    • Encrypted at rest với KMS

    • All Lambda functions retrieve từ single source

    • Easy credential rotation

  • IAM database authentication = temporary tokens, không phải connection strings

  • Lambda environment variables = per-function, không shared

  • NEVER store credentials trong database itself

📖 Reference:

  • Using Parameter Store parameters in AWS Lambda functions

questions.q:
A developer is working on a Python application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The developer wants to enable tracing of application requests to debug performance issues in the code.

Which combination of actions should the developer take to achieve this goal? (Choose two.)
o: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances.
Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on the EC2 instances.
Configure the application to write JSON-formatted logs to /var/log/cloudwatch.
Configure the application to write trace data to /var/log/xray.
Install and configure the AWS X-Ray SDK for Python in the application.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer working on Python application trên EC2 instances

  • Muốn enable tracing of application requests để debug performance issues

  • Chọn 2 actions để achieve goal

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on the EC2 instances.

  • X-Ray daemon là agent chạy trên EC2 để collect trace data từ application

  • Daemon listen for trace data và forward to X-Ray service

  • Required component để send traces to X-Ray

Install and configure the AWS X-Ray SDK for Python in the application.

  • X-Ray SDK instrument application code để generate trace data

  • SDK capture request/response data, subsegments, annotations

  • Required để application có thể create và send traces

  • Python SDK: import aws_xray_sdk

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances.

  • CloudWatch agent collect metrics và logs, không phải traces

  • CloudWatch không phải distributed tracing service

  • Không giúp debug performance với request tracing

❌ Configure the application to write JSON-formatted logs to /var/log/cloudwatch.

  • Writing logs to /var/log/cloudwatch KHÔNG automatically send to CloudWatch

  • Logs không phải distributed tracing

  • Không provide request flow visualization như X-Ray

❌ Configure the application to write trace data to /var/log/xray.

  • KHÔNG có /var/log/xray directory cho X-Ray

  • X-Ray daemon listen on UDP port 2000, không đọc từ log files

  • Application send traces to daemon qua SDK, không phải write to files

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Application tracing on EC2" → X-Ray daemon + X-Ray SDK

  • X-Ray architecture:

    1. X-Ray SDK = instrument application code (generate traces)

    2. X-Ray daemon = collect và forward traces to X-Ray service

  • CloudWatch = metrics và logs, không phải distributed tracing

  • X-Ray traces sent to daemon via UDP port 2000, không phải log files

  • Both daemon và SDK required cho X-Ray tracing

📖 Reference:

  • AWS X-Ray SDK for Python

questions.q:
A company is building an application for stock trading. The application needs sub-millisecond latency for processing trade requests. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store all the trading data that is used to process each trading request.

A development team performs load testing on the application and finds that the data retrieval time is higher than expected. The development team needs a solution that reduces the data retrieval time with the least possible effort.

Which solution meets these requirements?
o: Add local secondary indexes (LSIs) for the trading data.
Store the trading data in Amazon S3, and use S3 Transfer Acceleration.
Add retries with exponential backoff for DynamoDB queries.
Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache the trading data.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Stock trading application cần sub-millisecond latency để process trade requests

  • Dùng DynamoDB store all trading data

  • Issue: data retrieval time higher than expected during load testing

  • Requirement: reduce data retrieval time với least possible effort

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache the trading data.

  • DAX là in-memory cache cho DynamoDB với microsecond latency

  • Transparent caching: no application code changes needed (chỉ đổi endpoint)

  • DAX automatically cache read queries và invalidate cache on writes

  • Least effort: fully managed, minimal configuration

  • Perfect cho use case cần sub-millisecond latency

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add local secondary indexes (LSIs) for the trading data.

  • LSIs improve query flexibility, KHÔNG reduce latency đáng kể lắm

  • LSIs vẫn query từ DynamoDB tables (same performance characteristics)

  • Không provide caching hoặc sub-millisecond improvement

  • LSIs phải tạo at table creation time (không thể thêm sau)

❌ Store the trading data in Amazon S3, and use S3 Transfer Acceleration.

  • S3 KHÔNG designed cho low-latency queries như DynamoDB

  • S3 latency higher than DynamoDB

  • Transfer Acceleration optimize uploads, không phải query latency

  • Migration to S3 = tốn khá nhiều effort, không phải least effort

❌ Add retries with exponential backoff for DynamoDB queries.

  • Exponential backoff dùng cho handling throttling errors, không phải improve latency

  • Retries TĂNG latency, không giảm

  • Không address root cause của high retrieval time

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "DynamoDB + sub-millisecond latency" → DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)

  • LSIs = query flexibility, KHÔNG improve latency significantly

  • S3 latency cao hơn DynamoDB

  • Exponential backoff = retry logic, không improve performance

📖 Reference:

  • DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)

questions.q:
A company is expanding the compatibility of its photo-sharing mobile app to hundreds of additional devices with unique screen dimensions and resolutions. Photos are stored in Amazon S3 in their original format and resolution. The company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve the photos. The app includes the dimension and resolution of the display as GET parameters with every request.

A developer needs to implement a solution that optimizes the photos that are served to each device to reduce load time and increase photo quality.

Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
o: Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a dynamic CloudFront origin that automatically maps the request of each device to the corresponding photo variant.

Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a Lambda@Edge function to route requests to the corresponding photo variant by using request headers.
Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. Change the CloudFront TTL cache policy to the maximum value possible.

Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. In the same function, store a copy of the processed photos on Amazon S3 for subsequent requests.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Photo-sharing mobile app mở rộng đến hundreds of devices với nhiều kích thước màn hình và độ phân giải

  • Photos stored trong S3 original format/resolution

  • Dùng CloudFront serve photos

  • App includes dimension (kích thước) và resolution (độ phâ n giải) as GET parameters với mỗi request

  • Requirements:

    • Optimize photos served to each device

    • Reduce load time và increase photo quality

    • MOST cost-effectively

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. In the same function, store a copy of the processed photos on Amazon S3 for subsequent requests.

  • Lambda@Edge process photos on-demand at CloudFront edge locations

  • First request: optimize photo theo kích thước device, return và store processed copy trong S3

  • Subsequent requests: serve từ S3 (cached processed photos), không reprocess

  • Most cost-effective: chỉ process mỗi biến thể 1 lần, tái sử dụng cho future requests

  • No need pre-generate all biến thể (hundreds of devices)

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a dynamic CloudFront origin that automatically maps the request of each device to the corresponding photo variant.

  • Pre-generate all biến thể cho hundreds of devices = chi phí storage lớn

  • S3 Batch Operations + Lambda = high compute cost

  • Không có "dynamic CloudFront origin" feature như described

  • Not cost-effective

❌ Use S3 Batch Operations to invoke an AWS Lambda function to create new variants of the photos with the required dimensions and resolutions. Create a Lambda@Edge function to route requests to the corresponding photo variant by using request headers.

  • Pre-generate all biến thể = high storage cost

  • Maintain hundreds of variants per photo

  • S3 Batch Operations + Lambda cost high

  • Not cost-effective

❌ Create a Lambda@Edge function that optimizes the photos upon request and returns the photos as a response. Change the CloudFront TTL cache policy to the maximum value possible.

  • Optimize on every request nếu không store processed photos

  • KHÔNG lưu các biến thể đã processed = reprocess nhiều lần

  • High Lambda invocation cost

  • CloudFront TTL cache at edge, nhưng vẫn phải process lần đầu cho mỗi edge location

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Hundreds of device variants + cost-effective" → On-demand processing + cache results

  • Cost optimization strategy:

    • Tránh pre-generating tất cả biến thể (storage cost)

    • Process on-demand (chỉ biến thể thực sự cần)

    • Cache/store biến thể đã processed (tránh reprocessing)

  • Pre-generating tất cả biến thể = expensive với hundreds of combinations

📖 Reference:

  • Image Optimization using Amazon CloudFront and AWS Lambda

questions.q:
When a developer tries to run an AWS CodeBuild project, it raises an error because the length of all environment variables exceeds the limit for the combined maximum of characters.

What is the recommended solution?
o: Add the export LC_ALL="en_US.utf8" command to the pre_build section to ensure POSIX localization.
Use Amazon Cognito to store key-value pairs for large numbers of environment variables.
Update the settings for the build project to use an Amazon S3 bucket for large numbers of environment variables.
Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store large numbers of environment variables.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Developer chạy AWS CodeBuild project

  • Error: length of all environment variables exceeds the combined maximum limit

  • Tìm recommended solution

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store large numbers of environment variables.

  • Parameter Store integrate natively với CodeBuild

  • Store environment variables externally, không tính vào CodeBuild character limit

  • CodeBuild automatically retrieve parameters at build time

  • Support SecureString cho sensitive values

  • Cost-effective và recommended practice

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add the export LC_ALL="en_US.utf8" command to the pre_build section to ensure POSIX localization.

  • LC_ALL setting cho locale configuration, không liên quan đến environment variable limits

  • Không giải quyết character limit issue

  • Sai solution hoàn toàn

❌ Use Amazon Cognito to store key-value pairs for large numbers of environment variables.

  • Cognito dùng cho user authentication/authorization, không phải configuration management

  • Không integrate với CodeBuild cho environment variables

  • Sai use case

❌ Update the settings for the build project to use an Amazon S3 bucket for large numbers of environment variables.

  • CodeBuild KHÔNG có native feature để store environment variables trong S3

  • Phải manually download và parse từ S3 trong build script

  • Parameter Store là recommended approach, không phải S3

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "CodeBuild environment variables limit" → AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

  • Parameter Store với CodeBuild:

    • Native integration

    • Reference parameters: parameter-store:parameter-name

    • Không count vào character limit

    • Support encrypted values (SecureString)

  • Cognito = authentication, không phải config storage

  • S3 không có native CodeBuild env var integration

  • LC_ALL = locale setting, không liên quan

📖 Reference:

  • Build specification reference for CodeBuild

  • Environment variables in CodeBuild

questions.q:
An application that is deployed to Amazon EC2 is using Amazon DynamoDB. The application calls the DynamoDB REST API. Periodically, the application receives a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error when the application writes to a DynamoDB table.

Which solutions will mitigate this error MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)
o: Modify the application code to perform exponential backoff when the error is received.
Modify the application to use the AWS SDKs for DynamoDB.
Increase the read and write throughput of the DynamoDB table.
Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster for the DynamoDB table.
Create a second DynamoDB table. Distribute the reads and writes between the two tables.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Application trên EC2 dùng DynamoDB, calls DynamoDB REST API

  • Định kỳ receive ProvisionedThroughputExceededException khi write to table

  • Requirement: giảm error MOST cost-effectively

  • Chọn 2 solutions

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Modify the application code to perform exponential backoff when the error is received.

  • Exponential backoff retry logic giảm request rate khi throttled

  • AWS best practice cho handling throttling errors

  • No additional cost - chỉ code changes

  • Giúp spread requests over time, reduce throttling

Modify the application to use the AWS SDKs for DynamoDB.

  • AWS SDKs có built-in exponential backoff và retry logic

  • Automatically handle throttling errors

  • No additional cost - chỉ code refactor từ REST API sang SDK

  • Better error handling và performance so với direct REST API calls

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Increase the read and write throughput of the DynamoDB table.

  • Tăng throughput = tăng cost (pay for provisioned capacity)

  • Có thể giải quyết issue nhưng KHÔNG cost-effective

  • Nên implement retry logic trước khi tăng capacity

❌ Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster for the DynamoDB table.

  • DAX dùng cho caching reads, không giải quyết write throttling

  • DAX có additional cost (cluster charges)

  • Không address root cause của ProvisionedThroughputExceededException on writes

❌ Create a second DynamoDB table. Distribute the reads and writes between the two tables.

  • 2 tables = double cost (2× provisioned capacity)

  • Complex application logic để distribute data

  • KHÔNG cost-effective

  • Overkill solution

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "ProvisionedThroughputExceededException + cost-effective" → Exponential backoff + AWS SDK

  • Handling DynamoDB throttling:

    1. Implement exponential backoff (free, code change)

    2. Use AWS SDKs với built-in retry (free, better than REST API)

    3. Increase capacity (costs money, phương án cuối cùng)

  • AWS SDK benefits:

    • Built-in exponential backoff

    • Automatic retries

    • Better error handling

  • DAX = read caching, không help với write throttling

  • Multiple tables = expensive và complex

📖 Reference:

  • Error retries and exponential backoff

  • Using AWS SDKs with DynamoDB

questions.q:
A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that searches for items from an Amazon DynamoDB table that contains customer contact information. The DynamoDB table items have the customer’s email_address as the partition key and additional properties such as customer_type, name and job_title.

The Lambda function runs whenever a user types a new character into the customer_type text input.The developer wants the search to return partial matches of all the email_address property of a particular customer_type. The developer does not want to recreate the DynamoDB table.

What should the developer do to meet these requirements?
o: Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with email_address as the partition key and customer_type as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with job_title as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • DynamoDB table stores customer contact information

  • Table schema:

  • Lambda function search khi user types vào customer_type text input

  • Requirements:

    • Return partial matches (kết quả khớp một phần) của email_address property

    • Filter by particular customer_type

    • NOT recreate DynamoDB table

  • Tìm solution phù hợp

✅ Đáp án đúng:

Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

  • GSI với customer_type partition key cho phép query by customer_type

  • email_address sort key cho phép dùng begins_with condition cho partial matching

  • Query: Query(customer_type = "VIP", begins_with(email_address, "john"))

  • GSI có thể add sau khi table created (không cần recreate table)

  • Đáp ứng đầy đủ requirements

Các đáp án sai:

❌ Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with email_address as the partition key and customer_type as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

  • email_address partition key = phải biết chính xác email để query

  • KHÔNG thể dùng begins_with trên partition key

  • begins_with chỉ work trên sort key

  • Không filter được by customer_type trước

❌ Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

  • LSI PHẢI share partition key với base table

  • Base table partition key = email_address, không phải customer_type

  • KHÔNG THỂ dùng customer_type làm partition key trong LSI

  • Sai về LSI concept

❌ Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with job_title as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

  • LSI không thể change partition key

  • job_title không liên quan đến requirement (cần filter by customer_type)

  • Sai logic

🔑 Tips and tricks:

  • "Query by X + partial match on Y" → GSI với X = partition key, Y = sort key + begins_with

  • begins_with chỉ work trên sort key, KHÔNG work trên partition key

  • LSI vs GSI:

    • LSI = same partition key, different sort key, cannot add after table creation

    • GSI = different partition key và sort key, can add after creation

  • Pattern: customer_type partition key → email_address sort key → begins_with query

  • GSI không require table recreation

📖 Reference:

  • Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB

  • DynamoDB begins_with key condition

questions.q:
A developer is modifying an existing AWS Lambda function. While checking the code, the developer notices hardcoded parameter values for an Amazon RDS for SQL Server user name, password, database, host, and port. There are also hardcoded parameter values for an Amazon DynamoDB table, an Amazon S3 bucket, and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

The developer wants to securely store the parameter values outside the code in an encrypted format and wants to turn on rotation for the credentials. The developer also wants to be able to reuse the parameter values from other applications and to update the parameter values without modifying code.

Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
o: Create an RDS database secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Set the user name, password, database, host, and port. Turn on secret rotation. Create encrypted Lambda environment variables for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic.

Create an RDS database secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Set the user name, password, database, host, and port. Turn on secret rotation. Create SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic.

Create RDS database parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the user name, password, database, host, and port. Create encrypted Lambda environment variables for the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic. Create a Lambda function and set the logic for the credentials rotation task. Schedule the credentials rotation task in Amazon EventBridge.

Create RDS database parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the user name, password, database, host, and port. Store the DynamoDB table, S3 bucket, and SNS topic in Amazon S3. Create a Lambda function and set the logic for the credentials rotation. Invoke the Lambda function on a schedule.
questions.e:
📝 Tóm tắt đề:

  • Lambda function có hardcoded parameters:
